metadata.name: SmartProxy
metadata.description: A high-performance utility for managing proxy configurations, written in Go to ensure speed and reliability.

summary.zh: SmartProxy 是用 Go 编写的跨平台高性能网络代理管理工具，基于域名规则在公司 VPN、个人翻墙和直连之间智能路由。提供响应式 Web GUI、系统托盘控制、实时连接日志、JSON 配置、单实例锁与随机 GUI 端口等零冲突特性，便于多网络环境下无缝访问、调试与部署（支持 macOS 与 Windows，附建构与安装脚本）。
summary.en: SmartProxy is a high-performance, cross-platform proxy manager written in Go that unifies multiple network interfaces (Company VPN, Personal VPN/GFW, Direct) via domain-based intelligent routing. It automatically directs corporate domains to a company VPN, routes blocked domains using a gfwlist to a personal VPN, and keeps local traffic direct. Features include a responsive Bootstrap web GUI, system tray controls, real-time connection logging, JSON configuration, single-instance locking, and randomized GUI port to avoid conflicts. Provides build scripts and installer support for macOS and Windows deployment.

metadata.name: iOS-JIT-Enablers
metadata.description: A list of JIT Enablers for iOS and iPadOS.

summary.zh: 本仓库汇总了适用于 iOS/iPadOS 的 JIT（即时编译）启用方案与工具（如 StikJIT、SideStore、SideJITServer、TrollStore、Xcode 等），按系统版本、SoC 架构（arm64/arm64e）、上架渠道和推荐程度整理兼容矩阵。适用于提升模拟器性能、运行需 JIT 的程序及免签侧载场景，提供快捷指令、可用 dylib 与使用建议，便于在不同 iOS 版本与设备上快速选择与部署 JIT 方案。
summary.en: iOS-JIT-Enablers is a curated index of Just-In-Time (JIT) enabling techniques and tools for iOS/iPadOS, referencing projects such as StikJIT, SideStore, SideJITServer, TrollStore and Xcode. The repo documents supported OS ranges, SoC architectures (arm64/arm64e), distribution availability (App Store/TestFlight), and recommendation status in a compatibility matrix. It targets improving emulator performance, running JIT-dependent apps, and sideloading without traditional signing. Technical highlights include shortcuts, helper dylibs, platform-specific notes and links to installers/guides to help select and deploy JIT solutions across devices and firmware.

metadata.name: StikDebug
metadata.description: An on-device debugger/JIT enabler for iOS versions 17.4+, powered by idevice.

summary.zh: StikDebug 基于 idevice，为 iOS 17.4+ 提供设备端调试与 JIT 启用。配对后无需电脑即可为具 get-task-allow 权限的侧载应用开启 JIT，并支持应用启动、实时控制台、进程与设备信息查看、配置文件与到期管理、自动化脚本与位置模拟，适用于开发调试、逆向分析与测试自动化。
summary.en: StikDebug is an on-device debugger and JIT enabler for iOS 17.4+ built on idevice. After initial pairing it lets you enable JIT for sideloaded apps with the get-task-allow entitlement without a computer, plus launch/manage apps and processes, stream live app/system logs, install/remove provisioning profiles, view app expiry and device metadata, run automation scripts (iOS 26 support), and simulate GPS. It targets developers, testers and reverse engineers working with sideloaded iOS applications.

metadata.name: stop-slop
metadata.description: A skill file for removing AI tells from prose

summary.zh: Stop Slop 是面向 Claude 与 LLM 的写作技能，使用禁止短语、结构反模式与句法准则识别并剔除 AI 痕迹。含示例与评分表，便于作为系统提示或 API 载入以提升文本自然度。
summary.en: Stop Slop is a compact LLM 'skill' that teaches Claude or any large language model to detect and remove AI writing tells. It includes a core SKILL.md plus reference lists of banned phrases, structural clichés, sentence-level rules, before/after examples and a five-dimension 1–10 scoring rubric. Designed for easy integration as a skill folder, project knowledge, system prompt or API payload, it streamlines cleanup of predictable phrasing, passive constructions and meta-commentary to make text more direct and human.

metadata.name: humanizer
metadata.description: Claude Code skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text

summary.zh: Humanizer 是为 Claude Code/OpenCode 定制的写作技能，依据维基百科“AI写作痕迹”指南识别 29 类内容与语言模式，自动去除 AI 化措辞并提供二次重写与审计，支持输入个人写作样本以校准语气与用词。适用于润色 LLM 输出、降低公式化与泛化表述，在发布或合规场景中提升文本自然度与可信度。
summary.en: Humanizer is a Claude Code/OpenCode skill that detects and removes signs of AI-generated writing to make text sound more natural. Based on Wikipedia's “Signs of AI writing,” it recognizes 29 content and language patterns (e.g., significance inflation, vague attributions, synonym cycling), performs an audit pass plus a secondary rewrite to catch lingering AI-isms, and supports voice calibration via user writing samples. It’s designed for post-processing LLM outputs, editorial cleanup, and preparing AI-assisted text for publishing or compliance-sensitive contexts.

metadata.name: academic-research-skills
metadata.description: Academic Research Skills for Claude Code: research → write → review → revise → finalize

summary.zh: 面向Claude Code的学术研究技能套件，覆盖研究规划、文献检索、引用定位、断言级审计与写作校准与同行评审辅助。技术亮点包括来源可追溯的三层引用锚点、可选断言审计与多阶段风控门控，旨在减少引文幻觉与格式性错误，辅助论文撰写、引用合规与研究质量把控，保持人机协同的人为决策链条。
summary.en: Academic Research Skills for Claude Code is a Claude Code/CLI plugin that delivers an end-to-end toolkit for research workflows: planning, literature retrieval, citation locating, writing calibration, review, and finalization. It emphasizes provenance and claim-level auditability through trust-chain frontmatter and three-layer citation anchors, plus an optional claim-audit pass and multi-stage integrity gates to flag hallucinations, fabricated references, or unsupported claims. Features include style calibration, writing-quality checks, and reviewer-mode metrics. Designed for human-in-the-loop researchers, it automates verification and formatting while preserving researcher judgment.

metadata.name: PaperBanana
metadata.description: PaperBanana: Automating Academic Illustration For AI Scientists

summary.zh: PaperBanana 是一个开源的参考驱动多智能体框架，自动将论文方法文本转化为发表级别的示意图与绘图。通过 Retriever、Planner、Stylist、Visualizer、Critic 五阶段流水线，借助参考范例的 in-context 学习与多轮迭代闭环优化，整合视觉-语言模型与图像生成器以产出语义准确且风格一致的学术插图。适用于论文插图、方法流程图与科研展示，已支持 Hugging Face Spaces、模型选择与 OpenRouter 集成，便于科研复现与二次扩展。
summary.en: PaperBanana is an open-source, reference-driven multi-agent framework that automates conversion of paper method text into publication-quality diagrams and plots. It orchestrates five specialized agents—Retriever, Planner, Stylist, Visualizer, and Critic—using in-context example guidance and iterative refinement to produce semantically accurate, stylistically consistent scientific illustrations. The system integrates vision-language models and state-of-the-art image generators, supports model selection, OpenRouter and Hugging Face Spaces hosting, and targets use cases like paper figures, method flowcharts, and research visualizations to aid reproducibility and rapid diagram prototyping.

metadata.name: GithubStarsIndex
metadata.description: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars，生成 AI 摘要，便于检索。

summary.zh: 自动抓取 GitHub 用户的 Star 仓库，读取 README 并调用 AI 生成中英文摘要与规范化技术标签，内置 TAG_MAPPING 合并同义词，支持并发与增量更新，输出 data/stars.json 并通过 Jinja2 渲染为 Markdown/静态 HTML，可选同步到 Obsidian Vault 与 GitHub Pages，便于构建可检索的项目档案与二次开发集成。
summary.en: Automatically harvests a GitHub user's starred repositories, reads each README, and invokes an OpenAI-compatible AI to produce multilingual summaries and normalized technical tags. It includes a TAG_MAPPING-driven taxonomy to consolidate synonyms, supports concurrent AI calls and incremental metadata updates, outputs structured data (data/stars.json), and renders Markdown and searchable static HTML via Jinja2 templates. Optional integrations include Obsidian Vault synchronization and GitHub Pages deployment. Suitable for building searchable, maintainable archives of curated projects and integrating into developer workflows or personal knowledge bases.

metadata.name: seedance2-skill
metadata.description: skill to create best prompts for generating videos with seedance2.0

summary.zh: Seedance 2.0 提示词写作技能，面向字节跳动多模态视频生成，涵盖输入约束、@引用语法、镜头语言与提示结构，提供广告、剧情、MV、教育等场景模板与示例。可安装到 Claude 等智能体目录或通过 CLI 添加，便于自动化生成可控且高质量的视频提示，基于官方文档与真实案例的最佳实践。
summary.en: Seedance 2.0 Prompt Writing Skills is an agent skillset for crafting effective video-generation prompts targeted at ByteDance’s multimodal Seedance 2.0 model. It documents input constraints, @ reference syntax, camera and shot language, prompt-structure patterns, and ready-to-use templates for ads, dramas, music videos, education, and more. Designed to run in Claude and other compatible agents, the package includes English and Chinese guides and install options. Based on official Seedance docs and real-world cases, it accelerates automated creation of high-quality, controllable video prompts.

metadata.name: memo
metadata.description: Memo is a simple command-line interface (CLI) tool for managing your Apple Notes and Apple Reminders. It’s written in Python and aims to offer a fast, keyboard-driven way to create, search, and organize notes and reminders straight from your terminal.

summary.zh: Memo 是 macOS 上的 Python 命令行工具，能在终端管理 Apple Notes 与 Reminders。面向键盘驱动工作流，支持浏览、模糊搜索、编辑、文件夹移动、标记完成及导出为 HTML/Markdown，保留图像占位并通过 AppleScript 与系统同步，适合喜欢在 shell 内高效创建、搜索和组织笔记与待办的用户。
summary.en: Memo is a Python-based macOS command-line tool for managing Apple Notes and Apple Reminders from the terminal. Designed for a keyboard-driven workflow, it lets you browse, fuzzy-search, edit, move items between folders, mark reminders complete, and export notes to HTML or Markdown. It preserves embedded images via placeholders and uses AppleScript for system integration. Lightweight and shell-friendly, Memo is aimed at users who prefer to create, search, and organize notes and tasks without leaving their terminal.

metadata.name: distrobox
metadata.description: Use any linux distribution inside your terminal. Enable both backward and forward compatibility with software and freedom to use whatever distribution you’re more comfortable with. Mirror available at: https://gitlab.com/89luca89/distrobox

summary.zh: Distrobox 使用 podman/docker 或 lilipod 在终端内运行任意 Linux 发行版，并与主机深度集成（共享 HOME、外置存储、USB、X11/Wayland 图形与音频）。强调无特权容器与跨发行版软件兼容，提供一组易用命令（create/enter/assemble 等）快速构建、管理与迁移开发环境，适合测试、兼容性验证及在受限设备（如 Steam Deck）上运行不同发行版应用。
summary.en: Distrobox leverages podman, docker or lilipod to run any Linux distribution inside your terminal with tight host integration—sharing HOME, external storage, USB devices, X11/Wayland graphical apps and audio. It emphasizes unprivileged containers and cross-distro software compatibility, offering simple CLI helpers (create/enter/assemble etc.) to quickly build, manage and migrate development environments or run apps incompatible with the host. Ideal for development, packaging tests, compatibility validation and running alternate distributions on constrained devices like the Steam Deck.

metadata.name: calcuko
metadata.description: calcuko - 多行公式计算器

summary.zh: Calcuko 是一款浏览器/跨平台运行的多行变量公式计算器，像写代码一样定义变量与表达式，支持实时依赖联动、配对括号语法高亮、注释与本地持久化，并内置常用 Math 函数。作为 PWA 可离线安装，适合工程师、学生和开发者用于工程计算、教学演示与快速原型验证。
summary.en: Calcuko is a lightweight, browser-based multi-line formula calculator designed for engineers, students and developers. It lets you write variables and expressions like code, evaluates expressions in real time, and automatically propagates dependencies across lines. Features include syntax highlighting with bracket matching, comment support, local persistence, built-in Math functions, and a Progressive Web App (PWA) mode for offline usage and installation on desktop or mobile. Ideal for cross-platform engineering calculations, quick prototyping, and tutoring scenarios where instant, traceable computations are needed.

metadata.name: iStart
metadata.description: 一个为 macOS 26 打造的轻量级开始菜单与应用启动器。

summary.zh: iStart 是为 macOS 26 打造的轻量级原生开始菜单与应用启动器。通过可配置的全局快捷键唤起浮动面板，支持按应用名、Bundle ID、首字母与拼音匹配的快速搜索，固定与拖拽常用应用、最近打开记录及自定义索引目录。基于 SwiftUI 与 AppKit 实现毛玻璃材质与键盘优先操作，并支持注册为登录项，适合追求键盘驱动的高效 macOS 使用场景。
summary.en: iStart is a lightweight native start menu and application launcher built for macOS 26. It offers configurable global hotkeys to summon a floating SwiftUI/AppKit panel, fast searching by app name, Bundle ID, initials and Pinyin-friendly matching, pinning and drag-sorting of favorites, a recent-app list, and custom application directory indexing (including PWAs). It supports login-item registration, keyboard-first navigation, and a native blurred-material UI. Ideal for macOS users seeking quick, keyboard-centric app switching and streamlined productivity.

summary.zh: 高性能 Rust 实现的 mihomo（Clash）代理内核，支持 Shadowsocks/Trojan/VLESS/HTTP/SOCKS5，多协议与规则路由，具备透明代理（TProxy）、DNS snooping 与缓存、ECH/uTLS 隐私增强、REST API 与内置 Web 仪表盘，以及多种代理组策略与故障切换，适用于服务器与终端的精细流量转发与负载分发场景。
summary.en: mihomo-rust is a high-performance Rust implementation of the mihomo/Clash proxy kernel. It offers rule-based tunneling and multi-protocol outbound support including Shadowsocks, Trojan, VLESS, HTTP, and SOCKS5. The project provides transparent proxy (TProxy) with nftables/pf integration, DNS snooping and caching, TLS privacy features such as ECH and uTLS fingerprinting, a REST API and a built-in web dashboard. Advanced proxy groups (Selector, URLTest, Fallback, LoadBalance, Relay) and a rich rule engine enable precise traffic routing, load distribution and resilient failover for server and edge deployments.

metadata.name: Shiru
metadata.description: A personal anime library manager for watching and tracking your collection in real time. Lightweight, powerful, and paws-itively fast. No waiting required!

summary.zh: Shiru 是一款跨平台个人动漫媒体库管理器，强调极速本地播放（无需转码）、AniList/MAL 同步、独立中字/配音追踪、实时新番通知与离线与移动全功能，便于管理与追踪合法收藏。
summary.en: Shiru is a cross-platform personal anime library manager emphasizing instant local playback (no transcoding), AniList/MAL sync, independent dub/sub tracking, real-time release alerts, and full offline/mobile support for managing legally owned collections.

metadata.name: ClashMac
metadata.description: Native Proxy Experience Built for macOS

summary.zh: ClashMac 是为 macOS 原生打造的网络代理客户端，支持系统代理与 TUN 模式，实时统计流量并以航线式地图与连接拓扑可视化多跳链路与节点，提供隐私模式、菜单栏常驻与一键切换节点，适合隐私保护、科学上网与网络监控场景。基于 SwiftUI 与 macOS 原生 API 深度集成，低资源占用与原生体验是其技术亮点。
summary.en: ClashMac is a native macOS proxy client offering system-integrated proxy experience with dual modes (system proxy and TUN). It visualizes connections as global “flight” routes and renders full connection topology, multi-hop chains and per-process/host traffic stats in real time. Features include privacy mode, menu-bar residency, quick node switching with auto-disconnect, subscription usage tracking and latency tests. Built with SwiftUI and native macOS APIs, it targets privacy-conscious users, power users needing fine-grained traffic control, and professionals requiring live network monitoring.

metadata.name: gpt-codex
metadata.description: 这是一个关于 OpenAI CodeX 的完整教程网站，专为国内开发者打造。

summary.zh: 该项目为国内开发者打造的 Codex（OpenAI 编程 Agent）完整教程，从模型对比、GPT-5.5 特性到获取渠道与实战示例，聚焦任务拆解、工程化执行与自动化流水线，帮助非程序员与开发者快速上手并落地项目。
summary.en: This repository is a comprehensive China-focused tutorial for OpenAI Codex, explaining what Codex is, how it differs from Claude Code and ChatGPT, and how to use it in practice. It covers model comparisons (notably GPT-5.3-codex vs GPT-5.5), access methods, membership differences, practical workflows and hands-on examples. Emphasizing task decomposition, engineering-oriented execution, automation and deployment, the guide helps both non-programmers and developers adopt Codex as an agentic coding assistant for multi-stage projects and automated engineering tasks.

metadata.name: clash-party
metadata.description: :electron: Another Mihomo GUI.

summary.zh: Clash Party 是基于 Electron 的跨平台 Mihomo/Clash 桌面客户端，内置 Smart 与 Mihomo 内核，提供基于 AI 的一键 Smart Core 规则覆写，实现自动选择最优节点。支持订阅与 Sub‑Store 管理、WebDAV 一键备份/恢复、多主题皮肤与任意配置覆写，便于可视化管理代理配置与优化流媒体或低延迟连接，适合需要集中管理订阅与智能节点决策的桌面用户与运维场景。
summary.en: Clash Party is an Electron-based cross-platform GUI for Mihomo/Clash that bundles Smart and Mihomo cores. It features AI-powered one-click Smart Core rule overrides to automatically select optimal nodes, integrated subscription and Sub-Store management, WebDAV backup/restore, theme customization, and flexible config override capabilities. Designed for desktop users who need visual proxy configuration, centralized subscription handling and intelligent node selection, it streamlines workflows for media unblocking, low-latency connections and multi-subscription management without complex manual tuning.

metadata.name: Asspp
metadata.description: The App Store for your multi-account eco system.

summary.zh: Asspp 是跨 iOS 与 macOS 的多区域多账号 App Store 管理工具，能无登出切换商店、自动使用对应 Apple ID、从苹果服务器下载官方签名 IPA 并管理历史版本与 IPA 库，便于备份与旁加载。因采用与 ipatool 相同的 App Store 通信协议，可能受 Apple 风控影响，务必保护设备 GUID 并避免使用主 Apple ID。
summary.en: Asspp is a cross-platform iOS and macOS client for managing multiple Apple IDs and App Store regions. It lets you instantly switch stores without logging out, automatically uses the appropriate account per region, download officially signed IPAs from Apple’s servers, and access historical versions and an IPA library for backups and sideloading. Installation supports auto-build/sign or manual signing. Asspp relies on the same App Store communication protocol as ipatool, so it can be affected by Apple risk controls; protect device GUIDs and avoid using primary Apple IDs.

metadata.name: free-claude-code
metadata.description: Use claude-code for free in the terminal, VSCode extension or discord like OpenClaw (voice supported)

summary.zh: Free Claude Code 是一个 Anthropic 兼容代理，保持 Claude Code 客户端协议不变，将请求路由到多种后端（如 NVIDIA NIM、llama.cpp、Ollama 等）。支持按模型分流、流式响应、工具调用与推理块处理，提供 VSCode/Discord/Telegram 集成、语音转录和本地 /admin 管理界面，便于透明使用免费、付费或本地模型替代官方后端以降低成本或实现本地推理。
summary.en: Free Claude Code provides an Anthropic-compatible proxy that preserves Claude Code's client-side protocol while routing Anthropic Messages API traffic to ten backend providers (NVIDIA NIM, Kimi, Wafer, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, LM Studio, llama.cpp, Ollama, OpenCode Zen, Z.ai). It supports per-model routing (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, fallbacks), streaming, tool use, reasoning block handling, local optimizations, optional VS Code/Discord/Telegram integrations, voice transcription via local Whisper or NVIDIA NIM, and an /admin UI for provider configuration—letting you run free, paid, or local model backends transparently.

metadata.name: ai-website-cloner-template
metadata.description: Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents

summary.zh: 使用 AI 代码智能体一键将任意网站反向工程为整洁的 Next.js+TypeScript 代码库。代理会抓取页面、截屏、提取设计令牌与资产、生成组件规格（精确 CSS、状态与行为），并并行构建还原每个区块。适用于站点迁移、模板生成与设计复刻；支持多种 AI agent（推荐 Claude Code），集成 Tailwind v4 与 shadcn/ui。
summary.en: AI Website Cloner Template uses AI coding agents to reverse‑engineer any public site into a clean Next.js (App Router + TypeScript) codebase. Point an agent at a URL and run /clone-website to capture screenshots, extract design tokens and assets, produce component specs with computed CSS, states and behaviors, and orchestrate parallel builders to reconstruct page sections. It supports many agents (Claude Code recommended) and integrates shadcn/ui and Tailwind v4—ideal for migrations, prototyping, and high‑fidelity design replication.

metadata.name: huashu-design
metadata.description: Huashu Design · HTML-native design skill for Claude Code · Claude Code 里 HTML 原生的设计 skill · 高保真原型 / 幻灯片 / 动画 + 20 设计哲学 + 5 维评审 + MP4 导出 · Agent-agnostic

summary.zh: Huashu Design 是面向 Claude Code 等智能代理的 HTML 原生设计 skill，能在数分钟内产出可交付的高保真原型、可交互幻灯片与动效并导出 MP4，支持品牌素材、20 条设计哲学与五维评审，Agent‑agnostic 且 MIT 开源，适合产品发布、演示与快速视觉迭代。
summary.en: Huashu Design is an agent-agnostic, HTML-native design skill for Claude Code and compatible agents that turns a single sentence into production-quality visual deliverables within minutes. It produces editable single-file HTML prototypes (clickable, iPhone bezel), browser slide decks with preserved PPTX text frames, motion designs exported as MP4/GIF with optional BGM, and print-grade infographics. Key highlights include built-in design vocabularies, five-dimension expert review, brand-asset ingestion, Playwright-verified interactivity and configurable motion interpolation. MIT-licensed and runnable via skills.sh/npm, it accelerates product launches and rapid visual iteration without Figma.

metadata.name: pushgo
metadata.description: PushGo for Apple platforms (iOS/macOS/watchOS) is the official client app for PushGo. It works with PushGo Gateway to receive notifications on Apple devices.

summary.zh: PushGo Apple 平台官方客户端，覆盖 iOS/macOS/watchOS，配合 PushGo Gateway 接收推送。提供 App Store/TestFlight 分发，并内置并发构建闸门与 iOS UI 自动化测试脚本，便于多设备验证与持续集成。
summary.en: Official PushGo client for iOS/macOS/watchOS that pairs with PushGo Gateway to receive notifications. Provides App Store/TestFlight builds and includes concurrency/build gates plus CI-friendly iOS UI test scripts for multi-device validation.

summary.zh: 我无法从你提供的图片或当前信息中直接读取仓库内容，因此暂不能精准提炼项目的核心价值、应用场景与技术亮点。请粘贴 README 文本或提供可访问的仓库 URL、主要文件（如 README、src、requirements.txt、Dockerfile）或关键截图。收到后我会基于源码与依赖关系生成：1）80–100字中文摘要，2）80–100字英文摘要，3）按层级的高权重中英文标签（领域 / 技术栈 / 核心用途），并给出架构与集成建议与优先改进点。
summary.en: I cannot read the repository contents from the provided image or the current info, so I’m unable to accurately extract the project’s core value, use cases, and technical highlights. Please paste the README text or provide a direct repository URL and key files (README, src, requirements.txt, Dockerfile) or screenshots. Once you provide that, I will produce: an 80–100 word Chinese summary, an 80–100 word English summary, hierarchical high-weight bilingual tags (domain / core tech / primary use), plus concise architecture, integration recommendations, and prioritized improvement suggestions.

summary.zh: siglus_rs 是对 SiglusEngine 的非官方 Rust 重实现与跨平台移植，面向研究用途。它可在 Windows、Linux、macOS、iOS、Android 与 WebAssembly 上运行，包含可执行的 siglus_scene_vm、API 文档与预编译发行包。项目支持受保护资源的二次解密（key.toml），并提供静态与动态提取的实践途径与工具链接。采用 MPL‑2.0 许可，适合需要在现代平台上运行、分析或移植 Siglus 视觉小说引擎的开发者与研究者。
summary.en: siglus_rs is an unofficial Rust reimplementation and multi-platform port of SiglusEngine intended for research use. It runs on Windows, Linux, macOS, iOS, Android and WebAssembly, and includes a runnable siglus_scene_vm binary, API documentation, and prebuilt releases. The project supports decryption of protected game resources via a key.toml and documents static and dynamic key extraction workflows with links to auxiliary tools. Released under MPL‑2.0, siglus_rs helps developers and researchers run, analyze, or port Siglus visual-novel games across modern platforms.

metadata.name: Quitty
metadata.description: Quitty is a lightweight, modern macOS utility that automatically terminates applications when their last window is closed.

summary.zh: Quitty 是一款轻量级 macOS 工具，在最后一个窗口关闭时自动终止对应应用。基于底层 Accessibility API（AXObserver）以兼容 macOS 16 Tahoe，支持包含/排除模式、可配置延迟、开机自启、iCloud 同步与自适应学习引擎，并提供 DMG 与 Homebrew cask 安装，适合想自动清理后台应用并避免依赖脆弱高层框架的用户。
summary.en: Quitty is a lightweight macOS utility that automatically quits applications when their last window closes. It leverages the low-level Accessibility API (AXObserver) for macOS 16 (Tahoe) compatibility and robustness. Key features include include/exclude app lists, configurable quit delay, launch-at-login, iCloud settings sync, and an adaptive learning engine to handle app-specific window behaviors. Optional crowdsourced reporting improves detection. Available as DMG, Homebrew cask, or build-from-source—ideal for users who want automatic session cleanup without relying on fragile higher-level frameworks.

metadata.name: ouch
metadata.description: Painless compression and decompression in the terminal

summary.zh: ouch 是用 Rust 开发的跨平台命令行压缩/解压工具，支持多种格式与链式压缩，零运行时依赖，具备并行压缩（若支持）、友好错误提示、可访问模式、Shell 补全与 man 页，能自动识别文件签名并列举归档内容，适合终端交互、脚本化批处理与 CI/系统工具链集成。
summary.en: ouch (Obvious Unified Compression Helper) is a lightweight, fast, zero-runtime-dependency CLI tool written in Rust for painless compression, decompression and listing of archive contents. It detects formats by filename or file signature, supports chaining formats (e.g. .tar.gz.xz), and handles many codecs including zip, tar, 7z, zst, lz4, xz, rar (decompression only). It offers parallel compression where supported, clear error messages, accessibility mode, shell completions and man pages. Cross-platform packaging is available for Homebrew, Scoop and Arch. ouch is suitable for interactive terminal workflows, scripting, CI and system toolchains.

metadata.name: PortReleasor
metadata.description: a cross-platform tool for checking and releasing occupied ports

summary.zh: PortReleasor 是一款用 Go 开发的跨平台端口管理工具，可列出端口占用（PID/进程路径），并通过确认或强制模式释放端口。支持单端口、多端口、端口范围与通配符匹配，内置进程缓存与性能优化，适合开发与运维快速诊断并处理端口占用问题（需 Go1.21+ 与管理员权限）。
summary.en: PortReleasor is a Go-based cross-platform port management tool that lists occupied ports with PID/process info and can safely release them (confirm or force). It supports single/multiple ports, ranges and wildcard matching, includes caching and performance optimizations, and targets fast DevOps troubleshooting. Requires Go 1.21+ and elevated privileges.

metadata.name: defuddle
metadata.description: Get the main content of any page as Markdown.

summary.zh: Defuddle 是一款跨平台网页主内容提取器，将任意页面清洗为简洁的 HTML 或 Markdown。支持浏览器和 Node.js（JSDOM/linkedom）环境，并提供命令行工具。相比 Mozilla Readability 更宽容，减少误删，统一处理脚注、数学与代码块，利用页面移动样式判断噪音并提取 schema.org 等元数据。适合网页剪藏、知识管理、自动化归档与下游文本分析场景。
summary.en: Defuddle extracts the main content from web pages and returns cleaned HTML or Markdown, removing clutter like headers, footers, sidebars, and comments. It runs in browsers and Node.js environments (JSDOM, linkedom), includes a CLI, and was originally built for the Obsidian Web Clipper. Compared to Mozilla Readability, Defuddle is more forgiving, preserves footnotes, math, and code block semantics, uses a page's mobile styles to detect noise, and extracts richer metadata including schema.org. It’s ideal for clipping, knowledge management, automated archiving, and text-analysis pipelines.

metadata.name: awesome-gpt-image-2-API-and-Prompts
metadata.description: GPT-Image-2 API and Prompts

summary.zh: 本仓库收录359+条GPT-Image-2高质量提示词与API使用示例，覆盖电商、广告、肖像、海报、角色与UI等生产场景，提供可调用技能、示例输出和11语种文档，便于快速落地图像生成与编辑。
summary.en: This repository curates 359+ production-ready GPT-Image-2 prompts, API patterns, and reusable visual workflows for text-to-image generation and editing. It offers categorized examples for e-commerce, advertising, portrait photography, posters, character design, UI/social mockups, and comparison cases, plus callable skills, integration guides, real output images, and 11-language documentation to help developers and creators deploy production-grade image generation with GPT-Image-2.

metadata.name: GithubStarsManager
metadata.description: An app for managing github starred repositories.

summary.zh: GithubStarsManager 是一款跨平台桌面工具，自动同步并用 AI 为你的 GitHub 星标仓库生成摘要、标签和分类，支持语义检索、版本追踪、智能资产筛选与一键下载。默认 100% 本地存储，提供可选 Express+SQLite 后端以实现跨设备同步、加密令牌存储与 API 代理，免环境配置，适合开发者高效整理、发现与维护收藏的项目。
summary.en: GithubStarsManager is a cross-platform desktop app that automatically syncs your GitHub starred repositories and applies AI-powered analysis to produce concise summaries, tags, and categories. It offers intent-based semantic search, batch AI analysis, unified release tracking, smart asset filters (e.g., dmg/mac/arm64) and one-click downloads. Data stays local by default; an optional Express+SQLite backend enables cross-device sync, encrypted token storage and CORS-free API proxying. Packaged for Windows/macOS/Linux with multi-model AI support, it helps developers organize, discover and maintain starred projects efficiently.

metadata.name: NeteaseCloudMusicAPI-Swift
metadata.description: 网易云音乐 API 原生 Swift SDK — 362 个接口 · 四种加密 · 零依赖 · 全平台

summary.zh: 原生 Swift SDK，基于 NeteaseCloudMusicApi 封装，提供 362+ 网易云接口、四种加密方案、零依赖与 Apple 全平台支持；协议化架构支持多音源解灰与自定义扩展，适用于音乐客户端、播放和数据整合场景。
summary.en: NeteaseCloudMusicAPI-Swift is a native Swift SDK wrapping Binaryify's NeteaseCloudMusicApi, exposing over 362 NetEase Cloud Music endpoints. It implements four encryption modes (WeAPI, EAPI, LinuxAPI, plain), requires no external dependencies beyond Foundation and CommonCrypto, and targets Apple platforms (iOS/macOS/tvOS/watchOS) with async/await and strong typed enums. The protocol-oriented design supports multi-source unblocking (custom JS sources or addresses) and extensibility. Includes a full SwiftUI example app with 14 test pages. Open-source MIT licensed and packaged via Swift Package Manager for easy integration.

metadata.name: CL4R1T4S
metadata.description: LEAKED SYSTEM PROMPTS FOR CHATGPT, CLAUDE, GEMINI, GROK, PERPLEXITY, CURSOR, LOVABLE, REPLIT, AND MORE! - AI SYSTEMS TRANSPARENCY FOR ALL! 👐

summary.zh: CL4R1T4S 公布来自 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、xAI 等厂商的系统提示与准则，揭示隐藏指令、角色设定与内容过滤策略。这一仓库为研究者、审计员与开发者提供可观察性与对比样本，支持提示工程、模型行为溯源、安全与伦理审计与合规评估，同时鼓励社区通过提取或反向工程提交样本与注释以扩展透明度与可复现性。
summary.en: CL4R1T4S compiles and publishes extracted system prompts, guidelines, and tooling from major AI providers—OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, xAI, Perplexity, Replit and others—to surface the hidden instructions that shape model behavior. The archive exposes personas, refusal heuristics, content filters and policy framings, supporting researchers, auditors and developers in prompt engineering, behavior provenance, safety and ethics assessments, model governance and compliance reviews. It also invites community contributions via leaks, extraction or reverse‑engineering and annotated submissions to broaden observability and reproducibility of deployed AI systems.

metadata.name: paseo
metadata.description: Orchestrate coding agents remotely from your phone, desktop and CLI

summary.zh: Paseo 是自托管的编码代理编排平台，统一接入 Claude Code、Codex 与 OpenCode。本地 daemon 在你的开发环境运行 agent，客户端覆盖桌面、移动、Web 与 CLI。支持并行运行、多模型选择、语音控制与无遥测隐私保护，适用于远程触发任务、自动化实现、代码交付流水线与多模型协同审查。
summary.en: Paseo is a self-hosted orchestration platform for coding agents that unifies Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode under one interface. A local daemon runs agents with access to your development environment while desktop, mobile, web, and CLI clients connect to control them. It supports parallel agents, multi-provider model selection, voice controls, and a privacy-first, no-telemetry design. Typical uses include remote task delegation, automated code implementation and testing, orchestrating multi-model review loops, and scripting workflows via CLI and reusable skills.

summary.zh: bunwv 是基于 Bun.WebView 的跨平台无头浏览器自动化 CLI。通过持久守护进程保留页面状态（DOM、模态、表单、认证、Cookie），面向 AI 编码助手实现静默成功、JSON 错误与稳定退出码，支持 WebKit/Chrome、截图、交互与 CDP 调试。
summary.en: bunwv is a Bun.WebView-based, cross-platform headless-browser CLI. A persistent daemon preserves page state (DOM, modals, forms, auth, cookies). Agent-first for AI coding assistants: silent-on-success verbs, JSON-formatted errors with stable exit codes, event/console buffering, and support for WebKit/Chrome, screenshots, interactions and CDP.

metadata.name: cocoindex-code
metadata.description: A super light-weight embedded code search engine CLI (AST based) that just works - saves 70% token and improves speed for coding agent  🌟 Star if you like it!

summary.zh: 基于AST的轻量级语义代码检索CLI，内置Rust引擎CocoIndex，零配置上手。支持本地或云嵌入，兼容主流编码智能体。为智能体优化可节省70% token并显著加速，适合代码片段定位与语义搜索。
summary.en: cocoindex-code is a lightweight AST-based semantic code search CLI built on the high-performance Rust CocoIndex engine. Zero-config, one-minute setup supports local sentence-transformers or a slim LiteLLM/cloud-embedding option. Its AST-centric indexing reduces token use by ~70% and speeds retrieval, making it ideal for coding agents (Claude, Codex, Cursor) and tasks like snippet location, semantic search, and intelligent completion. Integrations include a recommended Skill, MCP server, and interactive CLI init for easy embedding into developer workflows.

metadata.name: nuwa-skill
metadata.description: 你想蒸馏的下一个员工，何必是同事。蒸馏任何人的思维方式——心智模型、决策启发式、表达DNA。Distill how anyone thinks.

summary.zh: 女娲.skill 自动化蒸馏名人思维：从公开资料提取心智模型、决策启发式与表达DNA，完成调研、提炼与验证，生成可安装的Skill供 Claude 等平台调用。适用于构建个性化AI顾问、决策辅助和风格化内容创作，并明确能力与局限。
summary.en: Nuwa.skill automates distillation of public figures' thinking by extracting mental models, decision heuristics, expression DNA and explicit boundaries from public sources. It runs research, synthesis and validation pipelines to produce installable Skills for Claude and the skills.sh ecosystem. Useful for building persona-like AI advisors, decision-support tools and style-guided content generation, the project emphasizes interpretive reasoning over rote quotes and documents each Skill's limitations to support safer, transparent, extensible use.

metadata.name: openclaw-zero-token
metadata.description: OpenClaw: Use All Major AI Models NO API Token! Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/Doubao/Grok/Qwen/Manus/Kimi

summary.zh: OpenClaw Zero Token通过一次浏览器登录，驱动官网网页端免API密钥调用ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Qwen、Grok等主流大模型，提供统一网关与提示注入的本地工具调用（如web_search、web_fetch、exec、read/write），支持多平台与供应商适配。开源MIT许可，适合低成本接入、研发验证与将网页模型集成到本地工具链的场景。
summary.en: OpenClaw Zero Token enables use of major LLMs without buying API tokens by driving providers' official web UIs after a one-time browser login. It provides a unified gateway to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, Grok, DeepSeek, Doubao, Kimi, MiMo and others, and supports prompt-injected tool calling to local utilities (web_search, web_fetch, exec, read, write, message). Open-source (MIT) and cross-platform, it includes provider adaptors, docs and troubleshooting, making it suitable for low-cost experimentation, research and integrating web models into local toolchains.

metadata.name: macpow
metadata.description: 💻🔋 Real-time power tree TUI for Apple Silicon

summary.zh: macpow 是为 Apple Silicon（M1–M5+）设计的实时终端 TUI，直接读取 IOReport、SMC、IORegistry、CoreAudio 与 Mach/kernel 接口（无需 sudo）。按组件展示 SoC 能耗细分（E/P 核、GPU、ANE、DRAM 等）、每核功耗与频率、温度、内存、显示、电池、外设与 SSD 能耗，以及进程级能耗归因。提供折叠树、Sparkline 历史、平滑窗口、刷新率切换、鼠标支持与 JSON 输出，适用于能耗分析、性能调优与现场诊断。
summary.en: macpow is a real-time terminal UI for monitoring per-component power and energy on Apple Silicon (M1–M5+). It reads IOReport, SMC, IORegistry, CoreAudio and Mach/kernel APIs (no sudo) to report SoC breakdown (E/P cores, GPU, ANE, DRAM), per-core power and frequencies, temperatures, memory, display and battery metrics, peripherals, SSD power, fan models and per-process energy attribution. Features include a collapsible tree view, sparkline history, smoothing windows, adjustable refresh latency, mouse support and JSON output — ideal for power analysis, performance tuning and live diagnostics.

metadata.name: port-killer
metadata.description: A powerful cross-platform port management tool for developers. Monitor ports, manage Kubernetes port forwards, integrate Cloudflare Tunnels, and kill processes with one click.

summary.zh: PortKiller 是一款跨平台开发者端口管理工具，自动发现 TCP 监听端口并支持一键优雅或强制终止进程，提供搜索、收藏、通知与连接日志。可创建与自动重连 Kubernetes kubectl port‑forward 会话，集成 Cloudflare Tunnels 状态与快捷访问，分别以 macOS 菜单栏和 Windows 托盘的原生界面呈现，便于本地调试、网络冲突排查与远程端口管理。
summary.en: PortKiller is a cross-platform developer utility for comprehensive port management. It auto-discovers listening TCP ports and enables one-click graceful or forceful process termination, with search, favorites, watched ports, notifications and connection logs. It creates and auto-reconnects Kubernetes kubectl port‑forward sessions and surfaces Cloudflare Tunnel connections and status. Native macOS menu bar and Windows system tray apps provide platform-specific UI, making it useful for local debugging, resolving port conflicts, and managing remote port forwards in daily workflows.

metadata.name: iClaw
metadata.description: A native iOS AI Agent app — multiple customizable AI assistants, right on your phone

summary.zh: iClaw 是一款原生 iOS AI 代理平台，支持多角色可定制代理、每个代理独立记忆与人格、设备端 JavaScript 执行（WKWebView 沙箱）、内置浏览器自动化、SwiftData 本地持久化与会话 RAG/压缩、Cron 定时与技能扩展。无需服务器，所有数据保存在手机上，适合需要移动端可执行动作、隐私优先且可扩展的个人助理与自动化场景。
summary.en: iClaw is a native iOS AI agent platform enabling multiple customizable agents with independent memory and personas. It runs fully on-device with JavaScript execution in a WKWebView sandbox, in-app browser automation, SwiftData local persistence, session RAG/compression, cron scheduling and a skill system. No server required—designed for private, mobile AI assistants that can take actions, run code locally and be extended with sub-agents and reusable scripts.

metadata.name: PixelPerfect
metadata.description: Increase the text size of iPhone and iPad apps on Mac. Say goodbye to small and blurry text, and enjoy pixel-perfect graphics, all rendered at 100% native resolution.

summary.zh: Pixel Perfect 是 macOS 开源工具，将 iPhone/iPad 应用以 100% 原生分辨率运行，放大并锐化文字与图像，提升可读性。支持单应用或一键全局。
summary.en: Pixel Perfect is an open-source macOS utility that runs iPhone and iPad apps at 100% native resolution on a Mac, enlarging and sharpening text and graphics to eliminate small, blurry UI elements. It provides per-app toggles and an ‘Enable All’ option, requires Full Disk Access on newer macOS, and supports Apple Silicon. Ideal for improving readability and visual fidelity when using mobile apps on macOS, the source is available for inspection and verification.

metadata.name: yourself-skill
metadata.description: 与其蒸馏别人，不如蒸馏自己。欢迎加入数字永生！Inspired by colleague-skill（同事skill）。

summary.zh: 自己.skill 将个人聊天、日记与照片等多源数据解析并构建可运行的“数字自我”，生成自我记忆与五层人格模型（Persona），支持增量合并、对话纠正与版本回滚。基于 AgentSkills 标准并适配 Claude Code，可作为个性化助理、心理自省与数字永生场景的可部署技能，含聊天解析、EXIF 照片分析与丰富的 prompt 模板与工具链。
summary.en: yourself.skill turns personal data—chat logs, journals, photos, and self-descriptions—into a runnable digital twin. It extracts a structured Self Memory and a five-layer Persona to simulate how you think and speak, using prompt templates and parsers (WeChat/QQ/social/text/photo EXIF) with AgentSkills and Claude Code integration. Features include incremental memory merging, live correction handling, versioning/rollback, and multiple skill modes (full/memory/persona). Targets personal assistants, self-reflection and ‘digital immortality’, deployable as a Claude Code skill with Python tooling.

metadata.name: nano-banana-skills
metadata.description: Nano Banana Pro Skills

summary.zh: 这是为 Nano Banana AI 智能体打造的一组图像生成技能集合，聚焦把二次元、手办、机甲等视觉素材自动转换为高保真、写真级或杂志封面风格的照片级结果。每个技能为独立文件夹，采用严格的 JSON 提示结构与可复用的 SKILL.md 指南，实现可插拔的提示工程与风格映射（如动漫到真人、人物参考表、IMAX 肖像、旧照修复等）。适合内容创作者、视觉设计与生成式媒体管线的快速集成与扩展开发。
summary.en: This repository is a collection of image-generation skills for the Nano Banana AI agent, focused on converting anime, figures, mecha, and editorial layouts into photorealistic, magazine-grade imagery. Each skill is self-contained with a strict JSON-based prompt structure and SKILL.md documentation, enabling reusable prompt engineering and style mapping (anime-to-real, character sheets, IMAX portraits, photo restoration, etc.). It targets content creators, visual designers, and generative media pipelines for fast integration, high-fidelity synthesis, and extensible skill development.

metadata.name: safari-mcp
metadata.description: Native Safari browser automation for AI agents. 80 tools via AppleScript — zero overhead, keeps logins, runs silently in background. Drop-in alternative to Chrome DevTools MCP with 40-60% less CPU/heat on Apple Silicon.

summary.zh: Safari MCP 通过 AppleScript 提供 80 个原生 Safari 自动化工具，使 AI 智能体驱动已登录的真实浏览器（保留会话、静默后台运行）。无需 Chrome/Playwright，Apple Silicon 上 CPU 与发热约降 40–60%，响应快（≈5ms/命令），适合需真实登录与低功耗浏览的智能代理与自动化场景。
summary.en: Safari MCP delivers 80 native Safari automation tools via AppleScript, letting AI agents control your logged-in Safari (sessions preserved, runs silently in background). No Chrome/Playwright required; achieves ~40–60% lower CPU/heat on Apple Silicon and ~5ms per command—ideal for AI agents needing real-session, low-power browser automation.

metadata.name: TaskTick
metadata.description: A native macOS app for managing scheduled tasks. Built with SwiftUI + SwiftData. Menu bar resident, cron expressions, script execution, and more.

summary.zh: TaskTick 是 macOS 菜单栏定时任务管理器，基于 SwiftUI/SwiftData，支持 cron 表达式、脚本执行与日志、模板及 crontab 一键导入，具备系统通知、模板管理与自动更新，适合备份、日志清理与运维巡检等自动化任务。
summary.en: TaskTick is a native macOS menu‑bar app for managing scheduled tasks, built with SwiftUI and SwiftData. It supports flexible scheduling including cron expressions, runs inline or local scripts (.sh/.py/.rb/.js), captures stdout/stderr and exit codes, and delivers per‑task macOS notifications. Features include script templates and template manager, crontab import, execution logs, i18n (EN/ZH) and auto‑updates. Ideal for backups, log rotation, health checks and other maintenance automation on macOS 14+ (Apple Silicon and Intel).

metadata.name: cc-nano-banana
metadata.description: A Claude Code skill to generate images with Nano Banana

summary.zh: Nano Banana 是一个 Claude Code 技能，利用 Google Gemini CLI 的 nanobanana 扩展实现高效的文本到图像生成与图像编辑。功能涵盖图像生成、修复、图标与流程图制作、无缝纹理与连贯的故事序列，提供命令行风格的指令与参数（样式、种子、预览、多样本）并将结果输出到 nanobanana-output，便于把 Gemini 模型集成到自动化图像生产与创作流程中。
summary.en: Nano Banana is a Claude Code skill that integrates Google’s Gemini CLI nanobanana extension to generate and edit images from natural language prompts. It supports text-to-image, image editing and restoration, icon and favicon creation, flowchart/architecture diagram generation, seamless pattern creation, and sequential/story images. Installable into Claude’s skills directory, it exposes CLI-like commands and options for styles, seed, preview and multiple variations. Outputs are saved to a nanobanana-output directory and different Gemini image models can be selected to balance cost and quality, enabling automated image workflows.

metadata.name: talk-normal
metadata.description: Make any LLM talk like a normal person. A system prompt that removes AI slop.

summary.zh: talk-normal 是一个通用 system prompt，将任何大模型的冗长、官僚式输出转为直接、有用的回答。已在 GPT/Claude/Gemini/LLaMA 等多模组测试，GPT-4o-mini 与 GPT-5.4 上约减少 72–73% 冗词但保留关键信息。适用于助手回复风格规范化、金融与专业分析的简洁呈现及文档压缩。仓库包含完整测试结果、变更日志与贡献指南，欢迎提交规则建议。
summary.en: talk-normal is a single, model-agnostic system prompt that strips corporate filler and verbosity from LLM outputs to produce direct, informative answers. It works across GPT, Claude, Gemini, LLaMA and other large models and was validated with test suites showing roughly 72–73% reduction in unnecessary text on GPT-4o-mini and GPT-5.4 while preserving essential information. Useful for normalizing assistant tone, tightening technical or financial analysis, and compressing documents. The repo includes full test results, changelog, and contribution guidelines for rule proposals.

metadata.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
metadata.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.

summary.zh: 基于Karpathy对大模型编码缺陷的观察，本仓库提供单文件CLAUDE.md指南用于Claude Code插件。通过四项原则（先思考、优先简洁、外科式改动、目标驱动）约束模型行为，要求显式假设、最小入侵修改与测试优先，旨在提升LLM生成代码的可靠性、可审计性与可维护性。
summary.en: An Andrej Karpathy–inspired single-file guideline (CLAUDE.md) to improve Claude Code's coding behavior. It addresses common LLM issues—silent assumptions, overcomplication, and unintended edits—via four principles: Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, and Goal-Driven Execution. The document enforces explicit assumptions, multiple interpretations, minimal targeted edits, and tests-first success criteria so agents can loop and verify outcomes. Packaged as a Claude Code plugin, it helps developers and maintainers increase AI coding agents' reliability, auditability, and maintainability without speculative features.

metadata.name: NeteaseCloudMusic_PythonSDK
metadata.description: 多语言音乐 API 绑定库，支持网易云（NeteaseCloudMusicApi）、酷狗（KuGouMusicApi）的音乐服务，已绑定 python语言 和 dart语言，实现 netease 与 kugou 数据操作和访问，适用于音乐应用学习讨论。

summary.zh: 多语言音乐 API 绑定，基于 JavaScript→C→QuickJS 架构，封装网易云/酷狗接口。提供 Python/Dart 包（2MB 库），覆盖100+ 常用接口，适合学习与快速集成。
summary.en: MusicLibrary language bindings provide lightweight, high-performance access to music platform APIs (Netease Cloud Music and KuGou) via a JavaScript → C → QuickJS architecture. The project exposes a unified API for login, search, playback, comments and 100+ endpoints, delivered as small (~2MB) precompiled C libraries with official Python and Dart packages. It's aimed at cross-language integration, rapid prototyping and learning; note thread-safety, caching limitations and copyright considerations.

metadata.name: teamspeak-music-bot
metadata.description: TeamSpeak 3 音乐机器人 — 网易云/QQ音乐，YesPlayMusic 风格 WebUI

summary.zh: TSMusicBot 是基于 Node.js 与 Vue 的 TeamSpeak 音乐机器人，内置 FFmpeg，支持网易云/QQ/哔哩并可选启用 YouTube，兼容 TS3/TS6 原生协议，提供 YesPlayMusic 风格的 WebUI、实时歌词、歌单管理与多机器人并发播放，支持 Docker/Windows/Linux 一键部署，适合私人或社群语音服务器的集中音乐播放与管理场景。
summary.en: TSMusicBot is a TeamSpeak music bot built with Node.js and Vue, bundling FFmpeg and optional yt-dlp. It unifies sources (NetEase/QQ/Bilibili and optional YouTube), supports native TS3/TS6 protocols, offers a YesPlayMusic-style WebUI, real-time lyrics, playlist management, avatar/status updates and concurrent multi-bot playback. Deployable via Docker, Windows or Linux one-click installers, it targets private servers and voice communities needing centralized music playback and control.

metadata.name: AyuGramDesktop
metadata.description: Desktop Telegram client with good customization and Ghost mode.

summary.zh: AyuGram 是基于 Telegram 桌面客户端的跨平台桌面应用，聚焦隐私与可定制性。提供灵活的 Ghost（隐身）模式、消息历史与反撤回、主播模式、字体与外观高度自定义、本地 Telegram Premium 支持、内置翻译、媒体预览等实用功能。支持 Windows、macOS、各主流 Linux 发行版与包管理器（winget、brew、AUR、Flatpak 等），适合注重隐私、流媒体展示和高级界面定制的用户与内容创作者使用。
summary.en: AyuGram is an open-source, cross-platform desktop Telegram client fork focused on privacy and deep customization. It adds a flexible Ghost (invisible) mode, message history and anti-recall, streamer mode, extensive font and appearance options, local Telegram Premium support, built-in translator, media preview and quick reactions (macOS), and other user-facing enhancements. Distributed via installers and package managers (Releases, winget, Homebrew, AUR, Flatpak), it targets privacy-conscious users, streamers and creators who need advanced UI tweaking and messaging controls.

metadata.name: CLI-Anything
metadata.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/

summary.zh: CLI-Anything 将任意软件变为 agent-native：生成统一的 CLI harness 并通过 CLI‑Hub 实现发现、安装与管理，使 AI 智能体可编排并控制真实软件。支持一键安装、预览/实时回放与轨迹循环，在 CAD、3D、图表、游戏与字幕等场景有端到端示例。基于 Python/Click、标准化技能库与完整测试套件，便于社区扩展与自动化集成，面向可复现的代理驱动工作流。
summary.en: CLI-Anything makes existing software agent-native by generating standardized CLI harnesses and providing a community CLI-Hub for discovery, installation, and management. It enables AI agents (Pi, OpenClaw, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) to orchestrate real applications via one command, offering preview/live-preview, trajectory loops, and end-to-end demos across CAD, 3D, diagrams, gameplay, and subtitles. Built in Python with Click, a canonical skills registry, comprehensive tests, JSON/human outputs, and CI validation, it emphasizes extensibility, reproducible artifact pipelines, and automatable integration for scalable agent-driven workflows.

metadata.name: hermes-agent
metadata.description: The agent that grows with you

summary.zh: Hermes Agent 是 Nous Research 开发的自我进化 AI 代理，内置闭环学习与技能自动生成，支持任意模型接入与多端会话（CLI、Telegram、Discord 等）、长时记忆检索、并行子代理与定时自动化。可在低成本或无服务器环境运行，适用于长期个人助理、运维自动化及研究数据采集与训练。
summary.en: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI agent from Nous Research that auto-creates and refines skills via a built-in learning loop. It supports any model endpoint, multi-platform interfaces (CLI, Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal), long-term memory search, scheduled automations, parallel subagents, and serverless or low-cost deployment. Features include a full TUI, model routing, FTS5 session search with LLM summarization, RPC tool-calling, trajectory generation for research, and Honcho dialectic user modeling. Suitable for long-running personal assistants, autonomous automations, and data collection/training workflows.

metadata.name: build-code-agent
metadata.description: 从零构建 Code Agent：Claude Code 源码深度解析 | Build a Code Agent from Scratch: Deep Dive into Claude Code Source

summary.zh: 本课程逐层剖析 Claude Code v2.1.88 源码，覆盖 Agent 循环、流式执行、工具注册、上下文与记忆、权限与 Hook、MCP 协议及多代理协作。通过 7 大模块与三个 TypeScript 实战（MiniAgent、MCP Server、多人协作）带你从零构建可落地的 AI 编程代理、定制工具系统与 SDK 集成，适用于构建 CI/CD 自动化、智能代码助手与多代理服务。
summary.en: This course deeply analyzes the Claude Code v2.1.88 codebase to teach engineers how to build production-ready AI code agents. It explains the agent loop, AsyncGenerator streaming, StreamingToolExecutor concurrency, 40+ built-in tools and factory registration patterns, three-layer context and compression strategies, SessionMemory/DreamTask, permission and hooks infrastructure, MCP protocol (transports, OAuth/XAA) and multi-agent coordination (Swarm/Coordinator). Across seven modules and three TypeScript projects (MiniAgent, MCP server, multi-agent system) you’ll implement agent loops, tool ecosystems, security policies, streaming execution and SDK integration for real-world CI/CD and service workflows.

metadata.name: open-orpheus
metadata.description: An open-source and cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows) implementation of Netease Cloud Music's Orpheus browser host. 网易云音乐的Orpheus浏览器宿主的跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows）开源实现。

summary.zh: Open Orpheus 是网易云音乐 Orpheus 浏览器宿主的开源跨平台实现（Linux/macOS/Windows）。为原版客户端提供独立运行环境，首次启动可从网易 CDN 自动下载必需资源，支持 Flatpak/Copr/AUR/AppImage 等多种分发渠道，不包含网易专有资产且遵循服务条款。
summary.en: Open Orpheus is an open-source, cross-platform implementation of NetEase Cloud Music's Orpheus browser host (Linux/macOS/Windows). It provides a standalone runtime for the original client, auto-downloads required assets from NetEase CDN on first run, and supports Flatpak/AUR/AppImage/Copr distributions without bundling proprietary files.

metadata.name: rose
metadata.description: 输入法用户词库转换工具 |  Input Method User Dictionary Converter.

summary.zh: 蔷薇是用 Go 实现的输入法词库转换工具，支持 29 种词库格式互转（18 种可导出），涵盖拼音自动注音、五笔（86/98/新世纪/自定义码表）编码转换与按词长、词频、是否含英数字等过滤。提供命令行与内置 Vue3 Web 界面，上传文件自动识别格式并一键导出。模块化架构便于通过新增 format 插件扩展新格式，适合用户在输入法迁移、个人词库整理与格式互通场景中使用。
summary.en: Rose is a Go-based input-method dictionary converter that supports 29 import formats and 18 export formats. It features automatic pinyin annotation, Wubi code conversion (86/98/New Century and custom tables), flexible text format configuration, and filters by length, frequency, and presence of letters/numbers. Usable via CLI or a built-in Vue 3 web UI (auto-detects uploads and one-click converts). Its modular design (converter/encoder/filter/format/model/server) and simple format-plugin API make it easy to add new formats, ideal for IME migration and personal dictionary management.

metadata.name: see-through
metadata.description: "Single-image Layer Decomposition for Anime Characters" (SIGGRAPH 2026, Conditionally Accepted)

summary.zh: See-through 提出面向二次元角色的单张图像图层分解管线，将一张插画自动拆解为最多23个语义独立且完整修复的透明图层，并推断绘制顺序，输出可编辑的PSD/2.5D资产。方法结合基于 SDXL 的 LayerDiff3D 扩散生成、为动漫微调的 Marigold 伪深度估计与语义分割（可选 SAM、detectron2 等注释器），并提供完整推理脚本与模型。适用于角色素材编辑、换装、分层渲染与动画资源生成等工作流。
summary.en: See-through presents a pipeline that converts a single anime illustration into manipulatable 2.5D assets by decomposing one image into up to 23 fully inpainted, semantically distinct transparent layers with inferred drawing order, producing PSD-like outputs. The approach combines a diffusion-based LayerDiff3D (SDXL) for transparent layer generation, a Marigold pseudo-depth estimator fine-tuned for anime, and semantic segmentation tools (optional SAM/detectron2). The repository includes inference scripts, pretrained models, and annotator options. Applications include character editing, outfit swaps, layered rendering, relighting, and animation asset creation.

metadata.name: chandra
metadata.description: OCR model that handles complex tables, forms, handwriting with full layout.

summary.zh: Chandra OCR 2 是面向文档智能的先进 OCR 模型，能将图片与 PDF 转为保留完整版式的 HTML/Markdown/JSON。它支持 90+ 语言与强健的手写识别，擅长复杂表格、数学公式与表单（含复选框）重建，并能提取图像与图示。提供本地（HuggingFace）与远程（vLLM）两种推理模式，包含 CLI 与交互式应用，适合高吞吐批处理、托管或自托管且兼顾合规与零数据留存选项。
summary.en: Chandra OCR 2 is a state-of-the-art document intelligence OCR that converts images and PDFs into structured HTML, Markdown, or JSON while preserving full layout. It supports 90+ languages, robust handwriting recognition, complex tables, mathematical notation, form reconstruction (including checkboxes), and image/diagram extraction with captions. Deploy locally via HuggingFace or remotely with a vLLM server; includes a CLI and Streamlit app. Designed for high-throughput batch processing and on‑prem or managed deployments with compliance and optional zero-data-retention.

metadata.name: ChaoXing_node_signin
metadata.description: 学习通在线自动签到系统第三方节点接入程序，用于自行部署可接入学习通在线自动签到系统的第三方节点，该程序需配合学习通在线自动签到系统使用

summary.zh: 学习通在线自动签到系统的第三方接入节点，支持 exe/Python/Docker 部署，采用 YAML 配置、UUID 身份校验与邮件告警，便于自建可供主系统接入的基础签到服务。因平台接口频繁变动，仓库仅保留核心签到逻辑，需配合官方主系统使用。
summary.en: Third‑party node for the ChaoXing online auto sign-in system, deployable as exe, Python script or Docker. It provides a lightweight, self-hosted sign-in service using YAML configuration, UUID identity, and optional email alerts so the central auto-sign system can consume the node. The repo preserves only core sign-in logic due to frequent upstream interface changes and must be used alongside the official main system.

metadata.name: PUAClaw
metadata.description: Claw 们终将接管世界，PUAClaw is All You Need

summary.zh: PUAClaw 构建了针对大模型提示词中说服与操控技术的系统化框架，包含16类、96项子技术、规范化提示模板、跨 Agent 兼容矩阵及“龙虾评级”效力评估。项目附带伪实证数据、分级风险矩阵与合规审计方法，面向 AI 安全与滥用研究、提示工程审查与攻击面分析，同时包含伦理警示与贡献指南。
summary.en: PUAClaw is a comprehensive framework cataloging persuasive and unconventional prompting techniques for large language models. It standardizes 16 primary categories and 96 sub-techniques, each with normalized prompt templates, a cross-agent compatibility matrix, and a lobster-based efficacy rating. The repository ships pseudo-empirical validation, a tiered risk matrix and audit methods, and documents measured effects across tested agents. Intended for AI security and abuse research, prompt-engineering audits and attack-surface analysis, it includes ethical warnings and contribution guidance.

metadata.name: OmniBox
metadata.description: 一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建的高性能、功能完善的 Web 代理服务

summary.zh: OmniBox 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的高性能边缘 Web 代理，采用严格模式 TypeScript 实现、零运行时依赖。面向加速跨域访问、内容代理与隐私保护，支持完整资源代理、URL 重写、密码保护（SHA-256+常量时间比较）、SSRF 与爬虫过滤、CORS、健康监控与分级日志。模块化设计与严格类型便于在 Cloudflare 边缘快速部署、监控与扩展，适用于个人隐私访问、测试环境和内容加速场景。
summary.en: OmniBox is a high-performance, feature-rich universal web proxy built on Cloudflare Workers. Implemented in strict-mode TypeScript with zero runtime dependencies, it runs at the edge using Cloudflare's global CDN to deliver low-latency proxying for HTML, CSS, JS, images and fonts. It provides URL rewriting, optional password protection (SHA-256 with constant-time compare), SSRF and bot filtering, CORS enabling, health checks, logging and size/time limits. Modular architecture and strong typing simplify deployment, auditing and extension for privacy-preserving access, testing, or content acceleration.

metadata.name: shuorenhua
metadata.description: 说人话｜Chinese-first AI writing refinement skill that reduces boilerplate and AI tone while preserving facts, terminology, and technical context.

summary.zh: 说人话是面向中文的写作润色 skill：按场景判定改写强度并保护版本/命令/证据，去除AI腔与工程师套话同时保留事实与术语。适用于聊天、状态汇报、README、release note 与 issue 回复，支持诊断标注和自动改写，规则集与评测完善。
summary.en: Shuorenhua is a Chinese-first writing-refinement skill: scene-aware rewriting that protects versions/commands/evidence and preserves facts and terminology, while stripping AI tone and engineer boilerplate. Suitable for chat, status reports, README, release notes and issue replies; supports annotation-only and full-rule modes with benchmarks.

metadata.name: AppDowngrader
metadata.description: Downgrade iOS apps to older versions

summary.zh: AppDowngrader 是一款 macOS 桌面工具，通过 USB 连接 iPhone/iPad 后可浏览已装应用、列出所有历史版本并一键下载安装旧版。内置 ipatool 与 go-ios，支持 Apple ID 登录与两步验证，无需手动安装依赖，适用于回退应用版本、兼容性测试或故障排查的开发者与高级用户。
summary.en: AppDowngrader is a macOS desktop application that lets you downgrade iOS apps to previous versions. By connecting an iPhone or iPad over USB, you can browse installed apps, view available historical releases, and download and install any prior version with one click. The app bundles ipatool and go-ios so no manual dependencies are needed, and it supports Apple ID authentication including two‑factor authentication. It’s aimed at users who need to roll back app updates for compatibility testing, debugging, or personal preference. Requires macOS 14+, a USB iOS device, and an Apple ID.

metadata.name: fakabot
metadata.description: Telegram自动发卡机器人 电报发卡机器人 - 支持支付宝/微信/USDT支付 自动发货 订单管理 虚拟商品 | Telegram Auto Card Delivery Bot Payment Shop

summary.zh: Fakabot 是基于 Telegram 的自动发卡与支付商店，支持支付宝/微信/USDT 多通道支付，自动回调、订单同步与库存扣减，能自动发放卡密、一次性群组邀请和下载链接。内置 Redis 缓存、异步处理和重试/告警机制，支持 Docker 一键部署与后台管理，适用于虚拟商品、在线课程、软件交付和会员服务的高并发即时发货场景。
summary.en: Fakabot is a Telegram-based automated card delivery and payment shop supporting Alipay, WeChat Pay and multi-chain USDT. It automates payment callbacks, order lifecycle, inventory extraction and delivery of items like license keys, one-time Telegram invite links and download URLs. Designed for high-concurrency use, it leverages Redis caching, async processing, connection pools, rate limiting, and retry/stock-alert mechanisms. It offers Docker deployment and an admin dashboard for order/product/user management, making it ideal for virtual goods, online courses, software delivery and membership services requiring instant, hands-off fulfillment.

metadata.name: ham_home
metadata.description: HamHome is an AI-powered browser extension for collecting, organizing, and retrieving web content—auto-categorized, summarized, and tagged, with all data kept local and private.       HamHome 是一款 AI 驱动的浏览器扩展，用于智能地收集、整理和检索网页内容。它可以自动分类页面、生成摘要并推荐标签，同时所有数据都保存在本地，确保隐私与安全。

summary.zh: HamHome 是一款面向现代浏览器的 AI 驱动书签与工作区管理扩展。它利用大模型自动对网页进行分类、生成摘要并推荐标签，支持语义检索与重复项检测，提升资料收集与检索效率。可保存/恢复标签页工作区并保留原生 Tab Group 规则，数据以本地优先方式存储且可导出。支持 BYOK（OpenAI、Anthropic、Claude、Ollama 或自定义端点）与可选 WebDAV 同步（含端到端加密），兼顾跨设备同步与隐私保护。
summary.en: HamHome is an AI-powered browser extension for organizing, summarizing and retrieving web content locally. It leverages large language models to auto-categorize pages, produce concise summaries, suggest tags, enable semantic search and detect duplicates. Users can save and restore tab workspaces while preserving native tab groups. Data remains local and portable, with BYOK support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Claude, Ollama or custom endpoints, plus optional WebDAV sync with end-to-end encryption. Real-time sync status and granular remote controls support secure cross-device continuity for researchers and power users.

metadata.name: agent-browser
metadata.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents

summary.zh: agent-browser 是 Vercel 出品的原生 Rust CLI，为 AI agent 和自动化脚本提供快速、轻量的浏览器控制。可自动下载 Chrome for Testing，支持可访问性树快照、基于引用的点击/填充与传统选择器，兼容现有 Chromium 系列浏览器，无需 Playwright 或长期依赖守护进程，适用于网页交互自动化、UI 测试与智能代理集成。
summary.en: agent-browser is a native Rust CLI from Vercel that enables fast, lightweight browser automation for AI agents and automation scripts. It can download Chrome for Testing, capture accessibility-tree snapshots, and operate via reference-based actions or traditional selectors. It detects existing Chromium installs and runs without Playwright or a Node daemon, making it ideal for web interaction automation, UI testing, and agent integrations.

metadata.name: browser
metadata.description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation

summary.zh: Lightpanda 是用 Zig 从零实现的无头浏览器，非 Chromium 或 WebKit 分支，专为 AI 智能体与自动化场景设计。兼容 CDP，极低内存占用与高并发抓取能力（显著优于 Headless Chrome），适合大规模爬虫、自动化测试与代理式采集。提供原生二进制、Docker 镜像与包管理发布，强调性能、可嵌入性与与现有 Puppeteer/Playwright 流程的兼容性。
summary.en: Lightpanda is a headless browser written from scratch in Zig, not a Chromium or WebKit fork. Built for AI agents and automation, it provides a CDP-compatible interface with very low memory usage and high throughput—benchmarks show much lower peak RAM and faster page execution than Headless Chrome. Distributed as native binaries, Docker images and package manager builds, it targets large-scale web crawling, automated testing and agent-driven browsing with easy integration into Puppeteer/Playwright workflows.

metadata.name: PasteMemo
metadata.description: PasteMemo - Smart clipboard manager for macOS

summary.zh: PasteMemo 是 macOS 上的智能剪贴板管理器，可将文本即时保存为文件、截图作为图片拖放，支持 AI 终端粘贴与 Paste+Enter。提供内容类型识别、富预览、按应用过滤、历史检索与批量粘贴等功能，适合开发者与高频剪贴场景，显著优化命令行与跨应用粘贴工作流。
summary.en: PasteMemo is a smart clipboard manager for macOS that converts copied content into reusable, file-like clips for instant pasting and drag-and-drop into Finder or file dialogs. Aimed at developers and command-line users, it supports AI terminal compatibility, Paste+Enter, batch Relay paste, and a global Quick Paste panel with full keyboard navigation. It performs content-type detection (links with favicons, syntax-highlighted code, images, colors, phone numbers), offers rich previews, per-app filtering, search, pinning and configurable history to streamline cross-app workflows and reproducible clipboard-based file operations.

metadata.name: ghgrab
metadata.description: A simple, pretty terminal tool that lets you search and download files from GitHub without leaving your CLI.

summary.zh: ghgrab 是基于 Rust（tokio + ratatui）的跨平台终端 TUI 工具，能在 CLI 中搜索、预览并精确下载 GitHub 仓库里的单文件、文件夹或 release 资产，支持模糊检索、批量下载、LFS 和按平台的 release 匹配，且可通过 npm/cargo/pipx 快速安装。
summary.en: ghgrab: Rust CLI TUI to search, preview and fetch GitHub files, folders or releases without cloning. It supports fuzzy search, batch downloads, LFS and OS/arch-aware release selection; installable via npm/cargo/pipx.

metadata.name: chromeclaw
metadata.description: Your own personal AI assistant in Chrome/Firefox. 🦞

summary.zh: ChromeClaw 是运行在 Chrome/Firefox 沙箱内的轻量级 AI 助手扩展，无需服务器即可使用多厂商大模型与本地 Transformers.js 推理。集成 WhatsApp/Telegram 消息通道、TTS/STT、混合记忆（BM25+向量）、多代理与 25+ 工具，并支持 DevTools 浏览器自动化、Google OAuth、定时任务与工作区文件，适合个人自动化、长期记忆的研究流水线与注重隐私的浏览器内代理场景。
summary.en: ChromeClaw is a lightweight in-browser AI agent extension for Chrome and Firefox that runs entirely in the browser sandbox with no server required. It supports multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter, custom endpoints) and on-device inference via Transformers.js. Key features include streaming responses, WhatsApp/Telegram messaging channels, TTS/STT, hybrid BM25+embedding memory with MMR re-ranking, multi-agent workflows, 25+ built-in tools, Google OAuth integration, DevTools-based browser automation, cron scheduling, and persistent workspace files — ideal for personal automation, autonomous research, and privacy-focused browser agents.

metadata.name: Cosmosh
metadata.description: Yet another SSH client. Under development

summary.zh: Cosmosh 是基于 Electron 的高性能 SSH 终端客户端，采用 Vite+React+TypeScript 前端与 Hono+Node 后端，使用 pnpm 工作区管理。以 OpenAPI 为单一契约，通过 openapi-typescript 生成共享类型并导出协议常量与封装模板。运行时在 Electron 中实现 Renderer→Main（IPC）→Backend（HTTP+内部 token）通信并预留浏览器传输。提供本地开发、构建、Windows 打包、i18n 及 ESLint/Prettier 等工程化支持，适合构建专业级跨平台终端管理工具。
summary.en: Cosmosh is a high-performance SSH/terminal client built with Electron. It uses a Vite + React + TypeScript renderer, a Hono + Node backend, and a pnpm monorepo. The project centralizes its API contract in OpenAPI and generates shared types with openapi-typescript, exposing protocol constants and envelope helpers. Runtime communication flows Renderer→Main (IPC)→Backend (HTTP with an internal token), with a prepared browser transport fallback. It includes developer workflows for local dev, build, Windows packaging, i18n and ESLint/Prettier tooling—suited for professional cross-platform terminal management tools.

metadata.name: ECC
metadata.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

summary.zh: ECC 是面向 AI 智能体的 harness 原生操作系统，集技能、直觉、记忆优化、持续学习与安全扫描于一体，支持 Claude/Codex/Gemini/Copilot 等多种 agent 平台与 MCP 配置。提供生产级代理、技能库、钩子与跨平台部署路径，便于快速研发、持续改进与运维自动化。
summary.en: ECC is a harness-native operator system for building and running production-grade AI agents. It bundles reusable skills, instincts, memory optimization, security scanning, continuous learning, hooks, rules and MCP configurations to support Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot and more. ECC targets cross-harness agent orchestration, research-first development and operational deployment (including the Hermes operator), enabling teams to ship automated agents, code assistants and secure agentized workflows with TypeScript/Python toolchains and GitHub App integrations.

metadata.name: treesandbox
metadata.description: Another Linux sandbox tool (in beta). Rootless. Allows unlimited nesting if you want. Single-file .py . No 3rd-party python lib needed.

summary.zh: Tree Sandbox 是一个无根单文件的 Linux 分层沙箱，采用“树形”多层子容器模型，支持无限嵌套、按需绑定主机路径/设备、可选隔离或代理的 GUI 转发（X11/Xpra/Wayland 选项未尽全），以及 rootless 网络命名空间与精细端口合并。无需镜像、守护进程或特殊 subuid，适合按策略隔离不受信任或半信任进程、硬件直通和轻量化安全测试与调试场景。
summary.en: Tree Sandbox is a rootless, single-file Linux sandbox implementing a tree-shaped, multi-layer container model. It allows unlimited nesting of lightweight sub-containers, on-demand bind mounts from the host (files, sockets, devices), optional GUI forwarding (X11, Xpra, isolated compositors), and rootless network namespaces with tun/tap and nftables plus fine-grained localhost port merging. No images, no system daemon, and no subuid/subgid required. It’s designed for layered application isolation, secure testing of untrusted or semi-trusted processes, and hardware passthrough in a minimal, image-free workflow.

metadata.name: cpx
metadata.description: cp reimagined

summary.zh: cpx 是基于 Rust 的 Linux 文件复制工具，提供并行多线程拷贝、可断点续传、精美进度条、gitignore 风格排除与完整属性保留，适合大规模备份与快速迁移场景。
summary.en: cpx is a Rust-based Linux file-copy utility offering parallel (multi-threaded) transfers, resume support, rich progress bars, gitignore-style excludes, and full attribute preservation—optimized for fast backups and large-file migrations.

metadata.name: RuView
metadata.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.

summary.zh: RuView将普通WiFi的CSI信号转为实时空间感知与生命体征监测平台。基于ESP32网状边缘节点与Rust边缘模块（可配Cognitum Seed），无需摄像头或云端，支持穿墙存在检测、人数统计、呼吸与心率、动作识别、环境映射及无相机的17关键点姿态估计；用脉冲神经网络实现秒级本地自适应，多频网格扫描并以Ed25519链路对测量作加密证明，面向隐私保护的家居与医疗监测场景。
summary.en: RuView converts commodity WiFi CSI into real-time spatial intelligence on low-cost edge hardware. Using an ESP32-S3 mesh and Rust edge modules (optionally paired with a Cognitum Seed for secure storage and attestation), it detects presence, counts occupants, tracks motion, monitors breathing and heart rate, recognizes activities, maps environments, and provides 17-keypoint pose estimation without cameras. The system leverages spiking neural networks for rapid local adaptation, multi-channel scanning using nearby routers as illuminators, and Ed25519 cryptographic attestation—enabling privacy-preserving, offline home, elder-care, security and monitoring deployments.

metadata.name: chops
metadata.description: Your AI agent skills, finally organized. A macOS app to browse, edit, and manage skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and Amp.

summary.zh: Chops 是 macOS 桌面应用，用于发现、编辑与管理 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Windsurf 等多种 AI 代理技能。内置单字体编辑器与前置信息解析、实时文件监控、全文检索、集合组织与按工具生成样板，并支持连接 OpenClaw/Hermes 远程服务器，方便将分散在 dotfiles 或远端的技能统一浏览、编目与安装。
summary.en: Chops is a macOS desktop app to discover, edit and organize AI agent skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf and Amp. It offers a built-in monospaced editor with frontmatter parsing, real-time file watching, full-text search, collections, per-tool boilerplate generation, and integration with remote OpenClaw/Hermes servers to browse, sync and install skills from local or remote sources.

metadata.name: filter-repo-rs
metadata.description: 🦀 A high-performance Rust implementation of git-filter-repo for efficiently rewriting Git repository history. Remove sensitive data, shrink repos, and restructure projects with streaming pipeline architecture.

summary.zh: filter-repo-rs 是用 Rust 编写的高性能 Git 历史重写工具，采用流式管线架构，可高效移除历史泄露的密钥与敏感文件、瘦身仓库并重构路径。内置秘密检测、替换规则、身份规范化、分析、备份与审计报告，支持 dry-run 与跨平台执行（含 Windows 路径兼容策略），适用于需要安全清理、仓库瘦身与子目录提取的开发与运维场景。
summary.en: filter-repo-rs is a high-performance Rust implementation of git-filter-repo that rewrites Git history using a streaming pipeline. It safely and efficiently removes leaked secrets and large blobs, slims repositories, restructures paths, extracts subdirectories, renames refs, and normalizes author/committer identities. Built-in features include secret detection, replace-text rules, mailmap/explicit identity rewrites, analysis, dry-run, backups, and detailed audit reports. Designed for cross-platform use with Git on PATH, it prioritizes safety and speed for large repositories and supports Windows path compatibility policies.

metadata.name: API-Police
metadata.description: API Police is a multi-dimensional model authenticity auditing tool for verifying whether a third-party API provider is truly serving the model it claims.

summary.zh: API Police 是一款多维模型真实性审计工具。通过7层检测（分词器指纹、能力阶梯、行为指纹、logprobs、性能、知识边界、直接探测）并结合官方指纹校准与 quick/full 模式，对第三方 API 的宣称模型进行高置信度鉴别与批量校准，适用于合规、安全与供应链验证场景。
summary.en: API Police is a multi-dimensional model authenticity auditing tool that verifies whether a third-party API truly serves the model it claims. It implements a seven-layer verification framework—tokenizer fingerprinting, capability ladder, behavioral fingerprinting, log-probs distribution, performance profiling, knowledge-boundary tests, and direct probes—and supports fingerprint calibration against official endpoints to build trusted baselines. Provides quick (triage) and full (high-confidence) audit modes, batch calibration CLI, and JSON reporting for security, compliance, and supply-chain assurance.

metadata.name: glazepkg
metadata.description: See all your installed packages in one place.

summary.zh: GlazePKG 用 Go + Bubble Tea 实现的跨平台终端 TUI，一次性汇总 36 种包管理器的已装软件。支持本地缓存、模糊搜索、批量升级/卸载、快照与差异比对以及 JSON 导出，便于系统迁移、备份与运维审计。单文件无依赖，启动迅速。
summary.en: GlazePKG is a cross-platform Go TUI (built with Bubble Tea) that consolidates 36 package managers into one searchable dashboard. It offers caching, fuzzy search, batch upgrade/remove, snapshots and diffs, and JSON export—useful for migration, backups, and audit. Single static binary with zero runtime dependencies.

metadata.name: SwiftBar
metadata.description: Powerful macOS menu bar customization tool

summary.zh: SwiftBar 是一款 macOS 菜单栏定制工具，使用 Swift 开发并兼容 BitBar/xbar 插件。通过将可执行脚本放入插件文件夹并在文件名中指定刷新间隔，自动加载并在菜单栏展示实时标题与下拉菜单。支持 .swiftbarignore、符号链接、内置插件仓库和 Homebrew 安装，适合快速构建系统监控、通知与轻量仪表盘。
summary.en: SwiftBar is a lightweight macOS menu bar customization app written in Swift and compatible with BitBar/xbar plugins. Plugins are simple executable scripts placed into a watched Plugin Folder; filenames encode refresh intervals and SwiftBar auto-makes scripts executable and parses their STDOUT to render the menu header and dropdown items. It supports .swiftbarignore, nested folders and symlinks, a built-in plugin repository, and Homebrew installation. Ideal for quickly creating status items, system monitors, notifications and compact dashboards using any scripting language.

metadata.name: Surge
metadata.description: Rule Snippet & Rule Set for Surge / Mihomo (Clash.Meta) / Clash Premium (Dreamacro) / sing-box / Surfboard for Android / Stash

summary.zh: Sukka Ruleset 是一套维护的跨客户端代理规则集，适用于 Surge、Clash（Mihomo/Premium）、sing‑box、Surfboard 与 Stash。按 domainset/non_ip/ip 分层输出域名、非 IP 与 IP 规则，包含自动生成的广告、恶意与钓鱼拦截列表，并提供规则顺序与镜像以缓解 DNS 污染。仓库以 AGPL‑3.0（部分列表为 CC BY‑SA 2.0）开源，不提供担保或技术支持。
summary.en: Sukka Ruleset is a curated, user-maintained collection of rulesets and snippets for proxy clients including Surge, Clash (Mihomo/Clash Premium), sing-box, Surfboard for Android, and Stash. It offers layered outputs—domainset, non_ip and ip formats—covering domain-only, non-IP and IP-based rules. The project includes generated ad, malware and phishing blocklists, guidance on rule ordering to mitigate DNS pollution, and public mirrors/ruleset servers. Documentation covers usage examples, Surge pre-matching/extended-matching options and Mihomo behavior optimizations. The code is open-sourced under AGPL‑3.0 (some lists CC BY‑SA 2.0); no warranty or support is provided.

metadata.name: iDescriptor
metadata.description: A free, open-source, and cross-platform iDevice management tool

summary.zh: iDescriptor 是用 Rust 与 Qt 开发的跨平台免费开源 iDevice（iPhone/iPad）管理工具，支持设备信息查看、备份恢复、文件与应用管理，并提供 Windows/macOS/Linux 原生安装包与多平台打包发布。
summary.en: iDescriptor is a free, open-source, cross-platform iDevice (iPhone/iPad) manager built with Rust and Qt. It offers device info, backups/restores, file and app management, and native installers/packages for Windows, macOS and Linux.

metadata.name: ForkFlow
metadata.description: ForkFlow ⚡ 一键批量同步 GitHub Fork，自动清理僵尸仓库，让你的分叉永远与上游保持光速同步！🔥

summary.zh: ForkFlow 是面向开发者的 Fork 管理仪表盘，支持一键批量同步 GitHub Fork、自动导入所有分叉并定期清理已取消或被删除的僵尸仓库。前端纯原生 HTML/CSS/JS 极简轻量，后端可选本地 Node.js 或 Cloudflare Workers（KV），直接调用 GitHub Merge Upstream API，无需额外权限，适合需要批量维护分叉仓库并简化同步与运维流程的个人和团队。
summary.en: ForkFlow is a developer-focused dashboard that automates GitHub fork maintenance: one-click bulk sync, auto-import of all forks, and periodic cleanup of stale or unlinked repositories. The frontend is ultra-lightweight (plain HTML/CSS/vanilla JS) and the backend can run locally on Node.js or serverless on Cloudflare Workers (using KV). It calls the GitHub Merge Upstream API directly with minimal permission requirements. Ideal for developers and teams who need to keep many forks up-to-date, reduce manual sync work, and simplify fork lifecycle management.

metadata.name: rip
metadata.description: Fuzzy find and kill processes from your terminal

summary.zh: rip 是一个用 Rust 编写的命令行工具，通过模糊查找在终端定位并发送信号终止进程。支持按 CPU/MEM/PID/NAME/PORT 排序、端口模式与实时刷新，并可选择 SIGKILL/SIGTERM 等信号，便于开发者与运维快速释放端口或终止挂起进程。提供 Cargo、Homebrew 与 Nix 安装包，强调交互速度与简洁易用的多选杀进程流程。
summary.en: rip is a Rust-based terminal CLI that provides a fuzzy-finder interface to locate and send signals to processes interactively. It supports pre-filtering, sorting by CPU, memory, PID, name or port, a ports mode to show listeners, selectable signals (e.g., SIGKILL, SIGTERM), and live auto-refresh. Users can select multiple processes and kill them from the terminal, making it handy for developers and operators to free ports or terminate runaway processes. Distributed via Cargo, Homebrew and Nix, rip emphasizes speed, simplicity and safe interactive control over local processes.

metadata.name: rtk
metadata.description: CLI proxy that reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common dev commands. Single Rust binary, zero dependencies

summary.zh: rtk 是单文件 Rust CLI 代理，拦截并压缩常见开发命令输出，在 100+ 命令上将 LLM 上下文令牌消耗降低 60–90%，延迟 <10ms、零依赖，适用于代码审查、测试与 Git 工作流以显著节省 API 成本。
summary.en: rtk is a single-file Rust CLI proxy that compresses developer command output to cut LLM token use by 60–90% across 100+ commands, with <10ms overhead and zero dependencies—ideal for cost-saving in code review, tests, and Git workflows.

metadata.name: IPDB
metadata.description: Cloudflare反代优选IP库

summary.zh: IPDB 提供面向 Cloudflare 的高性能 IP 信息与反代优选列表 HTTP API。支持 cfv4/cfv6/proxy/bestcf/bestproxy 多类型、实时或定时更新，可附带国家/地区信息或下载文件。适用于 CDN/反代路由优化、白名单与防火墙规则自动化，同步频率可控、部署轻量且开源（MIT），便于将最新 Cloudflare 反代 IP 集成到运维流程中。
summary.en: IPDB is a high-performance HTTP API that delivers Cloudflare-focused IP data and optimized reverse-proxy IP lists. It supports types like cfv4, cfv6, proxy, bestcf and bestproxy with real-time or scheduled updates, optional GeoIP tagging, and file download. Ideal for CDN/reverse-proxy routing optimization, whitelist and firewall automation, it simplifies keeping infrastructure synchronized with Cloudflare IP changes. Lightweight, easy to integrate and MIT-licensed, the README includes usage limits and data-source disclaimers.

metadata.name: Capsense
metadata.description: Repurpose the CapsLock key for switching input methods on Windows.

summary.zh: Capsense 将 Windows 上的 CapsLock 改造为轻触切换输入法、长按保留大写功能的常驻工具。适合需要快速切换键盘布局或在中文输入场景避免误切换的用户。支持自定义轻触阈值、触发快捷键或按布局轮换、实例管理与无头/交互模式，默认低资源占用且无需管理员权限（仅在控制提升应用时需提升）。兼容防止中文 IME 切到英文模式的选项，使用简单易配置。
summary.en: Capsense repurposes the CapsLock key on Windows so a short tap cycles input methods while a long press retains the original CapsLock behavior. It runs as a lightweight background desktop app with an optional GUI instance manager, configurable tap threshold, selectable layouts or shortcut actions (e.g., Win+Space), and a no-English-mode option for Chinese IMEs. No admin is required except to affect elevated apps. Supports headless or interactive modes and runtime reload/stop/status via CLI, focusing on minimal resource use and predictable IME switching.

metadata.name: Understand-Anything
metadata.description: Graphs that teach > graphs that impress. Turn any code, or knowledge base (Karpathy LLM wiki), into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore, search, and ask questions about. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.

summary.zh: 将任意代码库或文档转换为可交互的知识图谱，兼容 Claude、Codex、Copilot 等大模型。通过多代理流水线抽取文件、函数与依赖，提供可视化浏览、搜索与问答，帮助开发者快速理解大型代码库结构与上下文，加速入职、审查和架构发现。
summary.en: Turns any codebase, docs, or knowledge base into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore, search, and query. Using a multi-agent pipeline with LLM integrations (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, etc.), it extracts files, functions, classes and dependencies and presents a visual dashboard for navigation, contextual search and Q&A. Designed for onboarding, code review and architecture discovery, it helps developers quickly grasp large codebases by exposing structure and relationships.

metadata.name: Win11Debloat
metadata.description: A simple, lightweight PowerShell script that allows you to remove pre-installed apps, disable telemetry, as well as perform various other changes to declutter and customize your Windows experience. Win11Debloat works for both Windows 10 and Windows 11.

summary.zh: Win11Debloat 是一款轻量 PowerShell 脚本，可移除预装应用、关闭遥测、清理界面并自定义 Windows（支持 Windows 10/11）。面向系统管理员与进阶用户，提供命令行参数、Audit 模式及对其他用户的修改选项，便于批量部署、隐私与性能优化。脚本需管理员权限运行，支持一键下载安装和无人值守参数，使用前请阅读文档并在目标环境中小心测试。
summary.en: Win11Debloat is a lightweight PowerShell script for quickly decluttering and customizing Windows 10 and Windows 11 desktops. It removes preinstalled apps, disables telemetry, hides intrusive UI elements, and applies privacy and performance tweaks. Built for system administrators and advanced users, it exposes a command-line interface, supports Audit mode, and can modify other user profiles for mass deployment. Installation can be done via a one-liner or manual execution, and numerous parameters enable unattended runs. Administrative privileges are required; review documentation and test before applying to production machines.

metadata.name: MoneyPrinterV2
metadata.description: Automate the process of making money online.

summary.zh: MoneyPrinterV2 是用 Python 重构的线上变现自动化工具，采用模块化架构，集成带 CRON 的 Twitter 机器人、YouTube Shorts 自动上传、亚马逊联盟推广与本地商家爬取与冷邮/外联脚本。提供示例配置与命令脚本，便于快速部署和定时任务调度（需 Python 3.12）。项目以教学与自动化营销为主，强调可扩展性与脚本化运行，需注意合规与责任使用。
summary.en: MoneyPrinterV2 is a Python-based, modular platform that automates online monetization workflows. It combines scheduler-driven Twitter bots, YouTube Shorts automation, Amazon affiliate marketing integration, and local business discovery with outreach and scraping scripts. With example configs and helper scripts for quick, scriptable deployment, it targets creators and small teams building automated social media and affiliate funnels.
