The project requires Python 3.12, is AGPLv3-licensed, emphasizes education and extensibility, and includes CRON scheduling for recurring tasks while urging responsible use.

metadata.name: HardwareQuality
metadata.description: 硬件质量检测脚本 - Hardware Quality Check Script

summary.zh: HardwareQuality：跨发行版与多架构的硬件体检与基准脚本。采集CPU/GPU、内存、硬盘、主板与网卡等详尽信息，集成sysbench、fio、Geekbench与SMART检测，支持JSON输出与可视化比对，提供交互/静默/Docker运行与隐私模式。新增HQ加权评分与深度模式，适用于运维、VPS/裸金属验收与硬件性能分析。
summary.en: HardwareQuality is a cross-distro, multi-architecture hardware inspection and benchmarking script. It collects detailed CPU, GPU, memory, disk, motherboard, audio and network data, integrates sysbench, fio and optional Geekbench runs, and gathers SMART/NVMe health info. Outputs include JSON for analytics, visual benchmark comparisons, interactive and headless modes, Docker support, and a privacy mode that disables uploads. Recent updates add HQ weighted scoring and expanded deep-mode diagnostics, making it suitable for sysadmins, VPS providers and hardware acceptance testing.

metadata.name: zeroclaw
metadata.description: Fast, small, and fully autonomous AI personal assistant infrastructure, ANY OS, ANY PLATFORM — deploy anywhere, swap anything 🦀

summary.zh: ZeroClaw 是紧凑高效的个人 AI 助手运行时，单个 Rust 二进制可本地部署，兼容多家大模型并接入 30+ 通道，能通过 shell、浏览器、HTTP 等工具执行操作，强调私有化数据与可插拔组件，支持跨平台部署。
summary.en: ZeroClaw: a compact Rust agent runtime—local-first, provider-agnostic, 30+ channels, pluggable tools for private cross-platform AI assistants.

metadata.name: Lattice_release
metadata.description: A lightweight macOS literature manager built in native Swift.

summary.zh: Lattice 是为 macOS 原生打造的轻量文献管理器（Swift，需 macOS 14+）。它链接而非复制 PDF，聚焦元数据管理、PDF 注释提取、模板化导出（Markdown/BibTeX/TextBundle）与 Apple Shortcuts 自动化。适合作为已有阅读器用户的元数据、笔记与导出中心，强调小体积、低内存占用与开放可迁移的工作流，而非企图替代完整的阅读器或一体化科研平台。
summary.en: Lattice is a lightweight, native Swift literature manager for macOS (requires macOS 14+). It links to PDFs instead of importing them, focusing on metadata management, PDF annotation extraction, template-based export (Markdown, BibTeX, TextBundle), and Apple Shortcuts integration. Designed as a lean hub for users who prefer their own PDF reader, Lattice emphasizes a native macOS experience, small app/memory footprint, and automation-friendly, portable workflows rather than a full-featured all‑in‑one research platform.

metadata.name: KittenTTS
metadata.description: State-of-the-art TTS model under 25MB 😻

summary.zh: Kitten TTS 是基于 ONNX 的开源轻量级文本到语音库，模型规模 15–80M（磁盘约 25–80MB），支持 CPU 高效推理并提供 int8 量化版本。内置 8 种音色、24kHz 输出、语速可调与文本预处理，方便移动端、嵌入式和离线边缘部署，无需 GPU。适用于移动应用、嵌入式设备与资源受限服务器，兼顾音质、体积与推理性能。
summary.en: Kitten TTS is an open-source, ultra-lightweight text-to-speech library built on ONNX, offering models from 15M to 80M parameters (≈25–80 MB). It delivers 24 kHz audio with efficient CPU inference and an int8-quantized nano model optimized for edge and offline deployment without a GPU. Features include eight built-in voices, playback speed control, and robust text preprocessing. With a simple Python API, Hugging Face demo, and commercial support, it targets mobile apps, embedded devices, accessibility tools, and resource-constrained servers needing on-device TTS.

metadata.name: CloudflareSpeedTest
metadata.description: 🌩「自选优选 IP」测试 Cloudflare CDN 延迟和速度，获取最快 IP ！当然也支持其他 CDN / 多个解析 IP 的网站 ~

summary.zh: CloudflareSpeedTest 是一款用 Go 开发的跨平台命令行工具，按自选 IP 列表对 Cloudflare（及其他 CDN）IPv4/IPv6 进行延迟与下载速率测试，帮助用户批量并发定位最快可用 IP。提供可执行文件发布、并发测速、结果导出与下载测速选项，适用于网络优化、访问加速与 CDN 节点调优（注意遵循 Cloudflare 使用政策）。
summary.en: CloudflareSpeedTest is a cross-platform command-line tool written in Go that tests latency and download speed for Cloudflare CDN IPs (IPv4 and IPv6) from user-selected IP lists. It performs concurrent bulk probing to help identify the fastest reachable IPs, supports testing other CDNs or multi‑IP hostnames, offers downloadable binaries for major platforms, and can export results. It is aimed at network optimization, access acceleration and CDN node tuning while advising compliance with Cloudflare policies.

metadata.name: zoxide
metadata.description: A smarter cd command. Supports all major shells.

summary.zh: zoxide 是用 Rust 编写的跨平台命令行增强工具，替代传统 cd。它根据目录使用频率和模糊匹配算法快速跳转常用路径，支持所有主流 shell、交互选择（zi）、fzf 补全与高效匹配，安装方便且开销低，易于脚本集成。适合开发者与高级终端用户显著提升目录导航效率与工作流流畅度。
summary.en: zoxide is a Rust-based, cross-platform smarter replacement for cd that learns your directory habits and enables fast fuzzy jumping to frequently used paths. It supports all major shells, interactive selection (zi) with fzf integration, tab-completion, and an efficient ranking/matching algorithm. Available via installers and package managers for Linux, macOS, Windows and WSL, zoxide is low-overhead, scriptable, and designed to speed up terminal navigation for developers and power users.

metadata.name: agentskills-mcp
metadata.description: AgentSkills MCP: Bringing Anthropic's Agent Skills to Any MCP-compatible Agent

summary.zh: AgentSkills MCP 将 Anthropic 的 Agent Skills 带到任意 MCP 兼容代理。基于 FlowLLM，支持 stdio/SSE/HTTP 多种传输，提供零代码 pip 安装并兼容官方 Skill 格式，能自动识别、解析本地技能目录并按需加载技能（Progressive Disclosure），适合将 Claude 风格的模块化能力无缝集成到自定义代理、远端服务或多传输代理部署中。
summary.en: AgentSkills MCP brings Anthropic’s Agent Skills to any MCP-compatible agent by implementing Progressive Disclosure on top of the FlowLLM framework. It offers a zero-code pip install, multi-transport support (stdio/SSE/HTTP), and full compatibility with Anthropic’s official Skill format. The package auto-detects skill directories, parses SKILL.md assets, and loads specialized skills on demand to reduce context footprint. Typical uses include extending Claude-style modular skills to custom agents, running remote skill servers, and integrating specialized capabilities into heterogeneous MCP-based deployments.

metadata.name: uv
metadata.description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.

summary.zh: uv 是用 Rust 编写的跨平台高性能 Python 包与项目管理器，旨在替代 pip/poetry 等工具。它提供虚拟环境与 Python 版本管理、统一锁文件与工作区支持、全局缓存去重依赖，并兼容 pip 接口与脚本内联依赖。安装速度较 pip 快 10–100 倍，可通过 curl 或 pip 无需 Rust/Python 安装，支持 macOS、Linux 与 Windows。
summary.en: uv is an extremely fast, cross-platform Python package and project manager written in Rust that aims to replace tools like pip, poetry, pipx and virtualenv. It provides comprehensive project features: virtual environments, Python version management, a universal lockfile, Cargo-style workspaces, and a global cache for disk-efficient dependency deduplication. uv offers a pip-compatible interface for drop-in performance gains, runs package-published tools and scripts with inline dependency metadata, claims 10–100× faster installs than pip, and is installable via curl or pip on macOS, Linux and Windows.

metadata.name: pixi
metadata.description: Powerful system-level package manager for Linux, macOS and Windows written in Rust – building on top of the Conda ecosystem.

summary.zh: Pixi 是以 Rust 实现、基于 Conda 生态的跨平台系统级包管理器与工作流工具。它提供类似 Cargo/NPM 的简洁命令行体验，支持 Python、C++、R 等多语言包的项目级或全局安装，始终维护锁文件以保证可重复构建，兼容 Linux、macOS（含 Apple Silicon）与 Windows，目标是简化开发者的依赖管理与可复现部署流程。
summary.en: Pixi is a cross-platform, system-level package manager and workflow tool written in Rust on top of the Conda ecosystem. It delivers a Cargo/NPM-like CLI for installing multi-language packages (Python, C++, R) either per-project or system-wide, maintains an always-up-to-date lock file for reproducible environments, and supports Linux, macOS (including Apple Silicon), and Windows. Pixi leverages rattler/Conda tooling and prefix.dev packages to streamline reproducible developer workflows, deterministic installs, and simpler publishing and deployment.

metadata.name: OpenCLI
metadata.description: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.

summary.zh: OpenCLI 将任意网站、已登录的 Chrome 会话、Electron 应用与本地工具统一暴露为可命令行调用的确定性接口。通过轻量级浏览器桥接扩展和本地守护进程，内置多站点适配器（如 Bilibili、知乎、Reddit 等），并允许 AI 智能体通过 opencli-browser 技能在已登录浏览器上导航、点击、填表与数据抽取，同时支持适配器快速生成、验证与作为本地 CLI 聚合中心扩展。
summary.en: OpenCLI turns any website, logged-in Chrome session, Electron app, or local tool into a deterministic CLI surface. Using a lightweight browser-bridge extension and local daemon, it ships built-in adapters (Bilibili, Zhihu, Reddit, HackerNews, Twitter/X, etc.), enables AI agents via the opencli-browser skill to navigate, click, type/fill, and extract from pages in your logged-in browser, and provides an end-to-end authoring and verification workflow. It also serves as a CLI hub for local binaries and desktop app adapters, extensible via Node.js.

metadata.name: camofox-browser
metadata.description: Anti-detection browser server for AI agents — REST API wrapping Camoufox engine with OpenClaw plugin support

summary.zh: 本项目将 Camoufox（引擎级 Firefox 分支）封装为 TypeScript 实现的 REST 服务并兼容 OpenClaw。以 C++ 级别的指纹伪装替代脆弱的 JS 补丁，提供稳健的反检测能力。支持多会话与隔离上下文、持久化用户 Firefox 配置、会话级代理与地域预设、可访问性快照（带稳定元素引用）与结构化 JSON 抽取，以及图片提取与跟踪功能。面向 AI 智能体与跨语言自动化爬虫，便于通过 HTTP 驱动隐蔽浏览与精确数据采集。
summary.en: CamoFox Browser Server wraps Camoufox (an engine-level Firefox fork) into a TypeScript REST API with OpenClaw-compatible endpoints. It delivers C++-level fingerprint spoofing instead of fragile JS patches, providing robust anti-detection for AI agents and automated crawlers. Key features include multi-session isolated contexts, persistent per-user Firefox profiles, per-session proxy and geo presets, accessibility snapshots with stable element references, deterministic JSON structured extraction, image extraction and tracing support. The language-agnostic REST surface enables MCP/OpenClaw agents to drive covert browsing, precise interactions and efficient data collection.

metadata.name: Chaoxing-MiniProgram
metadata.description: ⭐⭐学习通签到助手⭐⭐ 本项目基于原生微信小程序开发，无需安装 签到更快捷，支持转发快速代签！无需安装，无安全隐患！✨非开源版支持自动通过滑块验证码，支持批量二维码签到，更多细节请阅读文档！

summary.zh: 学习通签到助手——基于原生微信小程序的轻量级自动签到工具，无需安装第三方客户端，适合学生快速完成定位、拍照与二维码签到。支持转发代签、非开源版自动通过滑块验证码与批量二维码签到。项目提供自建小程序与边缘代理方案，旨在降低封禁与限流风险，侧重用于技术学习和个人/院校自部署。
summary.en: Chaoxing MiniProgram Sign-in Assistant is a lightweight native WeChat Mini Program that automates attendance for the Chaoxing learning platform without installing extra clients. It streamlines location, photo, and QR-code sign-ins and supports forwarding quick proxy sign-ins for others. The open-source edition is no longer actively maintained; a non-open edition adds features like automatic slider captcha solving and batch QR sign-ins. The project documents self-hosted mini-program deployment and edge/Cloudflare worker proxying to mitigate server forwarding, rate limiting, and banning risks, intended for learning and personal deployment.

metadata.name: cloud-mail
metadata.description: A Cloudflare-based email service  | 基于 Cloudflare 的邮箱服务  | Cloudflare Email 邮箱 Mail

summary.zh: Cloud Mail 是基于 Cloudflare 的自托管邮箱平台，可在 Workers 上以单域名低成本部署。支持发收邮件与附件、群发、转发和推送，集成 Resend、R2、D1 与 Workers AI（验证码识别）及 Turnstile 防刷。提供响应式 Vue 前端、管理员 RBAC、开放 API、R2 文件存储与 ECharts 可视化，适合个人与企业搭建多账户邮箱、自动化邮件处理与消息转发场景。
summary.en: Cloud Mail is a lightweight, Cloudflare-based self-hosted email platform designed for low-cost deployment on Cloudflare Workers. It supports sending and receiving emails with attachments, bulk mail, forwarding, and push notifications, and integrates Resend, Cloudflare R2 and D1, Workers AI for OTP recognition, and Turnstile for anti-bot. Built with Hono, Drizzle and a Vue3/Element Plus frontend, it offers RBAC administration, open APIs, R2 file storage, KV caching, and ECharts visualizations. Suitable for individuals or organizations needing single-domain multi-account mailboxes and automated mail workflows.

metadata.name: nodewarden
metadata.description: Bitwarden-compatible server running on Cloudflare Workers

summary.zh: NodeWarden 是一款可自托管的 Bitwarden 兼容服务端，运行于 Cloudflare Workers，支持 R2/KV 存储与 D1 数据库、附件上传下载、原生 Web Vault、/api/sync 全量同步以及定时云端备份（WebDAV/S3）。兼容官方客户端、浏览器扩展与移动端，提供 ZIP 附件导入/导出与 Send 功能，适合在无专用服务器环境下进行轻量密码库托管与迁移。
summary.en: NodeWarden is a Bitwarden-compatible, self-hostable server designed to run on Cloudflare Workers. It delivers a native Web Vault, full /api/sync compatibility with official clients, attachment handling via R2 or KV, D1 database support, Send (text/file), ZIP import/export including attachments, and scheduled cloud backups (WebDAV/S3). Optimized for serverless deployment with easy GitHub + Wrangler workflows, it targets lightweight password hosting and migration without dedicated servers while maintaining broad client compatibility (desktop, mobile, browser extensions).

metadata.name: MCP-SuperAssistant
metadata.description: Brings MCP to ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Perplexity, Grok, Gemini, Google AI Studio, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, T3 Chat and more...

summary.zh: MCP SuperAssistant 是一款浏览器扩展，把 Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 注入 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini 等网页版 AI 平台，允许在对话界面直接调用 MCP 工具与外部数据源，扩展检索、插件与工作流能力。支持 Chrome 与 Firefox，并与 OpenRouter、Copilot、Mistral 等服务集成，便于将企业数据和自定义工具无缝接入对话式 AI 环境。
summary.en: MCP SuperAssistant is a browser extension that injects Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) into major web-based AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Studio, Grok and more. It enables users to invoke MCP tools and external data sources directly from chat interfaces, extending retrieval, tool execution, and workflow integrations. The extension supports Chrome and Firefox, integrates with services like OpenRouter, Copilot and Mistral, and aims to bring enterprise data access and custom tool connectivity into conversational AI without modifying host platforms.

metadata.name: AstrBot
metadata.description: AI Agent Assistant & development framework that integrates lots of IM platforms, LLMs, plugins and AI feature, and can be your openclaw alternative. ✨

summary.zh: AstrBot 是一个开源一体化智能体与开发框架，整合多家即时通讯平台、可插拔插件市场、LLM 接入与丰富 AI 功能。提供可扩展的会话基础设施、流水线和 SDK，便于构建多渠道聊天机器人、企业助手及自动化代理，适合自托管与二次开发。
summary.en: AstrBot is an open-source all-in-one AI agent and development framework that integrates multiple IM platforms, a plugin marketplace, LLM connectors and AI features. It provides scalable conversational infrastructure, pipelines and SDKs for building multi-channel chatbots, enterprise assistants and automated agents—suitable for self-hosting and extensible development.

metadata.name: AI-Search-Hub
metadata.description: One Query. All Search Skill. 聚合 Gemini、Grok、豆包、元宝等平台原生 AI 搜索能力，免费获取科技趋势、行业舆情、热点追踪、旅行规划、日常问题统一接进自己的 Agent 与工作流，指定链接免费爬取

summary.zh: AI Search Hub 将 Gemini、Grok、豆包等厂商的原生 AI 搜索与网页抽取能力聚合，支持跨平台一次提问或指定链接抓取，清洗并结构化社交媒体数据，统一回收到 Agent/工作流，免除自建爬虫、登录与风控维护成本。
summary.en: AI Search Hub aggregates native AI search and web-extraction (Gemini, Grok, Doubao, etc.), enabling cross-platform queries or link-based scraping to collect, clean and structure social data for integration into agents and workflows, avoiding custom crawlers and login/anti-bot overhead.

metadata.name: claude-context
metadata.description: Code search MCP for Claude Code. Make entire codebase the context for any coding agent.

summary.zh: Claude Context 是基于 MCP 的插件，为 Claude Code 等代码智能体提供语义代码检索。通过 OpenAI 嵌入将源码向量化并存入 Milvus/Zilliz Cloud 向量库，能从百万行代码中高效检索相关片段，避免每次请求加载整个仓库以节省 token 和计算成本。项目以 Node.js 实现，提供 MCP 服务、npm 包与 VS Code 扩展，便于把整个代码库作为模型上下文并与持久化记忆（memsearch）配合使用。
summary.en: Claude Context is an MCP plugin that provides semantic code search for Claude Code and other AI coding assistants, treating an entire repository as searchable context. It builds vectors using OpenAI embeddings and stores them in a vector database (Milvus/Zilliz Cloud), enabling retrieval of relevant code snippets from millions of lines without loading whole directories into the model. This approach reduces token and compute costs, scales to large codebases, and integrates via Node.js MCP components, npm packages and a VS Code extension. A companion project (memsearch) offers persistent agent memory across sessions.

metadata.name: recall
metadata.description: Full-text search and resume for Claude/Codex conversations

summary.zh: recall 是一款跨平台命令行工具，为 Claude/Codex 等对话建立本地全文索引，支持模糊或精确检索并一键将历史会话恢复到代理。无需MCP，可自定义恢复命令，方便开发者查找与复用对话上下文。
summary.en: recall is a cross-platform command-line utility that builds local full-text indexes of conversations from Claude, Codex, OpenCode and Factory, enabling fast fuzzy or precise search and one-command resumption of past sessions into an agent. It runs locally, requires no MCP, supports scope toggling, customizable resume commands via environment variables, and integrates with typical agent CLIs. It includes interactive navigation, session ID copying, and keyboard-driven controls.

metadata.name: IPQuality
metadata.description: IP质量检测脚本 - IP Quality Check Script

summary.zh: IPQuality 是跨平台的 Bash IP 质量与信誉检测脚本，支持 IPv4/IPv6、交互与参数模式，整合 MaxMind、IPinfo、AbuseIPDB、IP2Location、IPQS 等多源风控数据并检查 400+ 黑名单，提供流媒体解锁和邮件连通性检测，能输出美观终端报告或 JSON/ANSI/纯文本文件，支持 Docker、代理与隐私模式，便于网络运维与安全评估与共享结果。
summary.en: IPQuality is a cross-platform Bash IP quality and reputation checker that runs interactively or via CLI/Docker. It supports IPv4/IPv6, proxy and privacy modes, and outputs terminal-friendly ANSI reports or machine-readable JSON/text. The tool aggregates MaxMind and multiple risk sources (IPinfo, AbuseIPDB, IP2Location, IPQS, DB-IP, Scamalytics, Cloudflare risk), checks against 400+ blacklists, and tests streaming service unlock status and mail-provider connectivity. Built for network ops and security assessments, it automates dependency handling and produces concise, shareable reports.

metadata.name: impeccable
metadata.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.

summary.zh: Impeccable 是面向大模型的前端设计语言与技能集，包含7类设计参考、23条交互命令与27条确定性反模式规则。提供 CLI 与浏览器扩展可离线运行检测，并配套 12 条 LLM 深度评审。可生成 DESIGN.md、抽取组件与 tokens，自动化审校可访问性、响应式与系统化设计准则，帮助将 AI 建议转成可落地、生产就绪的前端方案。
summary.en: Impeccable is a design language and LLM skillset that makes AI-driven frontend design more consistent and production-ready. It includes seven domain references (typography, color, motion, spatial, interaction, responsive, UX writing), 23 slash-commands for tasks like polish, audit, extract and animate, 27 deterministic anti-pattern rules, and a 12-rule LLM critique. A CLI and browser extension can run deterministic checks offline without an API key. Use it to generate DESIGN.md, extract tokens/components, enforce accessibility and responsive patterns, and automate design review and polishing.

metadata.name: AITextDetector
metadata.description: Using SVM to classify human/AI-generated creative writing text

summary.zh: 本项目用支持向量机(SVM)对中文创作文本区分人类与AI生成，侧重中文创作的特征工程与训练并提供在线演示。仓库包含作者自写的训练/加载脚本，其余由Claude生成。注意模型对非训练域文本有系统性偏差。
summary.en: This repository implements an SVM-based detector that classifies Chinese creative writing as human- or AI-generated. The project emphasizes handcrafted feature engineering and supervised training specifically for Chinese creative prose, and provides an online demo. The srctrain/train.py and srctrain/loader.py were authored by the repository owner while other code was generated by Claude Opus 4.6 and validated by the author. Intended for evaluating creative Chinese text, the model may show systematic bias on texts from other domains or languages.

metadata.name: banana-slides
metadata.description: 一个基于nano banana pro🍌的原生AI PPT生成应用，迈向真正的＂Vibe PPT＂; 支持上传任意模板图片；上传任意素材&智能解析；一句话/大纲/页面描述自动生成PPT；口头修改指定区域、一键导出可编辑ppt - An AI-native slides generator based on nano banana pro🍌

summary.zh: 基于 nano banana pro 的原生 AI 幻灯片生成器，支持上传任意模板与素材并智能解析；可通过一句话、大纲或逐页描述快速生成页面，支持口头/自然语言调整指定区域并一键导出可编辑PPT。强调高视觉一致性与风格可定制，显著降低排版门槛，适用于教育、职场与创意场景，目标打造真正的“Vibe PPT”。
summary.en: Banana Slides is an AI-native slide generator built on the nano banana pro model that produces high-quality, style-consistent presentation pages from a one-line prompt, outline, or per-slide description. It accepts arbitrary template images and asset uploads, intelligently parses materials, supports natural-language or spoken edits to specific regions, and exports editable PPTX files. Focused on rapid creation of visually distinct "Vibe PPTs", it reduces manual layout work while enabling iterative customization for educators, students, designers and business users.

metadata.name: mise
metadata.description: dev tools, env vars, task runner

summary.zh: mise 是一款用 Rust 开发的跨平台 CLI，统一在 mise.toml 中管理项目的开发工具版本、环境变量和任务。它能自动安装并切换多版本工具（如 node、python、terraform）、按目录加载 .env 和其他来源的变量，并运行构建/测试/部署等任务。适用于本地开发、CI 与新终端初始化，保证不同机器与 shell 间的一致性与可重复性，提供注册表与激活钩子，真实安装可执行文件而非仅用 shim。
summary.en: mise is a cross-platform CLI written in Rust that centralizes developer tools, environment variables, and task definitions in a single mise.toml. It can install and switch between hundreds of tool versions (node, python, terraform, etc.), load per-directory environment settings including .env files and other sources, and run defined tasks for build/test/lint/deploy. Designed for local shells, fresh checkouts, and CI, mise ensures reproducible, consistent environments across machines and shells, integrates a tool registry, exposes a task runner, and installs real binaries rather than shims.

metadata.name: cc-switch
metadata.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI & Hermes Agent. Only official website: ccswitch.io

summary.zh: CC Switch 是基于 Tauri 的跨平台桌面管理器，聚合 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、OpenCode、OpenClaw 与 Hermes Agent 等多种模型与代理。提供统一的 API/代理配置、模型切换、CLI 与代理编排，便于在多供应商与本地代理间无缝切换、调试与成本控制，面向开发者与 AI 工程团队的一体化多模型管理工具。官网：ccswitch.io
summary.en: CC Switch is a Tauri-based cross-platform desktop manager that consolidates Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes Agent into one interface. It centralizes API and proxy configuration, model endpoint switching, CLI integration, and agent orchestration to enable seamless testing, switching and cost control across multiple LLM providers and local agents. Designed for developers and AI engineering teams, it simplifies multi-model workflows, environment management and hybrid provider setups. Official site: ccswitch.io

metadata.name: ClawRouter
metadata.description: The agent-native LLM router for OpenClaw. 41+ models, <1ms routing, USDC payments on Base & Solana via x402.

summary.zh: ClawRouter 是面向自治 AI 智能体的开源 LLM 路由器，本地运行且 <1ms 路由。它基于 15 维度评分在 55+ 模型间智能选路，能将 AI API 成本降低约 92%。无需注册或 API Key，使用本地钱包签名作为认证，并通过 x402 在 Base 与 Solana 支持 USDC 微支付。提供 10 个免费模型起步（含大上下文与视觉模型）、零外部依赖，MIT 许可，适合代理化自动化与边缘部署。
summary.en: ClawRouter is an open-source, agent-native LLM router built for autonomous agents. It runs locally and performs sub-millisecond routing, using a 15-dimensional scoring system to pick the cheapest capable model across 55+ models—cutting AI API costs by up to 92%. Agents authenticate via local wallet signatures (no API keys or signups) and pay per-request in USDC using the x402 micropayment protocol on Base and Solana. Includes 10 free models (large-context and vision-capable), zero external dependencies, MIT licensed—ideal for agentic automation and edge deployments.

metadata.name: http-relay
metadata.description: A lightweight HTTP relay that forwards /{absolute-url} requests with optional proxy and traffic dump.

summary.zh: http-relay 是一款轻量级 HTTP 转发器，通过 /{绝对URL} 将本地请求原样转发到上游。支持常规与反向代理模式、可选请求/响应流量导出（含认证字段掩码）、请求头添加/修改，提供 Go 一键安装与 Docker 镜像，适用于调试、抓包、流量采集与简单代理场景。
summary.en: http-relay is a lightweight HTTP forwarder that relays local /{absolute-url} requests to upstreams. It supports regular and reverse modes, optional request/response traffic dumps with auth masking, header add/modify, configurable timeouts, and is distributed via Go install and Docker image—useful for debugging, traffic capture and simple proxying.

metadata.name: neo
metadata.description: Turn any web app into an API. Chrome extension captures browser traffic, auto-generates schemas, lets AI replay APIs directly. No official API needed.

summary.zh: Neo 是一款 Chrome 扩展，可将任意 Web 应用转为可重放的 API，无需官方接口或脆弱的浏览器自动化。它被动拦截 fetch/XHR（包含 URL、头、请求/响应体与触发元素），自动生成端点与 schema（鉴权、参数、错误码），并通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 在页面上下文重放请求；若无可用接口，亦可基于可访问性树执行 click/fill/type/press 等 UI 自动化。支持 headless Lightpanda 与单一 CLI，可由 AI 驱动实现稳健的接口化与抓取。
summary.en: Neo is a Chrome extension that turns any web app into a replayable API without relying on official endpoints or brittle browser automation. It passively captures fetch/XHR traffic — URLs, headers, bodies, timing and the DOM trigger — and auto-generates API schemas (endpoints, auth, params, responses, error codes). Calls are executed inside the page via Chrome DevTools Protocol so cookies, CSRF and sessions are inherited; when no API exists Neo drives the UI via an accessibility tree (click/fill/type/press/scroll). Supports headless Lightpanda and a single CLI for AI-driven, robust automation and scraping.

metadata.name: dae
metadata.description: eBPF-based Linux high-performance transparent proxy solution.

summary.zh: dae 是基于 eBPF 的 Linux 透明代理，通过内核级 Real Direct 流量分流实现近乎零转发损耗。支持按进程名与 MAC 分流、反向匹配规则、自动节点延迟探测与策略切换、增强 DNS 与对 Shadowsocks/Trojan/SOCKS5 的全锥 NAT 支持。适用于需高吞吐、低延迟的代理、服务器/边缘流量管理与透明加速场景，侧重在内核层面最大化性能并降低资源开销。
summary.en: dae is an eBPF-based Linux transparent proxy that implements kernel-level 'Real Direct' traffic splitting to minimize forwarding overhead and enable near-zero performance penalty for direct flows. It supports process-name and MAC-based splitting, invert-match rules, automatic node latency probing and policy-driven node selection, enhanced DNS handling, and full-cone NAT for Shadowsocks/Trojan/SOCKS5. Designed for high-performance proxying, server and edge traffic management, and transparent acceleration, it achieves minimal additional resource consumption and supports configurable rulesets for flexible deployment in VPS, edge, and LAN environments.

metadata.name: frontend-slides
metadata.description: Create beautiful slides on the web using Claude's frontend skills

summary.zh: 该项目是一个 Claude Code 技能，能把文本或 PPT 快速转换为单文件、动画丰富的 HTML 演示。无需构建依赖，提供可视化风格预览、PPT 资产提取并保留图片、精选非泛用 AI 风格主题，以及可定制、可访问的生产级代码，便于非设计师和产品人员快速生成网页幻灯片或导出可编辑模板。
summary.en: Frontend Slides is a Claude Code skill that generates animation-rich, production-quality HTML presentations from scratch or by converting PowerPoint files. It outputs single-file, zero-dependency HTML with inline CSS/JS—no npm or build tools—while offering visual style discovery via generated previews. Key features include PPT asset extraction and preservation, curated non-generic style presets, accessibility and responsive layouts, and well-commented editable code. It targets non-designers and developers who need fast, customizable web slide exports and browser-ready templates.

metadata.name: humanize
metadata.description: From Automated Idea Factory to Realization

summary.zh: Humanize 是面向 Claude Code 的插件，采用 RLCR（Ralph-Loop with Codex Review）实现 AI 驱动的迭代开发与独立代码审查。Claude 负责实现、Codex 独立复审，形成持续反馈闭环；提供从想法草案、计划生成、注释化方案精炼到循环执行与 CLI 监控的端到端工作流，并可集成 Gemini 等模型以提升代码质量与可审计性。
summary.en: Humanize is a Claude Code plugin implementing RLCR (Ralph-Loop with Codex Review), an iterative development loop with independent AI code review. Claude performs implementation while Codex independently reviews with severity-marked findings; optional agent teams enable parallel swarm refinement. It provides an end-to-end CLI workflow for idea drafting, plan generation, annotated-plan refinement, loop execution, and monitoring, and integrates Codex and Gemini skills. By creating continuous feedback loops, Humanize aims to catch issues early and improve code quality, auditability, and developer confidence in AI-assisted engineering.

metadata.name: QwenPaw
metadata.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.

summary.zh: QwenPaw 是可本地或云端部署的个人 AI 助手，支持多渠道聊天、技能插件与多代理协作。数据与记忆由用户完全掌控，内置文档处理、日程与新闻摘要等能力，便于在私有环境中按需定制与扩展。
summary.en: QwenPaw: deployable AI assistant with multichannel chat, extensible skills and multi-agent collaboration. User-controlled memory and local data control enable privacy-focused, customizable deployments.

metadata.name: pure
metadata.description: Pretty, minimal and fast ZSH prompt

summary.zh: Pure 是一个简洁高效的 ZSH 提示符，追求美观与性能：异步显示 Git 分支、推/拉箭头与脏状态，非零退出用色提示，超时显示命令耗时，SSH/容器才显示用户主机，支持 VI 模式并能更新终端标题。轻量、可配置，可通过 npm 或 Homebrew 安装，适合作为自定义提示符的起点。
summary.en: Pure is a pretty, minimal and fast Zsh prompt that stays out of the way while providing essential context. It asynchronously shows Git branch, dirty state, and up/down (unpushed/unpulled) indicators, colors the prompt for non-zero exits, and displays command execution time when exceeding a threshold. Username/host are shown only in SSH/container sessions, it supports vi-mode indicators and updates the terminal title. Lightweight, configurable and installable via npm or Homebrew, Pure is an excellent base for custom prompts.

metadata.name: GalIsland
metadata.description: 本地galgame可视化管理

summary.zh: GalIsland 是一款本地 galgame 可视化管理桌面应用，支持添加/编辑/删除与批量导入，集成 VNDB 抓取游戏信息、封面与评分，利用 ggbases 获取中文标签并用 DeepSeek AI 翻译简介；提供本地封面与截图管理、拖拽上传、自定义分类与自动定位存档，便于库管理、快速启动与离线维护。
summary.en: GalIsland is a local visual manager for galgames that organizes and launches titles on the desktop. It supports adding, editing, deleting and bulk import, integrates VNDB to auto-fetch metadata, covers, screenshots and ratings, and pulls Chinese tags from ggbases. Descriptions can be translated via DeepSeek AI. The app stores covers/screenshots locally with drag-and-drop upload, offers custom categories, automatic save-game path detection and quick-launch configuration, simplifying library organization, metadata enrichment and offline game management.

metadata.name: zerobrew
metadata.description: A 5-20x faster experimental Homebrew alternative

summary.zh: zerobrew 是一个面向 macOS/Linux 的实验性 Homebrew 客户端，利用内容寻址存储与 APFS 克隆文件实现零开销复制与去重，优先使用 Homebrew 瓶装与配方，显著加速安装（常见配方冷态 2–6×，热态可达数十倍），建议与 Homebrew 并存试用。
summary.en: zerobrew is an experimental, performance-oriented client for the Homebrew ecosystem on macOS and Linux. It speeds up package installation by using content-addressable storage for deduplication, APFS clonefiles for zero-copy duplication, and falling back to Homebrew's Ruby DSL for source builds. By leveraging Homebrew formulas and bottles while optimizing client-side storage and copying, zerobrew achieves large cold/warm speedups across common formulas. It is intended to run alongside Homebrew rather than replace it, for users who need faster installs and more efficient disk usage.
tags_zh: 内容寻址存储、APFS 克隆文件

metadata.name: Feather
metadata.description: Free on-device iOS/iPadOS application manager/installer, using certificates part of the Apple Developer Program.

summary.zh: Feather 是开源且免费的 iOS/iPadOS 本地应用管理与安装器，利用 Apple 开发者证书在设备端签名并安装应用。支持 AltStore 仓库、可配置签名与兼容性补丁、Ellekit 注入（.deb/.dylib），可查看证书与应用详情，强调隐私无追踪，适合需要本地分发与定制化签名的高级用户与开发者。
summary.en: Feather is an open-source, free on-device iOS/iPadOS app manager that signs and installs apps using Apple Developer certificates. It supports AltStore repositories, configurable signing and compatibility patches, Ellekit injection (.deb/.dylib), and certificate/app inspection—focused on local distribution, customization and user privacy without analytics.

metadata.name: tart
metadata.description: macOS and Linux VMs on Apple Silicon to use in CI and other automations

summary.zh: Tart 是面向 Apple Silicon 的虚拟化工具集，可在 macOS 主机上构建、运行并管理 macOS 与 Linux 虚拟机。基于 Apple 虚拟化框架实现近原生性能，支持将 VM 镜像推/拉至任意 OCI 镜像仓库，提供 Packer 插件以自动化镜像构建，并易于集成到 CI/自动化流水线。常用作高性能、低成本的替代 GitHub-hosted runners，用于 CI/CD、自动化测试与可复现开发环境。
summary.en: Tart is a virtualization toolset for Apple Silicon that builds, runs and manages macOS and Linux VMs on macOS hosts. It leverages Apple’s Virtualization.Framework for near-native performance, supports pushing and pulling VM images to any OCI-compatible registry, and includes a Packer plugin to automate VM creation. Designed for CI and automation, Tart integrates with CI systems and powers Cirrus Runners as a high-performance, cost-efficient alternative to hosted runners, ideal for CI/CD, automated testing, and reproducible development environments on M1/M2 hardware.

metadata.name: styles
metadata.description: Official repository for Citation Style Language (CSL) citation styles.

summary.zh: 官方引用样式语言（CSL）样式仓库，维护数千个基于 XML 的学术引用与书目样式及本地化文件。仓库提供样式规范、开发与质量控制流程，并对提交样式进行人工审核。该开源集合被第三方渲染器和文献管理工具广泛采用，支持自动生成符合期刊、出版社与机构指南的参考文献与注释格式，贡献者可按文档化标准提交或请求新增样式。
summary.en: The official Citation Style Language (CSL) style repository hosts a curated, open-source collection of thousands of XML-based citation and bibliography styles and locale files that automate scholarly citation formatting. It supplies explicit style requirements, development guidance, quality-control procedures, and a documented submission/review workflow to ensure styles conform to published guides and broader community needs. Widely adopted by third-party CSL processors and reference managers, the repository enables automated generation of citations and bibliographies matching journal, publisher, or institutional formats. Contributors may request or submit styles under documented inclusion and licensing terms.

metadata.name: gemini-voyager
metadata.description: An all-in-one enhancement suite for Google Gemini & AI Studio - timeline navigation, folder management, prompt library, and chat export in one powerful extension. / Google Gemini & AI Studio 全能增强插件：集成时间轴导航、文件夹管理、提示词库及聊天导出等众多功能。

summary.zh: Gemini Voyager 是针对 Google Gemini 与 AI Studio 的跨浏览器扩展，提供时间轴会话导航、聊天文件夹、提示词库与会话导出。它优化对话检索、整理与复用流程，适合研究者、产品团队与重度用户用于回溯会话、管理提示模板及备份聊天数据。
summary.en: Gemini Voyager is an all-in-one browser extension for Google Gemini and AI Studio that adds timeline conversation navigation, chat folders, a reusable prompt library, and conversation export. Running across major browsers, it focuses on seamless integration with the Gemini UI to improve chat retrieval, organization and prompt reuse. Ideal for researchers, product teams and power users who need session history browsing, prompt templating, or local backup of conversations. Emphasizes usability, cross-browser compatibility and streamlined AI assistant workflows.

metadata.name: PiliPlus
metadata.description: PiliPlus

summary.zh: PiliPlus 是基于 Flutter 开发的开源 B 站第三方客户端，支持 Android/iOS/Pad/Windows/Linux 跨平台。提供高清播放、离线缓存、弹幕与直播、DLNA 投屏、AI 原声翻译、多账号与 WebDAV 备份等丰富功能，包含播放增强、富文本动态与社交交互，适用于追番、看直播与离线观影等场景，便于开发者定制与扩展。
summary.en: PiliPlus is an open-source third-party Bilibili client built with Flutter that runs on Android, iOS, iPad, Windows and Linux. It targets cross-platform media consumption and social interaction, offering high-quality video playback, offline caching, danmaku (bullet comments), live streaming, DLNA casting, AI original-voice translation, SuperChat and rich-text dynamic posting. The app includes multi-account support, WebDAV backups, cookie/SMS login adapters and playback enhancements (skip intros, PIP, subtitle/danmaku controls), suitable for binge-watching, live viewing and offline playback scenarios.

metadata.name: opencode
metadata.description: The open source coding agent.

summary.zh: OpenCode 是开源的 AI 编码代理，提供跨平台 CLI、桌面与 Web 控制台，集成模型后端与插件扩展，能自动生成、修改与审查代码，适合提升开发效率与自动化工程流程。
summary.en: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent offering cross-platform CLI, desktop and web UIs. It integrates model backends and plugins to automate code generation, edits and reviews, improving developer productivity and workflows.

metadata.name: awesome-nanobanana-pro
metadata.description: 🚀 An awesome list of curated Nano Banana pro prompts and examples. Your go-to resource for mastering prompt engineering and exploring the creative potential of the Nano banana pro(Nano banana 2) AI image model.

summary.zh: 这是为 Nano Banana Pro（Nano Banana 2）整理的高质量提示与范例库，汇集来自 X、微信、Replicate 及顶级提示工程师的实战配方。侧重摄影级写实、风格化美学与创意实验，覆盖人像、编辑、电商虚拟拍摄、室内与社媒场景，帮助提示工程师与视觉创作者快速复现高保真图像效果并加速工作流与模型试验。
summary.en: This repository is a curated prompt library for the Nano Banana Pro (Nano Banana 2) image model, aggregating high-quality prompts and examples from X, WeChat, Replicate and leading prompt engineers. It focuses on photorealism, stylized aesthetics and creative visual experiments across portraits, editing, e-commerce virtual shoots, interiors and social media. Aimed at prompt engineers and visual creators, it provides ready-to-use recipes, composition and lighting tips to reproduce high-fidelity results, accelerate workflows and support model tuning and experimentation.

metadata.name: openchamber
metadata.description: Desktop and web interface for OpenCode AI agent

summary.zh: OpenChamber 是面向 OpenCode AI 智能体的跨平台桌面与网页管理界面，为开发者提供代理编排、差异审查、工具输出可视化和本地开发服务器运行等功能。基于 Electron + React/TypeScript 构建，并可与 VS Code 扩展集成，便于跟踪 AI 生成的代码改动、审阅 diff、迭代补丁并调试代理日志。适用于将 AI 代码生成、安全审查与本地开发工作流结合的协同开发与自动化补丁场景。
summary.en: OpenChamber is a cross-platform desktop and web UI for OpenCode AI agents that helps developers manage agents, orchestrate toolchains, review code diffs, inspect tool outputs, and run local dev servers. Built with Electron, React and TypeScript and integrated with a VS Code extension, it surfaces agent settings, logs and diffs to make AI-driven code changes transparent and debuggable. Typical use cases include automated patch generation, collaborative review of AI suggestions, local testing of agent workflows, and safely incorporating AI-assisted coding into existing developer processes.

metadata.name: fresh
metadata.description: Terminal based IDE & text editor: easy, powerful and fast

summary.zh: Fresh 是一款零配置的现代终端文本编辑器，复刻 VS Code/Sublime 的交互体验，支持标准快捷键、鼠标、命令面板与多光标。擅长多GB文件的低内存快速加载与低延迟输入，内建 LSP、分屏视图、内置终端、主题与 TypeScript 插件扩展，适合终端环境下的高效代码编辑、导航与批量改写。
summary.en: Fresh is a zero-configuration modern terminal text editor that brings VS Code/Sublime-like UX to the terminal. It provides familiar keybindings, full mouse support, a command palette, multi-cursor editing, themes, and an interactive settings/keybinding UI. Engineered for real-world performance, Fresh loads multi-gigabyte files with minimal memory overhead and low input latency. Built-in LSP, split panes, integrated terminal, sandboxed TypeScript plugins, fuzzy finder and git integrations make it ideal for efficient terminal-centric coding, large-file editing and fast navigation.

metadata.name: hypermind
metadata.description: The High-Availability Solution to a Problem That Doesn't Exist.

summary.zh: Hypermind 是一个完全去中心化的点对点部署计数器与无状态聊天室，基于 Hyperswarm DHT 建立无中心“群集”。实时在线数由 45 秒 LRU 缓存维护，总唯一节点通过 HyperLogLog 以 >98% 精度估算，连接每 5 分钟轮换以保证拓扑动态性并增强阻断抵抗力。提供基于 Server-Sent Events 的仪表盘、局部/全局两种聊天模式（支持 Markdown）、粒子地图可视化与多主题界面，支持通过 Docker（建议 --network host）一键部署，适合演示与去中心化通信实验。
summary.en: Hypermind is a fully decentralized peer-to-peer deployment counter and ephemeral, serverless chat built on the Hyperswarm DHT. It keeps a realtime active peer count via a 45-second LRU cache and estimates total unique nodes with HyperLogLog (>98% accuracy). Connections rotate every five minutes to maintain a dynamic, unblockable mesh. Features include an SSE-powered realtime dashboard, local/global ephemeral chat with Markdown, particle-map visualizations and theme switching. Packaged for Docker (recommend --network host), it’s aimed at demos, experimentation and decentralized communications research.

metadata.name: typora-theme-alto
metadata.description: Alto - Typora Theme  - Encounter more elegant thinking.

summary.zh: Alto 是为 Typora 设计的轻量级 CSS 主题，通过单一 CSS 文件重塑编辑器界面而不修改母主题的基础样式。它以导入 Lapis 或 Spring 等母主题为模板，并在 :root 暴露配色变量，支持一体化窗口风格、浅/深色切换与自定义配色。提供 Releases 下载（推荐）或带子模块的克隆安装方式，便于复用原主题资源，并鼓励提交适配与配色贡献以扩展兼容性与风格。
summary.en: Alto is a lightweight CSS theme for the Typora markdown editor that redesigns the UI without altering underlying parent theme styles. Implemented as a single CSS file, it imports parent themes (e.g., Lapis or Spring) and exposes :root color variables for accent and background, enabling integrated window styling, light/dark switching, and easy color customization. Installation is recommended via Releases or via git clone with submodules. The project emphasizes reuse of existing themes, provides preview screenshots, and welcomes contributions for additional palettes and compatibility fixes.

metadata.name: witr
metadata.description: Why is this running?

summary.zh: witr 用于回答“为什么这个在运行？”。它自动聚合 ps、lsof、ss、systemctl、docker 等多源数据，构建可读的因果链，说明进程/服务/容器的启动路径与责任链。提供交互式 TUI 仪表盘与单文件跨平台 Go 二进制，便于运维、事故响应与取证分析，简化运行时调查与根因定位。
summary.en: witr answers “Why is this running?” by automatically correlating process and service state across layers—ps, lsof, ss, systemctl, Docker, supervisors, shells and ports—to produce a human-readable causality chain explaining where a running thing came from and how it was started. It ships as a single static Go binary for Linux, macOS, FreeBSD and Windows and includes an interactive TUI for exploration. Aimed at operators, incident responders and forensic engineers, witr simplifies runtime investigation, root-cause discovery and maintenance tasks.

metadata.name: ServerPackCreator
metadata.description: Create a server pack from a Minecraft Forge, NeoForge, Fabric, LegacyFabric or Quilt modpack!

summary.zh: ServerPackCreator 可将 Minecraft 的 Forge、NeoForge、Fabric、LegacyFabric 与 Quilt 等模组包自动转为服务器包。工具会过滤客户端专用模组、整理依赖与配置并打包为可直接部署的服务器压缩包，显著简化服务器管理员与托管服务的搭建与发布流程。
summary.en: ServerPackCreator converts Minecraft modpacks (Forge, NeoForge, Fabric, LegacyFabric, Quilt) into server-ready packs. It filters out client-only mods, organizes dependencies and configurations, and produces deployable server zip packages to simplify setup and hosting for server operators.

metadata.name: TS3AudioBot-CloudMusic-plugin
metadata.description: Teamspeak 3 流媒体音乐插件

summary.zh: Teamspeak 3 的流媒体音乐插件，接入网易云与 QQ 音乐，支持二维码/短信/Cookie 登录，播放歌单/专辑/单曲并提供播放模式、自动暂停与自动回频道等管理功能。通过可配置的 API 服务和请求头实现稳定的流媒体转发与播放控制，适合私有 TeamSpeak 语音服务器的音乐共享与自动化播放场景。
summary.en: A TeamSpeak 3 streaming music plugin integrating Netease and QQ Music. It supports QR/SMS/Cookie logins, playlist/album/song playback, play modes, auto-pause and auto-return to channel. Uses a configurable API server and headers to relay stable streaming and playback control, ideal for private voice servers to share and automate music playback.

metadata.name: misskey
metadata.description: 🌎 A completely free and open interplanetary-microblogging platform 🚀

summary.zh: Misskey 是一个开源、去中心化的联邦微型博客平台，支持自建实例与跨实例互联，适合社区与组织搭建可定制的社交空间。功能包括富媒体发布、自定义表情、投票、时间线过滤与实时 WebSocket 推送等；兼容 ActivityPub 联邦协议。技术上以 TypeScript/Node.js 后端与 Vue 前端为主，使用 PostgreSQL/Redis，支持 Docker 部署、主题与插件扩展，便于定制、国际化与运维扩展。
summary.en: Misskey is an open-source, federated microblogging platform that enables communities, organizations, and individuals to self-host customizable social instances. It features rich media, custom emoji, polls, timeline filters, and real-time WebSocket updates, with cross-instance federation via ActivityPub compatibility. Architecturally it uses a TypeScript/Node.js backend and Vue frontend, with PostgreSQL and Redis for persistence and caching, plus Docker deployment, themes and plugin extensibility. It targets operators seeking a privacy-respecting, extensible alternative to centralized social networks with tooling for scaling and customization.

metadata.name: Cloudflare-Workers-Proxy
metadata.description: 简单而功能强大的反代服务，允许你将一个网址映射到另一个网址，并处理跨域请求

summary.zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的轻量级反向代理，支持将任意目标网址映射并代理请求，自动修正相对路径与重定向，添加 CORS 头以便跨域访问。包含简单的输入界面、详尽部署步骤与安全免责声明，适合快速在边缘部署资源透传、前端调试与临时跨域代理场景，MIT 许可且易于定制。
summary.en: This repository provides a compact reverse-proxy implemented with Cloudflare Workers. It forwards client requests to arbitrary target URLs, rewrites relative resource paths to absolute, handles redirects, and injects CORS headers to enable cross-origin loading. A simple UI for entering target URLs, step-by-step deployment instructions, and explicit security/legal disclaimers are included. Practical for rapid serverless edge deployment, resource passthrough, and front-end debugging or temporary CORS proxying. MIT licensed and easy to adapt for custom use cases.

metadata.name: Mole
metadata.description: 🐹 Deep clean and optimize your Mac.

summary.zh: Mole：开源 macOS 命令行工具，单文件提供深度清理、智能卸载、磁盘可视化与实时监控。适用于回收磁盘空间、移除应用残留、重建缓存与刷新服务；支持预览、白名单与 Homebrew 一键安装，强调安全优先的路径校验与确认机制，便于自动化或交互式系统维护。
summary.en: Mole is an open-source macOS command-line utility that consolidates deep cleaning, smart uninstallation, disk visualization and live system monitoring into a single fast binary. It reclaims space by removing caches, logs, browser leftovers and orphaned app data, finds large files, rebuilds caches and refreshes services. Safety-first defaults include path validation, whitelists, dry-run previews and explicit confirmations. Installable via Homebrew or installer script, Mole suits both casual users and sysadmins for automated or interactive system maintenance; an experimental Windows branch is available for early adopters.

metadata.name: karakeep
metadata.description: A self-hostable bookmark-everything app (links, notes and images) with AI-based automatic tagging and full text search

summary.zh: Karakeep 是可自托管的“收藏一切”应用，存储链接、笔记、图片/PDF，支持自动抓取、OCR、全文检索与基于 LLM 的自动标签和摘要，提供浏览器扩展、移动端与 REST API，具备规则引擎、页面/视频归档与批量操作，适合个人或团队做知识归档与长期内容保存。
summary.en: Karakeep is a self-hostable "bookmark-everything" app for saving links, notes, images and PDFs with automated metadata fetching, OCR, full-text search and LLM-based tagging and summarization. It offers browser extensions, iOS/Android apps, a REST API, rule-based automation, page/video archival, RSS hoarding, SSO and agent/CLI integrations for programmable workflows. Open-source and self-hosted, it emphasizes privacy and extensibility via importers and local LLM support (e.g. ollama), making it suitable for personal/team knowledge archiving and long-term content preservation.

metadata.name: gopl-zh.github.com
metadata.description: :books: Go语言圣经中文版 🇨🇳

summary.zh: 《Go语言圣经》是《The Go Programming Language》的中文译本，提供在线与仓库内的完整教程与示例，便于系统学习 Go 语法、并发与工程实践。仓库列出译者信息、在线阅读地址及 CC BY‑NC‑SA 版权声明（禁止商业使用），并推荐 CGO、Go 汇编与语法树等进阶参考资料，适合从入门到进阶的学习与实践参考。
summary.en: The Go Programming Language (Chinese Edition) repository offers a complete Chinese translation of 'The Go Programming Language' with online and local-reading formats. It is tailored for systematic, example-driven learning of Go syntax, concurrency, and practical engineering. The project includes translator credits, reading links, and a Creative Commons BY‑NC‑SA license that forbids commercial use. The README also points to advanced resources on CGO, Go assembly, syntax trees, and toy compilers to support deeper study and hands-on exploration.

metadata.name: ebooks
metadata.description: 收藏的一些经典的历史、政治、心理、哲学、数学、计算机方面电子书(约10万本）

summary.zh: 该仓库整理约10万本PDF电子书，覆盖历史、政治、经济、心理学、哲学、数学与计算机等领域。提供基于Web的检索目录与Google Drive下载链接，便于自学、研究与教学参考；目录索引持续更新，原文件体积大由云端托管。
summary.en: A curated index of ~100,000 PDF ebooks covering history, politics, economics, psychology, philosophy, mathematics and computing. Provides a lightweight web-searchable catalog and Google Drive download links for self-study, research and teaching; the catalog is partial and being continuously updated.

metadata.name: Burner-X
metadata.description: Burner X - 浏览器即开即用，AI文献识别、文档批量翻译、阅读与智能分析工具 丨BYOK

summary.zh: Paper Burner X 是一款浏览器即开即用的本地化 AI 文献工作站，支持 PDF/DOCX/PPTX/EPUB 等多格式，提供 OCR、并发批量翻译、公式保真渲染与结构化信息提取。前端实现 Agent 驱动的 RAG（含 grep、vector search、fetch），可接入自定义模型端点与大规模术语库，面向研究人员的深度阅读、文献对照与智能分析场景。
summary.en: Paper Burner X is a browser-first, local-first AI workstation for academic literature. It ingests PDF/DOCX/PPTX/EPUB and supports OCR, high-speed concurrent batch translation, formula-preserving rendering, and structured information extraction. A front-end Agent-based RAG system equips the client with tools like grep, vector search and fetch so the model can perform multi-step reasoning over long texts without server-side data leaks. It supports large terminology libraries, custom model endpoints, and self-hostable OCR/Docker deployments—ideal for researchers doing deep reading, bilingual comparison, and automated literature analysis.

metadata.name: Nota
metadata.description: A Fast, Modern, Feature Rich and Lightweight Note taking desktop application made with native AI integration

summary.zh: Nota 是一款轻量且高速的跨平台桌面笔记应用（约16MB），基于 Tauri、Svelte 与 Bun/Rust 构建。内置自研富文本编辑器 Edra 并集成本地化 AI（BYOK），支持斜杠命令、Markdown 快捷、媒体嵌入、KaTeX 数学公式、表格与任务列表以及层级工作区和会话式认证。面向追求流畅编辑、低资源占用与可扩展 AI 能力的个人用户与知识工作者，提供桌面与 Web 双端体验。
summary.en: Nota is a fast, lightweight cross-platform desktop note-taking app (~16MB) built with Tauri, Svelte and Bun/Rust. It includes a custom rich-text editor (Edra) and native AI integration using a bring-your-own-key (BYOK) model for generation, summarization and more. Editor features include slash commands, Markdown shortcuts, media embeds, KaTeX math, tables and task lists; organizational features include hierarchical workspaces and session-based authentication. Nota targets users who want a responsive, low-resource alternative to Electron apps with extensible local AI capabilities for personal knowledge work.

metadata.name: hexo-shiki-plugin
metadata.description: A code highlight plugin,use shiki for better highlight,built for hexo!

summary.zh: Hexo Shiki Plugin 是为 Hexo 静态博客打造的代码高亮插件，基于 Shiki 提供高保真语法着色与主题支持。项目用 TypeScript + Vite 打包，包含浏览器运行时资产、四个内置主题与可扩展主题加载，支持行号、复制按钮、嵌套括号着色、代码折叠/高度限制与自定义 CSS。兼容 Hexo 配置（需禁用内置高亮），附带 Vitest 单元测试与标准化构建脚本，适合希望在 Hexo 站点上获得更一致、美观且可配置代码块展示的开发者与博客作者使用。
summary.en: Hexo Shiki Plugin is a Hexo-focused code highlighting plugin that leverages Shiki for high-fidelity syntax coloring and theme flexibility. Built with TypeScript and Vite, it delivers browser runtime assets, four built-in themes and support for custom themes. Features include line numbers, copy button, colorized nested brackets, collapse/height limits, and customizable CSS. It requires disabling Hexo's native highlighters, ships with Vitest tests and standard build scripts, and targets developers and bloggers who want consistent, configurable and visually improved code blocks on Hexo sites.

metadata.name: TrendRadar
metadata.description: ⭐AI-driven public opinion & trend monitor with multi-platform aggregation, RSS, and smart alerts.🎯 告别信息过载，你的 AI 舆情监控助手与热点筛选工具！聚合多平台热点 +  RSS 订阅，支持关键词精准筛选。AI 智能筛选新闻 + AI 翻译 +  AI 分析简报直推手机，也支持接入 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 自然语言对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测等。支持 Docker ，数据本地/云端自持。集成微信/飞书/钉钉/Telegram/邮件/ntfy/bark/slack 等渠道智能推送。

summary.zh: TrendRadar 是一款 AI 驱动的舆情与热点监测助手，聚合多平台与 RSS 订阅并支持关键词精准筛选。内置 AI 智能筛选、翻译与自动分析，兼容 MCP 大模型接入，支持 Docker 本地/云部署与 Webhook，能向微信/飞书/钉钉/Telegram/邮件等多渠道智能推送告警与分析简报。适合媒体监控、品牌公关与竞争情报，用于降低信息过载并实现情感洞察与趋势预测。
summary.en: TrendRadar is an AI-driven public opinion and trend monitoring assistant that aggregates multi-platform sources and RSS feeds with precise keyword filtering. It applies AI for smart news triage, multilingual translation and automated analysis to generate concise briefings and alerts. The project supports MCP for large-model NLP integration, local or cloud deployment via Docker, webhooks and quick developer configuration. Delivery channels include WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram, email, ntfy, Bark and Slack. Ideal for media monitoring, PR crisis detection and competitive intelligence to surface actionable trends and sentiment insights.

metadata.name: surf
metadata.description: Personal AI Notebooks. Organize files & webpages and generate notes from them. Open source, local & open data, open model choice (incl. local).

summary.zh: Deta Surf 是一款本地优先的开源 AI 笔记应用，将本地文件、网页和多媒体整合进交互式笔记流以加速研究与思考。由 Svelte/TypeScript 与 Rust 构建，跨平台运行并使用开放的 SFFS 存储格式，支持本地或云端大模型（BYOM）。核心功能包括多媒体库、智能笔记（@引用、网页检索、带来源的引用）、Surflets 无代码应用生成与离线使用，适合资料整理、知识合成与交互式探索。
summary.en: Deta Surf is an open-source, local-first AI notebook that organizes files, web pages and media into interactive, citation-aware notes to speed research and thinking. Built with Svelte/TypeScript and Rust, it runs cross-platform and stores data in an open Surf Flat File System (SFFS). Surf supports bring-your-own models (including local deployments), offers a multimedia library, Smart Notes with @-mentions and web-search ingestion, source-linked citations, and Surflets for no-code interactive app generation—targeting researchers and knowledge workers seeking privacy-first synthesis tools.

metadata.name: hugo-theme-luna
metadata.description: A simple, performance-first, SEO-friendly Hugo theme / 一个轻量，快速，SEO 友好的 Hugo 主题

summary.zh: Hugo Theme Luna 是一款轻量、性能优先且 SEO 友好的 Hugo 主题。集成 TailwindCSS、动态 JS 模块、KaTeX、PWA、swup PJAX、本地搜索（flexsearch）、响应式与延迟加载图片、暗色模式、图像库、短码、多语言与可选文章加密等功能。附带 exampleSite、部署示例（GitHub Pages、Netlify、Vercel、Cloudflare）和基于 Node/PostCSS 的构建流程，适合个人博客与文档站快速定制与高性能发布。
summary.en: Hugo Theme Luna is a lightweight, performance-first and SEO-friendly Hugo theme tailored for blogs and documentation sites. It combines Tailwind CSS styling, dynamic JS module imports, KaTeX math rendering, PWA support, swup-based PJAX transitions, FlexSearch local search, responsive and lazy-loaded images, dark mode, image galleries, Bionic Reading, shortcodes, multilingual support and optional article encryption. The repo includes an exampleSite, deployment guides for GitHub Pages/Netlify/Vercel/Cloudflare Pages, and a Node/PostCSS asset build workflow for easy customization and fast static-site publishing.

metadata.name: wechat-selkies
metadata.description: 基于Selkies的Linux网页版微信/QQ/Telegram，支持本地中文输入法，支持三方应用，支持AMD64和ARM64。

summary.zh: 基于Selkies的Docker化微信/QQ Linux客户端，通过WebRTC在浏览器中运行，支持本地中文输入法、第三方应用挂载、配置与消息持久化、可选GPU加速并兼容AMD64/ARM64，适合服务器部署与远程办公场景。
summary.en: A Dockerized Linux WeChat/QQ client built on Selkies WebRTC to run in-browser. It supports local Chinese IME, third‑party apps, persistent config/history, optional GPU acceleration, and AMD64/ARM64 compatibility—suited for server deployment and remote work.

metadata.name: hugo-theme-next
metadata.description: Easily & powerful theme for Hugo engine.

summary.zh: Hugo NexT 是为 Hugo 打造的高质量主题，兼容 Hexo NexT 布局与配置，提供四种配色方案、丰富页面模板与示例站点，便于从 Hexo 无缝迁移并快速搭建博客或文档站点。
summary.en: Hugo NexT: a refined Hugo theme compatible with Hexo NexT, four schemes, templates, easy migration.

metadata.name: claude-relay-service
metadata.description: CRS-自建Claude Code镜像，一站式开源中转服务，让 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Droid 订阅统一接入，支持拼车共享，更高效分摊成本，原生工具无缝使用。

summary.zh: CRS 提供自建 Claude/OpenAI/Gemini 等大模型的 API 中转与拼车共享，支持多账户轮换、按用户分配 API Key、连接池与缓存、健康检测式自动切换、使用统计、速率与访问控制，并内置监控面板。基于 Node.js + Redis，支持 Docker 和代理部署，提供一键安装脚本。适合无法直连官方服务、重视隐私或希望与他人分摊订阅成本的团队自托管。注意：请升级到 v1.1.249+ 修复管理员认证绕过风险。
summary.en: Claude Relay Service (CRS) is a self‑hosted API relay and account management platform for Claude Code and other model providers (OpenAI, Gemini, Droid). It enables multi‑account rotation, per‑user API keys, subscription carpooling to share costs, and seamless native tool integration. CRS includes connection pooling, caching, proxy support, health‑aware account switching, detailed usage accounting, rate and access controls, and a web monitoring dashboard for cost and performance visibility. Built on Node.js with Redis and Docker‑ready deployment, it offers a one‑click installer. Security note: upgrade to v1.1.249+ due to an admin auth bypass in earlier releases.

metadata.name: nerdctl
metadata.description: contaiNERD CTL - Docker-compatible CLI for containerd, with support for Compose, Rootless, eStargz, OCIcrypt, IPFS, ...

summary.zh: nerdctl 是针对 containerd 的 Docker 兼容命令行工具，提供与 docker 相同的 UX 并支持 Compose、rootless 模式、BuildKit 构建、lazy-pull（Stargz/Nydus/OverlayBD）、ocicrypt 镜像加密、IPFS 点对点分发与 cosign 签名验签等可选扩展。适合在 containerd 环境中进行镜像构建、运行、调试与本地 Kubernetes 集成，便于在不使用 Docker Engine 的情况下迁移或构建云原生工作流。
summary.en: nerdctl is a Docker-compatible CLI front-end for containerd that preserves the Docker UX while enabling native containerd features. It supports docker-compose commands, rootless operation, BuildKit image builds, lazy-pull technologies (Stargz/Nydus/OverlayBD), ocicrypt image encryption, optional P2P distribution via IPFS, and cosign signing/verification. Designed for building, running and debugging containers on containerd, it also aids local Kubernetes workflows and image workflows without relying on the Docker Engine, making cloud-native migration and lightweight runtimes straightforward.

metadata.name: xh
metadata.description: Friendly and fast tool for sending HTTP requests

summary.zh: xh 是用 Rust 实现的高性能且易用命令行 HTTP 客户端，借鉴 HTTPie 的交互风格并着重优化性能。支持 JSON、form 与 multipart、原始请求体、可配置的彩色与格式化输出，提供多平台包管理器与预编译二进制安装。适合交互式调试、脚本化请求与自动化场景，面向需要轻量、快速且可移植 HTTP 请求工具的开发与运维工作流。
summary.en: xh is a high-performance, user-friendly command-line HTTP client implemented in Rust that reimagines HTTPie's ergonomics with a strong performance focus. It supports JSON, form and multipart payloads, raw bodies, configurable pretty/format options, colored and formatted output, and ships prebuilt binaries across Linux, macOS and Windows with broad package manager support. Installable via Cargo, Homebrew, apt and others, xh is designed for interactive use, debugging, scripting and automation. It targets Rust 1.85+, minimizes dependencies, and emphasizes low-latency request handling.

metadata.name: NeteaseCloudMusicFlac
metadata.description: 根据网易云音乐的歌单, 下载flac无损音乐到本地. Download the FLAC music from Internet according to your NeteaseCloudMusic playlist.

summary.zh: NeteaseCloudMusicFlac 是一个 Python 命令行工具，能根据网易云音乐歌单解析并自动匹配下载 FLAC 无损音轨到本地，支持批量备份和 Hi‑Fi 播放需求。它通过网页解析与多线程加速下载，提供 MP3 可选项并包含基础错误处理。注意版权与地区（海外）访问限制，项目开源（MIT），仅供学习与个人使用。
summary.en: NeteaseCloudMusicFlac is a Python command-line utility that automates downloading FLAC lossless tracks from NetEase Cloud Music playlists. It parses playlist pages, matches song titles, and attempts to fetch high-quality FLAC files—optionally downloading MP3s. Designed for bulk playlist backup and audiophile users, it uses web scraping and multithreaded downloads to speed retrieval, with basic error handling and a dependency on requests. Note regional copyright/DNS restrictions may block downloads. The project is open-source (MIT) and intended for personal learning and convenience.

metadata.name: immich
metadata.description: High performance self-hosted photo and video management solution.

summary.zh: Immich 是一款高性能自托管照片与视频管理系统，提供跨平台手机与网页版客户端、自动与后台备份、去重、原生 RAW 支持与多用户共享。内建 EXIF/地图展示、相册与权限管理，并支持基于对象、人物和 CLIP 的视觉检索，适合在私有服务器或 NAS 上搭建可扩展的媒体库与备份方案（开源 AGPLv3）。
summary.en: Immich is a high-performance, open-source self-hosted photo and video management solution for private servers and NAS. It offers cross-platform mobile and web clients, automated background backup, deduplication, RAW/LivePhoto support, multi-user accounts, albums and admin controls. Built-in metadata (EXIF, maps) and AI-powered visual search (objects, faces, CLIP) enable fast retrieval and organization at scale. Immich focuses on efficient storage and scalable media serving, making it suitable for individuals and teams needing private, extensible media libraries under AGPLv3.

metadata.name: oauth2-proxy
metadata.description: A reverse proxy that provides authentication with Google, Azure, OpenID Connect and many more identity providers.

summary.zh: OAuth2‑Proxy 是基于 Go 的开源反向代理与认证中间件，支持多种 OAuth2/OIDC 提供者（如 Google、Microsoft Entra、GitHub 等）。它可拦截到访请求并把用户身份与组属性提取后作为 HTTP 头转发给上游，便于为多应用提供统一认证与授权边界。项目发布跨架构二进制与容器镜像（含 distroless/alpine 选项），能无缝集成到现有负载均衡或反向代理中以保护 Web 服务。
summary.en: OAuth2 Proxy is a flexible, open-source reverse proxy and middleware written in Go that protects web applications by delegating authentication to OAuth2 and OpenID Connect providers. It supports both a generic OIDC client and provider-specific integrations (Google, Microsoft Entra ID, GitHub, login.gov, etc.) to extract user attributes and groups, which can be forwarded to upstream apps as HTTP headers. Distributed as multi-architecture binaries and container images (distroless and Alpine variants), it integrates with existing reverse proxies or load balancers to centralize authentication across services.

metadata.name: RsyncUI
metadata.description: A SwiftUI based macOS GUI for rsync.

summary.zh: RsyncUI 是基于 SwiftUI 的 macOS 原生图形界面，封装并可视化配置 rsync，提供任务组织、参数细化与运行监控，无需命令行。要求 macOS Sonoma 及以上，可通过 Homebrew cask 或 release 安装，应用已签名并经苹果公证，文档基于 Docsy 发布。适合用于本地与远程的文件同步、备份和增量传输场景，为需要可视化管理 rsync 工作流的 macOS 用户提供方便可靠的工具。
summary.en: RsyncUI is a native macOS GUI built with SwiftUI that exposes and manages rsync without requiring command-line use. It offers task organization, fine-grained parameter configuration and execution monitoring to simplify file synchronization, backups and incremental transfers between local and remote endpoints. Targeting macOS Sonoma and later, the app is available as a signed and notarized Homebrew cask or via direct releases, with online documentation (Docsy) and release notes. Active development (v3.0.0) makes it a polished choice for macOS users seeking a GUI for robust rsync workflows.

metadata.name: Electorrent
metadata.description: A remote control client for µTorrent, qBittorrent, rTorrent, Transmission, Synology & Deluge

summary.zh: Electorrent 是基于 Electron 的跨平台桌面远程种子管理器，兼容 µTorrent、qBittorrent、Transmission、rTorrent、Synology Download Station 与 Deluge。支持磁力链接捕获、拖放与本地种子上传、模糊搜索、原生桌面通知及自签证书信任，提供一键安装和基于 Squirrel 的自动更新，便于在 NAS、VPS 或 seedbox 上远程管理和推送种子/磁力链接。
summary.en: Electorrent is a cross-platform Electron desktop client for remotely controlling popular BitTorrent servers and NAS download services. It supports µTorrent, qBittorrent, Transmission, rTorrent, Synology Download Station and Deluge, enabling magnet link handling, drag-and-drop and local torrent uploads, fuzzy searching, native desktop notifications and a built-in trust system for self-signed certificates. Delivered as native installers and AppImage with Squirrel-based auto-updates, Electorrent simplifies remote torrent management for NAS, VPS and seedbox hosts by streamlining the transfer of magnet links and torrent files to remote clients.

metadata.name: gpt4o-image-prompts
metadata.description: Nano Banana(nanobanana),GPT-5(GPT5),GPT-4o(GPT4o) Image Prompts，Nanobanana Prompts，nanobanana提示词

summary.zh: Nano Banana Pro/GPT-5/GPT-4o/Grok 图片提示词合集，收录大量高质量示例与参考图，提供 Markdown 源、Node.js 解析脚本（scripts/generate-dataset.js）生成结构化 data/prompts.json，以及静态画廊前端（index.html + assets）。支持标签聚合、组合筛选、关键字搜索与一键复制，便于提示工程师、视觉创作者与数据集构建者快速复用、迭代与导出展示（在线演示：opennana.com/awesome-prompt-gallery/）。
summary.en: A curated image-prompt collection for Nano Banana Pro / GPT-5 / GPT-4o / Grok, offering numerous high-quality prompts and example images for image generation. The repo includes Markdown source cases, a Node.js script (scripts/generate-dataset.js) that parses examples into a structured data/prompts.json with provenance and auto-generated tags, plus a static frontend (index.html + assets) providing gallery browsing, tag filtering, keyword search, and one-click prompt copy. Ideal for prompt engineers, artists, and dataset builders who need reusable prompts, fast iteration, and easy static hosting or demo preview.

metadata.name: MCHPRS
metadata.description: A multithreaded Minecraft server built for redstone.

summary.zh: MCHPRS 是用 Rust 编写的 Minecraft 1.20.4 创造服务器，专为计算型红石电路优化。每个 512×512 地块在独立线程上运行，显著降低延迟并提升并发能力；配套 Redpiler（红石编译器）可将高层逻辑编译成高效红石电路，从而在红石上运行复杂程序。项目提供地块管理、WorldEdit 支持、Velocity 转发表与 LuckPerms 数据库集成，配置灵活，适用于大规模并行红石计算、创意构建与高性能实验性服务器部署。
summary.en: MCHPRS is a Rust-based Minecraft 1.20.4 creative server engineered for computation-focused Redstone. Its architecture runs each 512×512 plot on a separate thread, reducing lag and enabling high concurrency; paired with Redpiler (the Redstone compiler) it compiles higher-level logic into efficient Redstone circuits to run complex programs inside Minecraft. The project includes plot management, WorldEdit compatibility, Velocity IP forwarding support and LuckPerms database integration. Configurable and performance-oriented, it’s designed for large-scale parallel Redstone computation, creative builds and experimental high-performance servers.

metadata.name: nixos-config
metadata.description: General purpose Nix starter template for macOS or NixOS w/ step-by-step instructions

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 macOS 与 NixOS 的通用 Nix 配置起始模板，基于 Nix Flakes 与 home-manager，提供声明式、可复现的跨平台开发环境。包含可声明的 macOS UI 与 App Store 应用、托管 Homebrew、磁盘声明式管理、agenix 密钥管理及快速 Emacs 配置，附带逐步引导与安装、平台兼容说明与 CI 流程，适合希望在笔记本、桌面与虚拟机间共享可维护系统配置的开发者与运维者。
summary.en: A general-purpose Nix starter template for macOS and NixOS that leverages Nix Flakes and Home Manager to provide declarative, reproducible development environments across laptops, desktops, and VMs. It includes declarative macOS UI and App Store app management, managed Homebrew (nix-darwin / nix-homebrew), disk management with disko, secrets via age/agenix, and a fast Emacs setup via community overlays. The repo offers step-by-step bootstrapping, secrets handling, package testing workflows, and CI lint/build, ideal for developers and operators seeking portable, maintainable system configurations.

metadata.name: latex-online
metadata.description: Online latex compiler. You give it a link, it gives you PDF

summary.zh: LaTeX.Online 是一个在线 LaTeX 编译服务，能够从单个 URL、Git 仓库、原始文本或 tar 包生成 PDF。提供 REST API、命令行客户端与可独立部署的 Docker 镜像，便于将 LaTeX 编译集成到 CI、文档发布或在线预览管道。请求成功返回 PDF，失败返回编译日志；通过 URL 编译单文件时会忽略 include。技术亮点包括容器化运行、远程源码拉取与简洁的 HTTP 接口，适合自动化和嵌入式文档生成场景。
summary.en: LaTeX.Online is an online LaTeX-to-PDF compilation service that builds PDFs from a URL, Git repository, raw text, or tarball. It offers a REST API, a command-line client, and a standalone Docker deployable image, making it easy to integrate LaTeX compilation into CI pipelines, documentation publishing, or web previews. Successful requests return a PDF, while failures return compilation logs; single-file URL mode ignores includes. Key technical strengths are containerized execution, remote source fetching from Git/links, and a minimal HTTP interface for embedding automated document generation.

metadata.name: Monocraft
metadata.description: A monospaced programming font inspired by the Minecraft typeface

summary.zh: Monocraft 是一款受 Minecraft UI 启发的等宽编程字体，重绘 1500+ 字形、加入编程连字与附魔字母，优化可读性与字距，支持跨平台安装与网页嵌入，适合在代码编辑器、终端与网站中使用。
summary.en: Monocraft is a monospaced programming font inspired by the Minecraft UI. It redraws 1500+ glyphs, adds programming ligatures and the enchantment alphabet, improves legibility and spacing, and supports cross-platform installation and web embedding for editors and terminals.

metadata.name: LKY_OfficeTools
metadata.description: 一键自动化 下载、安装、激活 Office 的利器。

summary.zh: LKY Office Tools 是一款一键化的 Windows Office 部署工具，自动下载、安装并以正版方式激活 Microsoft Office。能识别系统架构、按需选择组件、在用户同意下处理冗余版本，非篡改系统文件、绿色开源，适合个人或批量快速部署 Office（Windows 10 1703 及以上）。
summary.en: LKY Office Tools is a one‑click Windows utility to download, install and legitimately activate Microsoft Office. It auto-detects system architecture, lets users select optional components, handles redundant versions with consent, and performs non-invasive genuine activation. Open-source and suitable for rapid personal or bulk Office deployments on Windows 10 (1703+) and later.

metadata.name: skm
metadata.description: A simple and powerful SSH keys manager

summary.zh: SKM 是用 Go 实现的轻量级 SSH 密钥管理器，便于通过别名管理多把密钥，支持创建/导入/导出、备份/恢复、passphrase 增删旋转、指纹检测、远程公钥拷贝与模糊交互选择，适合开发与运维多密钥场景，并可通过 Homebrew 跨平台安装。
summary.en: SKM is a lightweight Go-based SSH key manager for handling multiple keys via aliases. It supports create/import/export, backup/restore, passphrase add/rotate/remove, fingerprinting, remote public-key copy, fuzzy interactive selection, and Homebrew installation—suited for multi-key developer and DevOps workflows.

metadata.name: OsEasy-ToolBox
metadata.description: 噢易多媒体网络教室工具箱 | 简易的课堂学习辅助工具箱

summary.zh: 噢易多媒体网络教室工具箱针对噢易学生端，提供解除键鼠与网络限制、绕过屏幕广播、进程管理等 Windows 运维功能，面向课堂的控制恢复与广播拦截。含系统级实验操作，需管理员权限并自负风险。
summary.en: OsEasy ToolBox is a lightweight Windows desktop toolkit for the OsEasy student client (V10.x). It helps classroom scenarios by unlocking keyboard/mouse and network restrictions, bypassing or intercepting full-screen broadcast commands, and managing processes and services to restore local control and support external display broadcasting. The project performs system-level experimental operations, requires administrator privileges and backups, and is provided for educational/research purposes only — users assume responsibility for any instability or policy consequences.

metadata.name: TimeMachineStatus
metadata.description: TimeMachineStatus is a little menu bar application for macOS which aims to show more useful information than the system default.

summary.zh: TimeMachineStatus 是一款 macOS 菜单栏轻量应用，比系统默认更详细地展示 Time Machine 备份状态。可列出所有备份目标并显示元数据、在指定卷上启动备份、定制菜单栏显示并支持应用内更新。使用 Xcode/Swift 开发，通过 GitHub Releases 或 Homebrew 分发。项目处于早期、欢迎贡献，适合需要更精细备份监控与操作的 macOS 用户。
summary.en: TimeMachineStatus is a lightweight macOS menu bar app that provides richer Time Machine backup information than the system UI. It lists all backup destinations with detailed metadata, shows current backup status in the menu bar, lets you start a backup on a specific volume, and allows menu item customization. Built with Xcode and Swift, it’s distributed via GitHub Releases or Homebrew and supports in-app update checking. The project is early-stage and open to contributions, aimed at macOS users who need finer-grained backup monitoring and control.

metadata.name: hurl
metadata.description: Hurl, run and test HTTP requests with plain text.

summary.zh: Hurl 是一个用 Rust 实现的跨平台命令行工具，使用简洁的纯文本语法定义并执行 HTTP 请求。支持链式请求、变量捕获、XPath/JSONPath 断言，以及状态码、响应头、时延和哈希校验，适配 REST、GraphQL、SOAP 与 HTML 抓取场景。可用于接口测试、数据抓取、轻量性能校验与回归测试，易于集成到 CI/CD（输出文本、JUnit、TAP、HTML 报告），便于在流水线中做自动化验证与调试。
summary.en: Hurl is a cross-platform command-line tool written in Rust that executes HTTP requests defined in a simple plain-text format. It supports chaining requests, capturing variables, and asserting responses with XPath, JSONPath, status codes, headers, timing, and hash checks. Hurl handles REST, GraphQL, SOAP and HTML scraping, and can run lightweight performance and regression tests. Designed for API testing, data fetching and CI/CD automation, it produces text, JUnit, TAP and HTML reports, and offers variable substitution, form/multipart support and an example-driven syntax for readable test scenarios.

metadata.name: NTrace-dev
metadata.description: NextTrace Dev

summary.zh: NextTrace 是用 Go 开发的开源轻量级可视化路由与网络诊断工具，提供图形化 traceroute 路径追踪与拓扑展示，方便运维人员进行网络故障定位与性能分析。项目支持多平台与多架构分发（APT 仓库、打包二进制、一键安装脚本与精简版），NTrace-dev 为先行测试分支，稳定版本同步到 NTrace-core。技术亮点包括高可移植性的 Golang 实现、交互式路径可视化以及面向生产的分发与自动化安装方案。
summary.en: NextTrace is an open-source, lightweight visual routing and network diagnostics tool written in Go. It delivers graphical traceroute path tracing and topology visualization to streamline network troubleshooting and operational analysis. The project supports multi-architecture distribution and easy installation through an APT repository, packaged binaries, and one-click install scripts, including a tiny edition. NTrace-dev functions as the development/beta branch before syncing stable releases to NTrace-core. Key highlights are a portable Golang implementation, interactive path visualization, and production-oriented distribution and deployment automation.

metadata.name: apple-emoji-ttf
metadata.description: Brings Apple's vibrant color emojis to Linux, Windows, and the Web

summary.zh: 将 Apple Color Emoji 转换并移植到 Linux 与 Windows 的开源字体项目。提供 CI 构建的 .deb/.rpm/.pkg 包、手动安装与 fontconfig 优先配置，以及替换 Windows seguiemj.ttf 的步骤，方便桌面环境使用苹果彩色表情。强调已知限制：部分 Linux/Qt 应用可能缩小或不渲染，且字体使用 Apple 的 morx/CBDT 表而非标准 GSUB，因而不能作为通用 @font-face 网页字体。源码不含 Apple 原始字形，构建需 Python 3.12+ 与 fonttools，并需自行承担授权风险。
summary.en: An open-source font conversion project that ports Apple Color Emoji to Linux and Windows, providing CI-built .deb/.rpm/.pkg packages plus manual install and fontconfig prioritization guidance to enable Apple’s color emoji on desktops. It documents steps to replace seguiemj.ttf on Windows and how to install user fonts on various distros. Key technical caveats: some Linux/Qt apps may render emojis smaller or not at all, and the converted TTF relies on Apple’s morx/CBDT color tables instead of GSUB, so browsers often reject it as a web @font-face. The repo doesn’t include Apple’s original asset; building requires Python 3.12+ and fonttools and carries licensing responsibilities.

metadata.name: claude-code-router
metadata.description: Use Claude Code as the foundation for coding infrastructure, allowing you to decide how to interact with the model while enjoying updates from Anthropic.

summary.zh: 基于 Claude Code 的 Claude Code Router，为代码生成场景提供可编程模型路由：支持多厂商与多模型路由、请求/响应变换、运行时模型切换、CLI 与 GitHub Actions 集成、日志与鉴权配置及插件扩展，便于在本地、容器或 CI/CD 中构建可控的编码流水线。
summary.en: Claude Code Router builds a programmable routing layer on Anthropic's Claude Code to control code-oriented LLM requests. It routes calls across multiple providers and models (e.g., OpenRouter, Ollama, Gemini), supports request/response transformers, runtime model switching via a /model command, CLI model management, logging, proxy and API-key authentication, GitHub Actions integration, and plugin extensibility. This enables reproducible, secure, and extensible coding workflows for local development, containers, and CI/CD automation.

summary.zh: Mathematica MCP Server 是基于 MCP 协议的桥接服务，利用 wolframscript 通过 Node.js 将本地 Mathematica 能力暴露给支持 MCP 的客户端（如 Cursor、Cline）。可执行复杂符号与数值计算、生成 LaTeX/Mathematica 表达，并自动验证或复现人类或 AI 提供的数学推导，适合集成到编辑器或代理的计算与验证工作流中。
summary.en: Mathematica MCP Server is an MCP-protocol bridge that exposes a local Mathematica installation to MCP-capable clients (e.g., Cursor, Cline) via a Node.js process invoking wolframscript. It enables clients to run symbolic and numeric computations, emit LaTeX or Mathematica-formatted expressions, and programmatically verify or reproduce mathematical derivations supplied by humans or AI. Lightweight and stdio-based for MCP discovery, it targets integration scenarios requiring rigorous computation and derivation checking within editor or agent workflows.

metadata.name: CookLikeHOC
metadata.description: 🥢像老乡鸡🐔那样做饭。已添加2026年发布的《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告 2.0中新出现的菜品。主要部分于2024年完工，非老乡鸡官方仓库。文字来自《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告》，并做归纳、编辑与整理。CookLikeHOC.

summary.zh: CookLikeHOC 是基于《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告》整理和编辑的社区维护菜品库与展示站，已收录至2026 年 Report 2.0 新增菜品。项目主体于2024年完成，提供网页端浏览、Docker 部署支持、AI 配图展示与结构化文字归档，便于菜品溯源、食材成分核查与菜谱研究。非老乡鸡官方仓库，文本来源公开报告并经整理，欢迎提交实拍图、修订与协作贡献。
summary.en: CookLikeHOC is a community-curated, non-official repository that catalogs dishes and provenance details extracted from the 'Laoxiangji Dish Traceability Report', now updated with items appearing in the 2026 Report 2.0. Primarily completed in 2024, the project provides a browsable web frontend, Docker deployment support, AI-generated illustrative artwork, and organized textual records for ingredient and provenance inspection. It targets food traceability, recipe archival and consumer transparency use cases; development docs and deployment helpers simplify contribution, and photo/correction submissions are encouraged with source attribution.

metadata.name: wljs-notebook
metadata.description: Open-source notebook interface for Wolfram Engine

summary.zh: WLJS Notebook 是基于 Wolfram Engine 的开源交互式笔记本界面，支持数学排版、富媒体输出与实时交互，可打开 .nb 文件并嵌入 JavaScript 沙箱，与内核双向通信。提供独立/可嵌入 HTML 与 MDX 导出、数百种导入器与函数库，Electron 驱动并跨平台（桌面、服务器、浏览器）运行，适用于交互式可视化、科研与教学的可版本化计算与展示工作流。
summary.en: WLJS Notebook is an open-source notebook interface built on the Wolfram Engine that delivers typeset math input, expressive Wolfram syntax, rich-media outputs and live interactivity. It can open .nb files, hosts a JavaScript sandbox with a dedicated channel to the Wolfram kernel, and exports standalone or embeddable HTML/MDX preserving interactive plots and controls. Electron-powered and cross-platform (desktop, server, browser), it targets interactive visualization, computational notebooks and reproducible, Git-friendly workflows for research, teaching and deployment. It bundles hundreds of Wolfram functions and importers to cover scientific and engineering use cases.

metadata.name: zx
metadata.description: A tool for writing better scripts

summary.zh: zx 是 Google 出品的跨平台脚本工具，基于 JavaScript/TypeScript 与 Node.js，封装 shell 操作与 child_process，自动转义参数并提供并发执行与可移植的默认行为，兼容 Bash、PowerShell、Deno 与 Bun。适用于部署、构建与运维自动化场景，能显著减少样板代码，使复杂脚本更可靠、可读且易维护。
summary.en: zx is a lightweight scripting toolkit from Google that makes writing shell-oriented scripts in JavaScript much easier. It provides cross-platform wrappers around child_process, safe argument escaping, sensible defaults, and simple concurrency primitives for running commands. zx supports Node.js, Bun, Deno and GraalVM, and works with Bash or PowerShell environments. It streamlines deployment, build orchestration and DevOps automation by reducing boilerplate and improving portability, readability, and maintainability of complex scripts. It also offers a Promise-based API, argument interpolation, and extensive examples and docs.

metadata.name: Pearcleaner
metadata.description: A free, source-available and fair-code licensed mac app cleaner

summary.zh: Pearcleaner 是一款源代码可见、采用 Fair‑Code 许可的 macOS 应用清理器。它将应用卸载、孤立文件搜索、Homebrew/PKG 管理、通用架构裁剪与语言精简等功能整合，提供拖拽、Finder 扩展、命令行、深度链接自动化与轻量回收站哨兵自动清理，并支持导出与主题定制。适合需要精确卸载、释放磁盘空间与维护开发环境的 mac 桌面用户与开发者。
summary.en: Pearcleaner is a free, source-available macOS application cleaner distributed under a Fair‑Code license. Inspired by AppCleaner, it integrates app uninstall, orphaned file search, Homebrew and PKG management, universal-binary architecture stripping, and localization pruning with utilities like a lightweight Sentinel monitor for automatic cleanup. It supports drag-and-drop, Finder extension, CLI and deep-link automation, export of bundles/file lists, theming, and customizable search paths. Pearcleaner targets mac desktop users and developers who need precise uninstallation and development-environment maintenance.

metadata.name: Tvlist-awesome-m3u-m3u8
metadata.description: 直播源相关资源汇总 📺 💯 IPTV、M3U —— 勤洗手、戴口罩，祝愿所有人百毒不侵

summary.zh: 面向电视盒、手机与 PC 的 IPTV/M3U/M3U8 直播源与工具汇总，按国家、地区与运营商分类并提供可下载的稳定 m3u 链接（含 IPv6/组播），并收录抓包、解析工具、插件与播放教程，定期更新，便于直接在播放器、Kodi 或网络盒子中播放与二次处理。
summary.en: This repository curates thousands of IPTV live stream sources (M3U/M3U8) and related tools, organized by country, region and ISP. It provides downloadable, regularly updated m3u playlists including IPv6 and multicast operator feeds, plus links to iptv-org and regional lists. Intended for TV boxes, mobile and desktop players, Kodi, and network appliances, it also collects capture/parsing tools, plugins and tutorials to fetch or maintain streams. The project emphasizes practical stability and accessibility for direct playback, integration into media frontends, or automation and research of stream management.

metadata.name: bilibili-api
metadata.description: 哔哩哔哩常用API调用。支持视频、番剧、用户、频道、音频等功能。原仓库地址：https://github.com/MoyuScript/bilibili-api

summary.zh: 异步 Python 库，封装 400+ B 站常用 API（视频、番剧、直播、用户、弹幕等），支持代理、BV/AV 互转、弹幕 WebSocket、字幕/弹幕下载与 aiohttp/httpx/curl_cffi 适配，便于数据采集与自动化交互。
summary.en: An async Python library wrapping 400+ Bilibili APIs (video, anime, live, user, danmaku). Supports proxies, BV/AV conversion, danmaku WebSocket, subtitle/danmaku download and adapters for aiohttp/httpx/curl_cffi—suited for scraping and automation.

metadata.name: N_m3u8DL-RE
metadata.description: Cross-Platform, modern and powerful stream downloader for MPD/M3U8/ISM. English/简体中文/繁體中文.

summary.zh: 跨平台的 DASH/HLS/MSS 媒体流下载器，支持点播与直播（DASH/HLS/MSS）。提供并发分片下载、重试与断点续传、可自定义输出命名模板、FFmpeg 合并或二进制合并、保存解析元数据（JSON）、日志与临时目录管理，支持为分片追加 URL 参数与直播时段控制，适用于批量抓取、离线播放、转封装与自动化归档场景。
summary.en: N_m3u8DL-RE is a cross-platform command-line media stream downloader for MPD/M3U8/ISM that supports DASH, HLS and MSS for both VOD and live streams.
