It offers concurrent segment downloading, retry and resume support, customizable output filename patterns, temp directory and log management, and multiple merge modes including FFmpeg concat and binary merge. It can append URL parameters, emit parsed metadata as JSON, and provides extensive CLI options (threads, timeouts, retries). Ideal for batch grabbing, offline playback, re-muxing and automated archiving workflows.

metadata.name: Microsoft-Office-For-MacOS
metadata.description: Installer Microsoft Office For MacOS

summary.zh: 此仓库汇集 macOS 版 Microsoft Office 的安装包与 Volume License 序列化器，提供安装与激活的操作流程（先安装 VL Serializer.pkg，再安装官方 pkg），并列明对 macOS 10.6–13 及 Apple Silicon 的兼容性。适合系统管理员或需批量/离线部署 Office 的场景，技术亮点在于集中官方下载链接、版本兼容说明与可用于企业卷授权激活的安装序列化器。
summary.en: This repository collects installers and instructions to install and activate Microsoft Office on macOS using Volume License serializers (LTSC 2021/2024) and official pkg files. It documents compatibility across older macOS releases through Ventura and notes Apple Silicon support. The recommended workflow is to install the VL serializer package, download the desired official Office pkg, then install to activate apps. It targets system administrators and bulk/offline deployment scenarios, highlighting centralized links, version compatibility guidance, and a reproducible activation sequence for diverse macOS environments.

metadata.name: Debian-Hyprland
metadata.description: For automated installation of Hyprland on Debian 13 Trixie (Testing) and Debian SiD (Unstable)

summary.zh: 为 Debian 13（Trixie）及以上（testing/SID）提供的 Hyprland 自动化安装脚本，自动处理依赖、编译与配置，包含点阵配置与演示资源。强调升级到 Forky/SID 后必须重编译并建议先备份，项目已移交至 LinuxBeginnings 维护，适合想在 Debian 上快速部署 Wayland 桌面的用户。
summary.en: Automated installer script for Hyprland on Debian 13+ (Trixie/testing/SID). It manages dependencies, compilation and configuration, bundles dotfiles and demo media, warns to recompile after upgrades and recommends backups. Project moved to LinuxBeginnings for maintenance; ideal for quickly deploying a Wayland desktop on Debian.

metadata.name: synctv
metadata.description: Synchronized viewing, theater, live streaming, video

summary.zh: SyncTV 是一款开源自托管的同步观影与直播平台，能将多端播放进度锁定一致，提供剧场化体验、聊天与弹幕功能。它内建视频与直播代理与缓存，支持 Alist、Bilibili、Emby 源解析，并通过 WebRTC 实现在线音频通话（视频/屏幕支持在路上）。提供二进制、Docker 镜像与 Helm Chart 部署，适用于远程观影派对、共看活动与私有流媒体共享场景。
summary.en: SyncTV is an open-source, self-hostable platform for synchronized movie and live-stream viewing. It keeps playback in lockstep across participants and offers a theater experience with chat and bullet comments. The project includes video and live proxies with caching, parsers for Alist, Bilibili and Emby sources, and WebRTC-based audio calling (video/screen support planned). Deployments are available as standalone binaries, Docker images and Helm charts for Kubernetes. SyncTV targets remote watch parties, co-watching events and shared live viewing with easy self-hosting and media integration.

metadata.name: Lorien
metadata.description: Infinite canvas drawing/whiteboarding app for Windows, Linux and macOS. Made with Godot.

summary.zh: Lorien 是一款基于 Godot 引擎的跨平台无限画布绘图与笔记应用。它以矢量化笔触记录笔迹，保持极小存档与高渲染性能，支持无限撤销/任意缩放、SVG 导出、绘图板压感与多文档管理，侧重头脑风暴与速写场景。项目开源且仍在开发中，欢迎贡献与本地化参与。
summary.en: Lorien is a cross-platform, infinite-canvas drawing and note-taking app built with the Godot Engine. Rather than using bitmaps it stores strokes as vector point collections, yielding very small savefiles and fast runtime rendering. Key features include infinite undo/redo, near-unlimited zoom and grid, SVG export, pressure-sensitive tablet support, rebindable shortcuts and multiple documents. Geared toward brainstorming, quick sketches and structured notes rather than full bitmap painting, Lorien is open-source and actively developed with community contributions welcome.

metadata.name: fcitx5-ios
metadata.description: Fcitx5 iOS edition, currently developer beta. 小企鹅输入法 iOS 开发者公测 https://t.me/fcitx5macos/16126

summary.zh: 将开源输入法框架 Fcitx5 移植到 iOS（≥16.3），提供系统键盘扩展与配套 App。仓库含 CMake 交叉编译、模拟器/真机调试、Appium E2E 测试与 77MB 键盘扩展内存限制说明。
summary.en: Port of open-source Fcitx5 to iOS (≥16.3): system keyboard + app, with CMake cross-build, simulator/device setup, and Appium E2E tests.

metadata.name: MahoShojo-Generator
metadata.description: 基于 AI 结构化生成的个性化魔法少女角色生成器。

summary.zh: MahoShojo-Generator 是一款基于结构化 AI 的网页生成器，能快速产出可成长的个性化魔法少女角色并支持实时流式战报、连续剧情与竞技场 PVP。项目集成多模型轮询、云端存档、角色卡导入/导出、敏感词检测与实验性立绘生成功能，适合创作、社群互动与轻量化竞技玩法。
summary.en: MahoShojo-Generator is a web-based structured-AI generator that creates personalized, evolvable magical-girl characters. It features real-time streaming battle reports, chained story mode, arena PVP, cloud saves, multi-model AI polling, card import/export, safety filters and experimental portrait generation—suited for creative storytelling, social sharing and light competitive play.

summary.zh: iQbit 是为 qBittorrent 打造的 iOS 风格 WebUI 主题，移动优先、遵循 Human Interface 指南，强调易用性。作为 PWA 可安装到设备，支持原生类特性；项目还提供独立服务端代理以分离移动与桌面 WebUI。易部署（指向 release 文件夹），GPLv3 开源，后续计划支持原生推送、相机导入及 Sonarr/Radarr 整合。
summary.en: iQbit is an iOS‑styled WebUI theme for qBittorrent that modernizes the torrent client with a mobile-first, Human Interface Guidelines-driven design. Delivered as a Progressive Web App, it can be installed on devices and expose native-like features; the project also includes an optional standalone server to proxy qBittorrent so mobile and desktop WebUIs can run separately. It focuses on ease of use and simple deployment (point qBittorrent at the release folder). Open-source under GPLv3, planned additions include push/camera features and Sonarr/Radarr integration.

metadata.name: mirotalksfu
metadata.description: 🏆 Self-hosted, open-source WebRTC video conferencing platform for real-time communication and collaboration. A modern alternative to Zoom, built on SFU architecture.

summary.zh: MiroTalk SFU 是基于 mediasoup 的自托管开源 WebRTC 视频会议平台，采用可扩展 SFU 架构，支持多方音视频、屏幕共享、流媒体转推与 Docker 部署。项目强调隐私与数据自主（AGPLv3），适合企业、组织与直播场景作为替代 Zoom/Meet 的低延迟、大规模实时协作和可扩展生产部署方案。
summary.en: MiroTalk SFU is a self-hosted, open-source WebRTC video conferencing platform built on the mediasoup SFU architecture. It delivers scalable, low-latency multi-party audio/video, screen sharing and stream relay with Docker-friendly deployment, AGPLv3 licensing and privacy-focused data control. As a modern alternative to Zoom, Meet or Teams, MiroTalk targets teams, enterprises and streamers needing on-premises conferencing, real-time collaboration, extensibility via APIs/plugins, recording and production scalability tuning, backed by documentation and an active community.

metadata.name: neodb
metadata.description: 🧩 a self-hosted server tracking what you read/watch/listen/play, powering a global distributed community federating via ActivityPub and (a bit of) ATProto.

summary.zh: NeoDB 是可自托管的去中心化媒体目录与社交平台，记录你读、看、听、玩的内容并支持评分、笔记与收藏。它通过 ActivityPub（并部分支持 ATProto）参与联邦，提供从 Goodreads/IMDB/Spotify/Steam 等一键导入、完整数据导入导出、可播放动态流、隐私权限与社交登录，适合部署私人或公有实例以分享与发现文化内容。
summary.en: NeoDB is an open-source, self-hosted media catalog and social platform for tracking what you read, watch, listen to, or play. It federates via ActivityPub (with partial ATProto support) so instances can join the Fediverse, offering one-click creation from many third-party sources (Goodreads, IMDB, Spotify, Steam, etc.), import/export of user archives, ratings, reviews, tags, collections, and playable feeds. NeoDB provides home timelines, privacy controls, social logins/imports, and Docker-friendly deployments for private or public servers to share and discover cultural content.

metadata.name: imessage-exporter
metadata.description: Export iMessage data + run iMessage Diagnostics

summary.zh: imessage-exporter 是一个用 Rust 编写的跨平台库与命令行工具，能从 iMessage 数据库中完整读取并导出消息与多媒体（图片、视频、音频、贴纸、Tapbacks、编辑记录等），生成可移植的 HTML/TXT 归档并可运行数据库诊断。适用于消息备份、跨设备迁移、合规取证与故障排查，兼容最新 macOS/iOS 特性并保留原始附件与格式化内容。
summary.en: imessage-exporter is a Rust-based cross-platform crate and CLI that reads, inspects and exports iMessage databases into portable HTML/TXT archives while preserving attachments (images, video, audio), formatted text, reactions, edits, stickers and other iMessage features. It includes a library for structured access and a binary for exports and diagnostics, supporting migration, backups, forensic compliance and database troubleshooting across macOS, Linux and Windows. The project aims for a comprehensive, faithful representation of iMessage history and multimedia for reliable preservation and analysis.

metadata.name: copyparty
metadata.description: Portable file server with accelerated resumable uploads, dedup, WebDAV, SFTP, FTP, TFTP, zeroconf, media indexer, thumbnails++ all in one file

summary.zh: copyparty 是一款可移植的文件服务器，将几乎任何设备变为支持断点续传、去重、媒体索引与增强缩略图的多协议文件中心。单文件部署、仅需 Python（2/3），依赖可选，内置 HTTP/WebDAV/SFTP/FTP/TFTP/SMB、zeroconf、RSS/OPDS、ZIP 打包与浏览器友好 UI，适用于局域网或公网共享、移动端上传、临时分享与轻量远程备份。
summary.en: copyparty is a portable, single-file file server that turns almost any device into a multi-protocol sharing hub. It provides accelerated resumable uploads/downloads, deduplication, media indexing and advanced thumbnails, plus zeroconf discovery and a browser-first UI. Server runs on Python (2/3) with optional dependencies and exposes HTTP/WebDAV/SFTP/FTP/TFTP/SMB, RSS/OPDS feeds, zip/tar on-the-fly and temporary share links. Ideal for LAN or Internet sharing, mobile uploads, lightweight remote backups and ad-hoc file distribution.

metadata.name: qbittorrent-nox-static
metadata.description: A bash script which builds a fully static qbittorrent-nox binary with current dependencies to use on any Linux OS

summary.zh: 基于 Bash 的自动化构建脚本，静态编译 qbittorrent‑nox 及其全部依赖，生成可在任意 Linux（多架构）运行的无外部库二进制。内置依赖版本元数据并同时提供 libtorrent v1/v2 选项，便于免环境部署与跨平台分发。
summary.en: A Bash automation script that produces fully static qbittorrent‑nox binaries bundling all dependencies for many Linux CPU architectures. It includes dependency-version metadata and offers libtorrent v1/v2 builds, enabling no-dependency deployment and easy cross-platform distribution.

metadata.name: Adobe-Downloader
metadata.description: macOS Adobe apps download & installer

summary.zh: Adobe Downloader 是面向 macOS 13+ 的桌面工具，从 Adobe 官方渠道批量下载并自动安装产品；自动修补 Adobe setup 以规避 2700 错误，采用 Helper（SMAppService）做权限代理，支持多任务、语言选择、安装日志持久化与清理工具，所有软件来自官方，非破解。
summary.en: Adobe Downloader is a macOS (13+) desktop application for downloading and installing Adobe products from official Adobe channels. It automates modification of the Adobe Setup to avoid installation error 2700 and leverages a signed helper (implemented via SMAppService) to perform privileged operations without repeated password prompts. Features include concurrent downloads, persistent task history, language selection, a cleanup tool for Adobe leftovers, execution logging and a helper playground for observing behavior. Packages are official, not cracked.

metadata.name: langshift.dev
metadata.description: 🌍 Programming language learning platform for developers. Master new languages through comparison learning. Interactive editor, performance monitoring, multi-language support.

summary.zh: LangShift.dev 是面向开发者的编程语言对比学习平台。通过并列对比、交互式在线编辑器、性能监测与 AI 辅助生成并审核的学习内容，覆盖 JS↔Python/Rust/Go/Kotlin/C++/C 等模块，帮助开发者快速掌握新语言并迁移到实战项目。
summary.en: LangShift.dev is a developer-focused language-comparison learning platform. It combines side-by-side comparisons, an interactive editor, performance monitoring and AI-curated content, covering JS↔Python/Rust/Go/Kotlin/C++/C modules to accelerate language mastery and practical migration.

metadata.name: r8125
metadata.description: 2.5G Ethernet LINUX driver r8125

summary.zh: 本仓库提供基于 DKMS 的 Realtek RTL8125/RTL8125B 2.5GbE PCIe 网卡 Linux 驱动封装（含 .deb 及 openSUSE 安装方案）。安装后驱动可随内核自动重建并在升级后保持生效，仓库含替换 r8169 的 modprobe 配置、update-initramfs 步骤与打包/更新说明。便于在 Debian/Ubuntu 与 openSUSE 系统上稳定维护高性能 2.5G 以太网驱动，并支持 fork 后通过 release 自动生成安装包。
summary.en: This repository provides a DKMS-based Linux driver package for Realtek RTL8125/RTL8125B 2.5GbE PCIe controllers, available as a .deb and with openSUSE install instructions. It ensures the r8125 kernel module is rebuilt automatically and remains active after kernel upgrades, includes steps to override the fallback r8169 driver, and documents installation and update workflows. Contributors can fork, update Realtek sources and create a tagged release to trigger automatic deb packaging. Licensed under GPL-2, it targets reliable 2.5GbE support on Debian/Ubuntu and openSUSE systems.

metadata.name: dashy
metadata.description: 🚀 A self-hostable personal dashboard built for you. Includes status-checking, widgets, themes, icon packs, a UI editor and tons more!

summary.zh: Dashy 是可自托管的个人仪表盘，将自建服务与链接集中到单一可定制界面。支持实时状态检测、可配置小部件、主题与图标包、可视化 UI 编辑器及单文件 YAML 配置。具备多页与工作区视图、启动方式定制、可选认证/SSO、加密云备份与多语言支持，且可通过 Docker 或一键部署快速上线，适合 homelab 与轻量运维场景的服务聚合、状态监控与快速访问入口管理。
summary.en: Dashy is a self-hosted personal dashboard that consolidates your self-hosted services and links into a single customizable UI. It provides real-time status checks, configurable widgets, theme and icon packs, a visual UI editor, and a single-file YAML configuration. Features include multi-page and workspace views, multiple opening methods, optional authentication and SSO, encrypted cloud backup, and multilingual support. Easily deployable via Docker or one-click cloud images, Dashy is ideal for homelab users and lightweight ops teams needing a fast, flexible service aggregator and startpage.

metadata.name: university-information
metadata.description: 收集全国各高校招生时不会写明，却会实实在在影响大学生活质量的要求与细节

summary.zh: 收集高校在招生信息中不写明但会影响大学生活质量的细节，覆盖宿舍、空调、热水、门禁、外卖、断电断网等。可在 colleges.chat 查询，仓库自动生成 Markdown（generated 分支），通过 Discussions 贡献与纠错。内容采用 CC BY‑NC‑SA 4.0 许可证。
summary.en: This project aggregates overlooked but consequential details about campus life at Chinese universities that are rarely disclosed during admissions: dorm layouts, air conditioning, hot water schedules, bathrooms, meal delivery policies, campus network uptime, curfews and checks, laundry and shared facilities, fitness/run requirements, and more. Inspired by Telegram posts, it provides a searchable site at colleges.chat and auto-generates Markdown records in the generated branch. Contributions, questions and corrections are handled via the repository Discussions. Content is licensed under CC BY‑NC‑SA 4.0; contact maintainers to report errors or request removals.

metadata.name: anylinuxfs
metadata.description: macOS: mount any linux-supported filesystem read/write using NFS and a microVM

summary.zh: anylinuxfs 在 macOS 上通过 libkrun 微型虚拟机与 NFS 实现对 ext4、btrfs、XFS、ZFS、NTFS 等 Linux 文件系统的完整读写挂载，无需内核扩展或 macFUSE。支持 LUKS/BitLocker、LVM、RAID 与磁盘镜像，按卷启动小型 VM（默认 512MB，可配置），适用于数据恢复、跨平台开发与在 Mac 上直接访问 Linux 磁盘（仅 Apple Silicon，CLI 工具）。
summary.en: anylinuxfs enables full read-write mounting of Linux-native filesystems (ext4, btrfs, XFS, ZFS, NTFS, exFAT, plus LUKS/LVM/RAID) on macOS by running a lightweight libkrun microVM per volume and exposing the filesystem over NFS. It avoids kernel extensions or macFUSE, supports disk images, encrypted volumes (LUKS/BitLocker) and multi-disk setups. CLI-focused and Apple Silicon–only, it trades a small VM per mount for native Linux filesystem fidelity, useful for recovery, cross-platform development and direct access to Linux disks from a Mac.

metadata.name: Resume-Matcher
metadata.description: Improve your resumes with Resume Matcher. Get insights, keyword suggestions and tune your resumes to job descriptions.

summary.zh: Resume Matcher 是开源的简历定制与优化工具。上传主简历（PDF/DOCX）并粘贴职位描述，AI 给出关键词建议、内容重写、求职信生成、版式自定义与 PDF 导出。支持本地 Ollama 或连接云端 LLM API，可在私有或云端环境中为每个岗位自动微调简历以提升匹配度，面向求职者与招聘方，社区驱动并采用 Apache‑2.0 许可。
summary.en: Resume Matcher is an open-source tool for tailoring resumes to specific job descriptions using large language models. Users upload a master resume (PDF/DOCX), paste a job posting, and receive keyword suggestions, AI-driven content rewrites, cover letter generation, layout customization, and polished PDF export. It runs locally with Ollama or connects to remote LLM APIs, enabling private or cloud workflows. Aimed at job seekers and recruiters, it automates resume optimization to improve semantic matching and application quality while remaining extensible and community-driven under Apache 2.0.

metadata.name: UniBoard
metadata.description: 个人介绍，导航页、笔记、短链、文件分享、探针，私有化部署。Profile、Note、ShortURL、FileSharing、probeMonitor…… with self-host

summary.zh: UniBoard 是基于 Vue 与 TypeScript 的前端模板，集个人主页、导航页、云笔记（Markdown/WYSIWYG）、短链统计、文件存储与分享、探针监控于一体。支持账号鉴权、内置图床、文件直链与私有化 Docker Compose 部署，前后端分离（后端另有仓库）。适合自托管个人资源、知识管理与文件分享场景，便于通过 Nginx 反向代理与升级流程进行生产部署。
summary.en: UniBoard is a front-end template built with Vue and TypeScript that unifies a personal homepage, link hub, cloud notes (Markdown and WYSIWYG), short URL service with analytics, file storage/sharing with direct links and auth, and a probe/monitoring dashboard. The repo contains only the client; a separate backend (UniBoard-Service) exposes the APIs. Designed for self-hosting via Docker Compose and optional Nginx reverse proxy, it provides a lightweight, private personal content and resource management portal with image hosting, authentication and clear upgrade guidance.

metadata.description: 015 is a self-hosted temporary file sharing platform. Focused on providing one-time, temporary file and text upload, processing, and sharing services.

summary.zh: 015 是一个可自托管的临时文件分享平台，侧重一次性/短期文件与文本的上传、处理与分享。前端基于 Vue 3/Nuxt3，支持分片上传、前端文件哈希与 Web Worker 实现的即时秒传和断点续传；后端用 Go + Echo，结合 Redis 与 Asynq 实现异步队列处理、JWT 下载控制与完整的分享管理（密码、次数与过期）。适用于需要私有部署、短期共享、一次性传输和对上传/预览、图片压缩及并发处理有要求的场景。
summary.en: 015 is a self-hosted temporary file sharing platform focused on one-time and short-lived file/text uploads, processing, and sharing. The frontend uses Vue 3/Nuxt 3 with chunked uploads, client-side hashing and Web Workers for instant transfer and resumable uploads. The backend is written in Go with Echo, using Redis and Asynq for async queue processing, JWT-based download control, and complete share management (passwords, limits, expirations). It’s ideal for private deployments requiring secure ephemeral links, fast deduplication, image processing, previews and concurrent handling.

metadata.name: Mangane
metadata.description: Alternative frontend for Akkoma

summary.zh: Mangane 是为 Pleroma/Akkoma（兼容 Mastodon API）打造的浏览器单页前端，强调易用性、可读性与品牌化定制。项目以纯前端 JavaScript/XHR 实现，包含后端功能探测以动态适配不同实例，便于在资源受限的服务器上轻量部署与维护，适合希望提供可定制联邦社交界面的实例运营方。
summary.en: Mangane is a browser-based single-page alternative frontend for Pleroma and Akkoma, fully compatible with the Mastodon API. It emphasizes usability, readability and brandable theming, implemented entirely client-side with JavaScript and XHR. The app detects backend features to adapt its UI and API usage across Pleroma/Akkoma/Mastodon instances, targeting lightweight, energy-efficient deployments on modest hardware and easy installation behind common proxies like nginx.

metadata.name: macos
metadata.description: MacOS inside a Docker container.

summary.zh: 在 Docker 容器内运行完整 macOS，利用 KVM 加速并提供网页 VNC 访问与自动镜像下载。支持 macOS 11–15 版本、可自定义磁盘大小与资源，能通过 Docker Compose、CLI、Kubernetes 或 GitHub Codespaces 部署，适合在非 Apple 主机上快速搭建远程 macOS 开发、测试与 CI 环境。注意：macOS 15（Sequoia）对 Apple ID 支持仍有限。
summary.en: Runs a full macOS installation inside a Docker container with KVM acceleration. The project automates macOS image download and exposes a web-based VNC viewer (port 8006) for interactive setup. It supports macOS versions 11–15, configurable disk size and resources, and can be deployed via Docker CLI, Compose, Kubernetes or GitHub Codespaces. Ideal for provisioning disposable macOS VMs on non‑Apple hosts for development, testing, CI, or remote desktop access. Note: macOS 15 (Sequoia) currently has limited Apple ID support.

metadata.name: diskonaut
metadata.description: Terminal disk space navigator 🔭

summary.zh: diskonaut 是用 Rust 开发的跨平台终端磁盘空间导航器。它将指定路径扫描并索引到内存，实时呈现可交互的矩形/树状可视化，支持边扫描边浏览、在终端删除文件并统计已释放空间，便于快速定位占用大量磁盘的文件和目录，适合系统维护与空间清理场景。
summary.en: diskonaut is a Rust-based cross-platform terminal disk-space navigator. It scans a path into memory and provides an interactive treemap/tree view, allowing browsing while scanning, deleting files from the terminal and tracking freed space—useful for quickly locating large files and cleaning up disk usage.

metadata.name: blockminer
metadata.description: o

summary.zh: BlockMiner 是一款基于 Fabric 的 Minecraft 客户端模组，利用活塞配合红石火把或拉杆的构造技巧，能破坏原版不可破坏方块（如基岩）。提供命令式控制、目标与依赖白名单、区域指定、距离计算模式、延迟/闪送与无头活塞兼容等技术选项，要求特定物品组合或信标增益并建议安装 fabric-api。使用可能被视为外挂，请在服务器允许的情况下使用并自担风险。
summary.en: BlockMiner is a Fabric-based Minecraft client mod that enables breaking vanilla unbreakable blocks (e.g., bedrock) by building piston contraptions driven by redstone torches or levers. It offers command-driven control, target and support block whitelists, area targeting, distance-calculation modes to adapt reach, blink-during-tick and ping-spike handling, and a headless-piston mode. Requires specific item setups (pistons, Efficiency V pickaxe for torch mode) and optionally Fabric API for commands/i18n. May be treated as cheating on servers—use only with permission.

metadata.name: DockerHub
metadata.description: 2026年5月更新，目前国内可用Docker镜像源汇总，DockerHub国内镜像加速列表，🚀DockerHub镜像加速器

summary.zh: 本仓库汇总并持续更新国内可用的 DockerHub 镜像加速器列表，列出可用与已失效源、访问限制与使用建议，提供社区与云厂商加速器链接，便于在中国境内快速拉取或切换镜像来源，减少因被下架或地域限制导致的拉取失败风险。
summary.en: This repository maintains an up-to-date list of Docker Hub mirror and accelerator endpoints available within mainland China (May 2026). It catalogs working and defunct services, notes access restrictions (region limits, login/tokens), and offers practical guidance for swapping accelerators to speed image pulls. The collection links community-run mirrors and cloud-provider options, helping developers and operations teams mitigate blocked or slow Docker Hub access in China and choose alternative sources quickly.

metadata.name: cherry
metadata.description: Cherry is a self-hostable bookmark service

summary.zh: Cherry 是一款可自托管的书签管理服务，基于 pnpm/Node.js 生态并生成类型文件。提供本地开发启动、.env 配置与 CLI 用户/权限管理，便于个人或团队在私有环境中整理、同步和管理书签。
summary.en: Cherry is a self-hosted bookmark manager built on the Node.js/pnpm ecosystem with generated type files. It offers easy local setup, .env configuration, a development server, and a CLI for user and admin management—suitable for private or team bookmark organization and sync.

metadata.name: docker_image_pusher
metadata.description: 使用Github Action将国外的Docker镜像转存到阿里云私有仓库，供国内服务器使用，免费易用

summary.zh: 用 GitHub Actions 将国外 Docker 镜像自动转存到阿里云私有仓库，便于国内服务器高速拉取。支持 DockerHub、gcr.io、k8s.io、ghcr.io 等任意源，单镜像可达 40GB，支持多架构（--platform）、命名空间冲突处理与定时同步。通过 images.txt 列表和仓库 Secrets 配置阿里云注册表、命名空间和凭证，免费易用并基于阿里官方线路提速。
summary.en: This repository provides a GitHub Actions workflow to automatically mirror foreign Docker images into an Alibaba Cloud Container Registry, enabling fast, reliable pulls for domestic servers. It supports sources such as Docker Hub, gcr.io, k8s.io and ghcr.io, handles images up to 40GB, multi-architecture images via --platform, namespace conflict resolution, and scheduled syncs. Users list images in images.txt and set Alibaba registry, namespace, username and password as Actions secrets. The solution uses Alibaba's official network for speed and is free and easy to deploy.

metadata.name: Graphite
metadata.description: Community-built comprehensive 2D content creation appplication for graphic design, digital art, and interactive real-time motion graphics powered by a node-based procedural graphics engine

summary.zh: Graphite 是社区驱动的开源 2D 内容创作器，将无损图层合成与节点式程序化图形引擎结合，统一矢量与光栅工作流，支持实时交互动效、数位绘画与 VFX，适用于平面设计与动态图形制作。
summary.en: Graphite is a community-built open-source 2D editor that combines nondestructive layer compositing with a node-based procedural graphics engine, unifying vector and raster workflows for digital art, motion graphics and VFX.

metadata.name: happy-llm
metadata.description: 📚 从零开始构建大模型

summary.zh: Happy-LLM 是 Datawhale 出品的系统性大模型学习与实战教程。从 NLP 基础、Transformer 与注意力机制出发，手把手实现 tokenizer 与 LLaMA2 架构，覆盖预训练、SFT 以及 LoRA/QLoRA 高效微调流程，并包含 RAG、Agent 等前沿应用与大量代码示例与实践指导，适合希望从零构建、训练与评估小型到中等规模 LLM 的研究者与工程师。
summary.en: Happy-LLM is a comprehensive, open-source learning and hands-on guide from Datawhale for building large language models from scratch. It guides readers through NLP fundamentals, Transformer architecture and attention mechanisms, tokenizer construction, and a practical LLaMA2 implementation. The material covers end-to-end workflows including pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA efficient tuning, and applications such as RAG and agent systems. Each chapter pairs theory with code examples and practical tips, aimed at researchers and engineers who want to implement, train, and evaluate small-to-medium LLMs.

metadata.name: danted
metadata.description: Fast script for installing & configing Danted--Socks5 Proxy Server.

summary.zh: 快速脚本，用于自动安装与管理 Dante（Socks5）代理：自动识别系统并编译、智能生成配置，支持多IP 同源轮换、PAM/系统/白名单多重认证，兼容 systemd，提供一键安装/卸载、用户管理、白名单更新与 Docker 容器化部署，便于在 Debian/CentOS 等 Linux 环境中快速搭建可控的 Socks5 服务并实现运维自动化。
summary.en: Danted is a fast install-and-management script for the Dante SOCKS5 server. It auto-detects the OS and can compile from source, auto-generates configs from network settings or arguments, and supports multi-IP rotation, PAM/system/whitelist authentication, and systemd. The project offers one-step install/uninstall, user management, whitelist updates, and Docker image/compose support for containerized deployment—making it ideal for admins who need to quickly provision and automate a controllable SOCKS5 proxy on Debian/CentOS Linux.

metadata.name: Docker-qBittorrent-Enhanced-Edition
metadata.description: Docker-qBittorrent-Enhanced-Edition

summary.zh: 基于 qBittorrent Enhanced Edition 的多架构 Docker 镜像，支持 x86-64/arm64/armhf，面向群晖/威联通等 NAS。静态编译、user mapping 与下载权限修复，默认中文与上海时区，内置 400+ tracker 并自动汇报以加速连接，精简无多余服务，支持通过环境变量或密钥文件配置 Web 密码，便于在 NAS/家庭服务器上稳定部署并提升 BT 下载性能。
summary.en: A multi-architecture Docker image packaging qBittorrent Enhanced Edition for NAS (Synology, QNAP) and x86-64/arm64/armhf platforms. It provides a statically compiled binary, user-mapping to run as the host user, automatic download-permission fixes, and a minimal, single-service footprint. Defaults to Asia/Shanghai and Chinese locale, includes 400+ built-in trackers with auto-reporting to speed peer discovery, supports environment/file PBKDF2 web password configuration, healthcheck and s6 integration, and automated updates for easy, stable BT deployment and faster downloads.

metadata.name: VueTorrent
metadata.description: The sleekest looking WEBUI for qBittorrent made with Vuejs!

summary.zh: VueTorrent 是基于 Vue.js 与 Vuetify 的 qBittorrent WebUI，界面美观响应，适配桌面与移动，支持添加/暂停/重命名/选择性下载、查看 trackers/peers/文件内容、内置搜索与丰富快捷键。提供模拟数据演示与 npm、docker-compose 开发流程，便于替代原生 WebUI 提升可用性与可定制性。
summary.en: VueTorrent is a polished Web UI for qBittorrent built with Vue.js (Vue 3) and Vuetify, delivering a modern, responsive interface for both desktop and mobile. It supports comprehensive torrent control — add, remove, pause, resume, rename torrents, selective file downloads, and viewing trackers, peers, content, tags and categories — plus integrated torrent search and extensive keyboard shortcuts. A live demo (mocked data) and developer-friendly setup via npm or docker-compose are provided. The project aims to supplant qBittorrent’s native WebUI by prioritizing usability, visual design and customization while interfacing with qBittorrent’s API.

metadata.name: ecs
metadata.description: VPS Fusion Monster Server Test GO Version Aiming to be the most comprehensive server testing project, implemented in Go with zero environment dependencies.      VPS融合怪服务器测评项目 GO版本 尽量成为最全能的服务器测评项目，使用 Go 实现，无需任何环境依赖。

summary.zh: ECS 是用 Go 实现的跨平台 VPS/服务器综合测评工具，零环境依赖，支持多架构。集成自研模块：CPU/内存/磁盘基准、IP 与安全检测、流媒体解锁、邮件端口与三网回程等，支持并发检测与自动化运维，便于性能对比与质量评估。
summary.en: ECS is a Go-based, zero-dependency, cross-platform VPS/server evaluation suite aiming to be a comprehensive benchmarking project. It bundles self-developed modules for CPU, memory and disk benchmarks, IP quality and security checks, streaming platform unlock tests, email port checks, and multi-network return path tests. Designed for concurrent, non-invasive measurements across many architectures and OSes, ECS suits automated operations, hosting providers, and performance comparison scenarios where reproducible, portable server quality metrics are needed.

metadata.name: knowledge-grab
metadata.description: knowledge-grab 是一个基于 Tauri 和 Vue 3 构建的桌面应用程序，方便用户从 国家中小学智慧教育平台 (basic.smartedu.cn) 下载各类教育资源。

summary.zh: knowledge-grab 是基于 Tauri 与 Vue 3 的跨平台桌面应用，专为从国家中小学智慧教育平台（basic.smartedu.cn）批量抓取并按分类下载教材与教学资源设计。支持批量下载、封面预览与打包发布，开发环境需 Node.js 与 Rust（Tauri）。仓库还提供多种前端模版与构建脚本。注意：对端网站改版可能导致下载逻辑需要额外分析与维护。
summary.en: knowledge-grab is a cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri and Vue 3 to streamline downloading educational materials from China’s National K–12 Smart Education platform (basic.smartedu.cn). It supports categorized and bulk downloads, cover previews, and packaging for distribution. The project uses Vite and pnpm for development and requires Node.js and Rust to build the Tauri backend. It includes UI templates and developer-friendly run/build commands. Note: upstream site changes can increase scraping complexity and may require additional analysis to restore download workflows.

metadata.name: RSS-to-Telegram-Bot
metadata.description: A Telegram RSS bot that cares about your reading experience (calling for new maintainers: https://github.com/Rongronggg9/RSS-to-Telegram-Bot/issues/747)

summary.zh: RSS to Telegram Bot 是一款注重阅读体验的多用户 Telegram 订阅转发器，保留富文本与媒体、替换表情与长图处理、自动分割长消息并支持 Telegraph 发布。具备多语言、OPML 导入导出、每源代理、HTTP 缓存与 Docker 部署，提供灵活格式化设置与性能优化，适合个人、频道或群组的内容聚合与推送场景。
summary.en: RSS to Telegram Bot is a production-ready Telegram RSS forwarder focused on reading experience. It preserves rich text and in-post media, converts emoji assets, handles long images and auto-splits lengthy messages, and can publish via Telegraph. Features include multi-user support, extensive i18n, OPML import/export, per-feed proxies, HTTP caching and Docker deployment. Flexible formatting options and performance optimizations make it ideal for personal users, channels and groups needing reliable content aggregation and push delivery.

metadata.name: zerotier-moon
metadata.description: 🐳 A docker image to create ZeroTier moon in one step.

summary.zh: 本仓库提供一键部署 ZeroTier Moon 的 Docker 镜像，自动检测公网 IPv4/IPv6、支持自定义端口并持久化数据。简化私有 Moon 节点与去中心化中继的搭建流程，适合快速构建私有 ZeroTier 骨干或 VPN 回程，运行后输出 Moon ID 和 stableEndpoints 便于客户端 orbit。
summary.en: This repository provides a Docker image for one-step creation of a ZeroTier Moon node. It automates public IP detection for IPv4/IPv6, allows a custom port (default 9993), and persists state via a mounted volume. The image streamlines deploying private ZeroTier root/relay nodes to build decentralized overlay networks or resilient VPN backbones, supports both docker run and docker-compose flows with required capabilities and /dev/net/tun, and outputs the Moon ID and stableEndpoints for client orbiting.
tags_zh: 私有 Moon 节点部署

metadata.name: zfile
metadata.description: 在线云盘、网盘、OneDrive、云存储、私有云、对象存储、h5ai、上传、下载

summary.zh: ZFile 是面向个人与小团队的在线网盘/私有云管理系统，统一接入 S3、OneDrive/SharePoint、Google Drive、本地存储、FTP/SFTP 等多种存储源。提供 Docker 部署、响应式界面、多用户权限、直链/短链（可过期）、丰富的在线预览（图片、音视频、Office、PDF、3D）和存储统一管理能力，适用于文件共享、私有云归档与媒体浏览场景。
summary.en: ZFile is an open-source online cloud drive and private cloud file management system for individuals and small teams. It unifies diverse storage backends—S3-compatible object stores, OneDrive/SharePoint, Google Drive, local disks, FTP/SFTP—into a single web UI. Key features include Docker/Docker Compose deployment, responsive interface, multi-user access controls, direct and expiring short links, and rich in-browser previews (images, audio/video, Office, PDF, text, 3D). Suitable for unified storage management, secure file sharing, lightweight private cloud hosting, and media browsing.

metadata.name: angie
metadata.description: Angie - drop-in replacement for nginx

summary.zh: Angie 是从 nginx 分支出的可替换 Web 服务器，兼容 nginx 配置与模块，原生支持 HTTP/3、内置 ACME 自动签发证书，提供 RESTful JSON API 与可定制的 Prometheus 导出，简化 location 配置并增强可观测性，适合高性能反向代理、边缘 TLS 与生产级部署场景。
summary.en: Angie is a high-performance, nginx-forked drop-in web server compatible with existing nginx configurations and modules. It advances nginx by providing native HTTP/3 for client and upstream connections, built-in ACME for automated TLS issuance (HTTP/DNS/ALPN), a RESTful JSON API for configuration and metrics, and customizable Prometheus exports. Angie also simplifies location matching and exposes observability via a lightweight console, making it suitable for production reverse-proxy, edge TLS, and performance-sensitive deployments that require modern protocol support and backward compatibility.

metadata.name: neko
metadata.description: A self hosted virtual browser that runs in docker and uses WebRTC.

summary.zh: Neko 是一个可自托管的虚拟浏览器，运行于 Docker 容器内并通过 WebRTC 实时流式传输完整桌面。提供隔离的浏览环境、可持久或临时会话、多人并发访问与会话共享，适用于隐私安全浏览、网页应用测试、远程协作、观影派对与演示场景，便于在任意设备上以低运维成本部署和访问浏览器实例。
summary.en: Neko is a self-hosted virtual browser running inside Docker that streams a full desktop over WebRTC. It offers isolated browser instances with persistent or ephemeral sessions, multi-user simultaneous access, and session sharing. Ideal for privacy-focused browsing, web app testing, collaborative development, remote demos and watch parties, Neko simplifies deploying browser environments without heavy infrastructure and enables secure, real-time remote access from any device.

metadata.name: tg-disk
metadata.description: tgNetDisc重构升级版，基于Telegram的♾️️无限容量网盘/图床，不限制文件格式，不限制文件大小（大文件会分块上传），不限制文件内容😏，占用很少的内存和磁盘空间📁，轻巧方便。 文件都存储在Telegram☁️端，拥有良好的安全性🔒和持久性。文件上传成功会生成HTML、Markdown、BBCode三种形式的外链🔗，可以用来当做图床、文件下载url。

summary.zh: tg-disk 通过 Telegram API 提供近乎无限容量的网盘/图床：不限文件类型与内容，大文件分片上传以突破大小限制，极低本地内存与磁盘占用，所有文件存储于 Telegram 云端并生成 HTML/Markdown/BBCode 外链，支持多线程下载与 Docker 一键部署，适合轻量化私有文件托管、分享与图床场景。
summary.en: tg-disk leverages the Telegram API to provide an effectively unlimited cloud drive/image host: no restrictions on file type/content and large files are chunked for upload, with minimal local resource usage. Files reside on the Telegram cloud and the service auto-generates HTML/Markdown/BBCode links. It supports multithreaded downloads and Docker one‑click deployment, making it ideal for lightweight private file hosting, sharing and image-hosting use cases.

metadata.name: copicseal
metadata.description: Copicseal is an EXIF-based photo watermarking tool for adding camera settings like shutter speed and ISO. Copicseal（可图匠）是一款基于 EXIF 的图片边框水印工具。

summary.zh: Copicseal 是一款基于 EXIF 的跨平台桌面水印工具，自动读取快门、ISO、焦距等拍摄元数据，在图片边框添加可定制水印。支持实时预览、批量处理与单文件零依赖安装，适合摄影作品标注、输出与流水线处理。
summary.en: Copicseal is an EXIF-driven cross-platform desktop tool that extracts camera data (shutter, ISO, focal) and applies customizable border watermarks. It offers live preview, batch processing and single-file zero-dependency installs—useful for photographers and export workflows.

metadata.name: reinstall
metadata.description: 一键DD/重装脚本 (One-click reinstall OS on VPS)

summary.zh: 一键VPS重装脚本，支持19个主流Linux发行版及原版Windows ISO安装，自动获取VirtIO与驱动、智能IP配置（IPv4/IPv6、/32、网关跨网段）、BIOS/EFI/ARM兼容、低内存适配，按分区UUID识别硬盘并实时从上游镜像拉取资源。
summary.en: One-click VPS reinstall script supporting 19 Linux distros and official Windows ISOs. It auto-fetches VirtIO/drivers, provides smart IPv4/IPv6 network setup, supports BIOS/EFI and ARM, is low-memory friendly, uses partition UUIDs to avoid wrong-disk writes, and pulls resources from upstream mirrors.

metadata.name: EasyTier
metadata.description: A simple, decentralized mesh VPN with WireGuard support.

summary.zh: EasyTier 是基于 Rust/Tokio 的去中心化网状 VPN，支持 WireGuard/AES-GCM 加密、NAT 穿越、KCP/QUIC 丢包优化、子网代理与零拷贝传输。提供跨平台（Win/Mac/Linux/Android/嵌入式）Web/GUI 管理与零配置部署，适合无需中心服务的内网互联、远程访问与高丢包网络加速场景。
summary.en: EasyTier is a Rust/Tokio-based decentralized mesh VPN offering WireGuard/AES-GCM encryption, NAT traversal, KCP/QUIC loss resilience, subnet proxying and zero-copy transport. It provides cross-platform Web/GUI management and zero-config deployment for private network interconnects, resilient remote access and high packet-loss optimization.

metadata.name: gemini-poise
metadata.description: 一个用于代理和管理 Gemini API 请求的全栈应用，支持 API Key 轮换和请求转发。

summary.zh: Gemini Poise 是面向 Gemini 大模型的全栈 API 代理与管理工具，提供 API Key 轮换、请求转发、Token Bucket 限流、用户认证与日志监控。适用于多密钥高可用接入与运维自动化，后端基于 FastAPI/SQLAlchemy/Redis，前端使用 React 与 Ant Design，强调自动化轮换与可观测性。
summary.en: Gemini Poise is a full-stack proxy and management platform for the Gemini API, enabling seamless request forwarding, API key rotation, and observability. It includes user authentication, configurable targets, request logging, and an advanced Token Bucket rate limiter with automatic fallback and load balancing. Suited for multi-key high-availability access to large models, automated key lifecycle management, and operational monitoring. Built with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Alembic and Redis on the backend, and React, Vite, Ant Design and Tailwind on the frontend for production-ready deployments.

metadata.name: stb
metadata.description: Stb图床 - 现代化图片托管解决方案

summary.zh: Stb图床是开源的现代图片托管系统，支持阿里/腾讯/S3等多种存储、图片压缩与格式转换、文字/图片水印、缩略图与鉴黄、上传限制和IP黑名单；具备角色存储策略、游客上传、邀请码注册、REST API、统计与上传日志等管理功能。适合个人或团队快速部署自托管媒体服务，便于与第三方存储和社交登录集成。
summary.en: Stb is an open-source, modern image hosting solution for self-hosted and private deployments. It integrates multiple third-party storages (Alibaba OSS, Tencent COS, S3-compatible, Qiniu, WebDAV, FTP, GitHub, Telegram), offers image compression and format conversion, text/image watermarks, thumbnails, NSFW detection, upload limits and IP blacklisting. It provides guest uploads, invitation-only registration, role-based storage policies, RESTful APIs, analytics and upload logs, plus social login support. Stb is aimed at individuals and teams needing a customizable, extensible media hosting service with robust backend storage integrations.

metadata.name: telegraph
metadata.description: 基于 Cloudflare Worker 和 Pages 的图床/视频床/文件床，轻松实现无服务器部署！

summary.zh: Telegraph在Cloudflare Workers/Pages上利用Telegram Bot API和D1实现无服务器图/视频/文件托管。支持拖拽/粘贴与多文件上传、图片压缩、哈希去重与可选Basic Auth，内置管理面板（批量操作、历史记录、复制多格式链接）并整合Cloudflare Cache加速，便于在Cloudflare上快速部署私有高性能文件床。
summary.en: Telegraph is a serverless image, video and file hosting solution built on Cloudflare Workers and Pages using the Telegram Bot API. It records file mappings in Cloudflare D1 and accesses content via Telegram fileId (with optional R2), offering drag-and-drop, multi-file and clipboard paste uploads, image compression, hash-based deduplication, optional Basic Auth and configurable max size. Includes an admin UI for batch operations, history and multi-format link copying, Cloudflare Cache integration and retry logic, enabling easy deployment of private high-performance file hosting on Cloudflare.

metadata.name: Construct
metadata.description: A Minecraft Bedrock addon to ease the survival building process.

summary.zh: Construct 是面向 Minecraft Bedrock 的生存建造插件，便于将创意模式建筑迁移到生存。提供精准放置、错误方块高亮、一键从箱子抓取材料、分层建造、结构批量管理与跨世界导入等功能。基于原版结构系统与行为包实现，需启用 Beta APIs，适合大规模、重复或多人协作的建造场景，能显著加速资源调配与精确放置流程。
summary.en: Construct is a Minecraft Bedrock addon that streamlines moving creative-mode builds into survival. It offers Easy Place for correct block placement, block validation highlights, one-click Material Grabbing from chests, layered building, multi-structure management, and fast importing of .mcstructure files from other worlds. Built on Minecraft's vanilla structure system and delivered as a behavior pack, Construct requires the Beta APIs experiment. It's aimed at large-scale, repetitive, or collaborative survival construction workflows, accelerating resource handling and precise placement while remaining compatible with vanilla structures.

metadata.name: airi
metadata.description: 💖🧸 Self hosted, you-owned Grok Companion, a container of souls of waifu, cyber livings to bring them into our worlds, wishing to achieve Neuro-sama's altitude. Capable of realtime voice chat, Minecraft, Factorio playing. Web / macOS / Windows supported.

summary.zh: AIRI 是可自托管的 Neuro‑sama 风格“灵魂容器”平台，用于构建可定制的虚拟角色/陪伴体。支持实时语音、多模态交互与自动化游戏代理（Minecraft、Factorio），提供 Web、macOS 与 Windows 跨平台客户端，并通过可扩展的模型与行为插件便于私有化部署与自定义扩展。
summary.en: AIRI is a self‑hosted Neuro‑sama‑style "soul container" platform for customizable AI companions. It supports realtime voice chat, multimodal interaction and autonomous game agents (Minecraft, Factorio). Runs on Web, macOS and Windows with extensible model and behavior plugins for private, customizable deployments.

metadata.name: duf
metadata.description: Disk Usage/Free Utility - a better 'df' alternative

summary.zh: duf 是用 Go 编写的跨平台磁盘使用/剩余空间命令行替代工具，支持 Linux、BSD、macOS 及 Windows。提供自适应终端宽度与主题的彩色表格、按挂载点或文件系统过滤/分组、排序与列选择、inode 报告、可配置阈值与 JSON 输出，便于交互查看与脚本化导出。提供各平台包与二进制发行，也可从源码编译，适合运维与监控管道中的磁盘可视化与诊断。
summary.en: duf is a fast, user-friendly disk usage/free CLI tool written in Go that serves as a modern replacement for df. It runs on Linux, BSD, macOS and Windows, adapts to terminal width and theme, and renders colorful, readable tables. duf supports filtering and grouping by mountpoints and filesystem types, sorting and column selection, inode reporting, configurable usage/availability thresholds, and JSON output for automation. Distributed as prebuilt packages and binaries with source build support, it’s designed for interactive inspection and integration into scripts or monitoring pipelines.

metadata.name: OpenList
metadata.description: A new AList Fork to Anti Trust Crisis

summary.zh: OpenList 是 AList 的社区驱动开源分叉，强调长期治理与抵御信任型风险。遵循 AGPL‑3.0，维护透明，支持本地、Aliyundrive、OneDrive、Google Drive、S3、FTP/SFTP、Seafile、WebDAV 等多种后端，便于自托管部署与网盘聚合，适合需要可审计、可控的文件服务与共享场景。
summary.en: OpenList is a community-driven, long-term governance fork of AList designed to defend open-source infrastructure against trust-based attacks. Licensed under AGPL-3.0, it prioritizes transparency and maintainability. The project aggregates multiple storage backends (local, Aliyundrive, OneDrive/SharePoint, Google Drive, S3, FTP/SFTP, Seafile, WebDAV, PikPak, 189cloud, UPYUN, 123pan) and provides an easy self-hostable file listing and sharing web service for auditable, controllable deployments.

metadata.name: fusion-pixel-font
metadata.description: 开源的泛中日韩像素字体，黑体风格

summary.zh: 缝合像素字体是开源的泛中日韩黑体风格像素字库，缝合多款位图字形，提供8/10/12像素等宽与比例版，含拉丁、简繁中、日语、韩语字形、字符统计与构建工具链，采用OFL许可，适合复古界面与游戏像素UI开发。
summary.en: Fusion Pixel Font is an open-source CJK-compatible pixel sans typeface that stitches multiple bitmap fonts into a cohesive 8/10/12-pixel family, offering both monospaced and proportional variants. Serving as a transitional companion to Ark Pixel Font, it supplies language-specific glyph sets (Latin, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean), character support reports, and an OFL-1.1 license. The project includes build tooling and dependencies (Pixel Font Builder/Knife, FontTools, Pillow, etc.), making it well suited for retro UIs, game text rendering, terminal-style displays and pixel-art typography workflows.

metadata.name: Sakurairo
metadata.description: A WordPress theme that is built with AI-assisted reading features, colorful, user-friendly, well-rounded, and rich in functionalities. Support Chinese, English, Japanese, Français (soutien de base) languages. Based on Theme Sakura.  一款具有 AI 辅助阅读功能的 WordPress 主题，多彩、友好、功能全面、体验完善。 支持中、英、日、法（基础适配）多语言。基于 Sakura 主题。

summary.zh: Sakurairo 是基于 Sakura 重构的多彩 WordPress 主题，内置 AI 辅助阅读与中/英/日/法多语言（基础）支持。集成 Kirki 与 Codestar 可视化设置、插件更新检测与无缝更新方案，功能完整、体验优化，适合博客、文档站与内容展示型网站，用以提升阅读流畅性与交互性。
summary.en: Sakurairo is a colorful, feature-rich WordPress theme rebuilt from Sakura V3 that embeds AI-assisted reading tools and basic multilingual support (Chinese, English, Japanese, French). It integrates Codestar and Kirki for visual configuration, uses a plugin update checker and supports seamless updates. Licensed under GPLv2 and focused on blogs and documentation sites, Sakurairo enhances reading experience, presentation and user interaction while providing ready-made demos, update channels and extensible theme settings for site maintainers and creators.

metadata.name: Foxel
metadata.description: A highly extensible private cloud storage solution for individuals and teams, featuring AI-powered semantic search.

summary.zh: Foxel 是面向个人与团队的可扩展私有云存储解决方案，统一管理本地、S3、WebDAV、云盘等多类后端，支持浏览器内预览、路径级 RBAC、分享链接与插件扩展。系统集成基于向量数据库的 AI 语义检索与可配置嵌入提供者，提供 S3/WebDAV 协议兼容、任务队列与内置 AI 代理，便于私有部署、协作存储与智能内容检索与自动化处理。
summary.en: Foxel is a highly extensible private cloud storage solution for individuals and teams that centralizes heterogeneous backends (local, S3-compatible, WebDAV, cloud drives, etc.). It provides in-browser previews, path-based RBAC, shareable links, a manifest-driven plugin system, asynchronous task processing, and protocol mappings (S3/WebDAV). Its standout feature is AI-powered semantic search using configurable embedding providers and vector databases (Milvus, Qdrant), plus an integrated AI agent for automated VFS operations and file processing—ideal for private deployment, collaborative storage, and intelligent content discovery.

metadata.name: XMusicDownloader
metadata.description: 一款 支持从百度、网易、qq、酷狗、咪咕等音乐网站搜索并下载歌曲的程序，支持下载无损音乐

summary.zh: XMusicDownloader 是一款基于 C# 的开源音乐下载工具，聚合百度、网易、QQ、酷狗、咪咕等多家站点，可搜索并批量下载歌曲。支持歌单、专辑、歌手一键抓取，提供 FLAC 无损及 320/128 码率下载，并通过可扩展的 Provider 接口接入第三方 API 获取真实下载地址，便于增加新源与定制下载策略。
summary.en: XMusicDownloader is an open-source C# music downloader that aggregates searches across Baidu, NetEase, QQ, Kugou, Migu and other Chinese music services. It supports bulk downloads, playlist/album/artist scraping, and offers FLAC lossless, 320kbps and 128kbps output. The tool exposes an IMusicProvider interface to detect playlists, fetch song lists and retrieve real download URLs—allowing extensibility via provider plugins or third‑party APIs for adding new sources and custom download strategies.

metadata.name: komari
metadata.description: A simple server monitor tool.

summary.zh: Komari 是一款基于 Go 的轻量自托管服务器监控工具，提供 Web 仪表盘与轻量 Agent，低资源占用，支持 Docker、二进制与一键安装，便于私有部署、性能监控与历史数据可视化。
summary.en: Komari is a lightweight, Go-based self-hosted server monitoring tool that provides a web dashboard and a lightweight agent. It uses minimal resources and supports Docker, binary and one‑click installs, enabling private deployment, performance monitoring and historical data visualization.

metadata.name: bird-lg-go
metadata.description: BIRD looking glass in Go, for better maintainability, easier deployment & smaller memory footprint

summary.zh: Bird-lg-go 用 Go 重写了 BIRD looking glass 的前端与代理，兼容原 Python 代理，旨在提升可维护性、简化部署并降低内存占用。功能覆盖对等状态与路由查询（含过滤）、whois、traceroute 及 AS 路径可视化（bgpmap）。配置通过 viper 支持多格式与环境变量，可构建为 Docker 镜像。master 分支仅支持 BIRDv2，BIRDv1 的最后兼容版本保存在 bird1 分支。
summary.en: Bird-lg-go is a Go reimplementation of the BIRD looking glass, providing both frontend and proxy components while remaining compatible with the original Python proxy. It focuses on improved maintainability, simpler deployment and reduced memory footprint. Features include peering status display, route queries (with filters), whois lookups, traceroute, and AS-path visualization (bgpmap). Configuration is managed via viper (multiple formats and environment variables) and Docker images are provided for easy deployment. The master branch targets BIRDv2; BIRDv1 support remains in the 'bird1' branch.

metadata.name: CloudFlare-ImgBed
metadata.description: A serverless, open-source file hosting solution built on Cloudflare. Supports image hosting, secure file storage, and personal cloud drive capabilities.

summary.zh: CloudFlare-ImgBed 是一款开源的无服务器与容器化文件托管/个人云盘解决方案，支持 Cloudflare Workers/Pages 和 Docker 部署。兼容 Telegram、Discord、Cloudflare R2、S3、Huggingface、WebDAV 等多种存储后端，提供 RESTful API 与 WebDAV 接口，聚焦图片托管、安全文件存储与私有云盘功能，并在并发、内存与数据迁移上做优化，适合快速搭建轻量可扩展的私有文件服务与图床平台。
summary.en: CloudFlare-ImgBed is an open-source file hosting and personal cloud drive solution designed for serverless and Docker deployments on Cloudflare. It supports Cloudflare Workers/Pages and Docker, integrating multiple storage backends such as Telegram, Discord, Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, Hugging Face and WebDAV. The project exposes RESTful APIs and WebDAV for programmatic access, emphasizing image hosting, secure file storage and private cloud capabilities, with optimizations for concurrency, memory and migration. It’s well suited to quickly build lightweight, extensible private file services or multi-backend image beds.
tags_zh: Cloudflare R2 · 无服务器部署

metadata.name: imgpush
metadata.description: Minimalist Self-hosted Image Service for user submitted images in your app

summary.zh: imgpush 是极简自托管图片服务，提供统一上传 API、文件或 URL 上传、自动格式转换与按需裁剪/缩放、限流与跨域白名单、删除与健康检查接口，支持本地存储或 S3 兼容后端。以 Docker 镜像分发并附带 Kubernetes 示例，便于在应用中快速部署用于头像或用户图片的轻量私有托管与按需交付。
summary.en: imgpush is a minimalist self-hosted image service for user-submitted images (e.g., avatars). It provides a single upload API supporting file or URL uploads, automatic format conversion, on-the-fly resizing/cropping, rate limiting, CORS origin whitelisting, delete and liveness endpoints, and optional S3-compatible storage (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO). Distributed as a Docker image with Kubernetes examples, it’s designed for easy integration into web apps needing lightweight, privately hosted image storage and delivery with basic security and scaling. Setup is container-first for quick deployment and scaling.

metadata.name: Picsur
metadata.description: An easy to use, selfhostable image sharing service like Imgur with built in converting

summary.zh: Picsur 是可自托管的类 Imgur 轻量级图像分享服务，支持匿名与账号上传、多格式（JPG/PNG/WEBP/HEIF 等）转换与编辑、Exif 清除、图片过期与删除，以及 ShareX 接入和 ARM64/AMD64 Docker 镜像，适合快速部署私有图床和临时图片分享场景。
summary.en: Picsur is a self-hostable, lightweight Imgur-like image sharing service supporting anonymous and account uploads, multi-format conversion and editing, EXIF stripping, expiring/deletable images, a ShareX endpoint, and ARM64/AMD64 Docker images—ideal for private image hosting and quick deployments.

metadata.name: PixPro
metadata.description: PixPro 一款个人需求的高效图床，集成了强大的图片压缩功能与优雅的前台。后台管理瀑布流展示和AJAX刷新，能有效降低存储与带宽成本。

summary.zh: PixPro 是一款轻量级 PHP 图床，集成高效可调图片压缩，支持多格式输出与本地/阿里云 OSS/S3/又拍云等多种存储。前端简洁支持拖拽、粘贴与批量上传，后台提供瀑布流展示与 AJAX 刷新，采用 SQLite 并提供 Docker 镜像，便于个人或小团队快速部署，降低带宽与存储成本。
summary.en: PixPro is a lightweight, efficient PHP image-hosting system for personal and small-team use. It pairs adjustable, high-quality image compression with multi-format support (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG, AVIF) and flexible storage backends including local filesystem, Alibaba OSS, Amazon S3, and Upyun. The clean frontend supports drag-and-drop, paste, and batch uploads; the admin offers a waterfall gallery with AJAX refresh. Built on SQLite and distributed with Docker images, PixPro enables quick deployment and reduces storage and bandwidth costs.

metadata.name: landscape
metadata.description: The goal is to make it easier to configure your favorite Linux distribution as a router. Built with Rust and eBPF.

summary.zh: Landscape 用 Rust 与 eBPF 将任意 Linux 发行版变为高性能路由平台，提供基于源/目的的流量转发与策略匹配、逐流 DNS 缓存、细粒度 NAT 控制、可将流量导入容器以扩展功能，并以单目录配置与完整 API 简化部署与跨发行版迁移。
summary.en: Landscape is an eBPF-based Linux router platform written in Rust that makes it simple to turn any Linux distribution into a managed router. It delivers high-performance traffic steering with source and destination matches, per-flow DNS and caching, finer-grained NAT controls, and the ability to redirect traffic into containers for TProxy-style extensions. A single-directory configuration, automatic migration and comprehensive APIs simplify deployment and cross-distribution maintenance, suited for home, edge and lab environments needing policy-driven routing.

metadata.name: CF-ImgBed
metadata.description: A simple ImgBed can deploy on cloudflare platform.

summary.zh: CF-ImgBed 是基于 Astro 和 Cloudflare（Pages/Workers、R2、KV）的轻量个人图床，支持拖拽/粘贴/批量上传、上传前图片编辑、目录式管理、API Key 与后台认证、短 ID 访问及自定义域名与防盗链设置，提供多格式一键复制链接。为在 Cloudflare 平台上快速部署与运维个人或小团队图片托管而设计，集成部署说明与本地开发支持。
summary.en: CF-ImgBed is a lightweight personal image hosting solution built with Astro and Cloudflare (Pages/Workers, R2, KV). It offers drag-and-drop, paste and bulk uploads, in-browser image editing before upload, directory-based management, API Key and admin authentication, short-ID public links, custom domain/prefix and basic hotlink protection, plus copy-ready URL/Markdown/HTML outputs. The project includes deployment guidance for Cloudflare Pages/Workers and local development, enabling fast, production-ready hosting of images for individuals or small teams on Cloudflare infrastructure.

metadata.name: music-dl
metadata.description: search and download music 从网易云音乐、QQ音乐、酷狗音乐、百度音乐、虾米音乐、咪咕音乐等搜索和下载歌曲

summary.zh: music-dl 是基于 Python3 的跨平台命令行工具，聚合网易云/QQ/酷狗/百度/虾米/咪咕等多个音乐源，优先检索无损→320K→128K 并下载高品质音频。支持代理、多线程搜索、结果去重与过滤、歌词/封面下载以及下载后自动播放，适合批量离线管理和快速检索中文音乐资源。
summary.en: music-dl is a Python3 cross‑platform CLI that aggregates Netease/QQ/Kugou/Baidu/Xiami/Migu to search and download lossless or high‑bitrate tracks. It supports proxies, multithreading, deduplication/filtering, lyrics/covers and optional auto‑play, suitable for batch offline music management.

metadata.name: custom-install
metadata.description: Installs a title directly to an SD card for the Nintendo 3DS

summary.zh: custom-install 是用 Python 开发的跨平台桌面工具，可将 Nintendo 3DS 的 CIA/标题直接写入 SD 卡。提供 GUI 与命令行两种模式，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux，需提供 boot9.bin、movable.sed 与（可选）SeedDB，并依赖 save3ds 与 custom-install-finalize 在设备上安装票据与种子。适合离线安装游戏与自制软件、3DS 主机改机与恢复场景，强调可移植性与对官方加密/种子流程的兼容。
summary.en: custom-install is a cross-platform Python desktop tool that writes Nintendo 3DS CIA/titles directly to an SD card. It offers both GUI and CLI usage on Windows, macOS and Linux, and requires boot9.bin, movable.sed and optionally a SeedDB. The project integrates with save3ds and provides a custom-install-finalize homebrew to install tickets and seeds so titles appear and function on the console. It targets offline title installation, homebrew deployment and 3DS modding workflows, prioritizing compatibility with 3DS encryption and seed handling.

metadata.name: ztncui
metadata.description: ZeroTier network controller UI

summary.zh: ztncui 是一个面向自托管 ZeroTier 网络控制器的 Web 可视化管理界面。它以 Node.js/Express（需 Node v14）实现，通过访问本机运行的 zerotier-one API 管理网络、成员和访问控制；使用 argon2 做密码哈希并通过 .env 提供 authtoken。项目提供 RPM/DEB 安装说明、Docker 镜像入口和 PM2 启动示例，适合想部署独立 ZeroTier 控制平面、为小中型组织或 IoT/远程接入场景构建私有网格网络的运维与网络管理员使用。
summary.en: ztncui is a web-based management UI for a standalone ZeroTier network controller. Implemented with Node.js/Express (requires Node v14), it talks to the local zerotier-one API to manage networks, members and access controls. It uses argon2 for password hashing and expects the ZeroTier authtoken via a .env file. The project includes RPM/DEB installation notes, a Docker image entrypoint, and PM2/run examples, making it suitable for self-hosting a ZeroTier controller for small-to-medium organizations, IoT deployments, or private mesh/remote-access scenarios.

metadata.name: lrc-maker
metadata.description: 歌词滚动姬｜可能是你所能见到的最好用的歌词制作工具

summary.zh: LRC Maker 是一款跨平台浏览器端的滚动歌词（.lrc）制作工具，支持拖拽导入、实时播放对齐、快捷键逐句打点与微调。基于现代浏览器 ES Module 与新 API 做了性能优化，构建后可作为静态站点或用 Docker 部署，适合字幕制作、卡拉 OK 与个人听歌对时的精确时间标注场景。
summary.en: LRC Maker is a browser-based, cross-platform tool for creating scrolling LRC lyric files (.lrc). It supports drag-and-drop import, real-time playback alignment, and efficient timestamp insertion and adjustment via keyboard shortcuts. Built with modern browser APIs and ES Modules for performance, it outputs static site builds that can be hosted on any CDN or packaged into a minimal Docker/Nginx image. Ideal for subtitle authoring, karaoke timing, and personal lyric synchronization workflows requiring fast, precise timestamp editing.

metadata.name: dream-han-cjk
metadata.description: Open-source pan-CJK font families with enormous range of weights, the CJK sans and serif you have dreamed of.

summary.zh: 梦源是一套开源泛CJK字体系列，基于思源黑/宋将可变字体轴实例化为27级单字重，采用线性与二次插值分别控制宋体与黑体字重，修复Adobe行高并合并重叠轮廓以提高渲染与兼容性。支持完整字符集、OpenType功能、TTF/TTC封装与Office嵌入，提供跨平台构建脚本与依赖说明。
summary.en: Dream Han CJK is an open-source pan-CJK type family derived from Source Han Sans and Serif. It instantiates the variable wght axis into 27 discrete weights, using linear interpolation for the serif and quadratic interpolation for the sans while bypassing the avar table. The project merges overlapping outlines and fixes Adobe’s excessive line-height to maximize rendering and software compatibility, preserving original glyphs and OpenType features. It provides full character coverage, TTF/TTC packaging, Office embedding support, and cross-platform build scripts with documented dependencies and build guidance.

metadata.name: fscan
metadata.description: 一款内网综合扫描工具，方便一键自动化、全方位漏扫扫描。(An intranet comprehensive scanning tool, enabling one-click automated, all-round vulnerability scanning)

summary.zh: Fscan 是用 Go 实现的内网综合扫描与利用框架，集主机发现、TCP端口与服务探测、Web 指纹、弱口令爆破、POC 漏洞检测与多类漏洞利用（如 MS17-010、Redis 利用）于一体。支持高并发与发包/超时/速率控制、代理与指定网卡、插件化编译、多格式输出与可视化 Web 管理，适用于红队渗透测试、内网安全评估与资产梳理，强调性能优化与指纹识别准确性。
summary.en: Fscan is a Go-based intranet comprehensive scanner and exploitation framework that combines host discovery, TCP port and service detection, web fingerprinting, credential brute-forcing, POC-based vulnerability detection, and various exploit modules (e.g., MS17-010, Redis RCE). It delivers high-concurrency scanning with rate/timeout control, proxy and interface selection, pluginized build tags, multi-format outputs, a web management UI and a Docker lab for testing. Aimed at red teams and internal security assessments, it emphasizes performance tuning, fingerprint accuracy, extensibility and reliable result persistence.

metadata.name: gopeed
metadata.description: A fast, modern download manager for HTTP, BitTorrent, Magnet, and ed2k. Cross-platform, built with Golang and Flutter.

summary.zh: Gopeed 是基于 Golang 与 Flutter 开发的跨平台高速下载器，支持 HTTP、BitTorrent、Magnet 与 ed2k 协议，具备多线程并发传输、插件/扩展体系与开放 API，便于定制集成与桌面批量下载管理。
summary.en: Gopeed is a cross-platform, high-speed downloader built with Golang and Flutter. It supports HTTP, BitTorrent, Magnet and ed2k, provides concurrent transfers, an extensions/plugins system and open APIs for custom integrations and automation.

metadata.name: nature
metadata.description: The Nature Programming Language

summary.zh: Nature 是一门面向系统编程的通用语言与编译器，强调高性能、内存安全与简洁语法。提供强类型与泛型、枚举/标记联合、接口、nullable/errable 类型，以及内置并发原语（go/future/channel/select）。直接编译为机器码且不依赖 LLVM，支持跨编译与基于 musl 的静态链接，具备零开销 C FFI、自研运行时（低停顿 GC、tcmalloc 式分配器、共享栈协程、libuv IO），并配套 npkg、LSP 与内联测试，适合构建网络服务、系统工具与高性能库。
summary.en: Nature is a general-purpose systems programming language and compiler focused on high performance, memory safety, and concise syntax. It features a strong static type system with generics, enums/tagged unions, interfaces, nullable/errable types and built-in concurrency primitives (go/future/channel/select). Nature compiles directly to machine code without relying on LLVM, supports cross-compilation and static musl linking, and provides zero-overhead C FFI. Its custom runtime implements a low‑pause GC, tcmalloc-style allocator, shared‑stack coroutines and libuv-based IO. Bundled tools include npkg, LSP, formatter and in-source testing—suited for network services, system tools and high‑perf libraries.

metadata.name: iperf3-static
metadata.description: Static builds of iperf3 binaries for Windows, Linux and MacOSX to do network testing on remote servers.

summary.zh: iperf3-static 提供 Windows、Linux 与 macOS 的跨平台静态 iperf3 二进制与多架构容器镜像。项目强调全流程透明与可核验的可重现构建（源到二进制的工作流、签名、Virustotal 扫描与 Zizmor 审计），静态链接 OpenSSL 并支持多种 CPU 架构，便于远程网络性能测试、快速部署与定制构建验证。
summary.en: iperf3-static delivers multiplatform, distro-independent static iperf3 binaries and multi-architecture Docker images for Windows, Linux, and macOS. The project focuses on a fully transparent, verifiable build pipeline—source-to-binary workflows, chain-of-custody attestation, signature verification, Virustotal scanning, and Zizmor workflow auditing—enabling reproducible, accountable releases. Builds statically link OpenSSL, support many CPU architectures, include Cygwin-based Windows tooling, and provide artifacts and containers for straightforward remote network performance testing, quick deployment, and custom or patched builds.

metadata.name: Netease_url
metadata.description: 网易云无损解析

summary.zh: 网易云音乐无损解析工具，基于 Python/Flask 提供 Web 界面与 RESTful API，支持关键词搜索、单曲/歌单/专辑批量解析与多音质下载（含 FLAC、Hi-Res 等）。需通过黑胶会员 Cookie 授权获取高品质资源。项目支持本地运行与 Docker 部署，并提供在线演示与接口文档，适合集成到自动化批量处理、私有化部署或媒体服务中，便于二次开发与快速上手。
summary.en: Netease Cloud Music lossless parser built with Python and Flask, offering a web UI and RESTful API. It supports keyword search, single/playlist/album parsing and batch extraction, and provides multi-quality downloads including FLAC and Hi-Res. High-quality access requires a NetEase Black Vinyl (VIP) account cookie for authorization. The project includes online demo, documentation, and supports local or Docker deployment, making it suitable for private deployments, automated batch downloads, and integration into media tools or services for developers needing programmatic access to lossless audio.

metadata.name: zellij
metadata.description: A terminal workspace with batteries included

summary.zh: Zellij 是用 Rust 开发的终端工作区/多路复用器，提供布局、浮动与堆叠窗格、多人协作、内置 Web 客户端与基于 WebAssembly 的插件系统，强调开箱即用体验与高度可定制，适合开发者与运维场景。
summary.en: Zellij is a Rust-built terminal workspace and multiplexer offering layouts, floating and stacked panes, true multiplayer collaboration, a built-in web client, and a WebAssembly-based plugin system. It emphasizes a great out-of-the-box experience and deep customization for developers and ops.

metadata.name: sharkey-stelpolva
metadata.description: 🌎 Sharkey is an open source, decentralized social media platform that's free forever! 🚀

summary.zh: Sharkey Stelpolva 是基于 Sharkey 开发分支的定制版，面向自托管的去中心化社交实例。它引入 PostgreSQL+pgroonga 全文搜索支持，并保持对 ActivityPub/Misskey 的兼容性；前端增加大量可配置改进（字体与表情自定义、MFM 优化、翻译回退、Bilibili 预览、自动扩展输入等）、更细粒度的隐私与时间线控制，以及实例/头像装饰白名单等实用运维与用户体验增强，便于部署与定制化改造。
summary.en: Sharkey Stelpolva is a customized fork of Sharkey (development branch) for self-hosted decentralized social instances. It adds PostgreSQL+pgroonga full-text search support, preserves ActivityPub and Misskey compatibility, and delivers many front-end and UX enhancements: font and emoji customization, MFM improvements, Google Translate fallback, Bilibili URL preview, autosize post form, finer privacy/timeline controls, avatar-decoration whitelist and deployment-oriented tweaks—making instance deployment, customization and user experience improvements straightforward.

metadata.name: cilikube
metadata.description: cilikube is a k8s admin mutli cluster manage platform, ideal for learning Vue.js, Go, and Kubernetes

summary.zh: CiliKube 是基于 Vue3/TypeScript 和 Go/Gin 的开源 Kubernetes 多集群管理平台，界面简洁可扩展，适合企业运维与开发者学习集群资源可视化与 API 集成。
summary.en: CiliKube is an open-source, enterprise-oriented Kubernetes multi-cluster management platform built with Vue3 and TypeScript on the frontend and Go/Gin on the backend. It emphasizes a clean, developer-friendly UI, modular architecture, and extensibility for custom workflows. CiliKube supports cluster resource visualization, Kubernetes API integration, and multi-cluster operations, making it suitable for infrastructure teams, platform engineers, and developers learning cloud-native patterns. The project is also a practical reference for building full-stack cloud-native tools and accelerating routine cluster administration tasks and observability in production-like environments.

metadata.name: FakeHTTP
metadata.description: Obfuscate all your TCP connections into HTTP protocol.

summary.zh: 生成失败
summary.en: Generation failed

metadata.name: WeClone
metadata.description: 🚀 One-stop solution for creating your AI twin from chat history 💡 Fine-tune LLMs with your chat logs to capture your unique style, then bind to a chatbot to bring your digital self to life.

summary.zh: WeClone 是一套端到端数字分身构建工具：从聊天记录导出、清洗预处理，到用文本与图像对话日志本地微调大模型并部署，支持 Telegram/Discord 等接入。聚焦将个人对话风格注入模型、实现可控本地化部署与隐私信息过滤，适用于想把历史聊天变成个性化聊天机器人或数字化“我”的场景。微调效果依赖模型规模与数据质量，多模态与隐私保护为其技术亮点。
summary.en: WeClone is an end-to-end toolkit to create a personalized AI twin from chat history. It exports and preprocesses chat logs (text + images), fine-tunes large language models locally, and binds them to chat platforms like Telegram and Discord for deployment. The project emphasizes reproducing individual conversational style, multimodal training, privacy-aware filtering, and controllable on-premise deployment—suiting users who want to turn message history into a custom chatbot or digital persona. Fine-tuning effectiveness depends on model size and data quality.

metadata.name: BongoCat
metadata.description: 🐱 跨平台互动桌宠 BongoCat，为桌面增添乐趣！

summary.zh: BongoCat 是基于 Tauri 的跨平台互动桌宠，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的原生窗口与全局置顶，能响应键盘与鼠标事件触发动画和音效并支持皮肤定制。适用于桌面美化、直播弹幕或系统提示场景，体积小、启动快、性能友好且易于扩展与定制。
summary.en: BongoCat is a lightweight, cross-platform interactive desktop pet built with Tauri for macOS, Windows and Linux. It offers a native always-on-top window that reacts to keyboard and mouse events, plays animations and sound effects, and supports theme/asset customization. Ideal for desktop personalization, live-stream overlays and playful system notifications, the project emphasizes low memory footprint, fast startup and easy extensibility via web front-end assets while leveraging Tauri/Rust for native integration. Releases include installers and the app is open for customization and contribution.

metadata.name: ChinaTextbook
metadata.description: 所有小初高、大学PDF教材。

summary.zh: 本仓库按年级与学科整理并开源存放小学到大学的官方PDF教材，覆盖数学等主科并以直接链接便于下载。目标是为海内外家庭与偏远地区提供免费、标准化教材，打击带私人水印的付费流通，推动义务教育资源共享与长期自学，而非单纯应试导向。
summary.en: This repository aggregates and openly hosts official PDF textbooks from primary school through university, organized by grade and subject (e.g., mathematics) with direct download links. Its purpose is to provide free, standardized learning materials to families at home and abroad and to underserved or remote regions, countering paid distribution of watermarked copies. The project emphasizes accessibility and sustained self-learning over exam-oriented instruction, helping overseas Chinese maintain familiarity with domestic curricula and promoting equitable access to compulsory education resources.

metadata.name: Wallos
metadata.description: Wallos: Open-source, self-hostable personal subscription tracker. Visualize your recurring expenses, manage your budget, and save money.

summary.zh: Wallos 是开源自托管的个人订阅追踪器，基于 PHP/Docker 部署，支持多币种与 Fixer 汇率、分类统计、移动端视图、徽标搜索、OIDC 与多渠道通知。提供 AI 推荐（ChatGPT/Gemini/Ollama），强调数据隐私与可定制化，适合个人或小团队管理经常性支出与预算。
summary.en: Wallos is an open-source, self-hosted personal subscription tracker and budgeting web app built for PHP environments with Docker support. It visualizes recurring expenses, supports multi-currency management via Fixer exchange rates, customizable categories, logo search, mobile-friendly UI, statistics, and multiple notification channels (email, Discord, Telegram, Pushover, Gotify, webhooks). Wallos includes OIDC/OAuth, multi-language support and optional AI recommendations (ChatGPT, Gemini, or local Ollama). It targets privacy-conscious users and small teams replacing spreadsheets with structured recurring-payment tracking and lightweight analytics. Demo and Docker/compose/bare-metal installs available.

summary.zh: MaClean 是一款用 Rust 编写的 macOS 命令行工具，用于扫描并清理无用文件（如缓存、临时文件和回收站），以释放磁盘空间。项目通过 GitHub Actions 发布可下载的压缩包，支持使用 cargo 本地安装，适合开发者与运维人员在手动或脚本化场景下进行磁盘维护和空间回收。
summary.en: MaClean is a lightweight Rust-based command-line utility for macOS that scans and removes unnecessary files to free disk space. It addresses common sources of waste—such as caches, temporary files, and the trash—providing a simple tool for developers and sysadmins to reclaim storage. Releases are distributed as zip artifacts via GitHub Actions, and the project supports local installation via cargo. MaClean focuses on pragmatic disk-cleanup workflows without system-wide changes, fitting both manual use and scripted maintenance on Mac machines.

summary.zh: 本仓库通过在 Darwin/macOS 上替换或注入 eligibility 覆盖文件与辅助脚本，实现长期启用 Xcode LLM、Apple Intelligence 与 iPhone Mirroring 等受限特性。提供两种方案：util 工具（一次性关闭 SIP + 设置 boot-args）和无需关闭 SIP 的 override 文件方法；并包含安装/卸载脚本与多功能组合选项。仅支持 macOS 15.0–15.3.1，15.4+ 已被系统实现改动阻断。项目以研究为目的，使用存在风险且需遵守相关法律法规。
summary.en: This repository enables persistent use of Xcode LLM, Apple Intelligence and iPhone Mirroring on macOS by providing eligibility override files and a utility script that patches Darwin behavior. It offers two modes: a util tool (requires a one-time SIP disable plus boot-args) and a non‑SIP override-file approach, with install/uninstall commands and combined option support. Tested on macOS 15.x (supported only through 15.3.1); Apple changed eligibilityd in 15.4+ breaking this method. Intended for research; use carries risk and legal responsibilities.

metadata.name: visualization-collection
metadata.description: 🌈 一个专注于前端视觉效果的集合应用，包含CSS动效、Canvas动画、Three.js3D、人工智能应用等上百个案例（持续更新）

summary.zh: visualization-collection 是面向前端开发与视觉设计者的开源示例库，汇集上百个可在线预览的效果：覆盖 CSS 动效、Canvas 粒子与交互动画、Three.js 三维场景及部分 AI 应用。提供源码与 Vue 版本，便于学习、灵感采集、效果原型制作与组件复用，适合教学演示与前端视觉实验。
summary.en: visualization-collection is an open-source front-end visual effects showcase that aggregates hundreds of live-demo examples. It includes CSS animations, Canvas-based particle and interactive effects, Three.js 3D scenes, and several AI-enabled demos, all with source code and an available Vue-specific version. Aimed at developers and visual designers, it serves as a learning and inspiration resource for quick prototyping, component reuse, UI interaction presentation, and front-end visual experiments, and is continuously updated with new experiments.

metadata.name: enableAppleAI
metadata.description: Enable Apple Intelligence on Macs sold in Mainland China with SIP enabled, for version between  MacOS 15.4.1+ and 26.5 beta3

summary.zh: enableAppleAI 提供在中国销售 Mac 上永久开启 Apple Intelligence 的一键脚本（适用于 macOS 15.4.1+ 至 26.5 beta3）。通过 lldb 注入模拟美版机型或直接修改 /private/var/db/eligibilityd/eligibility.plist 并锁定缓存，另可强制修改 countryd 为 US 以解锁地理受限功能。需管理员权限并临时禁用 SIP，完成后可恢复。注意：macOS 26.5 beta4 及以上不兼容。
summary.en: enableAppleAI is a command-line project that permanently enables Apple Intelligence on Macs sold in Mainland China for macOS versions from 15.4.1 up to 26.5 beta3. It offers two methods: a deeper approach using lldb to inject eligibilityd and simulate a US-model device, and a fallback that directly edits /private/var/db/eligibilityd/eligibility.plist and locks caches via uchg. Optionally modifies countryd cache to force US region for georestricted features. Requires admin rights and temporarily disabling SIP; SIP can be re-enabled afterward. Not compatible with macOS 26.5 beta4 and later.

metadata.name: yt-dlp-web-ui
metadata.description: A terrible web ui and RPC server for yt-dlp. Designed to be self-hosted.

summary.zh: 一个基于 yt-dlp 的简陋 Web 界面与 RPC 服务，专为自托管设计。提供 Web 界面与 HTTP/RPC 接口，便于远程和批量管理下载任务，支持与自动化脚本集成。项目轻量、源码可部署，适合在私有环境中用网页或 API 控制 yt-dlp 的用户。
summary.en: A lightweight web UI and RPC server for yt-dlp designed for self-hosting. It exposes HTTP/RPC APIs and a simple browser interface to manage, queue, and automate downloads, making it easy to integrate yt-dlp into private or scripted workflows.

metadata.name: clash-rs
metadata.description: custom protocol network proxy

summary.zh: ClashRS 是用 Rust 实现的规则化网络代理，支持丰富入/出站协议（Shadowsocks、Vmess、VLess、Trojan、QUIC 等）、多传输（gRPC/TLS/H2/WS/QUIC）、本地抗欺骗 DNS（UDP/TCP/DoH/DoT）与 TUN/TProxy 透明代理。适用于流量分流、多出口策略与动态远程规则/代理加载，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 与 iOS，内建 Jaeger 跟踪。
summary.en: ClashRS is a rule-based network proxy written in Rust that implements a broad set of inbound and outbound protocols and transports. It supports HTTP, SOCKS5, Shadowsocks, AnyTLS, TUN/TProxy and many outbound backends (Vmess, VLess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, WireGuard userspace, QUIC variants, SSH, Tor, Tailscale) over transports like gRPC, TLS, H2, WebSocket and QUIC. Features include local anti‑spoofing DNS (UDP/TCP/DoH/DoT), transparent TUN redirection, dynamic remote rule/proxy loading and Jaeger tracing. Cross-platform for traffic splitting, multi-exit routing and transparent proxying.

metadata.name: ente
metadata.description: 💚 End-to-end encrypted cloud for everything.

summary.zh: Ente 是一个开源的端到端加密云平台，单仓库包含服务端与跨平台客户端（iOS/Android/Web/桌面）。目前提供 Ente Photos（照片存储与共享）、Ente Locker（凭证与文档保管）和 Ente Auth（加密 2FA）。支持 3 倍数据冗余、面部检测与语义检索、私有分享与协作相册、背景上传与自托管，且加密实现已通过 Cure53、Symbolic 与 Fallible 的第三方审计。
summary.en: Ente is an open-source end-to-end encrypted cloud platform delivered as a monorepo that includes server and cross-platform clients (iOS, Android, Web, Linux, macOS, Windows). It ships Ente Photos for encrypted photo storage with 3x replication, face detection, semantic search, private sharing and collaborative albums; Ente Locker for secure document and credential storage; and Ente Auth as an encrypted authenticator. The project supports self-hosting, background uploads and easy import/export, and its cryptography has been externally audited by Cure53, Symbolic Software and Fallible.

metadata.name: dpanel
metadata.description: 轻量化 docker 可视化管理面板。lightweight  panel for docker

summary.zh: DPanel 是一款轻量化容器可视化管理面板，支持 Docker 与 Podman 的镜像/容器/网络/卷管理、实时日志与终端。标准版集成域名反代与证书申请，Lite 精简域名功能以降低资源占用。以容器方式部署并挂载 docker.sock，提供 Alpine/Debian 镜像、一键安装脚本、在线演示与文档，适合个人实验室、小型运维团队与边缘部署，侧重易用性与低资源开销。
summary.en: DPanel is a lightweight visual management panel for Docker and Podman designed to run as a container by mounting the host docker.sock. It offers image/container/network/volume management, real-time logs and terminal access, plus a dashboard for operational tasks. The standard edition adds domain reverse-proxy and automated certificate issuance while Lite removes domain features for a smaller footprint. DPanel provides Alpine/Debian images, a quick install script, documentation and an online demo, targeting home labs, small ops teams and edge deployments needing an easy, low-resource GUI for container administration.

metadata.name: home
metadata.description: 个人主页，我的个人主页，个人主页源码，主页模板，homepage

summary.zh: 基于 Vue 的个人主页模板，集成天气（高德 API）、MetingJS+APlayer 音乐、一言、日期/时钟与载入动效，支持移动端适配、字体优化与自定义链接。仓库提供 pnpm/Vite 本地构建及 GitHub Actions、Docker、Vercel 等部署示例，便于快速 fork、构建与二次定制，适合用于个人博客、作品集或静态展示站点。
summary.en: A lightweight personal homepage template built with Vue, featuring weather via AMap, music playback using MetingJS+APlayer, Hitokoto quotes, date/time display and loading animations with responsive mobile support. It supports custom links, font optimization and background images, and includes pnpm/Vite build instructions plus deployment examples for GitHub Actions, Docker and Vercel. Designed for quick fork-and-deploy workflows, easy static builds and straightforward customization for personal blogs or portfolio static sites with third‑party API integrations.

metadata.name: homer
metadata.description: A very simple static homepage for your server.

summary.zh: Homer 是一款极简静态主页与服务目录，由单个 YAML 配置驱动，支持 Docker 部署与 PWA 安装，提供智能卡片、模糊搜索、多页面分组和主题定制，适合自托管环境快速组织与访问服务。
summary.en: Homer is a minimal static homepage/service catalog driven by a single YAML file. It runs as a PWA or static site and supports Docker deployment, smart cards, fuzzy search, multi-page grouping and theming—ideal for organizing and quickly accessing self-hosted services.

metadata.name: sun-panel
metadata.description: A server, NAS navigation panel, Homepage, browser homepage. | 一个服务器、NAS导航面板、Homepage、浏览器首页。

summary.zh: Sun-Panel 是一款轻量可视的服务器/NAS 导航面板与浏览器首页，支持 Docker（含 ARM）、多账号隔离、系统状态查看与自定义 JS/CSS，无需外部数据库并支持内嵌小窗。界面简洁、资源占用低，适合家庭 NAS、个人服务器与快捷主页场景的集中管理与快速访问。
summary.en: Sun-Panel is a lightweight visual server/NAS navigation panel and browser homepage that supports Docker (including ARM), multi-account isolation, system status viewing, custom JS/CSS, and embedded mini-windows without requiring an external database. It offers a clean UI with low resource usage, suitable for home NAS, personal servers, and consolidated quick-access homepages.

metadata.name: docker-flare
metadata.description: Flare ✨ Lightweight, high performance and fast self-hosted navigation pages, resource utilization rate is <1% CPU, MEM <30 M, Docker Image < 10M

summary.zh: Flare 是用 Go 开发的超轻量自托管个人导航页面，镜像 <10MB，运行资源极低（CPU <1%、内存 <30MB）。无数据库依赖，配置以声明式文件管理，支持在线编辑、内置 6k+ Material 图标并兼容 x86 与常见 ARM 架构，适合 HomeLab 和注重隐私的本地部署场景，部署简单（Docker / docker-compose / Traefik）。
summary.en: Flare is a Go-based ultra-lightweight, self-hosted navigation dashboard for HomeLab and privacy-focused local deployments. The Docker image is under 10MB and runtime usage is minimal (CPU <1%, RAM <30MB). It requires no database, uses declarative files for data, offers an online editor and 6k+ Material Design icons, supports x86 and common ARM variants, renders thousands of bookmarks quickly, and is easy to deploy via Docker, docker-compose or Traefik.

metadata.name: uptime-kuma
metadata.description: A fancy self-hosted monitoring tool

summary.zh: Uptime Kuma 是一款界面友好、功能丰富的自托管监控工具，支持 HTTP/TCP/Ping/DNS/WebSocket 等多种探测，提供 20 秒探测间隔、状态页、证书与 Ping 图表，并集成 90+ 通知渠道（如 Telegram、Discord、邮件）。支持 Docker 与 Node.js/PM2 部署，适合个人和小型团队进行可用性与服务监控。
summary.en: Uptime Kuma is an easy-to-use, self-hosted monitoring application supporting multiple probe types (HTTP(s), TCP, Ping, DNS, WebSocket, Docker and more). It provides a reactive web UI, 20-second check intervals, status pages, certificate and ping charts, proxy and 2FA support, and integrations with 90+ notification services including Telegram, Discord and SMTP. Deployable via Docker or Node.js/PM2, it targets individuals and small teams seeking a lightweight, customizable uptime and availability monitoring solution.

metadata.name: mastodon
metadata.description: Chuckya, a glitch-soc fork used on wetdry.world

summary.zh: Chuckya 是基于 Mastodon Glitch Edition 的近源软分支，主要在 wetdry.world 运行。它为 Mastodon 引入多项实验性功能与修复：表情反应、气泡时间线、重写的 GIF 选择器、Mastodon Modern 主题、可配置的媒体附件限制、增强的管理工具与用户名屏蔽命令行、支持媒体与投票同发与单选投票、趋势半衰期配置、允许表情并列及自定义表情中破折号等。保持向后兼容，可作为服务器的无缝替代部署，安装与 glitch-soc 相同。
summary.en: Chuckya is a close-to-upstream soft fork of Mastodon Glitch Edition, primarily used on wetdry.world. It adds experimental features and fixes to improve the Mastodon experience: emoji reactions, a bubble timeline, a rewritten GIF picker, Mastodon Modern theme, configurable media attachment limits, extra moderation tools and a CLI for username blocks, polls with media and single-option polls, configurable status trend half-life, dashes in emote names, side-by-side emojis and other media tweaks. It remains backward-compatible and can be deployed as a drop-in server replacement using glitch-soc setup.
tags_zh: 可替换部署的社交服务器

metadata.name: mastomods
metadata.description: CSS tweaks and custom themes for Mastodon.

summary.zh: 为 Mastodon 提供模块化的 CSS/SCSS 主题与界面改造（如 linernotes_dark）。仓库整合了调色板、变量、覆盖样式及可复用的 mods（如 avatars_circle、columns 等），可将整个 app/javascript/styles 并入实例部署，或由终端用户通过 userstyle 扩展导入。适合管理员进行实例级统一主题部署，也便于用户本地导入，简化配色、布局、字体与界面微调的维护与复用。
summary.en: MastoMods delivers modular CSS/SCSS tweaks and custom themes for Mastodon, consolidating palettes, variables, overrides and reusable “mods” (e.g. avatars_circle, columns_gettingstarted).
