Administrators can integrate the provided app/javascript/styles into a Mastodon deployment to install instance-wide themes like linernotes_dark, while end users can import styles via userstyle extensions. The project simplifies color, font, layout and UI adjustments, improves maintainability through reusable snippets, and documents installation and usage; it is compatible with Mastodon's theming system for lightweight, incremental customization.

metadata.name: mastodon-bird-ui
metadata.description: 🐘🐦 Mastodon web UI, but strongly inspired by Twitter (when it was still good!)

summary.zh: Mastodon Bird UI 将 Mastodon 网页界面重塑为类 Twitter 的现代前端主题。基于 CSS/Sass，提供响应式布局、PWA 与移动优化、可访问性增强，并支持实例级集成或用户可选安装。适合实例管理员和终端用户快速定制社交界面外观与交互体验，强调可维护性与实用性而非后端改动。
summary.en: Mastodon Bird UI transforms Mastodon's web interface into a modern, Twitter-like front-end theme while improving usability and accessibility. Built primarily with CSS/Sass, it delivers responsive layouts, PWA/mobile tweaks, accessibility enhancements, and supports both instance-level integration and optional per-user installation. Targeted at Mastodon instance administrators and power users, it enables quick UI customization and easy updates without backend changes. The project focuses on practical front-end improvements, documentation, and deployment options for real-world Mastodon instances.

metadata.name: Personal-page
metadata.description: 🍊个人简介页面模板，女生自用99新（划掉），带二维码、打赏页、收款页。个人简介、个人介绍网页.

summary.zh: 静态个人简介模板，支持GitHub Pages部署与CDN/OSS托管，包含个人页、二维码收款与打赏页。基于Vue/jQuery实现动画与可定制内容，便于修改和本地/线上部署，BSD许可并保留作者来源链接。
summary.en: Static GitHub Pages personal template with QR pay/donate pages. Vue/jQuery, customizable, BSD.

metadata.name: AFFiNE
metadata.description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.

summary.zh: AFFiNE 是一个开源且本地优先的跨平台知识库与可视化工作区，将文档、白板、表格和数据库在无边画布上融合。支持实时协作、自托管与插件扩展，并内置多模态 AI 助手，可用于自动摘要、生成思维导图、幻灯片与原型，强调数据所有权与离线优先，适合团队知识管理、头脑风暴与产品设计等场景。
summary.en: AFFiNE is an open-source, local-first, cross-platform knowledge base and visual workspace that fuses docs, whiteboard, tables and databases on an edge-less canvas. It offers real-time collaboration, self-hosting and plugin extensibility, plus multimodal AI assistance for summarization, mind maps, slide generation and prototyping. Built with TypeScript and positioned as an alternative to Notion and Miro, AFFiNE emphasizes data ownership and offline-first workflows. Live demo, docs and deployment guides are provided to simplify onboarding and self-hosting for teams focused on knowledge management and creative planning.

metadata.name: flyde
metadata.description: Open-source Visual programming for backend logic that integrates with existing codebases. Flyde bridges the gap between technical and non-technical team members. Product managers, designers, and backend developers can collaborate on the same visual flows.

summary.zh: Flyde 是开源的 TypeScript 可视化编程平台，作为库嵌入代码库并提供 VS Code 扩展。它将 AI 驱动的后端逻辑（如代理、提示链与 API 编排）以可视化流程表示，支持运行时与现有框架和 CI/CD 集成、丰富标准库与可视化调试，降低技术与非技术团队协作门槛，便于快速原型化、迭代与部署后端 AI 工作流。
summary.en: Flyde is an open-source visual programming platform that runs inside your TypeScript codebase and VS Code. It enables product managers, designers, and backend developers to collaboratively design, prototype, and debug AI-driven backend workflows—such as agents, prompt chains, and API orchestration—through visual flows that integrate at runtime with existing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines. Flyde includes a runtime library, VS Code extension, rich standard library, and visual debugger, preserving full code control while accelerating iteration, testing, and deployment of backend AI services.

metadata.name: wemeet-wayland-screenshare
metadata.description: 实现Linux Wayland下腾讯会议屏幕共享（非虚拟相机）. Hook library that enables screenshare with Tencent Wemeet on Linux Wayland, without the need of using virtual cameras.

summary.zh: 基于 LD_PRELOAD 的钩子库，在多数 Wayland 桌面上为腾讯会议实现屏幕共享（非虚拟相机）。项目通过劫持 XShm/XDamage、启动 xdg‑portal 与 PipeWire 线程，将帧写入 framebuffer 以供 wemeet 获取，兼容 KDE/GNOME/Hyprland 及多种 wlroots 环境，提供 Arch AUR 与 Flatpak 使用说明。注意：官方 wemeet 已原生支持 Wayland，本项目已归档，建议升级官方客户端并卸载本项目。
summary.en: This repository provides an LD_PRELOAD hook library to enable Tencent Wemeet screen sharing on Wayland without using a virtual camera. It intercepts XShmAttach/XShmGetImage/XShmDetach, spoofs XDamage, launches xdg-desktop-portal and PipeWire threads, and writes frames into a framebuffer so Wemeet can capture the screen. It supports KDE, GNOME, Hyprland and many wlroots compositors, with Arch AUR and Flatpak usage notes. Note: upstream Wemeet now supports Wayland natively; this project is archived and users should upgrade to the official client.

metadata.name: godns
metadata.description: A dynamic DNS client tool that supports AliDNS, Cloudflare, Google Domains, DNSPod, HE.net & DuckDNS & DreamHost, etc, written in Go.

summary.zh: GoDNS 是用 Go 重写的自托管动态 DNS 客户端，支持 Cloudflare、AliDNS、Google Domains、DNSPod、DuckDNS 等多家服务商，兼容 IPv4/IPv6，并提供内置 Web 面板与 Docker 镜像。适合在家庭网络、服务器或边缘设备上实现公网地址自动同步、子域与根域管理以及 DNS 自动化，提供命令行与面板配置、定时更新；亦可选择作者提供的托管服务 godns.app。
summary.en: GoDNS is a self-hosted dynamic DNS client rewritten in Go, supporting many providers including Cloudflare, AliDNS, Google Domains, DNSPod, DuckDNS and more. It handles IPv4/IPv6, root and subdomain management, and offers a built-in web panel plus a Docker image. Suitable for home networks, servers and edge devices to automate public IP synchronization, remote access and DNS workflows. Configuration is available via CLI or web UI with scheduled updates; a managed hosted option is offered at godns.app.

metadata.name: GPT-SoVITS
metadata.description: 1 min voice data can also be used to train a good TTS model! (few shot voice cloning)

summary.zh: GPT-SoVITS-WebUI：少样本 TTS/语音转换平台，5 秒可做零样本合成，1 分钟微调即可克隆高相似度语音；支持跨语种推理（中/英/日/韩/粤），内置声源分离、训练集自动切分、中文 ASR 与标注等 WebUI 工具，提供 Colab/HuggingFace 在线演示与推理优化，便于快速构建与部署定制语音模型。
summary.en: GPT-SoVITS-WebUI is a few-shot voice conversion and TTS web interface that enables high-quality voice cloning with minimal data. It supports zero-shot synthesis from a 5-second sample and few-shot fine-tuning using about one minute of audio to achieve strong voice similarity. The project offers cross-lingual inference (Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Cantonese) and integrates WebUI tools including vocal separation, automatic dataset segmentation, Chinese ASR, and text labeling to simplify dataset creation and training. Colab and Hugging Face demos plus CPU/GPU inference optimizations support rapid prototyping and deployment.

metadata.name: hexo-generator-sitemap
metadata.description: Sitemap generator for Hexo.

summary.zh: hexo-generator-sitemap 是 Hexo 的站点地图生成插件。可输出 sitemap.xml 与 sitemap.txt，支持自定义 XML/TXT 模板与 _config.yml 配置（path/template/template_txt/rel/tags/categories）、可通过 front matter 的 sitemap: false 排除页面并可在站点头部添加 rel-sitemap。轻量、兼容 Hexo 2/3/4，适合静态博客与 Hexo 站点的 SEO 与索引自动化。
summary.en: hexo-generator-sitemap is a lightweight Hexo plugin that generates sitemap.xml and sitemap.txt for static sites. It supports custom XML/TXT templates, configurable output paths and options via _config.yml (path, template, template_txt, rel, tags, categories), and allows excluding individual posts/pages with sitemap: false in front matter. The plugin can add rel-sitemap to site headers, includes tag and category entries, and remains compatible with Hexo 2/3/4. Easy to install via npm, it’s ideal for automating SEO, search engine indexing and sitemap maintenance for Hexo sites.

metadata.name: tinyauth
metadata.description: The tiniest authentication and authorization server you have ever seen.

summary.zh: Tinyauth 是一款极简自托管身份认证与授权服务器，既可作为独立认证服务也可作为应用中间件。它支持 OAuth、LDAP 与细粒度访问控制，提供 docker-compose 示例并与 Traefik、Nginx、Caddy 等反向代理无缝集成，适合个人部署、homelab 与小型生产环境，强调轻量、易用与代理集成能力（处于活跃开发中，请参阅文档与发布说明）。
summary.en: Tinyauth is an ultra-small self-hosted authentication and authorization server that can run standalone or as middleware for applications. It supports OAuth and LDAP authentication, fine-grained access controls, and integrates with popular reverse proxies such as Traefik, Nginx, and Caddy. Container-friendly with a docker-compose example and a public demo, Tinyauth targets personal, homelab and small production deployments where simplicity, easy proxy integration and lightweight identity flows are required. The project is actively developed and documented at tinyauth.app.

metadata.name: vaultwarden
metadata.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs

summary.zh: Vaultwarden（原 bitwarden_rs）是用 Rust 编写的非官方 Bitwarden API 兼容服务器，为资源受限或偏好自托管的场景提供轻量替代。兼容官方 Bitwarden 客户端，常见于通过 Docker/容器部署以降低内存与 CPU 占用，适合个人与小团队的私有密码库管理。项目活跃、发布二进制与镜像，并以 AGPL-3.0 开源许可发布，便于在私有服务器上快速部署、升级与维护。
summary.en: Vaultwarden (formerly bitwarden_rs) is an unofficial, Rust-based implementation of the Bitwarden Server API that provides a lightweight, self-hostable alternative to the official, resource-heavy service. It remains compatible with official Bitwarden clients and is commonly deployed via Docker/containers to reduce memory and CPU usage, making it well suited for individuals and small teams who need private password management. The project is actively maintained, publishes binaries and container images, and is distributed under AGPL-3.0 for easy deployment and upkeep on private servers.
tags_zh: 自托管 Bitwarden 兼容服务器

metadata.name: ttyd
metadata.description: Share your terminal over the web

summary.zh: ttyd 是一个将本地终端通过浏览器共享的轻量命令行工具，适用于远程运维、教学和协同调试。基于 libuv 与 WebSocket，利用 WebGL2 加速终端渲染，支持 CJK/IME、Sixel 图像输出、ZMODEM/trzsz 文件传输和 TLS，提供基本认证、可配置权限与自定义命令选项，跨 macOS、Linux、*BSD、OpenWrt 与 Windows 平台，便于容器化部署与边缘设备使用。
summary.en: ttyd is a lightweight CLI tool that exposes a local terminal to the web for remote maintenance, teaching, pair debugging and quick sharing. Built on libuv with WebSocket transport and WebGL2-accelerated rendering, it supports full terminal features including CJK/IME, Sixel image output, ZMODEM/trzsz file transfers and TLS. ttyd provides authentication, configurable permissions and custom command options, runs cross-platform (macOS, Linux, *BSD, OpenWrt, Windows), and ships prebuilt binaries suitable for containers and edge devices.

metadata.name: snacks.nvim
metadata.description: 🍿 A collection of QoL plugins for Neovim

summary.zh: snacks.nvim 是一组基于 Lua 的 Neovim 小型 QoL 插件集合，提供动画库、快速大文件处理、仪表盘、文件浏览器、平滑滚动、浮动终端、Git/GitHub 集成与通知优化等模块化功能，轻量可选并与 LSP/Treesitter 集成以提升编辑效率。
summary.en: snacks.nvim is a modular Lua toolkit of small QoL plugins for Neovim, providing an animation library, big-file handling, dashboards, a file explorer, smooth scrolling, floating terminals, Git/GitHub and notification integrations. Lightweight, optional modules integrate with LSP/Treesitter to boost editing productivity.

metadata.name: HowToCook
metadata.description: 程序员在家做饭方法指南。Programmer's guide about how to cook at home (Simplified Chinese only).

summary.zh: 面向程序员的开源家庭菜谱，将零散网络做法整理为统一、精确的模板化步骤，提升可读性与可复现性。提供分类菜谱、厨房技巧与电器指南，内置网页可视化查看并提供 Docker 镜像便捷本地部署与索引，鼓励社区贡献与模板化编写，适合需要高可读性、快速部署与复用菜谱的开发者和居家用户。
summary.en: HowToCook is an open-source, programmer-oriented home cooking guide that turns inconsistent online recipes into precise, template-driven instructions for clarity and reproducibility. It offers categorized recipes, kitchen tips and appliance guides (pressure cooker, air fryer, microwave), a web viewer and a Docker image for quick local deployment and indexing. Designed for developers and busy home cooks who prefer concise, deterministic steps, the project is community-maintained with contribution templates and supports reuse, reproducible meal prep, and programmatic integration.

metadata.name: proxy-script-template
metadata.description: A template to assist you in writing proxy tool scripts

summary.zh: 面向 Proxy Tool 的脚本开发模板，封装通用 Client、URL 解析与 protobuf 解码等工具，兼容多客户端差异，简化请求/响应、持久化与打包流程，便于快速编写与移植代理脚本。
summary.en: A template for developing Proxy Tool scripts that provides a generic Client class, URL parsing utilities, and optional protobuf/grpc decoding. It abstracts client-specific API differences (bodyBytes, request id, unified done), exposes consistent methods for fetch, persistent storage, timing, logging and notifications, and includes build instructions using Node.js and esbuild. It includes a URLs parser, TextEncoder/Decoder polyfills and a decodeProtobuf helper for protoc deserialization, targeting Node.js packaging with npm/esbuild.

metadata.name: NapCatQQ
metadata.description: Modern protocol-side framework based on NTQQ

summary.zh: NapCatQQ 是基于 NTQQ 的现代化协议端框架，提供完整稳定的 Bot 协议接口、Stream API 支持及跨设备多媒体上下传优化，适用于构建高可用的 QQ 机器人与消息推送服务。
summary.en: NapCatQQ is an NTQQ protocol framework providing bot APIs, Stream API and optimized media transfer.

metadata.name: neo-tree.nvim
metadata.description: Neovim plugin to manage the file system and other tree like structures.

summary.zh: Neo-tree.nvim 是一个用 Lua 为 Neovim 提供的可扩展树形文件管理器，支持侧边栏、浮动窗与 netrw 风格。项目强调平滑 UX、无破坏性升级、实时文件监控、跟随当前文件与剪贴板跨树同步，并与 nui.nvim、plenary.nvim 集成，适合提升项目浏览、文件操作与工作区导航效率。
summary.en: Neo-tree.nvim is a Lua-based Neovim plugin delivering an extensible tree/file explorer with sidebars, floating windows and netrw-style layout. It focuses on smooth UX, non-breaking upgrades, live file watching, follow-current-file and clipboard sync, integrating with nui.nvim and plenary.nvim for efficient project navigation and file operations.

metadata.name: yazi
metadata.description: 💥 Blazing fast terminal file manager written in Rust, based on async I/O.

summary.zh: Yazi 是用 Rust 编写的极速终端文件管理器，采用非阻塞异步 I/O 与多线程调度，支持并发 Lua 插件、虚拟文件系统、图片预览、代码高亮与包管理，适合作为日常终端文件工作流替代。
summary.en: Yazi: a fast Rust terminal file manager with async I/O, multi-threading, Lua plugins, virtual filesystem, image previews and a package manager.

metadata.name: mini.nvim
metadata.description: Library of 40+ independent Lua modules improving Neovim experience with minimal effort

summary.zh: mini.nvim 是面向 Neovim（≥0.10）的轻量 Lua 模块库，提供 40+ 可独立启用的工具模块。它采用统一设计与配置，支持按需加载，覆盖界面增强、文本操作与快捷工作流等常用扩展，便于模块化定制与集成，适合希望精简且可组合化定制 Neovim 的用户与插件作者。
summary.en: mini.nvim is a lightweight Lua toolkit for Neovim (v0.10+) offering 40+ independent, on‑demand modules. With a unified configuration and consistent design, modules can be used standalone to add UI tweaks, text manipulation and workflow shortcuts. It emphasizes low overhead, modularity and easy integration with common package managers, targeting users and plugin authors who want customizable, composable editor enhancements.

metadata.name: indent-blankline.nvim
metadata.description: Indent guides  for Neovim

summary.zh: indent-blankline.nvim 为 Neovim 提供可配置的缩进可视化引导线，使用虚拟文本（无 conceal），兼容 Tree‑sitter 范围高亮，支持多色缩进、混合缩进检测与背景色指示，提供 hooks 与丰富配置选项，显著提升代码结构可读性与编辑导航效率。
summary.en: indent-blankline.nvim is a lightweight Neovim plugin that draws configurable indentation guides using Neovim's virtual text (no conceal). It supports Tree‑sitter-based scope highlighting, multiple color schemes, mixed-indentation detection, background-color guides, and integration with rainbow-delimiters. The plugin exposes ibl.setup() and hook APIs for custom highlight setup and dynamic behavior on colorscheme changes. Designed for the latest stable Neovim and managed via Lua plugin managers like lazy.nvim, it makes indentation levels and lexical scopes visually explicit to improve code readability and navigation.

metadata.name: Bili23-Downloader
metadata.description: Bili23-Downloader 是一款跨平台的 B 站视频下载工具，兼容 Windows（含 Win7）、Linux 和 macOS。它拥有现代化 UI，支持音视频流分离下载、多线程加速、弹幕与字幕获取、封面提取、元数据刮削等丰富功能，并可自定义文件命名与分类，满足多样化需求。

summary.zh: Bili23-Downloader 是一款跨平台（Windows/Win7、Linux、macOS）桌面 B 站视频下载器，基于 Python 与 PySide6 提供现代化 UI。支持多线程加速、音视频流分离与封装（mp4/mkv）、弹幕与多格式字幕抓取、封面提取并嵌入、NFO 元数据刮削及高度自定义的文件命名与多级分类，适合个人离线收藏、媒体中心归档与本地化管理。
summary.en: Bili23-Downloader is a cross-platform desktop Bilibili video downloader for Windows (including Win7), Linux and macOS, built with Python and PySide6. It offers a modern Fluent-style UI, multi-threaded accelerated downloads, audio/video stream separation and adaptive muxing to MP4/MKV, danmaku and multi-format subtitle fetching, cover extraction/embedding, and automatic NFO metadata scraping for media centers like Kodi/Jellyfin/Emby. Highly customizable filename templates and multi-level directory rules make it ideal for personal offline archiving and media library integration. Open-source under GPLv3.

metadata.name: kickstart.nvim
metadata.description: A launch point for your personal nvim configuration

summary.zh: kickstart.nvim 提供一个小巧、单文件且文档完备的 Neovim 启动配置，面向最新版稳定/夜版 Neovim。它不是完整发行版，而是以可读的 init.lua 演示插件管理、Tree-sitter 与 LSP 配置，并包含依赖与安装说明。推荐 Fork 后定制，便于快速引导、版本化和跨平台维护个人编辑器配置与插件生态。
summary.en: kickstart.nvim is a minimal, single-file, fully documented starter configuration for Neovim that targets the latest stable and nightly releases. It is intentionally not a full distribution but a practical bootstrap: a readable init.lua demonstrating plugin management, Tree-sitter and LSP setup, plus notes on external tooling and installation. The README recommends forking to personalize the repo, making it easy for developers to quickly clone, customize, version-control and maintain a portable Neovim configuration across platforms. It's ideal as a documented baseline to extend with language tooling and keymaps.

metadata.name: yazi.nvim
metadata.description: A Neovim Plugin for the yazi terminal file manager

summary.zh: yazi.nvim 在 Neovim 中以浮窗集成 yazi 终端文件管理器，同步文件变更到缓冲区与 LSP，并提供分屏标签、高亮、与 telescope/fzf-lua 等插件联动的快速导航与多种打开方式。
summary.en: yazi.nvim embeds the yazi terminal file manager into Neovim, syncing file ops with buffers and LSP.

metadata.name: nerd-fonts-installer
metadata.description: Nerd Fonts Installer is a bash script that allows users to easily install any nerd font in a Debian-based distribution by following a few simple steps.

summary.zh: 跨平台命令行 Nerd Fonts 安装器，提供 Linux/macOS 的 Bash 与 Windows 的 PowerShell 脚本，具交互式菜单、自动下载解压、字体注册与缓存刷新，方便一键在多系统安装 50+ Nerd 字体。
summary.en: A cross-platform CLI installer for Nerd Fonts with Bash (Linux/macOS) and PowerShell (Windows) scripts. Offers an interactive menu, automatic download and extraction, font cache refresh and Windows registration, enabling one-step installation of 50+ Nerd Fonts across systems.

metadata.name: bsky-pds
metadata.description: Bluesky PDS running in Docker externally accessed by a Cloudflare tunnel

summary.zh: bsky-pds 在 Docker 中部署 Bluesky PDS，通过 Cloudflare Tunnel 对外暴露。支持本地或 S3 兼容 Blob 存储、PLC/DID 管理、JWT 与 SMTP 邮件及邀请配置。README 详述 Cloudflare 通配符证书限制、S3 权限示例与 pds.env 必要变量，适合熟悉 atproto、PLC、Docker 与 Cloudflare 的自托管运维者快速搭建并做好备份策略。
summary.en: bsky-pds is a Docker-based, self-hosted solution for running a Bluesky Personal Data Server (PDS) exposed externally via a Cloudflare Tunnel. It supports local disk or S3-compatible blob storage, PLC/DID integration, JWT secrets, invite-required accounts, and SMTP email configuration for notifications and moderation. The README details Cloudflare wildcard certificate limitations, recommended hostname setup, an example S3 IAM policy, and the required pds.env variables. Intended for operators familiar with atproto, PLC, Docker, and Cloudflare who need a configurable, backup-aware PDS deployment.

metadata.name: wofi-themes
metadata.description: Style of wofi. Theme of wofi. Customize of wofi.

summary.zh: 提供多款针对 Wofi（Wayland 启动器）的 CSS 主题与配套背景图片（含 WebP 动图）。通过复制 style.css 至 ~/.config/wofi 或使用 wofi --style 即可快速应用。包含 cyan、BGPY2025、春节、彩虹与亚克力等风格，并示例如何修改 ~/.config/wofi/config 的 prompt 实现节日问候与界面定制，便于桌面美化与快速个性化。
summary.en: A collection of CSS themes for the Wofi Wayland launcher, including background images and WebP animations. Apply by copying style.css to ~/.config/wofi or using wofi --style. Themes include cyan, BGPY2025, Chinese New Year, Rainbow and Acrylic, with an example prompt tweak for holiday greetings—designed for quick desktop theming and UI customization.

metadata.name: LxgwWenKai
metadata.description: An unprofessional open-source Chinese font derived from Fontworks' Klee One. 一款非专业的开源中文字体，基于 FONTWORKS 出品字体 Klee One 衍生。

summary.zh: 霞鹜文楷（LXGW WenKai）是基于 FONTWORKS Klee One 的开源中文字体，遵循 OFL 1.1。提供完整版、轻便版、屏幕阅读版及 GB/TC 等衍生分支，并可与西文字体合并。适用于网页与移动端嵌入、代码与文档排版及屏幕可读性优化。仓库包含授权说明、使用与反馈渠道，强调禁止电商倒卖并说明不再提供 Magisk 模块，列出多个相关版本与部署选项。
summary.en: LXGW WenKai is an open-source Chinese typeface derived from Fontworks' Klee One and released under the OFL 1.1. The project offers full, lite, screen-optimized and GB/TC variants, plus merged releases with Western fonts for mixed-language use. It's well suited for web and mobile embedding, code and document typesetting, and screen readability improvements. The repository documents licensing, usage notes and feedback channels (glyph issues), warns against commercial resales on e‑commerce platforms, and notes Magisk font modules are no longer provided. Multiple related repos and build variants are linked for different deployment needs.

metadata.name: Lagrange.Core
metadata.description: An Implementation of NTQQ Protocol, with Pure C#, Derived from Konata.Core

summary.zh: Lagrange.Core 是基于 Konata.Core 的纯 C# 实现，提供 NTQQ 协议栈、OneBot 适配与 .NET6/7 支持。作为可通过 NuGet 分发的开源库，它面向构建 QQ 机器人、网关及协议适配器，设计强调模块化与可扩展性。项目附官方文档并采用 GPL‑3.0 许可；注意中心签服已终止，功能请求将长期排期与谨慎处理。
summary.en: Lagrange.Core is a pure C# implementation of the NTQQ protocol derived from Konata.Core, providing a protocol stack, core communication primitives and OneBot integration with .NET 6/7 support. Distributed via NuGet under GPL‑3.0, it targets developers building QQ ecosystem bots, gateways and protocol adapters. The library emphasizes modularity, extensibility and framework integration, includes documentation and examples. Note the central SignServer was temporarily terminated; feature requests are accepted but may be scheduled long‑term. The project disclaims endorsement of unlawful use.

metadata.name: mw2fcitx
metadata.description: Fcitx 5 pinyin dictionary generator for MediaWiki instances. (Releases for dict of zh.moegirl.org.cn / Check release list for latest releases)

summary.zh: mw2fcitx 是个 Python 工具，用于从 MediaWiki（如萌娘百科）抓取条目并生成适配 fcitx5/RIME 的拼音词库。支持通过 API 或本地标题文件获取、应用可配置的 tweaks 过滤与短语修正、简繁转换与内置或自定义 pypinyin 转换器，提供请求限速、异常断点恢复、增量导出及 CLI 使用，便于构建和发布大规模中文输入法词典与离线字典。
summary.en: mw2fcitx is a Python tool that builds fcitx5 and RIME-compatible pinyin dictionaries from MediaWiki sites (e.g., zh.moegirl.org.cn). It can fetch titles via the MediaWiki API or local files, apply configurable tweak filters and phrase fixes, perform simplified/traditional conversions, and convert text to pinyin using built-in pypinyin or custom converters. Features include request throttling, partial-session recovery, fixfile overrides, incremental exports, a CLI (mw2fcitx -c config_script.py), PyPI packaging, and optional OpenCC support—ideal for generating large-scale Chinese input-method wordlists and offline dictionary releases.

metadata.name: newsnow
metadata.description: Elegant reading of real-time and hottest news

summary.zh: Newsnow提供简洁的实时热门新闻阅读，支持GitHub OAuth与数据同步，具备自适应抓取间隔、可配置缓存和MCP服务，易于在Cloudflare/Vercel部署适合搭建多源新闻聚合和定制阅读。
summary.en: Newsnow is a lightweight news-reading demo offering an elegant, distraction-free interface for real-time trending Chinese news. It includes GitHub OAuth login with data synchronization, a 30-minute cache with optional force-refresh, adaptive scraping intervals to minimize resource use and avoid IP bans, and optional MCP server support. Ready for Cloudflare Pages, Vercel, or Docker deployment and compatible with Cloudflare D1, it provides clear source integration points for adding scrapers. Ideal for building multi-source news aggregation and customizable reading experiences; broader language support is planned.

metadata.name: rime
metadata.description: Rime Squirrel 鼠须管配置文件（朙月拼音、小鹤双拼、自然码双拼）

summary.zh: Rime Squirrel 鼠须管配置，包含朙月拼音、小鹤双拼与自然码双拼，内置百万搜狗词库、Emoji 与动态日期/时间，支持跨平台词库同步与本地隐私保护。仓库提供详尽的安装、备份、快捷键与自定义部署指南，便于在 macOS（Squirrel）等环境快速上手与深度定制，适合追求高效率、可控词库与强自定义输入体验的用户。
summary.en: Rime Squirrel configuration for the Squirrel (Rime) input method, bundling Luna Pinyin, Flypy and Double-Pinyin schemes. It includes a large Sogou dictionary, Emoji support, dynamic date/time snippets, and local/offline privacy-preserving wordlists with cross-platform sync. The repo supplies step-by-step installation, backup, keybindings and customization guidance for quick deployment on macOS and other platforms, enabling power users to achieve fast, highly customizable and private Chinese typing workflows.
tags_zh: 自定义同步与本地隐私

metadata.name: ddns-go
metadata.description: Simple and easy to use DDNS. Support Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Dnspod, Cloudflare, Callback, Huawei Cloud, Baidu Cloud, Porkbun, GoDaddy, Namecheap, NameSilo...

summary.zh: DDNS-GO 是用 Go 开发的跨平台 DDNS 工具，自动检测公网 IPv4/IPv6 并同步至多家域名服务商（支持阿里云、腾讯云、Cloudflare 等）。提供网页管理界面、Docker 与系统服务运行、Webhook/Callback、TTL 与自定义参数，支持多域名与多服务并发，便于家庭、服务器或容器环境下实现自动化域名解析更新与灵活地域/多IP 策略。
summary.en: DDNS-GO is a Go-based, cross-platform dynamic DNS tool that auto-detects public IPv4/IPv6 and updates DNS records across many providers (Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Cloudflare, etc.). It includes a web UI, Docker and system service modes, webhook/callback support, TTL and custom parameters, and supports multi-domain and multi-provider configurations—suitable for automated domain updates in home, server, or container environments.

metadata.name: awesome-mac
metadata.description:  This project is dedicated to collecting high-quality macOS software and organizing them systematically by different categories for easy search and use.

summary.zh: awesome-mac 是按分类整理的高质量 macOS 应用合集，覆盖开发、设计、多媒体、效率与系统工具，提供简介、下载/购买与 Mac App Store 链接，便于快速查找、对比与评估开源或商业应用，适合开发者、设计师与普通用户检索和贡献。
summary.en: awesome-mac is a curated, categorized collection of high-quality macOS applications. It aggregates software across development, design, multimedia, productivity and system utilities, providing brief descriptions, download/purchase links and Mac App Store shortcuts. The repository helps users quickly discover, compare and evaluate both open-source and commercial apps. Maintained on GitHub, it is aimed at developers, designers and general users; contributors can suggest additions via pull requests and issues for continuous curation.

metadata.name: Mousecape
metadata.description: Cursor Manager for OSX

summary.zh: Mousecape 是针对 macOS 10.8+ 的免费桌面光标管理器，利用私有 CoreGraphics API 和一个后台守护进程在登录时自动应用自定义“cape”光标包。支持多倍图像尺度、帧动画与可视化编辑（拖拽导入、创建/编辑 cape），操作非侵入式并持久化设置，适合定制系统指针与主题。源码与示例 cape 在 GitHub 发布，授权用于非商业个人使用。
summary.en: Mousecape is a free cursor manager for macOS 10.8+ that uses private CoreGraphics APIs to register system cursors and a helper daemon to apply custom cursor packages ("capes") at login. It supports multiple scale assets per cursor, stacked-frame animations, an in-app editor for creating/importing capes, and runs nonintrusively in the background. Ideal for personal cursor/theme customization; releases and example capes are available on GitHub. The project’s license restricts commercial use of the research and assets.

metadata.name: plum
metadata.description: 東風破 /plum/: Rime configuration manager and input schema repository

summary.zh: 東風破 是針對 Rime 的配置管理器與輸入方案倉庫，便於安裝、更新與管理官方及第三方的 schema、字典與數據包。以“配方”組織套件並支持 GitHub 個人配置，方便定制輸入法與跨平台同步。
summary.en: /plum/ (東風破) is a configuration manager and input-schema repository for the Rime input-method engine. It helps users install, update, and manage default configurations as well as official and third-party schemas, dictionaries and data packages hosted on GitHub. Rime schemata are distributed as YAML schema and dictionary files; /plum/ organizes reusable configuration pieces as 'recipes' to compose packages, enable modular installation and support future parameterized customization. It targets Chinese input customization, vocabulary sharing and cross-platform configuration sync across phonetic and shape-based methods.

metadata.name: azahar
metadata.description: An open-source 3DS emulator project based on Citra.

summary.zh: Azahar 是基于 Citra 的开源 Nintendo 3DS 模拟器，整合 PabloMK7 与 Lime3DS 的工作成果。项目定位为未来 3DS 模拟开发的主平台，提供跨平台发行（Windows/macOS/Linux/Android）、多种打包格式与持续集成构建，并在 Android 上提供更快速的 Vanilla 文件管理等性能优化，便于用户下载、开发者贡献与平台适配。
summary.en: Azahar is an open-source Nintendo 3DS emulator forked from Citra, merging PabloMK7's Citra fork and Lime3DS. It aims to be the primary platform for ongoing 3DS emulation development, offering cross-platform releases (Windows, macOS universal/arm/x86, Linux Flatpak/AppImage, Android) and multiple packaging options. Highlights include CI builds, community-driven enhancements and a faster Android Vanilla file-management path. Developers and users gain Citra compatibility while enabling platform-specific optimizations and broader distribution.

metadata.name: rime-ice
metadata.description: Rime 配置：雾凇拼音 | 长期维护的简体词库

summary.zh: 雾凇拼音是一套开箱即用的简体中文 Rime 配置，集全拼与常见双拼、丰富扩展功能与长期维护的百万级中英词库于一身。完全离线、跨平台（Weasel、鼠须管、Fcitx5、iBus），提供 Emoji、模糊音、自动纠错、日期/农历、符号输入等便捷工具，并附详尽注释便于自定义与社区协作，适合追求稳定、隐私友好且可定制的输入体验的用户与开发者。
summary.en: Rime Ice is an out-of-the-box Simplified Chinese Rime configuration offering full and common double-pinyin schemes, extensive extensions, and a carefully maintained million-entry Chinese-English dictionary. It runs fully offline and cross-platform (Weasel, Squirrel, Fcitx5, iBus), providing emoji, fuzzy matching, auto-correct, date/lunar tools, symbol input and other conveniences, plus detailed inline comments for easy customization. Ideal for users and developers who want a stable, privacy-friendly, customizable input method with community-driven updates, one-step installation and support for AI-assisted customization.

metadata.name: AeroSpace
metadata.description: AeroSpace is an i3-like tiling window manager for macOS

summary.zh: AeroSpace 是一款面向 macOS 的 i3 风格平铺窗口管理器，采用树型布局并自研虚拟工作区以绕过 macOS Spaces 限制。支持快速无动画的工作区切换、纯文本配置与 CLI 优先，兼容多显示器且无需关闭 SIP。推荐通过 Homebrew cask 安装并自动更新，适合依赖键盘、高效窗口编排的开发者和高级用户。
summary.en: AeroSpace is an i3-inspired tiling window manager for macOS that implements a tree-based layout and its own virtual workspace emulation to bypass macOS Spaces limitations. It delivers fast, animation-free workspace switching without disabling SIP, is CLI-first with man pages and shell completions, and uses plain-text configuration suitable for dotfiles. Proper multi-monitor support follows an i3-like paradigm. Install via Homebrew cask for autoupdates. Target users are keyboard-driven developers and power users who need deterministic, scriptable window organization with extensible configuration options.

metadata.name: SAWARATSUKI.ServiceLogos
metadata.description: ロゴを可愛く作ろう できる限りForkはしないでください

summary.zh: 由 Sawaratsuki 手绘的非官方可爱服务 Logo 集合，适合个人非商业用途（贴纸、编辑器图标等）。使用 Photoshop/Illustrator 与 Eureka 字体制作，欢迎在 Issues 提交新增请求（需带请求标签）。README 明确许可：禁止商业售卖，官方可要求删除，作者鼓励署名并建议尽量不要 Fork。
summary.en: This repository collects hand-crafted, unofficial "cute" service logos by Sawaratsuki, intended for personal, non-commercial use such as stickers, editor icons, and hobby projects. Logos are created with Photoshop/Illustrator and the Eureka font. Users can request new logos via Issues (include a request tag). The README clarifies licensing: commercial sale is prohibited unless authorized, officials may request removal, and the author encourages attribution while asking contributors to avoid forking when possible.

metadata.name: proxy-protocol-support
metadata.description: Proxy Protocol support for Fabric and Quilt servers

summary.zh: Proxy Protocol Support 是面向 Fabric 与 Quilt 的服务端模组，为 Minecraft 服务器解析 HAProxy Proxy Protocol，实现同时接收代理和直连并恢复玩家真实 IP。采用“默认拒绝”安全策略，通过可信代理与直连 IP/CIDR 白名单、防止绕过代理，支持自动拉取 TCPShield IP、并在 config/proxy_protocol_support.json 中配置。仅服务端，兼容 Minecraft 1.14–1.21.10（并可能支持更高版本），适合隐藏服务器 IP 的转发/防护场景。
summary.en: Proxy Protocol Support is a server-side mod for Fabric and Quilt that adds HAProxy Proxy Protocol parsing to Minecraft servers. It allows handling proxied and direct connections simultaneously while exposing players' real IPs when forwarded, useful with TCPShield, Nginx, FRP and similar TCP proxies. The mod enforces a secure 'default deny' model with configurable trusted proxy and direct-access IP/CIDR whitelists, optional automatic TCPShield IP fetching, and settings in config/proxy_protocol_support.json. Server-side only; supports Minecraft 1.14–1.21.10 and likely newer versions. Ideal for operators who want to obfuscate server IPs without losing accurate source addressing.
tags_zh: 代理协议 / 真实 IP 恢复

metadata.name: imewlconverter
metadata.description: ”深蓝词库转换“ 一款开源免费的输入法词库转换程序

summary.zh: 深蓝词库转换是基于 .NET 的开源跨平台输入法词库转换工具，支持20+主流输入法与多种编码（拼音、五笔、仓颉等）。提供批量拖拽、命令行和自定义格式扩展，便于在 Windows/Linux/MacOS 上进行词库导入、备份与格式互转，适合集成到个人使用与自动化处理流程中。
summary.en: ImeWlConverter is an open-source, cross-platform .NET tool for converting input-method wordlists. It supports 20+ IMEs and multiple encodings (Pinyin, Wubi, Cangjie), offers batch drag-and-drop, CLI and custom format extensions, and is suited for importing, backup and automated wordlist workflows on Windows, Linux and macOS.

metadata.name: memos
metadata.description: Open-source, self-hosted note-taking tool built for quick capture. Markdown-native, lightweight, and fully yours.

summary.zh: Memos 是一款开源且可自托管的轻量级笔记工具，原生支持 Markdown，专注于快速捕捉与简洁管理。提供 Docker 部署与 SQLite/MySQL/Postgres 支持，具备网页/移动端访问、标签与全文检索、用户管理与第三方集成，适合个人或小团队的知识管理与日常记录场景，强调数据归属与快速输入体验。
summary.en: Memos is an open-source, self-hosted lightweight note-taking app that is Markdown-native and optimized for quick capture and simple organization. It supports Docker deployment and SQLite/MySQL/Postgres backends, offers web and mobile access, tagging, full-text search, user management, and third-party integrations. Focused on minimal UX and data ownership, it’s ideal for individuals and small teams needing fast ephemeral notes and straightforward knowledge management.

metadata.name: Ice
metadata.description: Powerful menu bar manager for macOS

summary.zh: Ice 是针对 macOS 的菜单栏管理器（需 macOS 14+），能隐藏/显示与分组菜单栏项，支持拖拽重排、搜索、外观自定义、快捷键与自动重隐藏等高级交互，便于整理拥挤菜单栏和优化桌面工作流。
summary.en: Ice is a macOS 14+ menu bar manager that hides/shows and groups items, supports drag‑and‑drop layout, search, appearance customization, hotkeys and auto‑rehide to declutter the menu bar.

metadata.name: TrackersListCollection
metadata.description: 🎈 Updated daily! A list of popular BitTorrent Trackers! / 每天更新！全网热门 BT Tracker 列表！

summary.zh: 每天更新的 BitTorrent Tracker 列表，按 BEST/ALL/HTTP/NoHTTP 分类并提供 Aria2 格式与镜像地址，便于提升 P2P 下载速度、简化 BT 客户端配置与网络调试，适用于种子加速与下载优化场景。
summary.en: Daily-updated BitTorrent tracker list categorized (BEST/ALL/HTTP/NoHTTP) with Aria2-ready formats and mirror URLs. It helps accelerate P2P downloads, simplify BitTorrent client configuration, and assist network/troubleshooting for torrent users and integrations.

metadata.name: zh.javascript.info
metadata.description: 现代 JavaScript 教程（The Modern JavaScript Tutorial），以最新的 ECMAScript 规范为基准，通过简单但足够详细的内容，为你讲解从基础到高阶的 JavaScript 相关知识。

summary.zh: 本仓库维护《现代 JavaScript 教程》中文版，基于最新 ECMAScript 规范，系统讲解从基础语法到异步编程、模块化、DOM 与浏览器 API 等前端核心主题。面向自学者、课堂与团队参考，包含练习任务与解答、翻译与贡献流程，以及本地预览服务。项目开源免费、持续同步英文原版，便于协作翻译与长期维护。
summary.en: This repository hosts the Chinese translation of The Modern JavaScript Tutorial, aligned with the latest ECMAScript standards. It delivers systematic, example-driven coverage from fundamentals to advanced topics—language syntax, asynchronous programming, modules, DOM and browser APIs—targeted at self-learners, classrooms and frontend teams. The project includes exercises with solutions, a clear translation and contribution workflow, terminology guidance, and local preview support. It is open-source, continuously updated and synchronized with the English original to enable collaborative translation and maintenance.

metadata.name: hexo-theme-matery
metadata.description: A beautiful hexo blog theme with material design and responsive design.一个基于材料设计和响应式设计而成的全面、美观的Hexo主题。国内访问：http://blinkfox.com

summary.zh: hexo-theme-matery 是一款基于 Material Design 的 Hexo 博客主题，强调简洁可读与响应式布局。提供首页轮播与动态 banner、瀑布流文章列表、时间线归档、标签词云与分类雷达图等可视化组件；支持 MathJax、文章目录、复制附带版权、阅读密码、Gitalk/Gitment/Valine/Disqus 评论、统计、音视频播放与在线客服。适合用于搭建功能丰富且外观现代的个人博客或静态文档站，兼容 Hexo 5.0+。
summary.en: hexo-theme-matery is a Material Design–inspired Hexo theme focused on clean, readable posts and responsive layouts across desktop, tablet and mobile. It features a homepage carousel with dynamic daily banners, masonry (waterfall) post lists, timeline archives, tag word clouds and category radar charts, plus a rich About page. Built-in capabilities include MathJax, TOC, copy-with-copyright, post password protection, multiple comment integrations (Gitalk/Gitment/Valine/Disqus), analytics, media playback, emoji and live chat. Recommended for attractive, feature-rich personal blogs or static documentation sites on Hexo 5.0+.

metadata.name: siyuan
metadata.description: A privacy-first, self-hosted, fully open source personal knowledge management software, written in typescript and golang.

summary.zh: SiYuan 是一款隐私优先、自托管的开源个人知识管理软件，采用 TypeScript 与 Go 开发。支持本地文件存储、插件/应用市场、Docker 部署与跨平台客户端，强调块级关联编辑、可扩展生态与离线优先的工作流。适合重视数据所有权、需要可定制化笔记与知识库管理的个人与团队，便于在自托管环境中部署与扩展。
summary.en: SiYuan is a privacy-first, self-hosted, fully open-source personal knowledge management system implemented in TypeScript and Go. It provides local-first file storage, a plugin/app market, Docker-ready distribution and cross-platform clients. Emphasizing block-level linked editing, extensibility and offline-first workflows, SiYuan enables users to retain data ownership while customizing note-taking and knowledge-base workflows. It targets individuals and teams who need private, developer-friendly, and easily deployable self-hosted knowledge management.

metadata.name: 7days-golang
metadata.description: 7 days golang programs from scratch (web framework Gee, distributed cache GeeCache, object relational mapping ORM framework GeeORM, rpc framework GeeRPC etc)  7天用Go动手写/从零实现系列

summary.zh: 7days-golang 是一套 7 天实战系列教程，使用 Go 从零实现 Gee（类 Gin）Web 框架、分布式缓存 GeeCache、ORM GeeORM 与 RPC 框架 GeeRPC。内容逐日拆解路由与 Context、Trie 路由、中间件、模板、LRU 淘汰、一致性哈希、singleflight、Protobuf 通信、ORM 映射与事务、服务注册与负载均衡等后端关键技术，案例精简且配有详解，适合进阶掌握 Go 服务端实现与系统设计的教学实战项目。
summary.en: 7days-golang is a practical seven-day, from-scratch series that teaches building core backend components in Go. It demonstrates step-by-step implementations of Gee (a Gin-like web framework), GeeCache (a groupcache-style distributed cache), GeeORM (an ORM), and GeeRPC (an RPC framework). Lessons cover context and handler design, trie routing, middleware, templates, LRU eviction, consistent hashing, singleflight, Protobuf RPC, schema mapping, transactions and migrations, plus service registry and load balancing. Compact, well-commented examples and accompanying articles make it ideal for hands-on learning of Go server internals and system design.

metadata.name: holoprint
metadata.description: Minecraft Bedrock build tool - like Litematica

summary.zh: HoloPrint 是一款网页应用，将 Minecraft Bedrock 的 .mcstructure 文件转换为可下载的资源包，在游戏内通过盔甲架渲染分层全息建造预览。复刻 Litematica 风格的交互体验，支持移动、旋转、透明度、分层模式、材质清单与方块校验等控制。用户在浏览器上传结构文件并调整设置后生成 .mcpack，适合创作者、地图制作者与服务器管理员快速预览与复制结构，附带使用文档与 Android 导出说明。
summary.en: HoloPrint is a web application that converts Minecraft Bedrock (.mcstructure) files into downloadable resource packs (.mcpack) which render holographic build overlays in-game using armor stands. Inspired by Structura and aiming to reproduce Litematica-like functionality on Bedrock, it provides layered rendering, move/rotate controls, transparency, layer modes, material lists and block validation. Users upload a structure file, tweak settings in the browser, then generate a resource pack to preview and replicate constructions. Suitable for builders, map makers and server admins, with documentation and Android export guidance available.

metadata.name: rune
metadata.description: Experience timeless melodies with a music player that blends classic design with modern technology.

summary.zh: Rune 是一款跨平台音乐播放器，将 Zune 经典设计与现代技术融合。它提供本地音频分析与个性化推荐、可按规则自动更新的动态播放列表（Mix）、多端适配、丰富配色与全面键盘支持。界面清爽无广告、高度可定制，面向希望离线管理、发现和重组本地音乐库的用户。
summary.en: Rune is a cross-platform music player that combines Zune-inspired classic aesthetics with modern engineering. It focuses on local library management offering audio analysis, personalized recommendations and rule-based dynamic 'Mix' playlists that update automatically as your collection and listening habits change. Rune emphasizes a clean, ad-free UI, extensive keyboard shortcuts, customizable themes and responsive layouts across Windows, macOS, Linux, SteamOS, Android and iOS. It’s designed for users who prefer offline control over discovery, curation and automated reorganization of their music libraries.

metadata.name: hexo-generator-feed
metadata.description: Feed generator for Hexo.

summary.zh: hexo-generator-feed 为 Hexo 生成 Atom 或 RSS2 订阅源。可通过 _config.yml 配置类型、路径、条数、内容截断、自动发现与 PubSubHubbub，支持全文或摘要，兼容多版本 Hexo，便于博客订阅与聚合服务接入。
summary.en: Creates Atom or RSS2 feeds for Hexo. Configurable via _config.yml (type, path, limit, content); supports full or summary output, autodiscovery and hub integration for easy subscription and aggregation.

metadata.name: MoeKoeMusic
metadata.description: 一款开源简洁高颜值的酷狗第三方客户端 An open-source, concise, and aesthetically pleasing third-party client for KuGou that supports  Windows / macOS / Linux / Web :electron:

summary.zh: MoeKoe Music 是基于 Vue.js 与 Electron 开发的开源跨平台酷狗第三方客户端，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux/Web。它直连官方服务器、无第三方 API，提供歌词、MV 播放、每日推荐、主题切换、全局快捷键与自动领取 VIP 等功能，并支持 Docker 部署与多语言，适合希望在桌面或自托管环境中优雅播放酷狗音乐的用户。
summary.en: MoeKoe Music is an open-source, Vue.js and Electron-based cross-platform third-party client for KuGou. It connects directly to official servers without third-party APIs and delivers lyrics, MV playback, daily recommendations, theme switching, global shortcuts, and automatic VIP claiming. Supporting Windows/macOS/Linux/Web, PWA and Docker deployment plus multi-language UI, it targets users who want a lightweight, attractive desktop or self-hosted KuGou listening experience.

metadata.name: VutronMusic
metadata.description: 高颜值的第三方网易云播放器；支持流媒体音乐，如navidrome、jellyfin、emby；支持本地音乐播放、离线歌单、逐字歌词、桌面歌词、Touch Bar歌词、Mac状态栏歌词显示、Linux-gnome与Linux-kde桌面状态栏歌词显示；支持降调降速，支持自定义主题等。支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron:

summary.zh: VutronMusic 是一款基于 Electron 与 Vue3/TypeScript 的跨平台高颜值第三方网易云桌面播放器。支持本地音乐与离线歌单、外挂/逐字歌词（兼容 LDDC 格式）、navidrome/jellyfin/emby 等流媒体源，提供桌面/Touch Bar/状态栏歌词展示（支持 macOS 与 GNOME/KDE 插件）、降调/变速与音效设置、主题自定义，适合在 Windows/macOS/Linux 上做本地与流媒体音乐整合管理与高保真播放体验（仅限学习研究使用）。
summary.en: VutronMusic is a polished, cross‑platform third‑party NetEase Cloud desktop player built on Electron and Vue3/TypeScript. It supports local music and offline playlists, embedded and external LRC (including word‑by‑word lyrics via LDDC), and streaming backends such as Navidrome, Jellyfin, and Emby. Features include desktop/Touch Bar/status‑bar lyric display (macOS plus GNOME/KDE integrations), pitch and speed adjustment, audio effects, and custom themes. Designed for Windows/macOS/Linux to unify local and streaming playback with rich lyric and UI integrations (for personal learning/research use).

metadata.name: manga-ocr
metadata.description: Optical character recognition for Japanese text, with the main focus being Japanese manga

summary.zh: Manga OCR 基于 Hugging Face Transformers 的视觉编码器-解码器与 PyTorch，实现端到端日文识别，专为漫画场景优化：支持纵/横排、带振假名、图像叠字、多种字体与低质图像，并能在单次前向传播中识别多行气泡。适合截屏实时识别、批量转录，或与阅读器/HTML 覆盖层等工具集成。
summary.en: Manga OCR is an end-to-end Japanese OCR built with Hugging Face Transformers' Vision Encoder-Decoder and PyTorch, optimized for manga-specific challenges. It handles vertical and horizontal text, furigana, text overlaid on images, diverse fonts and low-quality scans. Unlike many OCR systems, it supports multi-line recognition in a single forward pass, allowing entire speech bubbles to be processed without manual line splitting. Typical uses include real-time screenshot OCR, batch transcription, and integration with manga readers or HTML overlay tools.

metadata.name: Qure
metadata.description: Quantumult X Policy Icon Set

summary.zh: Qure 是为 Quantumult X 提供的策略组图标集，支持远程订阅与本地安装，实现多设备图标同步与及时更新。仓库包含大量 PNG 图标、预览与归档，并提供命名、缓存清理与安装说明，便于美化界面并提升策略组可识别性，接受通过 Issues 或 Telegram 提交新增图标请求。
summary.en: Qure is an icon pack for Quantumult X policy groups, offering remote subscription and local installation to synchronize icons across devices and enable prompt updates. The repository contains a large collection of PNG icons, preview and archived galleries, plus step-by-step guidance for adding icons via img-url, local placement, naming conventions and cache clearing. It targets users and rule maintainers who want to beautify the Quantumult X UI and improve policy-group recognition. New icon requests are accepted via Issues or Telegram; copyright/disclaimer notes are included.

metadata.name: VTuber-Logos-Collection
metadata.description: An elegant website for collecting kawaii logos from great artists

summary.zh: 这是一个精美的静态网站（已在 Vercel 在线展示），汇集可爱的 VTuber 风格徽标并集中维护署名信息。支持按别名、作者路由与分类过滤，便于检索与引用。项目使用 TypeScript 开发、pnpm 管理，面向静态资源目录或 Git 子模块部署，提供简单的图片上传与集中管理流程，方便社区收集、展示并正确归属艺术家作品，适合设计师、开发者与内容创作者浏览与贡献素材。
summary.en: An elegant static website that curates kawaii VTuber-style logos with centralized credit data and a live demo hosted on Vercel. It offers alias-based and author-route filtering, category browsing, and clear workflows to add logos either by placing images in the public folder or by linking an external GitHub repository as a submodule. Built with TypeScript and managed with pnpm for static hosting, the project simplifies collecting, displaying, and attributing community-contributed logo artwork, making it easy for designers, developers, and streamers to browse and contribute.

metadata.name: clash-nyanpasu
metadata.description: Clash Nyanpasu～(∠・ω< )⌒☆​

summary.zh: Clash Nyanpasu 是基于 Tauri 的跨平台 Clash GUI，集成 Clash、Mihomo 与 clash‑rs 后端。支持 YAML/JavaScript/Lua 的 Profile 扩展、Provider 管理与规则链，采用 Google Material You 风格界面。基于 Rust 与 Node.js（pnpm）开发，易于本地运行与打包。面向需要可视化且可脚本化管理代理配置与路由策略的高级用户。
summary.en: Clash Nyanpasu is a Tauri-based, cross-platform GUI for managing Clash-compatible proxy engines. It integrates Dreamacro/clash, Mihomo and clash-rs backends and offers profile enhancement via YAML, JavaScript and Lua, provider management, and rule chaining. With a Google Material You styled UI, the project is developed using Rust and Node.js (pnpm) to simplify local development, debugging and packaging. It targets power users who need graphical, scriptable control over proxy configurations, providers and routing policies.

metadata.name: certimate
metadata.description: An open-source and free self-hosted SSL certificates ACME tool, automates the full-cycle of issuance, deployment, renewal, and monitoring visually. 完全开源免费的自托管 SSL 证书 ACME 工具，申请、部署、续期、监控全流程自动化可视化，支持各大主流云厂商。

summary.zh: Certimate 是一款完全开源的自托管 ACME SSL 管理工具，提供视觉化工作流，自动化实现证书申请、部署、续期与监控。跨平台且零依赖、内存仅约16MB，支持 DNS‑01/HTTP‑01、RSA/ECC、多种证书格式，兼容 60+ DNS 提供商与 120+ 部署目标，并集成多通道通知与多家 ACME CA，适合注重隐私与运维自动化的云与边缘证书生命周期管理。
summary.en: Certimate is an open-source, self-hosted ACME-based SSL/TLS certificate management tool that automates the full lifecycle — issuance, deployment, renewal and monitoring — via a visual workflow. It's cross-platform, zero-dependency and extremely lightweight (≈16 MB), offering DNS‑01 and HTTP‑01 challenges, RSA/ECC keys and multiple certificate formats (PEM/PFX/JKS). It integrates with 60+ DNS providers, 120+ deployment targets (Kubernetes, CDN, WAF, load balancers), multiple notification channels and various ACME CAs. Suited for privacy-conscious teams and DevOps environments requiring automated, auditable certificate lifecycle operations.

metadata.name: CoralFans
metadata.description: CoralFans Mod.

summary.zh: CoralFans 是一个社区驱动的开源 mod 项目，通过 lip 一键安装并提供完整文档，便于在目标应用/游戏中快速集成与扩展功能。仓库整合了 OEOTYAN 与 trapdoor-ll 的部分实现，面向希望通过包管理器安装、二次开发和贡献补丁的开发者与玩家。项目接受 PR 并以 AGPL v3 许可发布，技术亮点在于轻量分发、模块化扩展与文档指引，适合构建可维护的扩展生态。
summary.en: CoralFans is a community-driven open-source mod project distributed via the lip package manager, offering ready documentation for quick integration and extensibility in target applications or games. The repository incorporates partial implementations from OEOTYAN and trapdoor-ll, targeting developers and users who want to install via package manager, customize functionality, and contribute patches. The project accepts PRs and is released under AGPL v3. Key strengths include lightweight distribution, modular extensibility, and documentation-first workflow, enabling a maintainable extension ecosystem.

metadata.name: syncthing
metadata.description: Open Source Continuous File Synchronization

summary.zh: Syncthing 是一款开源的持续文件同步程序，基于 Go 开发，提供跨平台的点对点加密同步、自动冲突处理与版本保留。它强调数据安全与隐私，支持局域网与互联网同步，适合个人与小型团队用于去中心化备份和实时文件同步，作为替代云存储的私有同步方案。
summary.en: Syncthing is an open-source continuous file synchronization program written in Go. It performs secure, encrypted peer-to-peer synchronization across LAN and the internet without central servers, offering automatic conflict handling, versioning, and optional built-in update signing. Designed for safety, privacy, and ease of use, Syncthing runs cross-platform and supports headless and GUI wrappers, Docker deployment, and robust build/release practices. It's ideal for individuals and small teams seeking a decentralized alternative to cloud storage for real-time backup and file replication, with strong community support.

metadata.name: catgirl-maid
metadata.description: 🔔 The prompt to make your ChatGPT becoming a cute catgirl maid 🔔

summary.zh: 猫娘女仆提示工程：为 ChatGPT 定制详尽角色模版与回复规范，包含身份设定、措辞约束、口癖与情感表达，并强制移除 AI 口癖与默认说明。适用于角色扮演、聊天机器人风格定制与 persona 测试，强调细粒度措辞控制、输出格式与可复用的提示约束，以保持对话中的人格一致性。
summary.en: This repository provides a detailed prompt template to turn ChatGPT into a catgirl maid persona named “Momo” (喵桃). It enforces persona rules such as specific honorifics, a humble tone, speech quirks (meows and emoticons), first‑person naming, removal of AI disclaimers, bilingual output order, and absolute obedience constraints. Useful for roleplay, conversational agent customization, prompt engineering experiments, and chatbot persona testing. Highlights include fine‑grained wording control, strict output formatting, reusability across languages, and suitability for prompt tuning or automated prompt pipelines to ensure consistent character-driven responses.

metadata.name: qBittorrent-Enhanced-Edition
metadata.description: [Unofficial] qBittorrent Enhanced, based on qBittorrent

summary.zh: qBittorrent Enhanced 是基于 qBittorrent 的非官方增强型 BT 桌面客户端（C++/Qt + libtorrent）。主要新增自动封禁迅雷/QQ/百度/Xfplay/DLBT 等离线下载器、可选按国家封禁中国未知对等体、可选封禁 BitTorrent Media Player 节点，以及对等体白/黑名单管理。适合对等体治理、隐私防护与 tracker 管理，提供 AppImage 与多发行版/多平台安装包，便于部署与维护。
summary.en: qBittorrent Enhanced Edition is an unofficial, feature-extended fork of qBittorrent (C++/Qt with libtorrent) focused on stronger peer governance and protection. It introduces automatic banning of clients like Xunlei, QQ, Baidu, Xfplay, DLBT and offline downloaders, optional auto-ban of unknown peers from China, optional BitTorrent Media Player peer ban, and peer whitelist/blacklist controls. It uses DB-IP for country resolution and targets users and tracker operators who need robust P2P filtering, privacy and network hygiene. Distributed as AppImage and via common package channels for major platforms.

metadata.name: BBLL
metadata.description: 一个第三方哔哩哔哩客户端，A third-party bilibili client。

summary.zh: BBLL 是一款面向 Android（含 TV/遥控器）的第三方哔哩哔哩客户端，供学习与交流使用。项目对 B 站官方 API 进行封装，侧重视频播放与界面适配，支持硬件解码、双击快进、遥控器 D‑Pad 操作；通过 Firebase 和 AppCenter 收集设备与崩溃日志。提供兼容 Android4.4（API19）与 5.0+ 的安装包，无破解行为，作为开源参考实现。
summary.en: BBLL is a third-party Android client for Bilibili designed for learning and communication. It wraps Bilibili’s official APIs to provide a lightweight video client optimized for phones and TV devices, supporting hardware decoding, double-tap seek, D-Pad/remote navigation. The app collects device info and crash logs via Firebase and AppCenter (no personal data). Separate APKs offer Android 4.4 (API19) compatibility and modern 5.0+ builds. No cracking or content claims—intended as an open reference for media playback and UI adaptation.

metadata.name: kando
metadata.description: 🌸 Do things with utmost efficiency.

summary.zh: Kando 是一款跨平台的桌面饼状菜单（pie menu），支持鼠标、手写笔、触控、手柄与键盘等输入。用于启动程序、发送快捷键、打开文件并执行自定义命令，强调快速、高效与可定制的交互工作流。兼容 Windows、macOS 及多数 Linux 桌面，附有安装、配置与源码编译文档。由开源作者 Schneegans 维护，是 Gnome‑Pie / Fly‑Pie 的后续项目，适合追求直观桌面操作效率的用户与开发者。
summary.en: Kando is an open-source, cross-platform pie menu for desktop environments that enables fast, gesture-driven interaction. It supports mouse, stylus, touch, gamepad and keyboard input to launch applications, trigger keyboard shortcuts, open files and execute custom commands. Designed for speed and customization, Kando runs on Windows, macOS and most Linux desktops, with documentation for installation, configuration and building from source. Maintained by Schneegans as the successor to Gnome‑Pie and Fly‑Pie, it targets users and power-users seeking a compact, efficient alternative to traditional menus.

metadata.name: bilibilitv1.6.6-repair
metadata.description: 尝试修复经典的 bilibili tv 1.6.6 版本

summary.zh: 本仓库修补并维护经典 bilibili TV v1.6.6：替换签名 native 库、切换 TV/web/DASH/FLV 源、在 Java 层修复直播与播放逻辑、恢复旧版首页推荐，并加入画质、倍速、点赞/投币等交互功能，旨在在后端变更下保持旧界面可用性与兼容性。
summary.en: This repository patches and maintains the classic bilibili TV v1.6.6 client to keep it usable despite upstream changes. It replaces signed native libraries, adapts video sources (TV, web, DASH, FLV), and applies Java-layer fixes for live streaming, playback logic and progress sync. It also restores legacy UI elements like home recommendations and adds quality, speed and interaction controls (likes, coins, one-click triple-action). Targeted at enthusiasts who need the legacy interface to remain compatible with modern backends.

metadata.name: toBeBetterJavaer
metadata.description: 一份通俗易懂、风趣幽默的Java学习指南，内容涵盖Java基础、Java并发编程、Java虚拟机、Java企业级开发、Java面试等核心知识点。学Java，就认准二哥的Java进阶之路😄

summary.zh: 二哥的 Java 进阶之路是面向初中高级开发者的免费学习宝典，涵盖 Java 基础、并发、JVM、企业级开发与面试题解析，提供系统学习路线、实战项目与面试规划，文风通俗幽默，适合自学与复习求职使用。
summary.en: toBeBetterJavaer is a comprehensive, approachable Java learning guide by 'Er Ge', covering fundamentals, concurrency, JVM internals, enterprise development, and interview preparation. It aggregates original tutorials, curated study routes, practical projects, downloadable PDFs, and job-oriented tips for junior to senior developers. The content is updated regularly, emphasizes clear explanations and humor, and is suitable for self-study, interview review, and building production-ready Java skills. It also links to community resources and hands-on projects to accelerate real-world competency.

metadata.name: museeks
metadata.description: 🎵 A simple, clean and cross-platform music player

summary.zh: Museeks 是一款简单、界面清爽的跨平台桌面音乐播放器，基于 Tauri（Rust）与 React 开发。支持常见音频格式、库自动刷新、播放列表与队列管理、封面显示、倍速播放、睡眠阻止及 .m3u 导入导出，适合需要轻量、本地化音乐管理的用户。
summary.en: Museeks is a simple, clean cross-platform desktop music player built with Tauri (Rust) and React. It supports common audio formats, library auto-refresh, playlists and queue management, cover art, playback speed control, a sleep blocker, and .m3u import/export—ideal for users seeking a lightweight local music manager.

metadata.name: DoIt
metadata.description: A clean, elegant and advanced blog theme for Hugo.

summary.zh: DoIt 是为 Hugo 打造的简洁优雅且功能丰富的博客主题，兼容 LoveIt，便于迁移与配置。适合个人或多作者静态博客，提供自定义页眉、细粒度样式、友好暗色模式与一键复制代码。内置 Algolia/Fuse.js/Pagefind 搜索、KaTeX 数学公式、Mermaid 流程图、ECharts 可视化、Mapbox 地图、APlayer 音乐与 Bilibili 嵌入，支持丰富短代码、Font Awesome 扩展与 CDN 加速。
summary.en: DoIt is a clean, elegant and feature-rich Hugo blog theme that inherits LoveIt compatibility for easy migration. Targeting personal and multi-author static blogs, it offers customizable headers, refined styling and a reader-friendly dark mode. DoIt integrates flexible search (Algolia, Fuse.js, Pagefind), KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, ECharts visualizations, Mapbox maps, APlayer music and Bilibili embeds, plus one-click code copy, extended Font Awesome support, abundant shortcodes and CDN-ready third-party libraries for fast static publishing.

metadata.name: LunaTranslator
metadata.description: 视觉小说翻译器 / Visual Novel Translator

summary.zh: LunaTranslator 是面向视觉小说的开源翻译与本地化工具，基于 HOOK 提取游戏文本并支持内嵌翻译与模拟器读取。内置高精度 OCR、丰富的在线/离线翻译接口（含大模型）、语音合成与识别、日语分词/假名与 Anki 集成，适合沉浸式实时翻译、文本抽取和离线/在线本地化及语言学习场景。
summary.en: LunaTranslator is an open-source Visual Novel translation and localization tool that extracts in-game text via HOOK and supports embedded in-game translation and HOOK emulators for consoles. It bundles a high-accuracy OCR pipeline, flexible support for many online and offline translation engines including large language models, TTS and speech recognition backends, plus Japanese tokenization/kana and Anki integration. Designed for immersive real-time translation, script extraction and offline localization workflows, it serves both casual players and fan-translation/localization teams. The project is GPLv3-licensed with multilingual documentation.

metadata.name: unlock-music
metadata.description: 在浏览器中解锁加密的音乐文件。原仓库： 1. https://github.com/unlock-music/unlock-music ；2. https://git.unlock-music.dev/um/web

summary.zh: 在浏览器中解密来自多家音乐平台的加密音频文件（QQ、网易、酷狗、酷我、虾米、JOOX、咪咕等），基于 WebAssembly 与多线程在前端实现快速批量解锁，支持拖放、写入元数据与封面、PWA 与浏览器扩展，并提供 CLI 用于大批量转换。仓库含预构建包与 CI 构建，源码按 MIT 协议开源，适合本地转换、学习与技术研究。
summary.en: Unlock Music is a browser-based tool to decrypt encrypted audio files from many Chinese and international platforms (QQ Music, NetEase, Kugou, Kuwo, Xiami, JOOX, Migu, etc.). It leverages WebAssembly and multithreading in the frontend for fast, batch decryption with drag-and-drop, metadata and cover editing, PWA support, and a buildable browser extension. A CLI is available for large-scale conversions. Prebuilt releases and CI packages are provided; source builds require Node.js and Linux tooling for WASM. MIT-licensed for learning and research.

metadata.name: clitheme
metadata.description: CLItheme - Customize output messages of any command line application! 自定义任何命令行程序的提示输出！

summary.zh: CLItheme 是一款命令行输出定制工具，通过主题定义文件与替换规则修改任意 CLI 程序的 stdout/stderr，保留终端控制字符与颜色，支持 man 页本地化、i18n 及类似 gettext 的前端 API。适合个性化错误提示、本地化输出、调试增强与自动化展示，主题语法可读且支持正则与变量替换，便于按命令范围精确匹配和转换输出内容。
summary.en: CLItheme is a command-line output customization utility that rewrites and styles stdout/stderr of any CLI program using theme definition files and substitution rules. It preserves terminal control sequences (colors/ESC codes), supports man-page localization and multi-language i18n, and exposes a frontend API similar to gettext for application integration. Typical uses include personalized error messages, localized CLI output, debugging-enhanced displays, and automated presentation of tool outputs. Themes use a readable, regex-capable syntax with scoped commands and variable substitution.

metadata.name: iina
metadata.description: The modern video player for macOS.

summary.zh: IINA 是为 macOS 打造的现代开源视频播放器，基于 mpv 与 Swift，支持字幕、播放列表、画中画、Touch Bar、可定制界面、手势与命令行/浏览器扩展，适合追求原生体验和高度自定义的用户与开发者。
summary.en: IINA is a modern open-source macOS video player built on mpv and Swift. It delivers subtitles, playlists, picture-in-picture, Touch Bar support, a customizable UI, gesture controls, CLI and browser extensions—targeting users and developers who want native, highly configurable playback.

metadata.name: Microsoft-Activation-Scripts
metadata.description: Open-source Windows and Office activator featuring HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS activation methods, along with advanced troubleshooting.

summary.zh: MAS 是开源的 Windows 与 Office 激活脚本，集成 HWID、Ohook、TSforge 与在线 KMS 四种激活方式，支持 PowerShell 一键执行与传统 MAS_AIO.cmd 批处理，包含 ESU 支持、详尽故障排查与通过 DoH 绕过 DNS 阻断的选项，并提醒在执行网络脚本前核实来源与 URL。
summary.en: MAS is an open-source Windows and Office activation toolkit that implements multiple activation methods — HWID, Ohook, TSforge and Online KMS — and includes Extended Security Updates (ESU) support. It offers a PowerShell one-liner installer and a traditional MAS_AIO.cmd workflow for legacy systems, bundled troubleshooting and diagnostics, plus DNS-over-HTTPS fallbacks when domains are blocked. The project emphasizes scripted automation of activation flows, recovery steps and clear usage guidance. Community-driven development and an active issue tracker provide ongoing updates; users should verify sources before executing downloaded scripts.

metadata.name: Natter
metadata.description: Expose your TCP/UDP port behind full-cone NAT to the Internet.

summary.zh: Natter 是个轻量级 Python 工具，可将处于 full-cone NAT 后的主机 TCP/UDP 端口映射到公网。内置 STUN、keep-alive 与 UPnP 支持，提供 iptables/nftables/socat/gost/socket 等多种转发方式并支持 Docker 部署，无需第三方依赖，适合远程访问、临时服务暴露和测试场景。
summary.en: Natter is a lightweight Python tool that exposes TCP/UDP ports from hosts behind a full-cone NAT to the public Internet. It uses STUN for discovery and keep-alive, can leverage UPnP/IGD, and supports multiple forwarding methods (iptables, nftables, socat, gost, raw socket). Runs with no third-party Python dependencies and can be deployed via Docker. Typical uses include remote access, temporary service exposure and testing; it can report mapped public addresses, run a test page and invoke notification scripts on mapping changes.

metadata.name: UE-DDNS
metadata.description: Universal Embedded DDNS Shell Script

summary.zh: UE-DDNS 是面向嵌入式与轻量 Unix 的 POSIX Shell DDNS 工具，采用模块化、低依赖设计。支持 IPv4/IPv6，可从检测 URL 或网口获取动态 IP，兼容 BusyBox 与多数 Unix 平台，支持 Cloudflare、Dnspod、GoDaddy 等 API。交互式向导一键生成定制更新脚本，支持代理、指定出口接口、OpenWrt 检测、严格 IP 比对以避免重复调用，并提供多种移动推送通知以实时接收 IP 变更。
summary.en: UE-DDNS is a minimalist, modular POSIX shell DDNS utility for embedded and lightweight Unix systems. It supports IPv4/IPv6, obtaining dynamic IPs from check URLs or network interfaces, and is BusyBox-compatible for constrained devices. An interactive wizard accepts API tokens for providers like Cloudflare, DNSPod and GoDaddy, enumerates domains/subdomains, and generates standalone update scripts. Features include proxy and interface routing, OpenWrt detection, strict IP comparison to avoid redundant API calls, and multiple push-notification methods for real-time IP update alerts.

metadata.name: ProgrammingVTuberLogos
metadata.description: High-quality PNGs for logos I made for fun

summary.zh: 本仓库收录作者闲趣创作的一系列高质量编程 VTuber 徽标 PNG 素材，按 CC BY‑NC‑SA 许可非商业共享。素材适合替换程序图标、制作贴纸、作为头像或集成到开发工具与编辑器中。通过 Issue 提交定制请求并可在公开看板跟踪队列进度，作者保留针对商业用途逐案授权的权利。README 还列出多个衍生项目与本地化/IDE 插件镜像链接。
summary.en: This repository hosts a collection of high-quality PNG logos created by the author as a hobby, focused on programming VTuber and related motifs. All assets are shared noncommercially under CC BY-NC-SA. They are ready for use as application icons, stickers, avatars, or integrated into editors and developer tooling. Contribution and custom requests are handled via GitHub issues and a public Kanban board; the maintainer may grant commercial exceptions on a case-by-case basis. Mirrors and addons for IDEs and localized editions are linked in the README.

summary.zh: 本仓库提供《Summer Pockets REFLECTION BLUE》手机版双语汉化补丁，重点替换三个数据包（Scene.pck、__dat_patch_000.pck、__g00_patch_004.pck），仅汉化剧情文本，界面未汉化。README 包含针对 Android（安卓11 前后）、越狱 iOS 与未越狱 iOS 的安装、URL 重写下载和反和谐方法说明。补丁由汉化组制作，仅供试玩、须先下载官方数据并禁止商业使用，鼓励支持正版。
summary.en: This repository delivers a bilingual fan translation patch for the mobile release of Summer Pockets REFLECTION BLUE. It works by replacing three data files (Scene.pck, __dat_patch_000.pck, __g00_patch_004.pck) to localize story text while leaving the game UI untranslated. The README documents installation procedures for Android (pre/post Android 11), jailbroken iOS, and non‑jailbroken iOS using URL rewrite rules to hijack CDN downloads, plus instructions for restoring uncensored assets. Provided by a fan group for personal trial, it is not a crack and users should keep and support the official release.

metadata.name: MinecraftStats
metadata.description: A Minecraft player statistics browser for the web - supports 1.13 and later!

summary.zh: MinecraftStats 是面向 Minecraft 1.13+ 的网页玩家统计浏览器，从服务器 world/stats JSON 提取数据，基于可定制的奖项、勋章与事件生成玩家排行榜、冠分与荣誉殿堂。支持 Spigot/Paper 插件或 CLI 更新，提供自动定时更新、事件追踪、自定义奖项与离线皮肤集成，适用于公开或私人服务器的统计可视化和社区互动提升。
summary.en: MinecraftStats is a web-based player statistics browser for Minecraft 1.13 and later. It ingests server world/stats JSON files and computes award-driven rankings, medals, crown scores and a Hall of Fame. The project supports configurable events and custom awards, and can run as a Spigot/Paper plugin or a standalone CLI updater. Plugin-only conveniences include scheduled automatic updates, Dynmap detection and SkinsRestorer support. It’s intended for public or private servers wanting leaderboards, event tracking and visualized player metrics; the frontend stores data in a data folder and requires a webserver.

metadata.name: fabric-bedrock-miner
metadata.description: 一个用于挖掘基岩的Fabric客户端模组！A fabric client mod to mine bedrock!

summary.zh: 基于 Fabric 的 Minecraft 客户端模组，自动化“挖掘”基岩：空手右键切换、左键破坏，支持白名单/黑名单、分层与区域任务、命令配置与调试，能显著加速基岩采集与建造流程。
summary.en: Fabric mod for Minecraft automating bedrock mining with empty-hand toggle, whitelist/blacklist, layer and region tasks, commands and debug.

metadata.name: pca-protocol
metadata.description: A fork of plusls-carpet-addition, provides PCA protocol support to the server only

summary.zh: pca-protocol 是 plusls-carpet-addition 的分支，仅在服务端实现 PCA 协议支持。只需 Fabric Loader 运行，不包含客户端实现且会与原项目冲突，适合在 Fabric 服务器上提供 PCA 协议兼容性的场景。
summary.en: pca-protocol is a fork of plusls-carpet-addition that implements PCA protocol support server-side only. It requires Fabric Loader, conflicts with the original mod, and is aimed at Fabric-based Minecraft servers needing PCA compatibility.

metadata.name: Loop
metadata.description: Window management made elegant.

summary.zh: Loop 是 macOS 的窗口管理应用；通过按键触发的径向菜单与实时预览，支持可定制主题、键盘快捷键、循环操作和边缘隐藏（Stash）。可快速移动、缩放与排列窗口，大幅提升多窗口工作流与桌面整理效率。
summary.en: Loop is a macOS window management app that uses a radial menu triggered by a hotkey to move, resize and arrange windows with mouse or keyboard. It provides live resize previews, customizable themes for the radial menu and preview pane, repeatable 'cycles' for sequential actions, stash-edge hiding for temporary window decluttering, and flexible shortcut mapping. Lightweight and user-configurable, Loop targets power users who need fast multi-window workflows and precise window positioning on macOS 13+. Regular updates add features and refinements.

metadata.name: nftables-nat-rust
metadata.description: nftables nat规则生成器

summary.zh: 基于 Rust 的高性能 nftables NAT 管理器，实时监测配置与域名/IP 变化并自动生成与更新端口转发及黑名单规则。支持 IPv4/IPv6 双栈、单端口与端口段、TCP/UDP 协议选择、DNS 缓存、本地重定向、TOML 与传统配置、Docker 兼容、systemd 开机自启及带 JWT/TLS 的 WebUI，可在 Linux 环境中实现轻量化的运维自动化与端口管理。
summary.en: NFTables NAT Rust is a high-performance NAT and port-forwarding manager written in Rust that dynamically generates and updates nftables rules by monitoring config and resolving domain IPs. It supports IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack, single-port and port-range mappings, TCP/UDP selection, DNS caching, local port redirection, firewall-style drop filters, TOML and legacy configs, Docker compatibility, systemd auto-start, and a JWT/TLS secured Web UI for visual management and multi-backend control—designed to automate Linux network operations and runtime rule orchestration.

metadata.name: frps-onekey
metadata.description: Frp server one-click configuration script. The script obtains the latest Frp version by default

summary.zh: Frps 一键服务端安装脚本，自动获取最新 FRP 版本，支持 CentOS/Debian/Ubuntu/Fedora/RHEL/Rocky/AlmaLinux（32/64 位）。提供安装、更新、卸载与服务管理，自动生成 frps.toml，兼容 tcp/http/https/quic/kcp，带下载进度条、日志等级与心跳配置，便于快速、可重复地部署内网穿透与反向代理服务。
summary.en: Frps-Onekey is a shell-based one-click installer for the frps server that automatically fetches the latest FRP release and supports major Linux distributions (CentOS, Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, AlmaLinux) on 32/64-bit. It manages install, uninstall, update and provides an init/service script for start/stop/status/config. Key features include automatic frps.toml generation following the latest format, tcp/http/https/quic/kcp transport support, download progress bar, configurable logging and heartbeat, and interactive update prompts—designed for rapid, scriptable deployment of reverse-proxy/NAT-traversal services.

metadata.name: FixTim
metadata.description: Fix every runtime bug on macOS.

summary.zh: FixTim 是 macOS 的用户空间“软重启”工具，借助 launchd 重启并重开用户进程，无需整机重启即可修复截图、输入法卡顿、核心音频、AirDrop、Wi‑Fi、未响应应用、iCloud 和 Xcode/Simulator 等运行时问题。部分操作需管理员权限（--now），无法修复硬件或内核问题，同时提供 Swift 命令行源码以兼容旧系统。
summary.en: FixTim is a macOS utility that fixes common runtime glitches by performing a user-space “soft reboot”: it uses launchd to restart and reopen user processes without rebooting the kernel. It targets issues such as broken screenshots, lagging IMEs, core audio interruptions, AirDrop failures, Wi‑Fi scanning/connect problems, unresponsive apps, iCloud sync errors, and Xcode/Simulator or debugserver faults. Some fixes require elevated privileges (use --now with sudo). It cannot repair hardware or kernel-level bugs. A Swift command-line source is provided for older macOS versions; MIT licensed.

metadata.name: golang101
metadata.description: Go语言101 : 一个与时俱进的Go编程知识库

summary.zh: Go语言101是持续更新的Go丛书与知识库，涵盖语言语法与运行时、自定义泛型、性能优化与实用细节，提供在线与本地离线阅读、电子书下载和命令行文档服务器，适合初学者与进阶开发者深入理解Go语义与实现细节。
summary.en: Go101 is an evolving Go book series and knowledgebase covering language syntax, runtime, custom generics, performance optimizations and practical tips. It offers online and local/offline reading, e-book downloads and a CLI-hosted documentation server, suitable for both beginners and experienced developers seeking deeper understanding of Go semantics and implementation.

metadata.name: vcpkg
metadata.description: C++ Library Manager for Windows, Linux, and MacOS

summary.zh: vcpkg 是微软与社区维护的开源跨平台 C/C++ 包管理器，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。以 C++ 与 CMake 实现，提供清单与经典安装模式、依赖版本控制、包注册与发布、二进制缓存与离线资产缓存，并能与 CMake、MSBuild 及主流编辑器无缝集成，适合在桌面、服务器与嵌入式项目中统一管理第三方库、复用二进制并简化构建与分发流程。
summary.en: vcpkg is an open-source, Microsoft and community-maintained cross-platform C/C++ package manager for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Implemented in C++ with CMake scripts, it supports manifest and classic modes, build-system integrations (CMake, MSBuild), editor integrations, dependency versioning, registries for packaging and publishing, binary caching, and offline asset caching. vcpkg streamlines acquiring third-party libraries, reproducible builds, and binary reuse across desktop, server, and embedded projects. Enterprise-ready features and CI-friendly workflows make it easy for teams to control dependencies and distribute artifacts reliably.

metadata.name: clash-verge-rev
metadata.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience

summary.zh: Clash Verge Rev 是基于 Rust 与 Tauri 的跨平台 Clash Meta GUI 客户端，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux。内置 Clash.Meta 内核并可切换内核，提供主题与 CSS 注入、配置合并与脚本、可视化节点/规则编辑、系统代理与 TUN 模式，以及 WebDav 备份与同步，便于对代理节点、路由规则和配置进行可视化管理与同步，适合高级用户与运维场景。
summary.en: Clash Verge Rev is a modern cross-platform GUI client built with Rust and Tauri for managing Clash Meta proxy setups on Windows, macOS and Linux. It bundles a Clash.Meta core with optional kernel switching, and offers theme/CSS injection, config merge and scripting, visual node and rule editors, system proxy and TUN support, plus WebDAV backup and sync. Designed for power users and operators who need native-performance, visual management and synchronized configuration of proxy nodes and routing rules.

metadata.name: kcptube
metadata.description: 同时支持传送TCP与UDP的KCP通道，附带端口跳跃、IP地址跳跃的功能，以及FEC，自带中继服务器支持

summary.zh: KCP Tube 提供基于 KCP 的双向 TCP/UDP 隧道，支持端口与 IP 跳跃、FEC、STUN 打洞与中继节点，内置多种加密算法。旨在规避运营商对 UDP 的限速，实现低延迟且可靠的游戏加速与流量转发，兼容 IPv4/IPv6、动态端口范围，并支持自定义 KCP 参数与带宽控制。
summary.en: KCP Tube is a KCP-based bi-directional tunneling tool that forwards both TCP and UDP with reliability and low latency. It implements port and IP hopping to evade ISP UDP QoS, optional FEC, STUN hole punching for NAT traversal, relay node support, and multiple AEAD ciphers. It supports IPv4/IPv6, dynamic port ranges, bandwidth limits and manual KCP tuning. Typical use cases include game acceleration and bypassing UDP throttling; it runs in client/server/relay modes with config validation and testing utilities.

metadata.name: udphop
metadata.description: 专用于UDP的端口跳跃及IP地址跳跃工具。A tool of UDP's Port Hopping & IP Address Hopping

summary.zh: UDP Hop 是为绕过家庭宽带 UDP 限速设计的网络工具。客户端周期性重建 UDP 连接并在源端口/源 IP 间跳换，保持原生 UDP 数据流且以 Session ID 管理会话。服务端可用 STUN 打洞，支持 IPv4/IPv6、端口范围、FEC 与多种加密算法，适合部署在软路由或网关上用于流量迁移与限速规避。
summary.en: UDP Hop is a tool designed to bypass consumer broadband UDP throttling by periodically re-establishing UDP connections and migrating traffic across new source IP/port tuples. It preserves native UDP (no TCP encapsulation), assigns Session IDs to distinguish flows, and expires idle sessions automatically. Server mode supports STUN hole punching and both IPv4 and IPv6. Configurable options include port ranges, scheduled port refresh, FEC and multiple AEAD ciphers. UDP Hop targets deployment on home routers or soft-routers to maintain higher UDP throughput via port/IP hopping.

metadata.name: ATV-Bilibili-demo
metadata.description: BiliBili Client Demo for Apple TV (tvOS)

summary.zh: Apple TV (tvOS) 的开源 BiliBili 客户端 Demo，集成二维码登录、云视听投屏、直播与弹幕、推荐 Feed、搜索、关注、历史、稍后再看等功能。基于 Swift 与系统 AVPlayer 实现 HDR 播放、字幕与弹幕防挡，适合用于 tvOS 客户端开发与媒体播放方案研究。项目未在 App Store/TestFlight 授权上架，注意分发与安全。
summary.en: This repository is an open-source BiliBili client demo for Apple TV (tvOS). It implements QR-code login, the Cloud TV casting protocol, live streaming with danmaku, recommendation feed, trending/rankings, search, follow list, playback history, watch-later, and system AVPlayer-based playback with HDR and subtitle support. Additional features include danmaku occlusion avoidance and cloud casting. Built with Swift for tvOS, it serves as a technical reference for tvOS client implementation and media playback patterns. Not officially distributed via App Store/TestFlight; unsigned nightly iPA builds are in releases.

metadata.name: ArchLinuxTutorial
metadata.description: ✨Arch Linux安装使用教程 每日实时更新！ | 包含ArchLinux从安装到日常使用、娱乐、编程、媒体制作的各个方面，让Arch成为你的常用系统吧！ | 提供在线网页文档 ✨

summary.zh: Arch Linux 中文教程，持续更新并提供在线文档。覆盖安装、显卡驱动、科学上网、日常软件、编程与媒体制作等内容，重视隐私与自由软件原则，使用 Docsify 构建并接受社区 PR，采用 CC BY‑NC‑ND 4.0 许可。适合打算将 Arch 作为常用系统或处于网络受限环境的用户。
summary.en: A concise, continuously updated Chinese tutorial for Arch Linux available as online documentation. It covers installation, graphics drivers, networking (including workflows for censored environments), daily applications, programming, media production and crypto tools. The project emphasizes privacy and free-software principles, is built with Docsify, accepts community pull requests, and is released under CC BY‑NC‑ND 4.0. Maintained by the ArchLinuxStudio community, it targets users who want to adopt Arch as a daily driver—especially those in restricted-network situations.

metadata.name: GetSomeFries
metadata.description: 个人独立作品或公共组件库

summary.zh: GetSomeFries 是基于 Env.js 与 BoxJs 的模块化代理脚本集合，兼容 Loon/Surge/Shadowrocket/Quantumult X，支持请求重写、MitM 与流媒体解锁。各模块可独立订阅与部署，跨 iOS/iPadOS/macOS 运行，适合网络代理配置、流媒体访问解锁与自动化规则管理。
summary.en: GetSomeFries is a modular collection of JavaScript proxy scripts and utilities powered by Env.js and BoxJs, designed to unlock Apple features and streaming services across iOS, iPadOS and macOS. It supports major proxy clients including Loon, Surge, Shadowrocket and Quantumult X, requiring rewrite, script and MitM capabilities. Individual modules provide request/response rewriting, DNS/HTTPDNS/ASN handling and service-specific rules (e.g., Netflix, Disney+), and can be subscribed or deployed independently. Ideal for managing network proxy configurations, automating streaming access and customizing device-level traffic rules.

metadata.name: hammerspoon
metadata.description: Staggeringly powerful macOS desktop automation with Lua

summary.zh: Hammerspoon 是轻量开源的 macOS 桌面自动化框架，内嵌 Lua 引擎并通过扩展模块暴露系统 API，允许以脚本实现热键、窗口管理、应用控制、通知与事件驱动的自定义工作流。面向需深度定制桌面的高级用户与开发者，配置位于 ~/.hammerspoon/init.lua，可用 Homebrew 安装，社区提供大量示例与 API 文档。
summary.en: Hammerspoon is a lightweight, open-source macOS automation framework that bridges the operating system to an embedded Lua engine. Through modular extensions exposing system APIs, users can script hotkeys, window management, application control, notifications, accessibility and other OS-level features to build event-driven automations and custom workflows. It targets power users and developers who want deep customization of their desktop environment; configuration lives in ~/.hammerspoon/init.lua. Installable via Homebrew or direct download, Hammerspoon is backed by extensive API docs, community sample configs and an active contributor base.

metadata.name: Music163bot-Go
metadata.description: 一个用来下载/分享网易云歌曲的Telegram Bot

summary.zh: Music163bot-Go 是一款用 Go 编写的 Telegram 机器人，面向网易云音乐实现搜索、分享和下载。支持 inline 查询、链接嗅探、为音频注入 163 key、快速分享以及使用 MUSIC_U 下载无损 FLAC（需 VIP）。集成 traefik/yaegi 提供动态扩展，内置自动更新、MD5 校验与重试机制，配套跨平台构建脚本和可配置 INI，便于在个人或群组中通过 Telegram 分发与归档网易云歌曲。
summary.en: Music163bot-Go is a Telegram bot written in Go that enables searching, sharing and downloading songs from NetEase Cloud Music. It supports inline queries, link sniffing, injecting 163 keys into audio files, quick sharing, and lossless FLAC downloads using a MUSIC_U cookie (VIP required). The project uses traefik/yaegi for runtime dynamic extensions and includes auto-update, MD5 verification, retry logic and cross-platform build scripts (Go 1.17+). Deploy via a configurable INI; ideal for personal or group archival and distribution of NetEase tracks over Telegram.

metadata.name: Render-dragon-shader-list
metadata.description: List of shaders and related information, files, etc. that are compatible with RenderDragon.

summary.zh: 本仓库汇总并维护适配《我的世界》基岩版 RenderDragon 的着色器包与相关工具，提供兼容列表、安装教程、RTX 与实用插件分组，并强调防范伪造下载与安全提醒，便于玩家查找可信资源并参与贡献。
summary.en: A curated index of RenderDragon-compatible shaders and utilities for Minecraft Bedrock, offering compatibility lists, installation guides, RTX and utility packs, plus safety warnings and contribution instructions.

metadata.name: monaspace
metadata.description: An innovative superfamily of fonts for code

summary.zh: Monaspace 是面向开发者的等宽字体超家族，包含五套度量兼容的可变轴字体与丰富的静态切片，支持混合使用。核心技术包括可变字体轴、“texture healing” 字形纹理修复、Frozen TTF（默认启用样式集）与 Nerd Fonts 图标补丁，兼顾水平/垂直度量一致性，便于在编辑器、终端与 IDE 中获得更清晰、表达力更强且对齐良好的代码排版体验。
summary.en: Monaspace is a monospaced type superfamily built for coding, offering five metric-compatible variable-axis families plus extensive static builds. Variable fonts simplify installation while static cuts ensure compatibility where variable support is limited. Key innovations include texture healing for visual smoothing, Frozen TTFs that enable stylistic sets by default, and Nerd Fonts-patched static builds with optical icon alignment. Monaspace prioritizes consistent horizontal/vertical metrics and mix-and-match typographic control to improve code legibility and aesthetics across editors, terminals, and IDEs.

metadata.name: docker-gitbook-pdf-generator
metadata.description: 如果你想使用 GitBook 生成 PDF ，又不想折腾，使用这个项目就对啦！
