summary.zh: 本项目提供已封装 weasyprint 与 Python 的 Docker 镜像，一键将 GitBook 网站生成体积小的 PDF。支持挂载本地字体修复中文显示、挂载自定义 gitbook.css 调整样式，并通过挂载输出目录或 docker-compose 快速批量生成电子书。适合需要便捷、可复现地导出轻量化、可传播电子书的作者与文档维护者。
summary.en: Docker Gitbook PDF Generator is a prebuilt Docker image that converts GitBook sites into compact PDFs using WeasyPrint and Python, addressing GitBook's oversized PDF output and lack of compression. It supports mounting local fonts for correct Chinese rendering, custom CSS overrides, and output-directory mounting for easy retrieval. Ideal for authors and documentation maintainers who need quick, repeatable, and portable e-book generation workflows. Includes Docker and docker-compose usage examples, font troubleshooting tips, and is MIT-licensed for easy reuse.

metadata.name: geoip
metadata.description: 🌚 🌍 🌝 GeoIP 增强版，支持自由定制 V2Ray dat 格式文件 geoip.dat、MaxMind mmdb 格式文件、sing-box SRS 格式文件、mihomo MRS 格式文件、Clash ruleset、Surge ruleset 等。Enhanced edition of GeoIP for V2Ray, Xray-core, sing-box, Clash, mihomo, Shadowrocket, Quantumult X, Surge, hysteria, Trojan-Go, Leaf, Nginx, etc.

summary.zh: GeoIP 增强版每周生成多种 GeoIP 文件并提供 CLI 定制，支持 V2Ray dat、MaxMind MMDB、sing-box、mihomo、Clash/Surge 等格式。基于 GeoLite2 并补充中国 IPv4/IPv6 数据，新增 Cloudflare/Google/Netflix/Tor 等专项分类，便于在代理、规则分流与部署场景（如 V2Ray/Xray、Trojan‑Go、Nginx 等）中使用与自动化更新。
summary.en: Enhanced GeoIP publishes multiple GeoIP formats weekly and provides a CLI for custom exports. It builds V2Ray dat, MaxMind MMDB (Country.mmdb), sing-box SRS, mihomo MRS, Clash and Surge rulesets, and more—compatible with V2Ray/Xray, sing-box, Trojan-Go, hysteria, mihomo and Nginx. Based on MaxMind GeoLite2 but replaces/supplements China IPv4/IPv6 ranges and adds special categories (Cloudflare, Google, Netflix, Telegram, Tor, etc.), making it ideal for proxy rule routing, geo-based filtering and automated deployments.

metadata.name: surge-list
metadata.description: Rules for Surge. DOMAIN-SET update daily.

summary.zh: surge-list 提供可被 Surge 直接引用的 AdGuard 域名规则集合，覆盖广告、追踪、社交、中文域名和 DNS 主机等分类，规则通过 jsDelivr 发布并由仓库脚本每日自动更新，方便在 Surge 配置中快速引入域名黑白名单与隐私防护规则，实现自动化同步与精细域名路由管理。
summary.en: surge-list is a curated collection of DOMAIN-SET domain lists formatted for direct use with Surge. It aggregates AdGuard-maintained filter lists (ads, tracking, social, Chinese-specific filters, DNS hosts, neohosts, etc.) and publishes them via jsDelivr so users can import domain sets into Surge. The lists are updated daily through repository scripts, simplifying automated synchronization and rule management for ad blocking, privacy protection, and custom domain-based routing. Contributions are handled through the scripts folder to maintain Surge compatibility.

metadata.name: ML-For-Beginners
metadata.description: 12 weeks, 26 lessons, 52 quizzes, classic Machine Learning for all

summary.zh: 微软开源的机器学习入门课程，12周、26节课、52测验。提供基于Python与scikit-learn的交互式笔记本、练习与幻灯片，含多语言翻译与自动化流程，覆盖回归、分类、聚类与模型评估等核心算法，适合课堂教学、自学与企业内训。
summary.en: ML-For-Beginners is Microsoft's open-source, modular 12-week curriculum with 26 lessons and 52 quizzes that teach core machine learning concepts using Python and scikit-learn. It includes interactive Jupyter notebooks, slides, hands-on labs, and automated multi-language translations via GitHub Actions. The material covers core algorithms (regression, classification, clustering), model evaluation, and practical tips for applying models to real datasets. Designed for zero-to-intermediate learners, educators, and corporate upskilling, it’s ready for classroom adoption, self-study, or integration into training programs.

metadata.name: music
metadata.description: a music player forked from YesPlayMusic。高颜值的第三方网易云播放器，支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron/Docker:

summary.zh: R3PLAYX 是基于 YesPlayMusic 的高颜值第三方网易云音乐桌面客户端，采用 React 与 Electron 开发，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 与 Docker 部署。功能涵盖网易云账号登录（扫码/手机号/邮箱）、MV 播放、歌词显示、私人 FM 与多音源，界面注重视觉体验与本地播放。项目处于 Beta 阶段，基于 AGPL 开源，仅供学习研究与非商业使用。
summary.en: R3PLAYX is a high‑polish third‑party Netease Cloud music player forked from YesPlayMusic. Built with React and Electron, it runs cross‑platform on Windows, macOS and Linux and can be deployed via Docker. Key features include Netease account login (QR/phone/email), MV playback, lyrics display, private FM and multiple music sources, with a focus on visual design and local playback experience. The project is in beta, distributed under AGPL, and intended for personal study and non‑commercial research.

metadata.name: clash-speedtest
metadata.description: clash speedtest

summary.zh: Clash-SpeedTest 是基于 Clash/Mihomo 的开源命令行测速工具，直接读取本地配置或订阅地址，兼容 Proxies 与 Proxy Provider 的所有节点类型。无需额外 Clash 进程即可并发测试延迟与下载/上传速率，支持多种测速模式、正则/关键词过滤及阈值筛选，并可将结果上传到 Gist 或仓库，适合代理节点筛选与运维优化。
summary.en: Clash-SpeedTest is an open-source CLI tool built on the Clash/Mihomo kernel for quickly benchmarking proxy nodes. It accepts local Clash config files or subscription URLs, supports all Proxies and Proxy Provider node types, and runs without spawning an external Clash/Mihomo process. The tool performs concurrent latency and download/upload tests with multiple modes (fast/download/full), regex and keyword filtering, threshold-based stopping, and can upload results to GitHub Gist or repositories. Ideal for selecting high-quality proxy nodes and automating proxy performance checks.

metadata.name: QuantumultX-Rewrite
metadata.description: QuantumultX QX quantumult 圈X quanx 重写 脚本 rewrite 规则 分流 破解 解锁

summary.zh: 本仓库汇集大量适用于 QuantumultX 的重写规则（.conf），覆盖去广告、应用/会员解锁、分流与代理链路检测等场景。规则以请求/响应重写、Header/Body 修改和路由匹配为技术手段，支持直接订阅或按需合并到 QX 配置。面向 iOS QuantumultX 用户与高级配置爱好者，用于精细流量控制、绕过区域限制与解除付费功能，便于快速部署与持续维护。
summary.en: This repository aggregates a comprehensive set of QuantumultX rewrite rule files (.conf) for iOS, targeting ad blocking, app/premium unlocking, traffic routing and proxy chain checks. Rules implement request/response rewrites, header/body modifications and route matching, and can be subscribed to or merged into existing QX configs. It’s intended for QuantumultX users and power-configurers who need fine-grained traffic control, region-unlock and feature-unlocking capabilities, enabling quick deployment and easy maintenance of rewrite policies.

metadata.name: sgmodule
metadata.description: surge module

summary.zh: 本仓库为 Surge 的 sgmodule 集合，提供针对 YouTube（去广告、画中画、后台播放、翻译）、Bilibili（去弹幕、去广告、阻止 P2P）、阿里 DoH JSON 鉴权适配与 Keep 去广告/导航精简的规则。通过 Surge 请求/响应改写与脚本部署，便于在支持的客户端快速启用与定制流量处理策略。
summary.en: This repository is a collection of Surge sgmodule scripts to enhance streaming and DNS workflows: YouTube (ad blocking, PiP, background play, translation), Bilibili (remove danmaku/ads, block P2P), Aliyun DoH JSON auth adapter, and Keep ad/navigation tweaks. Implemented via Surge request/response rewrites and scripts for quick deployment and customizable proxy policies on compatible clients.

metadata.name: phantun
metadata.description: Transforms UDP stream into (fake) TCP streams that can go through Layer 3 & Layer 4 (NAPT) firewalls/NATs.

summary.zh: Phantun 是用 100% safe Rust 编写的轻量 UDP→TCP 混淆隧道，将 UDP 数据流封装为伪 TCP 连接以穿透 L3/L4 状态/无状态防火墙与 NAT，同时保留 UDP 的无序传输与低延迟特性，避免 TCP 重传与流控开销。支持创建 TUN 接口并针对多核优化，适用于 UDP 被封锁或限速但允许 TCP 的网络环境。
summary.en: Phantun is a lightweight, high-performance UDP-to-TCP obfuscator written in safe Rust. It encapsulates UDP packet streams into fake TCP connections designed to traverse L3/L4 stateful and stateless firewalls and NATs while preserving UDP semantics such as out-of-order delivery and avoiding TCP-style retransmission and flow control. Phantun creates TUN interfaces on client and server, is optimized for multi-core scaling, and minimizes encapsulation overhead. It’s ideal when UDP is blocked or throttled but TCP is permitted, providing low-latency tunneling without L7 proxy compatibility.

metadata.name: v2ray-agent
metadata.description: Xray、Tuic、hysteria2、sing-box 八合一一键脚本

summary.zh: v2ray-agent 是一键部署与管理脚本，整合 Xray、Tuic、Hysteria2 与 sing-box 等内核，支持 VLESS/VMess/Trojan/NaiveProxy 等多协议，自动申请与续期 TLS，生成订阅并提供用户、端口、分流、域名黑名单与 BT 管控，支持脚本与 Docker 部署，便于快速搭建加密代理、流媒体解锁与灵活流量分流管理。
summary.en: v2ray-agent is a one‑click installer and management script bundling multiple proxy cores (Xray-core, Tuic, Hysteria2, sing-box). It supports protocols like VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Hysteria2, Tuic and NaiveProxy, automates TLS issuance/renewal, generates subscription links, and provides user/port management, traffic splitting, domain blacklist and P2P controls. Available as shell or Docker deployment, it enables rapid setup of encrypted proxies for streaming unblocking, privacy protection and flexible traffic routing.

metadata.name: server
metadata.description: Revive unavailable songs for Netease Cloud Music (Refactored & Enhanced version)

summary.zh: UnblockNeteaseMusic 是基于 Node.js 的代理服务，用于替换网易云“变灰”歌曲链接。支持多音源回溯、X-Real-IP 绕过地域限制、指定网易服务器 IP、上游 HTTP/HTTPS 代理与完整系统代理（含 PAC）。提供可执行文件、npm/npx、Docker 与注册为 Windows 服务等多种部署方式，适合个人或局域网恢复不可播放曲目并做流量代理与调试。
summary.en: UnblockNeteaseMusic is a Node.js proxy server that revives unavailable (greyed-out) tracks in Netease Cloud Music by replacing broken URLs with alternative sources. It aggregates multiple music providers, injects X-Real-IP to bypass region restrictions, allows specifying upstream Netease server IPs, and supports upstream HTTP/HTTPS proxies. It functions as a full HTTP/HTTPS system proxy (PAC compatible) and can be deployed via prebuilt binaries, npm/npx, Docker, or installed as a Windows service—ideal for personal or LAN use to restore playback and proxy streaming traffic.

metadata.name: Adblock4limbo
metadata.description: 毒奶去网页广告计划用户脚本 For Quantumult X & Surge & Shadowrocket & Loon & Stash & 油猴 ；1.导航 2.通过 JS/CSS 移除特定网站网页广告 —— 搜索引擎（Bing/Google）广告及内容农场结果清除/低端影视/欧乐影院/iyf爱壹帆/哔滴影视/Pornhub/Javbus/Supjav/Jable(M3U8)/MissAv/91porn/hitomi/紳士漫畫/禁漫天堂/等视频&ACG&小说&漫画网站上的弹窗广告&视频广告&Gif广告，沉浸式翻译/提取M3U8等，保持网页清爽干净无打扰！ P.S. 欢迎提交issue

summary.zh: 毒奶去网页广告计划：为 QuantumultX/Surge/Shadowrocket/Loon/Stash 及油猴提供用户脚本，通过注入 JS/CSS 与 1.8万+ 通用选择器，针对搜索引擎与大量影视、ACG、漫画与成人站点精准移除弹窗、图片与视频广告；支持 M3U8 提取与沉浸式翻译、导航与工具箱。适用于 iOS 浏览器（Chrome/Safari），需按说明配置 MITM 与 script-response-body，仓库持续维护并欢迎 issue 反馈。
summary.en: Adblock4limbo is a maintained userscript suite for Quantumult X, Surge, Shadowrocket, Loon, Stash and Tampermonkey that injects JS/CSS and uses 18k+ generic selectors to remove intrusive ads on search engines and many video/ACG/comic/adult sites. It removes popups, image and video ads, supports M3U8 extraction and immersive translation, and provides a navigational toolbox. Intended to improve iOS browser (Chrome/Safari) viewing experience; requires hostname/MITM and script-response-body configuration. Ongoing updates and issue reports are encouraged.

metadata.name: Script
metadata.description: QuantumultX｜Surge｜Loon

summary.zh: 本仓库汇聚适用于 QuantumultX、Surge 与 Loon 的规则、配置与脚本，包含代理订阅、分流/路由、广告拦截与重写规则等实用片段。以社区贡献为主，整理上游来源与致谢，便于在 iOS 移动端快速部署与定制流量策略和规则管理，适合需要统一维护代理配置、优化访问或屏蔽广告的用户与运维人员。
summary.en: This repository aggregates rules, profiles and scripts for QuantumultX, Surge and Loon, including proxy subscriptions, routing/diversion rules, ad-blocking filters and rewrite/snippet scripts. It is a community-curated collection that documents upstream sources and acknowledgements, enabling quick deployment and customization of traffic policies on iOS proxy clients. Useful for users and operators who need unified management of proxy configurations, access optimization, and ad/content filtering across multiple mobile proxy tools.

metadata.name: uPic
metadata.description: 📤uPic is a native, powerful, beautiful and simple picture and file upload tool for macOS.

summary.zh: uPic 是一款原生 macOS 的图片与文件上传客户端，自动捕获截图与本地文件并在菜单栏显示上传进度。支持 SM.MS、又拍云、七牛、阿里 OSS、腾讯 COS、百度 BOS、GitHub/Gitee、S3、Imgur 及自定义上传 API，上传完成可自动复制 URL/Markdown/HTML 链接并支持全局快捷键与模板配置。适合博客写作、即时聊天与开发者集成，提供 App Store、Homebrew 与源码编译安装，开源 MIT 许可可自定义扩展与私有托管。
summary.en: uPic is a native macOS image and file uploading client that automatically captures screenshots and local files, showing upload progress in the menu bar. It supports many backends—SM.MS, Upyun, Qiniu, Aliyun OSS, Tencent COS, Baidu BOS, GitHub/Gitee, Amazon S3, Imgur—and custom upload APIs. Finished uploads auto-copy configurable links (URL/Markdown/HTML) to the clipboard. With global shortcuts, link templates and clipboard automation, uPic is ideal for bloggers, chat users and developer workflows. Distributed via App Store, Homebrew or source builds; open-source under the MIT license.

metadata.name: Surge
metadata.description: Surge自用配置以及模块和脚本

summary.zh: 此仓库为作者针对 Surge 的移动与桌面端所用的自定义配置、模块与脚本合集，收录稳定配置与模块、分流与重写规则，并提供与 Boxjs 与 iRingo 的集成参考与链接。项目聚焦流量分流、广告屏蔽与部分 Apple 功能解锁，适合作为个人备份與规则示例。仓库强调仅供学习与自用备份，不保证全部脚本可用性并附带免责声明，作者建议不要 fork 并列出原作者与参考资源以便溯源。
summary.en: This repository is the author's personal collection of Surge configurations, modules and scripts for mobile and desktop use. It includes stable configs, modular scripts, traffic routing and rewrite rules, plus links and integration guidance for Boxjs and iRingo. Intended for traffic routing, ad blocking and partially unlocking Apple integrated features, the repo serves as a reference and backup of practical rule sets. Contents are provided for personal use and study only, with no guarantee of availability or maintenance; disclaimers and upstream credits are included and forking is discouraged.

metadata.name: Universal
metadata.description: 通用流媒体平台增强及双语字幕解决方案

summary.zh: DualSubs Universal 提供面向各类流媒体的通用增强与双语字幕方案，侧重字幕抓取/导入、时轴同步与可选实时翻译。支持双轨并列显示、样式自定义与快捷控件，便于作为浏览器扩展或播放器插件集成，提升可访问性与语言学习体验，同时利于跨站点字幕复用与本地化工作流。
summary.en: DualSubs Universal offers a platform-agnostic enhancement toolkit for streaming services, delivering synchronized bilingual subtitles and playback improvements. It focuses on capturing or importing subtitles across sites, timeline synchronization, optional real-time translation, dual-track side-by-side rendering, customizable styling and quick controls. Designed for integration as a browser extension or player plugin, it improves accessibility, language learning and cross-site subtitle reuse while enabling localization workflows.

metadata.name: mini
metadata.description: mini icon

summary.zh: mini 是面向 Quantumult X、Loon 与 Pharos Pro 的图标集，包含订阅、策略组、节点地区与 Task 的彩色与透明版本。图片以 raw.githubusercontent 链接远程托管，支持在配置文件或 UI 中直接引用，便于统一替换与美化代理订阅展示与任务图标。
summary.en: mini is an icon pack for Quantumult X, Loon and Pharos Pro, providing subscription, policy-group, node-region and task icons in color and alpha variants. Images are hosted on raw.githubusercontent and can be referenced remotely in configs or UI for easy, consistent proxy subscription and task icon customization.

metadata.name: surge-rules
metadata.description: 🦄 🎃 👻 Surge 规则集(DOMAIN-SET 和 RULE-SET)，适用于 Surge for iOS 和 Surge for Mac 客户端。

summary.zh: 本项目为 Surge（iOS/Mac）自动生成 DOMAIN-SET 与 RULE-SET，数据来源于 v2ray-rules-dat、domain-list-community 与 dnsmasq/china_ip_list 等，包含直连/代理/拒绝/Apple/Google/GFW 等分类域名列表。通过 GitHub Actions 每日构建并提供 raw 与 jsdelivr 在线地址，方便流量分流与访问控制配置。
summary.en: Generates DOMAIN-SET and RULE-SET for Surge (iOS/Mac), based on v2ray-rules-dat, domain-list-community and dnsmasq/China IP data. It provides categorized domain lists (direct/proxy/reject/apple/google/gfw), is rebuilt daily via GitHub Actions, and served via raw/jsdelivr for straightforward traffic routing and access control.

metadata.name: pytorch-tutorial
metadata.description: PyTorch Tutorial for Deep Learning Researchers

summary.zh: 本仓库为深度学习研究者提供系统且精简的PyTorch教程与示例，覆盖从基础（线性/逻辑回归、前馈网络）到中级（CNN、ResNet、RNN）与高级（GAN、VAE、风格迁移、图像描述）任务。多数模型实现短小（多在30行以内），便于学习、复现与快速原型开发，包含TensorBoard等实用工具，兼容PyTorch 0.4+，适合用于教学与研究样例参考。
summary.en: This repository provides concise, example-driven PyTorch tutorials for deep learning researchers, with many models implemented in under 30 lines. It spans basics (linear/logistic regression, feedforward networks), intermediate topics (CNNs, ResNet, RNNs, bidirectional RNNs, language models) and advanced topics (GANs, VAEs, neural style transfer, image captioning). Includes utilities such as TensorBoard integration. Designed for quick learning, reproducible examples and fast prototyping; recommended for researchers and learners who want runnable, minimal PyTorch reference code. Compatible with PyTorch 0.4+.

metadata.name: Mos
metadata.description: 一个用于在 macOS 上平滑你的鼠标滚动效果或单独设置滚动方向的小工具, 让你的滚轮爽如触控板  |  A lightweight tool used to smooth scrolling and set scroll direction independently for your mouse on macOS

summary.zh: Mos 是一款面向 macOS 的开源菜单栏工具，将鼠标滚轮事件插值为触控板级别的平滑滚动。支持按应用与轴向独立配置、自定义步长/速度/持续时间、滚动快捷键与按键重映射，并兼容 Logi/HID 按键事件。适合希望在不同软件间保留鼠标精度同时获得顺滑滚动体验的用户，提供 Homebrew 安装和完整权限/设备处理的实用方案。
summary.en: Mos is an open-source, lightweight macOS menu-bar utility that interpolates mouse wheel events to produce touchpad-like smooth scrolling while preserving mouse precision. It offers per-app and per-axis configuration, adjustable step/acceleration/duration, modifier keys for toggling behavior, button remapping to actions/scripts/apps, and Logitech/HID event support. Designed for users who want consistent, configurable smooth scrolling across apps, Mos is implemented in Swift, supports macOS 10.13+, and is distributed via Releases and Homebrew with accessibility and device permission handling.

metadata.name: my_yesplaymusic
metadata.description: 高颜值的第三方网易云播放器，支持本地音乐播放、离线歌单、桌面歌词、Touch Bar歌词、Mac状态栏歌词、Linux-gnome环境状态栏歌词显示。支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron:

summary.zh: YesPlayMusic 是基于 Electron 与 Vue 的高颜值第三方网易云桌面播放器，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 跨平台。提供本地音乐与离线歌单、桌面/状态栏/Touch Bar 歌词、MV 播放与 UnblockNeteaseMusic 音源替换等扩展功能，适合需要本地播放、丰富歌词显示与增强网易云体验的桌面用户。
summary.en: YesPlayMusic is a polished third-party NetEase Cloud Music desktop player built with Electron and Vue. It runs cross-platform on Windows, macOS and Linux, offering local music playback, offline playlists, MV playback, and multiple lyric display modes including desktop OSD, Touch Bar and system tray. It integrates UnblockNeteaseMusic sources, supports account login, Last.fm scrobbling, custom/global hotkeys and PWA/web deployment. Ideal for desktop users seeking enhanced local playback, richer lyric presentation and a more feature-complete alternative to the official client.

metadata.name: Dress
metadata.description: 好耶 是女装 | 备份·接受PR

summary.zh: Dress 是面向零编程门槛的 Git/GitHub 学习仓库，通过 Fork→分支→提交→PR 的实战流程帮助新手掌握版本控制与协作。项目以提交女装照片为趣味载体，规定文件夹命名、图片压缩与去 EXIF 等规范，并提供新手指南与在线预览，采用 CC BY‑NC‑SA 许可，便于社区参与与审核。
summary.en: Dress is a low‑barrier Git/GitHub learning repository that guides newcomers through the full Fork → branch → commit → pull request workflow with hands‑on practice. No coding skills are required: contributors submit a photo (female‑presentation attire) and follow clear rules for folder naming, image compression and EXIF removal. The repo includes a beginner guide, contribution guidelines and an online preview to teach version control, collaboration and PR etiquette. It is community driven and licensed under CC BY‑NC‑SA 4.0 for noncommercial sharing.

metadata.name: vim-galore-zh_cn
metadata.description: Vim 从入门到精通

summary.zh: Vim 从入门到精通的中文全面指南，系统整理常用命令、键位映射、宏录制、正则替换、窗口分割与插件配置等实战技巧，适合初学者与进阶用户，内容已迁移至作者网站并持续维护。
summary.en: Chinese Vim guide covering commands, mappings, macros, splits and plugins; moved to author's site.

metadata.name: Rules-For-Quantumult-X
metadata.description: 适用于 Quantumult X 规则整理集合. 所有内容源自 互联网,仅作为收集和整理

summary.zh: 本仓库整理适用于 iOS 的 Quantumult X 规则与 Rewrite 列表，覆盖国内直连、海外加速、媒体解锁、运营商劫持拦截与应用去广告等场景。提供 raw 链接与 CDN 镜像便于订阅与更新，社区维护并注明来源。
summary.en: This repository aggregates and organizes rule and rewrite lists for the iOS proxy app Quantumult X. It includes profiles for domestic direct routing, overseas acceleration, selective media unlocking, ISP hijack blocking, and in-app ad blocking. The project supplies raw file URLs and recommends CDN mirror domains for stable subscription and updates. Maintained by the community with attribution, it helps users create granular traffic routing, strategy group icons, and curated filtering policies, ideal for advanced users who need customizable, shareable rule sets.

metadata.name: ShellCrash
metadata.description: Run sing-box/mihomo as client in shell

summary.zh: ShellCrash 是基于 Shell 的一键部署与管理工具，用于在路由器和各类 Linux 设备上运行 mihomo/sing-box 客户端。它支持在线订阅导入与配置文件管理、定时自动更新、可选的本地 Web 仪表盘、以及多种流量转发模式（路由/本地）。兼容 OpenWrt、主流 Linux 发行版与 Docker，便于在边缘设备上实现代理服务的自动化部署与运维。
summary.en: ShellCrash is a shell-based tool for one-click deployment and management of mihomo and sing-box clients on routers and general Linux devices. It enables online import of subscription links and configuration files, scheduled updates, optional local Web dashboard for rule and traffic visualization, and multiple forwarding modes (Router/Local). Compatible with OpenWrt, mainstream Linux distributions, and Docker, it streamlines automated deployment, switching and maintenance of proxy kernels on edge devices and servers.

metadata.name: Script
metadata.description: This project is based on the scripting capabilities of several excellent iOS proxy tools (e.g. Surge, Quantumult X)

summary.zh: 本仓库汇集面向 iOS 代理客户端（Surge、Quantumult X、Loon、Stash）的一系列 JavaScript 脚本与重写规则，涵盖自动签到、策略组切换、订阅解析与流量查询等功能。脚本提供示例与配置模板，可增强代理客户端的自动化能力；部分功能需启用 MITM 并手动信任根证书。适合需要自动化日常任务、管理代理策略和分发订阅的进阶用户与运维场景。
summary.en: This repository gathers JavaScript scripts and rewrite rules for iOS proxy clients (Surge, Quantumult X, Loon, Stash). It automates daily bonus sign-ins, policy-group switching, subscription parsing, traffic queries and other proxy-related enhancements. The project provides examples and configuration templates to extend client automation; some features require enabling MITM and manually trusting a generated root certificate. Targeted at power users who want to automate routine tasks, manage proxy policies and distribute subscription data across iOS proxy clients.

metadata.name: dufs
metadata.description: A file server that supports static serving, uploading, searching, accessing control, webdav...

summary.zh: Dufs 是基于 Rust 的轻量级跨平台文件服务器，支持静态托管、目录打包下载、断点上传/下载、WebDAV、权限控制与搜索。提供 SPA/index 渲染、HTTPS、Docker/Homebrew 发布和简洁 CLI，适合个人自建文件共享、开发静态托管与内网文件管理。
summary.en: Dufs is a lightweight, Rust-based cross-platform file server for easy self-hosted file sharing and static hosting. It supports static serving, folder downloads as ZIP, resumable/partial uploads and downloads, drag-and-drop upload, WebDAV, access control with simple auth rules, full-text search, SPA/index rendering, HTTPS and CORS. Distributed as binaries, a Docker image and Homebrew formula, it provides a concise CLI for binding, permissions, TLS and logging—ideal for personal file sharing, developer static hosting and internal file portals.

metadata.name: d2l-zh
metadata.description: 《动手学深度学习》：面向中文读者、能运行、可讨论。中英文版被70多个国家的500多所大学用于教学。

summary.zh: 《动手学深度学习》中文开源教材，结合数学原理与可运行代码，覆盖PyTorch/TensorFlow示例，适用于高校教学与自学实践，社区持续维护并提供讨论与贡献渠道。
summary.en: Dive into Deep Learning (Chinese edition) is an open-source, runnable textbook that teaches deep learning through concise math, critical thinking, and hands-on code. It provides complete notebooks and implementations across major frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), exercises, and practical examples for model development and experimentation. Widely adopted by universities worldwide, the book targets both classroom instruction and self-directed learners aiming to become applied deep learning practitioners. The repository is community-maintained, frequently updated, and includes contribution guides and discussion forums to facilitate collaboration and continuous improvement.

summary.zh: 这是一个将中文字符逐字替换为二维码的字体库，支持6万余字符。通过二维码形式隐藏字面信息，适用于视觉加密、艺术排版或需逐字扫码阅读的场景。仓库含演示图与字体文件，便于下载、试用与集成到排版与设计流程中。
summary.en: A QR-code font library that renders each Chinese character as an individual QR code, enabling literal text obfuscation and a novel scanning-based reading experience. The project supports over 60,000 glyphs and includes demo imagery and downloadable font files. It suits visual encryption, artistic typography, experimental publishing, or contexts where hiding surface text while preserving machine-readable content is desired. Designers and integrators can drop the font into typesetting or design workflows to create playful or privacy-aware materials revealed only via QR scanning.

metadata.name: ios_rule_script
metadata.description: 分流规则、重写写规则及脚本。

summary.zh: 本仓库整合 iOS 平台的分流与复写规则及大量基于 MagicJS 的自动化脚本，兼容 Quantumult X/BoxJS 订阅，覆盖去广告、自动签到、库存监控与离线下载等场景，侧重规则整合与备份，供学习研究使用，作者不对使用后果负责。
summary.en: This repository collects iOS-oriented routing (traffic) and rewrite rules together with numerous automation scripts primarily implemented in MagicJS, compatible with proxy tools like Quantumult X and BoxJS subscriptions. It centralizes rule sets, galleries and subscription files for ad removal, daily check-ins, inventory monitoring, offline downloads and related workflow automation. The project emphasizes integration, backups and reusable script templates drawn from community sources; resources are provided for study and research only, with no warranty or liability for usage.

metadata.name: BedrockMap
metadata.description: GUI application  for bedrock level (Map biomes and so on)

summary.zh: BedrockMap 是面向 Minecraft Bedrock 的桌面 GUI 地图查看与编辑工具，能够可视化地形与生物群系并进行简单编辑，便于地图分析、定制和维护。仓库包含源码与编译指南，采用 AGPL 开源许可，适合模组开发者与服务器管理员用于离线地图检查与修改。
summary.en: BedrockMap is a desktop GUI map viewer and editor for Minecraft Bedrock levels. It visualizes terrain and biomes and offers basic editing for level inspection, analysis, customization, and maintenance. The repository includes source code and a compile guide and is released under the AGPL license. It targets modders and server operators who need offline map visualization and editing tools.

metadata.name: thorough-pytorch
metadata.description: PyTorch入门教程，在线阅读地址：https://datawhalechina.github.io/thorough-pytorch/

summary.zh: 《深入浅出PyTorch》是面向入门与进阶教程，结合理论、notebook实战与视频，覆盖张量运算、自动求导、模型搭建、训练优化、可视化、timm微调与ONNX部署，适合组队实战掌握深度学习开发流程。
summary.en: Thorough-PyTorch is a comprehensive, hands-on tutorial series for learning PyTorch from basics to advanced topics. It combines theory, notebook exercises and video lectures to teach tensors, autograd, model construction, loss/optimization, training techniques (including mixed precision and LR scheduling), visualization (TensorBoard and wandb), timm-based fine-tuning, and ONNX deployment. Organized into progressive chapters with practical projects and source markdowns, it targets practitioners who know Python and basic ML concepts and prefer team-based, project-driven learning to master deep learning development workflows.

metadata.name: giscus
metadata.description: A commenting system powered by GitHub Discussions. :octocat: :speech_balloon: :gem:

summary.zh: giscus 是基于 GitHub Discussions 的开源网站评论系统，免数据库且无广告或追踪，便于在静态站点、博客和文档中快速添加评论与互动。它通过 Discussions API 与 OAuth 授权匹配或自动创建讨论，支持实时拉取评论/编辑、可自定义主题、多语言和自托管部署，并提供面向 React/Vue/Svelte 的组件库与高级配置。核心价值在于把评论数据留在 GitHub，利用 GitHub 的审核与权限体系实现轻量、可审计的社区讨论集成。
summary.en: giscus is an open-source commenting system powered by GitHub Discussions that requires no database and operates without ads or tracking. It maps pages to GitHub Discussions (by URL, pathname, title, etc.), can auto-create discussions, and uses OAuth for users to post via the giscus app. Features include live fetching of comments/edits, custom themes, multilingual support, self-hosting, and framework components for React/Vue/Svelte. Ideal for static sites, blogs, and docs that want lightweight, auditable comments integrated with GitHub's moderation and permission model.

metadata.name: Dango-Translator
metadata.description: 梦想是做出最棒的生肉翻译软件喵

summary.zh: 团子翻译器是面向Windows的OCR实时生肉翻译桌面工具，集成离线/在线OCR（基于PaddleOCR与DangoOCR/星河云）、本地与云端AI翻译，支持自动模式下的屏幕区域实时识别与翻译，以及漫画图片的自动识别、消字与嵌字。自 v4.5.8 起以Golang重构，提供账号云端配置同步、内存优化与低延迟截图识别，适用于游戏字幕、漫画与任意屏幕文本的即时翻译与批量图片处理场景。
summary.en: Dango Translator is a Windows desktop OCR-based translator focused on translating “raw” content in real time. It combines offline and online OCR (PaddleOCR, DangoOCR, Stariver), local and cloud AI translation backends, an automatic capture mode for continuous screen-region recognition, and specialized manga/image workflows including text removal and retypesetting. Rewritten in Go since v4.5.8, it provides account-backed cloud config sync, memory and latency optimizations, robust screenshot handling (overlay-ignore) and features aimed at live game subtitles, comic translation and bulk image processing.

metadata.name: BedrockReplay
metadata.description: A Minecraft: Bedrock Edition proxy replay system

summary.zh: BedrockReplay 是基于代理的 Minecraft: Bedrock 回放系统，可录制并重放玩家游戏，会话支持播放速度与摄像机模式自定义，生成可分享的回放文件并通过独立 viewer 回放。采用 Java 17（Azul Zulu）以单个 JAR 部署，配置 address/port 后用 Bedrock 客户端连接并通过聊天命令控制录制/回放。项目仍在开发，构建产物托管于 Actions，欢迎在仓库提交问题反馈。
summary.en: BedrockReplay is a proxy-based replay system for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition that records and replays player sessions. It supports adjustable playback speed and multiple camera modes, exports shareable replay files, and runs as a standalone Java 17 (Azul Zulu) JAR. Users configure address/port in config.json, connect with a Bedrock client, and control recording via chat commands (!replay record/stop/play). It can capture singleplayer via Bedrock Dedicated Server. The project is under active development; artifacts are provided via GitHub Actions and issues and feedback are encouraged.

metadata.name: wallpaper-player-mac
metadata.description: A powerful open source live wallpaper app for mac

summary.zh: Wallpaper Player 是一款开源 macOS 实时壁纸引擎（非 Steam 版本），提供 TestFlight 体验，面向希望在 Mac 上运行或定制动态桌面的用户与开发者。项目以社区协作为导向，作者在 QQ 建群便于贡献与讨论，适合替换静态壁纸、展示动态内容或打造个性化桌面效果。
summary.en: Wallpaper Player is an open-source live wallpaper engine for macOS, independent from the Steam Wallpaper Engine. It offers a TestFlight build for early testing and targets users and developers who want to run, customize, or develop dynamic desktop backgrounds on Mac. The project emphasizes community-driven collaboration; the maintainer hosts a QQ group to coordinate contributors and discussion. Useful for replacing static wallpapers with animated content and creating personalized desktop experiences, the repository serves as a foundation for extending macOS desktop visuals through community contributions.

metadata.name: Paolujichang
metadata.description: 科学上网🕸️之跑路机场名单收集（2020-2026），欢迎投稿。Ad🔗🈲🙅❌

summary.zh: 本仓库自2020年至2026年持续收集并维护“机场”跑路与预警名单，聚合 GitHub issues 与电报频道的用户举报、时间线与外链证据。旨在帮助受影响用户核验信息、提交线索并进行社区互助，提供历史事件记录与实用风险提示（如仅月付、准备备用机场）。本项目为社区驱动的信息汇总与风险预警平台，非商业服务，内容由用户投稿并由维护者整理发布。
summary.en: This repository (2020–2026) compiles a community-maintained list of VPN/proxy “airports” that have shut down or shown warning signs. It aggregates GitHub issues and Telegram reports, timestamps, and external references to document incidents and vendors. The project helps affected users verify claims, submit tips, and coordinate community alerts, offering historical incident records and practical precautions (e.g., prefer monthly subscriptions, keep backups). It is a crowd-sourced risk-awareness and evidence-collection resource rather than a commercial service.

metadata.name: CialloResearch
metadata.description: Research project of Ciallo for SIGGRAPH publication

summary.zh: Ciallo 是 SIGGRAPH 2024 提出的 GPU 加速向量笔触渲染方法，面向多种笔刷实现高性能实时渲染。仓库包含交互教程与 Web 演示，计划集成至 Blender Grease Pencil，并纠正论文中关于笔触参数化的错误。核心在于基于多段线的高效顶点生成与 GPU 着色器流水线，适用于数字绘画与 DCC 插件开发。
summary.en: Ciallo is a GPU-accelerated vector brush-stroke rendering system presented at SIGGRAPH 2024. It enables high-performance, real-time rendering for diverse brush types by operating directly on polylines and leveraging GPU shader pipelines instead of costly reparameterization. The repository offers an interactive tutorial, a web demo, SIGGRAPH artifacts, and ongoing integration into Blender Grease Pencil. Key contributions include efficient polyline-based vertex placement, GPU rasterization/compute strategies, and practical guidance for editor/DCC integration. An erratum corrects a paper statement about stroke parameterization.

metadata.name: arch-guide
metadata.description: ✨ archlinux 简明指南 | 本指南包含从 archlinux 安装、显卡驱动、日常软件配置、多媒体制作、编程等你可能需要的全部内容 | 提供在线文档 ✨

summary.zh: arch-guide 是基于 VitePress 的 Arch Linux 精简中文指南，涵盖安装、显卡驱动、日常软件配置、多媒体制作与编程环境。内容注重原理与实践，提供可视化示例、在线文档及本地编译（pnpm/Docker）流程，兼顾实用性与容错性，适合新手与进阶用户快速部署、定制与维护 Arch 系统。
summary.en: arch-guide is a concise Chinese handbook for Arch Linux built with VitePress. It covers end-to-end topics including installation, GPU drivers, daily software setup, multimedia production, and programming environments. The guide emphasizes principles and practical explanations, includes visual aids, online hosting, and local build instructions using pnpm and Docker. It is pragmatic about nonfree software and derived from ArchLinuxStudio materials. Contributions and local build guides are provided to help community collaboration, making it suitable for newcomers and intermediate users deploying and maintaining Arch systems.

metadata.name: llm-action
metadata.description: 本项目旨在分享大模型相关技术原理以及实战经验（大模型工程化、大模型应用落地）

summary.zh: 本项目系统整理大模型工程化与落地实战，涵盖训练（预训练/LoRA/QLoRA/RLHF）、推理、量化、分布式训练、测评与 MLOps，提供详尽教程、实战代码与优化/国产化适配指导，便于构建高效可部署的 LLM 应用。
summary.en: A practical LLM engineering collection with tutorials and hands-on code covering training (pretrain/LoRA/QLoRA/RLHF), inference, quantization, distributed training, evaluation and MLOps—focused on production-ready deployment and optimization.

metadata.name: yabai
metadata.description: A tiling window manager for macOS based on binary space partitioning

summary.zh: yabai 是基于二分空间划分（BSP）的 macOS 平铺窗口管理器，提供命令行与可定制热键（如 skhd）控制窗口、桌面与显示器。支持焦点跟随鼠标、禁用切换动画、扩展桌面数量，并通过 Accessibility API 与可选的 Dock 注入实现深度自动化与高效布局管理。
summary.en: yabai is a macOS tiling window manager based on binary space partitioning. It offers CLI and hotkey control (e.g. skhd), focus‑follows‑mouse, animation toggles, extended virtual desktops, and deep automation via the Accessibility API and optional Dock injection.

metadata.name: rmtrash
metadata.description: rmtrash 是linux和mac下命令行版本rm的回收站，安装后对用户透明，符合正常使用rm的习惯(支持rm -fr file哦)，有了他再也不怕rm时候手颤抖了(能自动拒绝 rm -fr / 哦)。 rmtrash stands for "rm trash" which acts just like the system built-in rm command,and just moves the file to the trash for recovery when needed.

summary.zh: rmtrash 是一款在 Linux 与 macOS 下替代 rm 的透明命令行回收站脚本。安装后按常规 rm 使用，但将文件移动到可恢复的回收目录并记录删除历史，支持恢复、列举、按名删除与清空等操作。兼容常见参数（-r/-f/-fr），并能自动拒绝危险命令（如 rm -fr /）。支持单用户启用或通过 /etc/bashrc 全局别名覆盖，安装简单（wget + mv + chmod），需要时可用 /bin/rm 绕过回收站彻底删除。
summary.en: rmtrash is a lightweight shell wrapper that transparently replaces the system rm on Linux and macOS, moving removed files to a recoverable recycle bin instead of permanently deleting them. It preserves deletion history and provides commands to list, restore, delete-by-name and empty the bin. It supports common rm flags (-r, -f, -fr) while guarding against dangerous operations (e.g. rejecting rm -fr /). Installation is simple (wget, move, chmod) and can be enabled per-user or globally via an alias; use /bin/rm to bypass the trash for permanent removal.

metadata.name: Dress
metadata.description: 好耶  是女装

summary.zh: 极简仓库，仅包含 README，标题为“好耶 是女装”。仓库不含源代码或可运行项目，主要作为个人表达、社群话题或占位示例；无技术实现细节或文档结构可供复用。
summary.en: Minimal repository containing only a README titled '好耶 是女装'. It includes no source code or runnable project and serves as personal expression, a community meme, or a placeholder; no implementation details provided.

metadata.name: PyQuickInstall
metadata.description: :zap::zap::zap:超好用的pip下载加速工具，谁用谁知道！

summary.zh: pqi 是一款轻量命令行工具，可快速将 pip 源切换为清华/豆瓣/阿里/USTC 等国内镜像，显著加快 Python 包下载速度。兼容 py2/py3 及 Linux/Windows/Mac，提供列举、切换、添加、删除和显示当前源等命令，安装便捷（pip install pqi），适合在国内受限或不稳定网络环境下稳定提升包管理效率与成功率。
summary.en: pqi is a lightweight terminal utility that quickly switches pip's package index to domestic mirrors (TUNA, Douban, Aliyun, USTC) to significantly speed up Python package downloads. It offers simple commands to list available mirrors, switch the active index, add or remove custom sources, and show current configuration. Compatible with Python 2/3 and Linux/Windows/MacOS, pqi installs via pip and is designed to make package management more reliable and faster for developers working behind slow or unstable network connections. MIT licensed.

metadata.name: typescript-tutorial
metadata.description: TypeScript 教程

summary.zh: 本仓库是面向初学者的开源 TypeScript 教程，系统讲解类型系统、类型注解、接口、泛型、模块与编译配置等基础概念与实战用法。通过示例代码、配置示范与迁移建议，帮助 JavaScript 开发者快速上手，在项目中安全引入静态类型、减少运行时错误并优化开发流程，适合自学、课堂教学与团队内部培训。
summary.en: This repository is an open-source, beginner-focused TypeScript tutorial that systematically introduces core concepts and practical usage: the type system, annotations, interfaces, generics, modules, tsconfig and compiler workflows. It emphasizes hands-on examples, configuration patterns and migration tips for JavaScript projects, helping developers adopt static typing to catch errors earlier and improve maintainability. The guide also covers common tooling and editor integrations to streamline workflows, suitable for self-study, classroom instruction, and team onboarding.

metadata.name: Dress
metadata.description: 好耶  是女装

summary.zh: Dress 是一个以收集换装照片为载体的开源 Git/GitHub 实践仓库，面向零编程经验用户。通过克隆、分支、提交与 Pull Request 等真实流程教学，强调文件命名、图片压缩与去 EXIF、Markdown 文档规范。项目提供 GitHub Pages 演示与 CI 徽章，采用 CC BY‑NC‑SA 4.0 许可，适合社区协作与 Git 新手的实操练习。
summary.en: Dress is an open-source, non-code repository designed to teach Git/GitHub workflows through a simple, community-driven photo collection. Contributors (no programming required) learn cloning, branching, committing, and pull-request workflows while following file-naming, Markdown, image compression and EXIF-removal rules. The project includes GitHub Pages demos and CI status badges, clear contribution guidelines, and is licensed under CC BY‑NC‑SA 4.0. It’s intended as a hands-on, collaborative learning space for newcomers to gain practical experience with version control and GitHub processes.

metadata.name: Locale_Remulator
metadata.description: System Region and Language Simulator.

summary.zh: Locale Remulator 是针对 Windows 的区域与语言模拟器，为 32/64 位进程提供按进程的地区/编码仿真（例如日服冒险岛）。基于 Microsoft Detours 钩取 ANSI/Unicode 接口，配合 SharpShell 实现右键菜单与快捷方式。支持 x86/x64 注入与安装，便于在不修改系统全局设置下测试或运行需特定语言环境的应用。
summary.en: Locale Remulator is a Windows region and language simulator that extends locale-emulation to 64-bit applications. It leverages Microsoft Detours to hook ANSI/Unicode APIs and uses SharpShell/.NET for context-menu and shortcut integration, enabling per-process locale emulation without changing global system settings. It supports x86/x64 injection, installer/uninstaller and shortcut creation, aimed at running or testing region-locked or encoding-sensitive programs (e.g., Japanese MapleStory). Open-source (LGPL-3.0), it targets developers and power users needing non-invasive locale testing and compatibility.

metadata.name: Dress-Backup-Detached
metadata.description: 这里仅做备份！现在最活跃的repo是：https://github.com/Cute-Dress/Dress

summary.zh: 本仓库为 Dress 项目的备份，主仓库现迁至 Cute-Dress/Dress。Dress 是一项零编程门槛的 Git/GitHub 学习与实操项目，以提交女装照片为载体，让参与者通过克隆、建分支、推拉提交与发起合并请求等流程熟悉版本控制。项目对文件夹命名、图片压缩与删除 EXIF、禁止盗图等有明确规范，并提供在线演示与 CONTRIBUTING 指南，内容采用 CC BY‑NC‑SA 4.0 许可。
summary.en: This repository is a detached backup of the Dress project; the active repository now resides at https://github.com/Cute-Dress/Dress. Dress is a beginner-friendly, non-code contribution initiative that uses user-submitted cross-dressing photos as a practical vehicle to learn Git and GitHub workflows. Participants practice cloning, creating branches, pushing and pulling commits, and making pull requests without programming skills. The project enforces folder-naming conventions, forbids stolen or unauthorized images, requires image compression and EXIF removal, links to live demos, follows a CONTRIBUTING guide, and is licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

metadata.name: book-cn
metadata.description: Rust  程序设计语言 中文版——Chinese translation of The Rust Programming Language (Book)

summary.zh: 《Rust 程序设计语言》官方书的中文译本与源码仓库，紧跟上游更新并已完成全文翻译。提供 mdBook 源码、构建与测试指引、CI 与拼写检查脚本，以及贡献流程与双授权许可（MIT/Apache-2.0）。适合希望从入门到进阶系统学习 Rust、作为教学与参考、并参与开源翻译与文档维护的开发者与教育者使用。
summary.en: This repository hosts the Chinese translation and source of "The Rust Programming Language", tracking upstream updates and offering a complete translated text. It includes the mdBook source, build and test instructions, CI and spellcheck tooling, contribution guidelines, and dual MIT/Apache-2.0 licensing. Maintained for accuracy and bilingual display, the project is intended as a practical learning and reference resource for developers learning Rust from beginner to advanced levels, educators, and contributors to documentation workflows.

metadata.name: BetterRenderDragon
metadata.description: 更好的渲染龙

summary.zh: BetterRenderDragon 是针对 Minecraft: Bedrock 的 RenderDragon 引擎增强 mod，启用可配置的延迟渲染（需 Direct3D12）、可关闭光线追踪以提升性能、支持从资源包加载自定义 RenderDragon 着色器并集成可调 ImGui 菜单（F6 切换），兼容官方 1.20.30+ 版本。使用需通过仓内启动脚本启动，非 Mojang 官方产品。
summary.en: BetterRenderDragon is an enhancement mod for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition's RenderDragon engine. It enables configurable deferred rendering (requires Direct3D 12), allows disabling raytracing to improve performance, and loads custom RenderDragon shaders directly from resource packs. The mod provides an ImGui in-game menu (toggle with F6) and targets official 1.20.30+ releases. Installation uses the provided launcher scripts every session. It is an unofficial project, not affiliated with Mojang Studios.

metadata.name: FiraCode
metadata.description: Free monospaced font with programming ligatures

summary.zh: Fira Code 是一款免费开源的等宽编程字体，内置面向代码的连字（如 ->、<=、:=），通过字体渲染将多字符序列呈为单一符号以提升代码可读性。提供多种样式集与字符变体、丰富的箭头与进度条专用字形及良好 Unicode/数学符号覆盖，兼容多种编辑器与终端，仓库提供发行包、安装说明和常见问题排查文档，便于在 IDE/终端中替换默认等宽字体并自定义字形特性。
summary.en: Fira Code is a free, open-source monospaced programming font that implements ligatures for common multi-character sequences (e.g. ->, <=, :=), rendering them as single glyphs to improve code readability while keeping source ASCII. It offers stylistic sets and character variants, extensive arrow fragments, dedicated progress-bar glyphs, and broad Unicode/math coverage. Widely compatible with editors and terminals across platforms, the repository provides releases, installation guides, feature toggles (cv/ss/zero/onum/calt) and troubleshooting to help developers adopt and customize the font.

metadata.name: TrollStore-IPAs
metadata.description: A collection of IPA files from many different sources, for TrollStore!

summary.zh: TrollStore‑IPAs 是为 TrollStore 汇集的 iOS IPA 仓库，按日整理发布并提供 apps.json / apps_esign.json 以便与 ESign、Appdb、TrollApps 和 AltList 集成。项目便于持久侧载安装、版本追踪与离线获取，但存在维护风险：曾因合作者账号被删导致发行缺失，并在维护者公告中宣告库已 EOL。使用时应优先参考原始维护者和发布记录，核验来源与兼容性以保证安全。
summary.en: TrollStore‑IPAs is a curated repository of iOS IPA packages collected from multiple sources for use with TrollStore. It publishes daily releases containing packaged IPAs and JSON manifests (apps.json, apps_esign.json) to integrate with sideloading services like ESign, Appdb, TrollApps and AltList. Releases are organized by date and edited throughout the day to minimize notifications, so users may wait until a day closes for final assets. The project simplifies persistent sideload installs and version tracking, but carries operational risks: contributor account removal affected some releases and the maintainer announced the repository is EOL. Verify sources and prefer original maintainers' builds for safety.

metadata.name: CleanMyWechat
metadata.description: 自动删除 PC 端微信缓存数据，包括从所有聊天中自动下载的大量文件、视频、图片等数据内容，解放你的空间。

summary.zh: CleanMyWechat 是一款 Windows 桌面工具，自动识别并清理 PC 端微信自动下载的图片、视频与文件缓存。支持多账号管理、自定义路径和按时间阈值删除，删除项会移至回收站以防误删，且不触及文字聊天记录。基于 Python 开发并可打包为独立 EXE，适合快速回收因长期群聊媒体占用的大量磁盘空间。
summary.en: CleanMyWechat is a Windows desktop utility that automatically clears PC WeChat cache including downloaded images, videos and files to free up potentially tens of gigabytes. It auto-detects WeChat accounts, supports multiple accounts, custom paths and configurable age thresholds for deletion. Deleted items are moved to the Recycle Bin to avoid accidental loss, and plain text chat logs are preserved. Implemented in Python and packable as a standalone EXE, it provides a simple, focused solution for reclaiming disk space consumed by long-term WeChat media accumulation.

metadata.name: ChuanhuWallpaper
metadata.description: A GUI for Wallpapper, generates dynamic wallpapers for macOS

summary.zh: 川虎壁纸为 Wallpapper 提供 macOS 图形界面，生成 .heic 格式动态壁纸，支持按亮/暗模式、时间或太阳位置自动切换。基于 Swift 开发，兼容 macOS 11 及以上，内置中英文界面，便于制作与安装动态壁纸。
summary.en: Chuanhu Wallpaper is a macOS GUI for Wallpapper that generates .heic dynamic wallpapers and switches by appearance, time or sun position. Swift-based, compatible with macOS 11+, and offers English/Chinese UI.

metadata.name: vnote
metadata.description: A pleasant note-taking platform in native C++.

summary.zh: VNote 是基于 Qt 的跨平台开源笔记应用，专注于 Markdown 编辑与笔记管理，提供分层笔记库、实时预览、代码高亮与流畅的编辑体验。仓库包含构建脚本、子模块初始化、跨平台 CI 与持续构建，以及 clang-format 的 pre-commit 钩子，采用 LGPLv3 许可。适合偏好本地、离线优先的开发者与技术用户，作为原生 C++/Qt 的轻量笔记与知识管理替代方案。
summary.en: VNote is a Qt-based, cross-platform (Windows/Linux/macOS) open-source note-taking application focused on Markdown. It pairs structured notebook management with a refined editing experience—live preview, syntax highlighting, hierarchical organization, and extensible editing components. The repository includes build scripts, submodule initialization, cross-platform CI, continuous builds/releases, and pre-commit formatting hooks (clang-format). Licensed under LGPLv3, VNote targets developers and power users who prefer local, offline-first knowledge workflows and offers a native C++/Qt alternative to Electron-based note apps; its design allows extending formats beyond Markdown.

metadata.name: console-minecraft-launcher
metadata.description: 一个在命令行上运行的 Minecraft Java 版启动器 A Minecraft Java Edition Launcher Running on the Command Line

summary.zh: Console Minecraft Launcher 是一个基于 Java 的跨平台命令行 Minecraft 启动器，支持正版/外置登录与统一通行证、模组/整合包搜索安装、自定义皮肤与资源、可配置下载源与游戏目录。提供 Windows 可执行文件、Homebrew/AUR 包及通用 jar，强调轻量、可脚本化与自动化，适合偏好终端操作或需在脚本/服务器中集成启动流程的用户。
summary.en: Console Minecraft Launcher is a Java-based, cross-platform command-line launcher for Minecraft Java Edition. It supports official and external authentication, unified account handling, mod and modpack search/install, custom skins/resources, and configurable download sources and game directories. Distributed as Windows executables, Homebrew/AUR packages, and a universal JAR, it focuses on being lightweight, scriptable and automatable. Ideal for terminal-oriented users, server environments, or workflows that require integrating game launch processes into scripts without a GUI.

metadata.name: LAVFilters
metadata.description: LAV Filters - Open-Source DirectShow Media Splitter and Decoders

summary.zh: LAV Filters 是基于 FFmpeg（libavformat/libavcodec）的 DirectShow 过滤器集合，提供媒体分离器与音视频解码器，支持 MKV/MP4/TS/Blu‑ray 等容器，具备按语言优先的音轨选择、四种字幕自动选择模式与高优先级注册，便于在 DirectShow 播放器中兼容播放几乎所有格式。
summary.en: LAV Filters is a set of FFmpeg-based (libavformat/libavcodec) DirectShow filters providing a media splitter and audio/video decoders for MKV/MP4/TS/Blu‑ray and more. It offers language-priority audio selection, four subtitle-selection modes, and high-merit registration to make its decoders preferred in DirectShow players.

metadata.name: Structura
metadata.description: This is a project to make a sort of analog to litematica for bedrock

summary.zh: Structura 是为 Minecraft 基岩版实现的 Litematica 类工具，将 .mcstructure 文件转换为可安装资源包。通过修改盔甲架模型并把方块作为骨骼以“幽灵方块”渲染，提供分层逐层可视化和放置指引。支持 GUI 与命令行、跨平台运行（含 Linux 指南），便于大型建造复制、协作与资源分享，无需行为包即可在任意世界展示结构预览。
summary.en: Structura is a Litematica-like tool for Minecraft Bedrock that converts .mcstructure files into installable .mcpack resource packs. It alters armor-stand rendering so each block becomes a model bone and uses ghost blocks to visualize where to place real blocks, enabling layer-by-layer building guidance. The app provides a GUI and CLI, cross-platform support (including Linux instructions), and lets builders replicate, share, and preview large constructions without adding behavior packs, making it ideal for collaborative building and server use.

metadata.name: so-vits-svc-fork
metadata.description: so-vits-svc fork with realtime support, improved interface and more features.

summary.zh: 该仓库是 so‑vits‑svc 的分支，增加实时推理与更完善的交互界面并扩展功能，兼容 v4.0 系列模型，适用于歌声/语音变声与低延迟音频处理。提供文档与 PyPI 发布，但自 2023 年起维护有限，建议在生产或长期使用前评估更活跃的 RVC 等替代方案。
summary.en: This repository is a fork of so‑vits‑svc that adds real‑time inference, a significantly improved user interface, and additional features for singing and voice conversion. Built on the v4.x codebase with compatibility focused on v4.0 models, it supports live audio processing and low‑latency conversion workflows, and is published on PyPI with documentation. Active development has slowed and maintenance is limited; users should evaluate more actively maintained RVC-based projects or other modern voice-conversion toolchains for production use. Community forks and alternatives are listed in the README.

metadata.name: hexo-filter-mathjax
metadata.description: 💯 Server side MathJax renderer plugin for Hexo.

summary.zh: Hexo Filter MathJax 是一个在服务器端用 MathJax 渲染 LaTeX 公式的 Hexo 插件，无需前端脚本。支持单美元内联、扩展包与可选 CSS 注入，按文章 front-matter 启用。推荐与 Pandoc 配合以避免 Markdown/TeX 冲突，适合需要在静态博客或文档中生成高质量数学公式的场景。
summary.en: Hexo Filter MathJax is a Hexo plugin that renders LaTeX with MathJax on the server side, removing the need for front-end math scripts. It supports single-dollar inline delimiters, package/extension options, optional CSS injection, and per-post activation via front-matter. Recommended with Pandoc to avoid Markdown/TeX conflicts; ideal for static blogs and documentation requiring high-quality math rendering.

metadata.name: VisualNovelUpscaler
metadata.description: 一键将视觉小说/Galgame以高分辨率重制，现已支持Kirikiri2/Z及Artemis引擎

summary.zh: Visual Novel Upscaler 可一键将视觉小说/Galgame 资源重制为高分辨率，已支持 Kirikiri2/Z 与 Artemis 引擎。工具整合多种神经网络超分后端（waifu2x-ncnn-vulkan、Real-CUGAN、Real-ESRGAN、SRMD、RealSR、Anime4KCPP），并兼容游戏资源解析与编解码工具（tlg2png/png2tlg、FreeMote、AlphaMovieDecoder/Encoder、FFmpeg），通过 PySide6 桌面界面按输入/输出目录批量处理。使用前需拆包游戏并将程序放在纯英文路径。
summary.en: Visual Novel Upscaler automates remastering of visual novels/Galgame assets to higher resolutions, currently supporting Kirikiri2/Z and Artemis engines. It orchestrates multiple neural upscaling backends (waifu2x-ncnn-vulkan, Real-CUGAN, Real-ESRGAN, SRMD, RealSR, Anime4KCPP) alongside resource parsers and encoders (tlg2png/png2tlg, FreeMote, AlphaMovieDecoder/Encoder, FFmpeg) to process sprites and alpha movies. A PySide6 desktop GUI enables batch processing by pointing to unpacked game folders and an output directory; the program should reside in an ASCII-only path. Suitable for fan remasters, preservation, and asset enhancement workflows.

metadata.name: CS_CCME_Posts
metadata.description: 公众号推送备份

summary.zh: 本仓库备份并整理了微信公众号（CS_CCME）的推送文章，按资源列表（rsrc.md）以 Markdown 格式存档，便于离线阅读、检索与长期归档，适合知识管理、迁移与引用。
summary.en: Archives CS_CCME WeChat posts as Markdown (rsrc.md), enabling offline reading, search and archival.

metadata.name: MaterialBinTool
metadata.description: MCBE RenderDragon着色器解包/打包/编译工具

summary.zh: MaterialBinTool 是一款 Java 命令行工具，用于解包、打包与编译 Minecraft Bedrock（RenderDragon）的 .material.bin 着色器包。它支持 ESSL/Direct3D/Metal/Vulkan 平台、集成 bgfx shaderc、支持 defines.json 自定义宏、Variant 标记注释与多平台 JSON 合并，便于跨平台重建、调试与集成着色器资源到模组或构建流水线中。
summary.en: MaterialBinTool is a Java CLI utility for unpacking, repacking and compiling RenderDragon .material.bin shader packages used in Minecraft Bedrock. It extracts material data to JSON, integrates with bgfx shaderc to compile sc/glsl sources for ESSL, Direct3D, Metal and Vulkan targets, supports defines.json for custom macros, variant flag handling, raw shader output, multi-platform JSON merging and threaded compilation, facilitating cross-platform shader rebuilding, debugging and asset-pipeline integration.

metadata.name: rust-by-example-cn
metadata.description: Rust By Example 中文版(包含在线代码编辑器)

summary.zh: 《通过例子学 Rust》中文完整翻译，集成在线代码编辑器与中英切换。基于 mdBook 提供可运行示例与教学导向内容，便于学习 Rust 语法与实践、支持本地离线构建与社区贡献，采用 MIT/Apache 双重许可证。
summary.en: Chinese translation of Rust By Example with an integrated online editor and bilingual toggle. mdBook-based, it supplies runnable examples for learning Rust syntax and practical patterns, supports local offline builds and community contributions under a dual MIT/Apache license.

metadata.name: live2d-widget
metadata.description: 把萌萌哒的看板娘抱回家 (ノ≧∇≦)ノ | Live2D widget for web platform

summary.zh: Live2D Widget 是用 TypeScript 开发的轻量级前端组件，便于将 Live2D 看板娘嵌入网页。仅依赖 Live2D Cubism Core，支持按需动态加载不同 Cubism 版本、通过 CDN 或自托管提供模型。提供 initWidget 可配置项、工具按钮、拖拽与提示规则，适合集成到静态站点、博客或任意网页以增强交互与趣味性。
summary.en: Live2D Widget is a lightweight TypeScript web component to embed Live2D mascots into sites. It depends only on the Live2D Cubism core and supports dynamic loading of Cubism versions, CDN or self-hosted model assets. Configurable via initWidget, it offers tool buttons, drag support and customizable tips, making it easy to integrate into static sites, blogs or any webpage to add interactive, decorative mascots.

metadata.name: RLE-wiki
metadata.description: RLE.wiki is a free, open, and continuously updated transgender real-life-experience site.

summary.zh: RLE.wiki 是 Project Trans 发起的开源跨性别现实生活体验（RLE）指南站点，面向 MtF、FtM、酷儿及其他性别多元群体，汇集实用指引、资源与个体经验，内容持续更新并采用 CC BY-SA 4.0 许可。项目以 VitePress 构建、部署于 Cloudflare Pages，使用 vitepress-theme-project-trans 作为主题并鼓励社区协作与贡献，同时在部署上说明了可复现性的注意事项。
summary.en: RLE.wiki is an open, community-driven site by Project Trans that collects real-life experience (RLE) guidance for transgender and gender-diverse people, including MtF, FtM, and queer identities. It provides practical RLE advice, resource links, and personal experience contributions under a CC BY-SA 4.0 license. Built with VitePress and deployed on Cloudflare Pages, the site uses the vitepress-theme-project-trans package for theme and previewing. Content is continuously updated; community contributions, issue reports, and discussions via GitHub or email are encouraged. Deployment notes cover reproducibility caveats.

metadata.name: pacvis
metadata.description: Visualize pacman local database using Vis.js, inspired by pacgraph.

summary.zh: pacvis 使用 Vis.js 在浏览器中可视化 Arch/pacman 本地包数据库，绘制包依赖图并标注可选依赖与可移除大小，支持按名搜索并以本地服务形式运行（可通过 AUR 或 pip 安装）。采用 pyalpm 解析依赖，改造过 vis.js 以提升可伸缩性，但超过 ~2000 包时布局仍较慢。
summary.en: pacvis visualizes a pacman local database in-browser using Vis.js, rendering package dependency graphs with optdepends and removable-size estimates. It resolves dependencies via pyalpm, supports name search and runs as a local web service (installable via AUR or pip). A modified vis.js improves scalability, though layout becomes slow beyond ~2000 packages.

metadata.name: hexo-theme-fluid
metadata.description: :ocean: 一款 Material Design 风格的 Hexo 主题 / An elegant Material-Design theme for Hexo

summary.zh: Fluid 是一款基于 Hexo 的 Material Design 风格主题，提供响应式布局、暗色模式、多种代码高亮、LaTeX 与 mermaid 支持、页面组件懒加载、内置评论、访问统计与本地搜索等功能。通过 npm 或 release 安装，文档详尽并支持多语言与插件集成，适合用于构建现代化静态博客、个人站与项目文档，便于定制与扩展。
summary.en: Fluid is an elegant Material Design theme for Hexo focused on building modern static blogs and documentation sites. It delivers responsive layouts, dark mode, multiple code highlighting options, LaTeX math rendering and Mermaid diagrams, lazy-loaded components, built-in comments, traffic statistics and local search. Installable via npm or release package, it supports Hexo >=5 and Node >=10.13, offers comprehensive documentation, multi-language support and plugin integrations. Ideal for developers and content creators seeking a customizable, performance-oriented Hexo theme with rich multimedia features.

metadata.name: learn-regex
metadata.description: Learn regex the easy way

summary.zh: Learn Regex 是面向开发者的实用正则表达式教程，系统覆盖元字符、字符集合、量词、捕获/非捕获分组、环视、锚点、标志与贪婪/惰性匹配等概念。仓库提供在线测试示例、多语言翻译与可下载 PDF，便于用于表单校验、文本提取、替换与复杂模式匹配的学习与实践。
summary.en: Learn Regex is a practical, developer-focused guide to regular expressions that walks through fundamentals and advanced topics: metacharacters, character classes, quantifiers, capturing and non-capturing groups, lookarounds, anchors, flags, and greedy vs. lazy matching. The repository includes hands-on links to online testers, illustrated examples, a downloadable PDF, and many community translations. It's designed for engineers who need reliable pattern matching for form validation, text extraction, data cleanup, and search-and-replace tasks, making regex concepts approachable and immediately applicable across languages and tools.

metadata.name: Aria2-Trackers
metadata.description: 自动获取tracker文件并转换为Aria2可用格式

summary.zh: Aria2-Trackers 自动从多个源抓取并将 tracker 列表转换成 Aria2 可用格式，改用 jsDelivr CDN 提升国内访问并支持 XIU2/TrackersListCollection 数据源，可与 docker-aria2 联动自动更新，有效提升 BT/磁力下载速度与连接成功率。
summary.en: Aria2-Trackers automatically fetches tracker lists from multiple sources and converts them into Aria2-compatible format. It uses jsDelivr CDN for faster domestic access, supports XIU2/TrackersListCollection, and can auto-update (e.g. with docker-aria2) to improve BitTorrent/magnet download speed and connectivity.

metadata.name: HMCL
metadata.description: A Minecraft Launcher which is multi-functional, cross-platform and popular

summary.zh: HMCL 是开源且社区驱动的跨平台 Minecraft 启动器，支持模组管理、模组加载器安装（如 Forge、Fabric、Quilt、OptiFine 等）、模组包创建与界面定制。兼容 Windows、macOS、Linux、FreeBSD 及多种 CPU 架构（x86/ARM/RISC-V/MIPS/LoongArch），提供源码构建说明、多渠道发布与贡献流程，适合需要自定义启动与扩展生态的玩家与 MOD 开发者。
summary.en: Hello Minecraft! Launcher (HMCL) is an open-source, community-driven, cross-platform Minecraft launcher that provides mod management, modloader installation (Forge, Fabric, Quilt, OptiFine, etc.), modpack creation, and UI customization. It runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, FreeBSD and supports multiple CPU architectures (x86, ARM, RISC-V, MIPS, LoongArch). HMCL offers source build instructions, multi-channel releases, and contribution guidelines, making it suitable for players and mod developers who need a customizable, extensible launcher and robust cross-platform support.

metadata.name: favorite
metadata.description: 东方本命角色测试

summary.zh: 基于前端静态站点的“东方本命角色”在线测试，通过问卷式交互为用户匹配最合适的东方角色并展示结果。源码托管于 GitHub，提供主站与 GitHub Pages 分站，使用 Travis CI 自动化构建，易于部署与二次定制，适合二次元社群分享、爱好者测评与简单前端练手项目。
summary.en: A client-side static web quiz that matches users to their preferred Touhou (东方) character via a questionnaire and displays results. The source is hosted on GitHub with both a main site and a faster-updating GitHub Pages mirror, and uses Travis CI for automated builds. It's a lightweight HTML/CSS/JavaScript project aimed at fandom sharing, quick deployment, and easy forking/customization—suitable for community quizzes, personal sites, or front-end practice.

metadata.name: Waifu2x-Extension-GUI
metadata.description: Video, Image and GIF upscale/enlarge(Super-Resolution) and Video frame interpolation. Achieved with Waifu2x,  Real-ESRGAN, Real-CUGAN, RTX Video Super Resolution VSR, SRMD, RealSR, Anime4K, RIFE, IFRNet, CAIN, DAIN,  and ACNet.

summary.zh: Waifu2x-Extension-GUI 是一款 Windows 可移植桌面工具，集成 Waifu2x、Real-ESRGAN、Real-CUGAN、RTX VSR、SRMD、Anime4K 与 RIFE/CAIN/DAIN 等多种深度学习超分与插帧引擎。支持图像/GIF/视频批量处理、多 GPU 与 AMD/NVIDIA/Intel 加速，提供一键预设与细粒度参数、视频帧分析与自动智能调优，便于对二次元与实拍素材进行高质量放大、去噪与帧插补的工作流自动化。
summary.en: Waifu2x-Extension-GUI is a portable Windows desktop application that aggregates multiple deep-learning super-resolution and frame-interpolation engines (Waifu2x, Real-ESRGAN, Real-CUGAN, RTX VSR, SRMD, RealSR, Anime4K, RIFE, CAIN, DAIN, IFRNet). It handles images, animated GIFs/APNG/WebP and videos with batch processing, multi-GPU support and AMD/NVIDIA/Intel acceleration via NCNN-Vulkan and CUDA backends. The GUI offers one-click presets, per-engine granular settings, video frame analysis and smart automatic tuning, making it suitable for both anime and real-world footage enhancement, large-scale upscaling and automated frame interpolation workflows.

metadata.name: YesPlayMusic
metadata.description: 高颜值的第三方网易云播放器，支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron:

summary.zh: YesPlayMusic 是基于 Vue + Electron 的高颜值跨平台第三方网易云音乐播放器，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux，提供歌词、MV、私人 FM、音乐云盘、Last.fm 打点、MPRIS、Touch Bar、全局快捷键与 PWA 支持。可集成 UnblockNeteaseMusic 替换灰色/缺失音源，提供原生安装包并支持在 Vercel 或自托管部署。项目已发布 2.0 Alpha，现进入维护模式。
summary.en: YesPlayMusic is a polished third‑party NetEase Cloud Music client built with Vue.js and Electron, running on Windows, macOS and Linux. It delivers MV playback, lyric display, Private FM, cloud storage, Last.fm scrobbling, MPRIS, Touch Bar, custom/global shortcuts and PWA support. It can integrate UnblockNeteaseMusic to replace unavailable sources (YouTube requires yt-dlp). Native installers are provided and the app can be deployed on Vercel or self-hosted with NeteaseCloudMusicApi. The repo ships a 2.0 Alpha and is now in maintenance mode.

metadata.name: explorerTool
metadata.description: Custom Windows Explorer background image

summary.zh: ExplorerBgTool 是针对 Windows 10/11 的桌面工具，通过注册 Shell 扩展为文件资源管理器设置自定义背景，支持多图随机、调节透明度与显示位置、为指定路径单独配置并可应用于文件对话框。提供一键注册/卸载脚本与 config.ini 实时生效设置，支持 png/jpg；遇到兼容问题可按 ESC 启动或卸载，适合追求资源管理器个性化的用户。
summary.en: ExplorerBgTool is a Windows 10/11 desktop utility that installs a shell-extension DLL to add custom background images to File Explorer. It supports random switching among multiple images, per-path custom backgrounds, adjustable image position and alpha, and optional application inside file-open dialogs. Installation and removal are handled via provided register/unregister scripts or regsvr32; appearance is configurable through config.ini and takes effect immediately. Supports PNG/JPG (invalid files may crash Explorer; use ESC to open without images). Ideal for users who want to personalize Explorer visuals.

metadata.name: Magpie
metadata.description: A general-purpose window upscaler for Windows 10/11.

summary.zh: Magpie 是一款轻量级 Windows 窗口放大器，支持全屏与窗口级实时缩放，集成 Anime4K、FidelityFX FSR、CRT 等高效重采样与滤镜，基于 WinUI 提供暗/亮主题与多显示器支持，并依赖 DirectX11 加速。适用于旧游戏与低分辨率应用的画质增强，提供内置效果、可本地化界面与编译文档，便于二次开发与自定义实时放大策略。
summary.en: Magpie is a lightweight window upscaler for Windows 10/11 that provides real-time per-window scaling in both fullscreen and windowed modes. It bundles multiple efficient algorithms and filters (Anime4K, FidelityFX FSR, CRT shaders, and more), runs on DirectX11, and exposes a WinUI-based interface with light/dark themes and multi-monitor support. Aimed at enhancing low-resolution games and legacy applications, Magpie offers built-in effects, localization, build guidance, and open-source extensibility for developers to customize realtime upscaling workflows.

metadata.name: WDControl
metadata.description: Windows Defender 状态设置工具

summary.zh: WDControl 是一款针对 Windows Defender 状态的轻量命令行工具，可在启用“篡改保护”的系统上无破坏地禁用、启用或移除 Defender。适用于系统封装、运维、测试与自动化部署场景，解决注册表/组策略在新版 Windows 上失效的问题，避免第三方工具导致的注册表丢失，操作可回退并通过简洁开关便于脚本化管理。请谨慎在移除后安装替代防护软件。
summary.en: WDControl is a lightweight command-line utility for managing Windows Defender state on systems where 'Tamper Protection' prevents registry or Group Policy changes. It can disable, enable, or remove Defender non-destructively, providing reversible actions and simple switches (/Disable, /Enable, /KillWD) for imaging, IT maintenance, and testing workflows. The tool avoids registry loss and system-file damage seen with some third-party methods, addressing shortcomings of registry hacks and group policy approaches—use caution when performing removal and install alternative protection afterwards.

metadata.name: lshort-zh-cn
metadata.description: A Chi­nese edi­tion of the Not So Short Introduction to LaTeX2ε

summary.zh: 《Not So Short Introduction to LaTeX2ε》中文译本，包含完整源文件、样式与构建脚本。基于 XeLaTeX/CTeX/xeCJK，提供 Makefile、latexmkrc 与 Windows 批处理，便于生成中文版 PDF，适合学习 LaTeX 基础与中文排版实践与参考。
summary.en: Chinese edition of 'The Not So Short Introduction to LaTeX2ε' including full sources, styles and build scripts. Built around XeLaTeX/CTeX/xeCJK and providing Makefile, latexmkrc and Windows batch files to produce the Chinese PDF. Suitable as a practical LaTeX tutorial and Chinese typesetting reference.

metadata.name: OnStep
metadata.description: Arduino telescope goto for equatorial and alt/az mounts

summary.zh: OnStep 是基于 Arduino/Teensy 的开源望远镜 GoTo 控制器，支持赤道仪与经纬台（含 Dobsonian），驱动步进电机，提供 USB/蓝牙/ESP8266 Wi‑Fi/以太网等多种连接，兼容 LX200、ASCOM 与 INDI，含内置网页与 Android 应用，便于 DIY 与天文爱好者实现自动定位与跟踪。
summary.en: OnStep is an open-source Arduino/Teensy-based telescope GoTo controller for equatorial and alt-az mounts (including Dobsonians). It drives stepper motors and offers flexible command channels—USB, Bluetooth, ESP8266 Wi‑Fi, Ethernet or serial—plus a built-in web interface and Android app. OnStep speaks LX200 and supports ASCOM and INDI drivers, enabling control from planetarium software. Designed for DIY builders and serious amateur astronomers, its modular firmware accommodates various mount geometries and hardware interfaces, providing reliable automated pointing, tracking and integration under a GPL license.

metadata.name: WorldEdit-BE
metadata.description: WorldEdit-BE-LL

summary.zh: WorldEdit-BE 是面向 Minecraft Bedrock Edition 的开源 WorldEdit 移植与地图编辑工具，提供方块区域选择、复制/粘贴、结构保存与批量替换等功能，便于服务器管理与地图制作。仓库附带使用说明与 wiki 文档，面向服主与地图作者快速改造与部署地形结构。
summary.en: WorldEdit-BE is an open-source WorldEdit port for Minecraft Bedrock Edition, providing region selection, copy/paste, schematic save and batch block-edit features. It helps server admins and map makers rapidly modify and deploy terrain and structures; repository includes documentation and a wiki.

summary.zh: 基于Qt的轻量级跨平台课程表桌面程序，实时显示当前/下一节课与倒计时，支持CSV导入、自定义文字/字体/颜色与背景图。带托盘菜单、置顶与可移动窗口，配置以UTF‑8 JSON保存，兼容Qt5/Qt6，适合作为教室黑板替代或个人课表提醒，强调易用性与可扩展性。
summary.en: TimeTable-Qt is a lightweight Qt-based desktop timetable application for classrooms or personal desktops. It shows real-time current and next class info, precise countdowns, and customizable text formats, fonts, colors, and background images. Lessons import from CSV (UTF-8) and configuration is JSON-driven. Features include tray menu, top-most and movable windows, optional Windows 11 acrylic effect, per-element FPS and UI layout control, and builds for both Qt5 and Qt6. Designed for simplicity, low resource use and extensibility as a blackboard replacement or schedule notifier.

metadata.name: CMWTAT_Digital_Edition
metadata.description: CloudMoe Windows 10/11 Activation Toolkit get digital license, the best open source Win 10/11 activator in GitHub. GitHub 上最棒的开源 Win10/Win11 数字权利（数字许可证）激活工具！

summary.zh: CloudMoe Windows 激活工具（Digital Edition）是用 C# 编写的开源桌面程序，通过数字权利为 Windows 10/11 提供激活支持。项目包含图形界面与中英文说明，适合系统管理员或高级用户在合规场景下绑定或恢复数字许可证。源码采用 GPL‑2.0 许可，便于审计、整合与二次开发，侧重透明性与可扩展性。
summary.en: CloudMoe Windows 10/11 Activation Toolkit (Digital Edition) is an open-source C# desktop utility that helps apply digital license (digital entitlement) activation for Windows 10 and Windows 11. It provides a graphical user interface and bilingual documentation (English and Chinese), making it suitable for system administrators and advanced users who need to bind or restore digital licenses in compliant scenarios. The project is released under GPL‑2.0, enabling code inspection and modification for auditing or integration. It focuses on transparency and extensibility rather than circumvention.

metadata.name: LeviLamina
metadata.description: A lightweight, modular and versatile mod loader for Minecraft Bedrock Edition, formerly known as LiteLoaderBDS

summary.zh: LeviLamina 是一款为 Minecraft Bedrock 提供的轻量级模块化模组加载器（前身 LiteLoaderBDS）。它暴露完整的 C++ API、实用接口与强大的事件系统，支持服务器与客户端部署，便于快速开发与扩展游戏玩法。项目提供详尽文档、安装指南与使用/EULA 指引，并有活跃社区支持，是面向 C++ 开发者的稳定、高性能模组开发基础。
summary.en: LeviLamina is a lightweight, modular, and extensible mod loader for Minecraft Bedrock Edition (formerly LiteLoaderBDS). It provides a comprehensive C++ API, utility interfaces, and a robust event system to streamline creation of gameplay extensions and custom mods. Suitable for both server and client deployment, LeviLamina emphasizes developer productivity with a flexible plugin architecture, thorough documentation, installation guides, and EULA/usage guidance. Backed by an active community and LGPL components, it offers a stable, high-performance foundation for C++ modders targeting Bedrock servers and clients.

metadata.name: Luma3DS
metadata.description: Nintendo 3DS "Custom Firmware"

summary.zh: Luma3DS 是面向 Nintendo 3DS 系列的开源自定义固件，重写并补丁系统以延长主机寿命并增强功能。主要提供一流的 homebrew 支持、Rosalina 覆盖菜单（截图、屏幕滤镜、输入重定向、作弊、NTP 同步）、LayeredFS 资源重定向、每游戏语言覆盖与 3GX 插件、可替换系统模块、完整的 GDB 调试桩以及链式启动，适用于游戏模组开发、逆向工程与长期维护。需要 boot9strap 安装。
summary.en: Luma3DS is an open-source custom firmware for the Nintendo 3DS family that patches and reimplements large parts of the system software to extend the platform beyond its end-of-life. It delivers first-class homebrew support, the Rosalina overlay (screenshots, blue-light and other filters, input redirection for external controllers, cheats, NTP time sync), LayeredFS for asset redirection, per-game language overrides, 3GX plugins, system module replacement, a full GDB stub for debugging and reverse engineering, and a chainloader for other firmware payloads. Requires boot9strap; aimed at modders, homebrew developers and preservationists.

metadata.name: Ventoy
metadata.description: A new bootable USB solution.

summary.zh: Ventoy是开源的可启动U盘解决方案，无需反复格式化，只需拷贝ISO/WIM/IMG/VHD(x)/EFI镜像到U盘即可引导并在启动时选择。支持Legacy BIOS及多种UEFI架构（x86/x86_64/ARM64/MIPS64）与MBR/GPT分区，已测试1300+镜像并广泛兼容Windows与各类Linux发行版，适用于系统安装、部署、维护与应急恢复场景。
summary.en: Ventoy is an open-source bootable USB solution that lets you boot ISO/WIM/IMG/VHD(x)/EFI files simply by copying them to a USB drive—no repeated reformatting. It supports Legacy BIOS and multiple UEFI architectures (x86, x86_64, ARM64, MIPS64) as well as MBR and GPT partition styles. Ventoy presents a boot menu for multiple images, supports browsing local images, and is tested with 1300+ ISOs covering most Linux distributions, Windows and rescue tools—ideal for installation, deployment, maintenance and recovery workflows.

metadata.name: BedrockConnect
metadata.description: Join any Minecraft Bedrock Edition server IP on Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and PS4/PS5

summary.zh: BedrockConnect 是开源且轻量的 Minecraft 基岩版 中介服务，利用 DNS 重定向与简易 Web 界面，让 Switch、Xbox 与 PlayStation 玩家在游戏内加入并管理任意第三方服务器。无需额外客户端或商店下载，几分钟即可部署，适合社区服务器目录与个人自托管，弥补主机端缺乏第三方服务器列表的限制。
summary.en: BedrockConnect is an open-source, lightweight service enabling players on Nintendo Switch, Xbox and PlayStation to join any Minecraft: Bedrock Edition server via a server-list web interface and DNS redirection. It exposes third‑party servers through redirect-compatible featured servers so consoles can add and manage saved servers in-game without installing additional apps. The project focuses on minimal deployment and quick setup (minutes), ideal for community server directories and self-hosted Bedrock servers with minimal infrastructure.

metadata.name: WebGAL
metadata.description: A brand new web Visual Novel engine | 全新的网页端视觉小说引擎

summary.zh: WebGAL 是一款面向浏览器的开源视觉小说引擎，提供美观的 GUI、脚本体系与可视化编辑器，让创作者无需网页开发技能即可快速构建交互剧情。引擎兼容 Pixi.js，可扩展自定义渲染与特效，附带示例、调试工具、VS Code 语法插件与完善文档，并支持 Live2D 等社区扩展。采用 MPL-2.0 许可，适合独立游戏、互动小说与网页发布的跨平台创作与部署。
summary.en: WebGAL is an open-source, browser-native visual novel engine combining a polished GUI, a script language and a visual editor so creators can build interactive stories without web-development skills. It integrates with Pixi.js for custom rendering and effects, and ships with demos, debugging tools, a VS Code script plugin and documentation. Community extensions (Live2D, language tooling) and an example Steam title demonstrate its production readiness. Licensed under MPL-2.0, WebGAL targets indie developers and narrative designers for rapid, cross-platform web deployment of visual novels.
tags_zh: 可视化编辑器/无代码创作

metadata.name: mobile-export
metadata.description: Enables Minecraft world exporting on mobile.

summary.zh: 面向移动端的 Minecraft 世界导出工具，读取并打包游戏存档以便备份、迁移与分享，便于集成到启动器或备份应用，并处理移动文件访问与权限问题。
summary.en: A mobile tool to export Minecraft worlds by reading and packaging world saves for backup, transfer, and sharing; suitable for integration with launchers or backup apps and handling mobile file access.

summary.zh: SlimeChunkFinder 是用 Rust 编写的高性能 Minecraft BE 工具，可在数分钟内遍历数十亿区块以定位多连史莱姆区块。支持任意形状与不同刷怪半径的模拟搜索，便于服务器运维、地图规划与种子分析。使用需安装 Rust，按需修改 main 中参数后以 cargo run --release 编译运行。
summary.en: SlimeChunkFinder is a high-performance Rust command-line tool for Minecraft Bedrock Edition that locates multi-slime spawning chunks across massive areas. It can scan billions of chunks—reportedly over 3.5 billion on a high-end CPU—completing comprehensive border searches in minutes. The tool supports arbitrary-shaped query regions and configurable mob spawn radii to emulate different spawn ranges. It's aimed at server operators, seed analysts and map planners who need deterministic slime-chunk detection at scale. Build requires Rust; tweak parameters in main and run cargo run --release.

metadata.name: kirikiroid2
metadata.description: kirikiroid2资源整理

summary.zh: kirikiroid2资源整理，聚焦 Kirikiroid2（KiriKiri 引擎的 Android 移植）相关素材、补丁、配置与工具脚本，汇总安装教程与兼容性说明并给出常见问题修复示例，便于运行、调试与二次打包。面向玩家、移植者与维护者，帮助快速定位所需文件、进行资产转换与兼容性处理，降低移植与部署门槛，作为实用参考中心。
summary.en: This repository organizes resources for Kirikiroid2, the Android port of the KiriKiri visual-novel engine. It aggregates game assets, compatibility patches, configuration files and utility scripts, and provides installation guidance and troubleshooting examples to simplify running, debugging and repackaging KiriKiri titles on mobile. Aimed at players, porters and maintainers, the collection helps locate required files quickly, assists asset conversion and compatibility fixes, and serves as a practical reference hub for deploying and maintaining Kirikiroid2-based game packages.
